每个点数只保留第一张牌，丢弃其余重复牌
why: 3-sum 思路把内层查找转成哈希补数查询，从 O(n^3) 降到 O(n^2)。这只是加速枚举，不自动改善选择质量。
why_en: The 3-sum pattern fixes one card and uses a hash table to find complementary pairs.
whenOtherWins: 如果后续还要给每个候选做昂贵的位置级评分，枚举加速本身仍然不够。
options_en: Run DFS backtracking over all cards, exhausting the game tree to the end.
Fix one position and use a hash map to find the complementary pair among the rest.
Randomly draw three cards until they happen to hit the target sum.
Keep only the first card of each value and discard the rest.
tradeoff: 哈希补数加速枚举 vs 完整博弈树搜索的指数级开销

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种三数之和的经典模式：固定一个数，用哈希表在近似线性时间内找另外两个数的组合，把三重枚举降到平方级。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: 3-sum fixes one value and uses a hash map to find the other two in near-linear time, cutting a cubic triple-enumeration down to quadratic.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用键直接定位值的数据结构，平均下插入和查找都是 O(1)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hash map looks up or inserts a value by key in average O(1) time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 穷举式搜索：尝试一个选择、递归探索后果，行不通就撤销换下一个选择。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Backtracking is exhaustive search that tries a choice, recurses on its consequences, and undoes it to try the next option if it fails.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种从起点尽量往深处走、走不通再回退的图/树遍历算法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DFS explores as deep as possible along each branch before backing up and trying another.

optionExplanations: DFS 回溯到游戏结束是为了搜索完整走法序列，这一步只是想更快找到一个三元组，两者目标不一样。
对，固定一个数、用哈希表查另一个数是不是在场上，正是经典 3-sum 套路，把内层查找从线性扫描降到近似 O(1)。
随机抽三张牌命中目标和只是碰运气，没有稳定的复杂度保证，不算算法模式。
只保留每个点数的第一张牌会直接丢失重复值信息，导致原本能凑出的合法三元组被漏掉。
optionExplanations_en: DFS backtracking to the end of the game searches full move sequences — this step only needs to find one triple faster, a different goal.
Right — fixing one value and hashing to check whether its complement is on the board is the classic 3-sum trick, cutting the inner lookup to near O(1).
Randomly drawing three cards and hoping to hit the target has no reliable complexity bound — it isn't really an algorithmic pattern.
Keeping only the first card per value throws away duplicate-value information, so legal triples that need repeats get missed.

q: 填空：3-sum 枚举把三元组查找从 {{O(n^3)}} 降到 {{O(n^2)}} 每次调用。
q_en: Fill in: 3-sum enumeration reduces triple search from {{O(n^3)}} to {{O(n^2)}} per call.
text: 3-sum 枚举把三元组查找从 {{O(n^3)}} 降到 {{O(n^2)}} 每次调用。
why: 哈希表让第三个值的查找接近常数时间，内层复杂度从线性扫描降为常数，总复杂度从三重降为二重；瓶颈很快转移到「给每个候选打分」这一步。
why_en: A hash map makes finding the third value near-constant time, so total complexity drops from cubic to quadratic, and the bottleneck shifts to scoring each candidate.
scenario: 把朴素三重枚举换成 3-sum 式的哈希查找，比较两者单次调用的时间复杂度。
scenario_en: Replace naive triple enumeration with a 3-sum-style hash lookup and compare the per-call time complexity.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种三数之和的经典模式：固定一个数，用哈希表在近似线性时间内找另外两个数的组合，把三重枚举降到平方级。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: 3-sum fixes one value and uses a hash map to find the other two in near-linear time, cutting a cubic triple-enumeration down to quadratic.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用键直接定位值的数据结构，平均下插入和查找都是 O(1)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hash map looks up or inserts a value by key in average O(1) time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 描述算法运行时间或空间随输入规模 n 增长的上界，例如 O(n^3) 表示操作数大致按 n 的三次方增长。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Big-O notation describes the upper-bound growth rate of an algorithm's time or space as input size n grows, so O(n^3) means the work grows roughly as the cube of n.

scenario: 你已经能枚举所有合法三元组，并想选择更不容易把后续局面堵死的一组。
scenario_en: You can already enumerate every legal triple, and now you want to choose the one least likely to block future moves.
q: 第二版用什么评分思想避免选坏三元组？
q_en: What scoring idea does version two use to avoid bad triples?
options: 选位置编号最小的那个合法三元组
只挑点数最大的三张牌，凑够目标和就行
模拟移除该三元组后，统计剩余网格还能形成多少个三元组
永远优先选包含「目标和的一半」这个点数的牌
why: 一层 lookahead 用“移除后选择空间有多大”衡量当前移动好坏。结构上正确，但位置空间实现太慢。
why_en: One-step lookahead scores a move by how many triples remain after removing it.
whenOtherWins: 如果运行时间极紧且只需通过小测试，不评分的 first-found 更短更简单。
diagram:
flowchart TD
  Moves[Legal triples] --> Sim[Remove one triple]
  Sim --> Count[Count remaining triples]
  Count --> Rank[Pick highest score]
options_en: Pick the legal triple with the smallest position index.
Just pick the three highest-value cards that still sum to the target.
Simulate removing the triple and count how many triples the remaining grid can still form.
Always prefer a triple that includes a card worth half the target sum.
tradeoff: 评估移除后剩余选择空间 vs 只看当前这一步是否合法

termDefinitions.meaning: 在真正执行一个候选移动前，先模拟它的后果并打分，用来比较哪个候选更好。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Lookahead simulates a candidate move's consequences and scores it before committing, so candidates can be compared.

optionExplanations: 选位置编号最小的三元组只是决定性的 tie-break 顺序，跟这个三元组本身好不好没有关系。
只挑点数最大的三张牌是一种简单启发式，但没有模拟后果，仍可能孤立掉别的关键牌。
对，先假装移除这个三元组，再数剩余局面还剩几个三元组，剩得越多说明这步棋对后续越友好。
偏爱包含「目标和一半」点数的牌只是碰巧对某些目标和有效的猜测，不是通用评分规则。
optionExplanations_en: Picking the smallest position index is just a deterministic tie-break rule — it says nothing about whether that triple is actually a good pick.
Grabbing the three highest-value cards is a naive heuristic that never simulates consequences, so it can still strand other key cards.
Right — simulate removing the triple, then count how many triples the remaining board still supports; more remaining means a friendlier future position.
Favoring a value equal to half the target sum is a lucky guess that only works for certain target sums, not a general scoring rule.

q: 为什么 3-sum 加位置级 lookahead 会超时？
q_en: Why does 3-sum plus position-level lookahead time out?
options: 哈希表这种数据结构本身无法用来存储整数值
所有候选三元组排序时使用的键并不稳定
目标和 39 定得太小，导致几乎凑不出候选三元组
每个候选移除后都要在近百个位置上重新统计三元组
why: 满棋盘约有 2500 个合法候选，每个候选再做 O(n^2) 统计。真正的瓶颈是候选评分循环。
why_en: The positional lookahead times out because every candidate triggers another large positional enumeration.
options_en: A hash map as a data structure simply cannot store integer values.
The sort key used to order all candidate triples is unstable.
Target sum 39 is set too small, so almost no candidate triples exist.
Removing each candidate forces a fresh triple count over nearly a hundred positions.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用键直接定位值的数据结构，平均下插入和查找都是 O(1)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hash map looks up or inserts a value by key in average O(1) time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 游戏引擎里固定的常量，三张牌的点数必须加起来等于它，一局游戏内它不会改变。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TARGET_SUM is the engine's fixed constant that three card values must sum to, and it never changes mid-game.

optionExplanations: 错，哈希表存整数是最基本的用法，这不是瓶颈所在。
错，排序键是否稳定只影响并列结果的顺序，不会造成超时。
错，目标和 39 在 25 个点数值域下候选相当充足，约 2500 个候选正说明并不稀缺。
对，问题不在找候选，而在每个候选都要在近百个位置上重新扫一遍统计三元组，候选数乘以这个成本才是真正的瓶颈。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — storing integers in a hash map is the most basic use case; that's not where the cost comes from.
Wrong — sort-key stability only affects tie-break order; it can't cause a timeout on its own.
Wrong — target sum 39 still leaves plenty of candidates in a 25-value domain; about 2,500 candidates shows it isn't scarce.
Right — the cost isn't finding candidates, it's rescoring each one over nearly a hundred positions; multiplying that by candidate count is the real bottleneck.

q: 填空：满 10x10 局面大约有 {{2500}} 个合法三元组，每个评分约 {{4700}} 次配对检查，单回合约 {{11.75 million}} 次操作。
q_en: Fill in: a full 10x10 board has about {{2500}} legal triples; each score costs about {{4700}} pair checks, or about {{11.75 million}} operations per turn.
text: 满 10x10 局面大约有 {{2500}} 个合法三元组，每个评分约 {{4700}} 次配对检查，单回合约 {{11.75 million}} 次操作。
why: 约 2500 个候选 × 约 4700 次配对检查 ≈ 1175 万次操作；这个数字后续要乘以 33 回合和 30 次测试，用来判断这套评分方案能不能在时限内跑完。
why_en: About 2,500 candidates times roughly 4,700 pairwise checks gives ~11.75 million operations per turn, the figure later multiplied by 33 turns and 30 trials to test whether this scoring approach can finish in time.
scenario: 3-sum 找到约 2500 个候选三元组后，每个候选都要模拟移除、在剩余局面上重新统计一遍三元组来打分；你要估算单回合的总操作量。
scenario_en: After 3-sum finds about 2500 candidate triples, each candidate is simulated and the remaining board is rescored; estimate the total work for one turn.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种三数之和的经典模式：固定一个数，用哈希表在近似线性时间内找另外两个数的组合，把三重枚举降到平方级。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: 3-sum fixes one value and uses a hash map to find the other two in near-linear time, cutting a cubic triple-enumeration down to quadratic.

q: 3-sum 枚举加位置级评分的每回合复杂度为什么是 O(n^4)？
q_en: Why is 3-sum enumeration plus position-level scoring O(n^4) per turn?
options: O(n^2) 个候选乘以每个候选 O(n^2) 的重新评分
每回合都要把整个棋盘复制出 O(2^n) 份来做穷举
候选排序这一步本身的复杂度就已经是 O(n^4)
目标和检查这一步本身的复杂度就已经是 O(n^4)
why: 候选数量和候选评分都在位置空间里随 n^2 增长。相乘就是 n^4。
why_en: Quadratic candidate generation times quadratic rescoring yields quartic work per turn.
scenario: 3-sum 枚举给出 O(n^2) 个候选三元组，每个候选又要在剩余局面上做一次 O(n^2) 的重新统计。
scenario_en: 3-sum enumeration produces O(n^2) candidate triples, and each candidate runs another O(n^2) rescore on the remaining board.
options_en: O(n^2) candidates times an O(n^2) rescoring pass for each one.
Every turn copies the whole board into O(2^n) separate states for exhaustive search.
Sorting the candidates by itself already costs O(n^4).
Checking the target sum by itself already costs O(n^4).

termDefinitions.meaning: 描述算法运行时间或空间随输入规模 n 增长的上界，例如 O(n^3) 表示操作数大致按 n 的三次方增长。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Big-O notation describes the upper-bound growth rate of an algorithm's time or space as input size n grows, so O(n^3) means the work grows roughly as the cube of n.

optionExplanations: 对，候选数是 O(n^2)，每个候选重新评分又要 O(n^2)，两个二次项相乘正好得到 O(n^4)。
错，这里没有指数级的状态复制，n^4 完全是多项式增长，跟 2^n 不是一回事。
错，排序候选顶多是 O(n^2 log n)，不是复杂度的主要来源。
错，检查一次目标和只是常数时间的加法比较，不会单独产生 n^4。
optionExplanations_en: Right — O(n^2) candidates times an O(n^2) rescore each gives exactly the O(n^4) product.
Wrong — there's no exponential state copying here; n^4 is polynomial growth, nothing like 2^n.
Wrong — sorting the candidates costs at most O(n^2 log n); it isn't the dominant term.
Wrong — checking one target sum is a constant-time addition and comparison; it can't produce n^4 by itself.

q: 位置空间和点数直方图空间在这个题里的关键差异是什么？
q_en: What is the key difference between position space and value-histogram space in this problem?
options: 直方图这种表示方式根本没法表达点数重复出现多次的情况
位置空间有 100 个位置状态，直方图只压缩到 25 个点数桶
位置空间这种表示方式本身就不允许真正执行一次移动
换成直方图表示后会导致目标和的数值也跟着一起变化
why: 求和规则只看点数，同点数不同位置在评分时可以互换；直方图保留了选择质量需要的信息（点数库存），丢掉的是评分不需要的冗余位置身份。
why_en: Since the sum rule only cares about values, positions sharing a value are interchangeable for scoring, so the histogram keeps exactly what scoring needs and drops redundant positional identity.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  P[100 positions] -->|compress by value| H[25 value buckets]
  H --> Score[Fast value scoring]
  H --> Pos[Value to positions]
  Pos --> Move[Real move]
options_en: A histogram representation simply cannot express a value that repeats multiple times at all.
Position space has 100 position states; the histogram compresses that down to 25 value buckets.
Position space as a representation does not, by itself, allow actually playing a move.
Switching to a histogram representation would also change the target sum's own value.
tradeoff: 状态空间大小（100 个位置 vs 25 个点数桶） vs 是否保留位置身份信息

termDefinitions.meaning: 按值分桶计数的数组，例如 hist[8] 记录点数为 8 的牌还剩几张。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A histogram is a value-indexed count array, e.g. hist[8] tracks how many cards of value 8 remain.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把每个点数映射到拥有该点数的所有实体牌位置的列表，用来在选定点数后取回真实坐标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: pos_by_value maps each card value to the list of grid positions holding that value, used to recover real coordinates once a value triple is chosen.

optionExplanations: 直方图正是靠计数表达重复：hist[8]=3 就表示还有三张点数 8 的牌，重复值没被丢掉，只是换了记法。
对，100 个位置压成 25 个点数桶，状态规模缩到约四分之一，这也是后面评分能变快的根本原因。
位置空间本身当然能执行移动，真正的问题是它在评分阶段携带了比赛结果不需要的位置身份，拖慢重复枚举。
目标和是引擎里的固定常量，换任何表示都不会让它变化，这个选项混淆了表示和规则。
optionExplanations_en: A histogram represents duplicates exactly via counts — hist[8]=3 means three cards of value 8 remain; nothing about repeats is lost, only how it's recorded.
Right — compressing 100 positions into 25 value buckets shrinks the state to roughly a quarter of the size, exactly why scoring gets cheaper downstream.
Position space can obviously still play a move — the real issue is it carries positional identity that scoring doesn't need, which slows down repeated enumeration.
The target sum is a fixed engine constant; switching representations never changes it — this option confuses representation with rules.

scenario: 游戏评分只依赖牌的点数和数量，同点数不同花色在选择三元组时可以互换。
scenario_en: Scoring depends only on card values and counts, and cards with the same value but different suits are interchangeable when choosing triples.
q: 最合适的优化表示是什么？
q_en: What is the best optimized representation?
options: 把每个位置序列化成字符串后逐一暴力比较
按位置坐标建一张 100x100 的矩阵
按点数建计数直方图，同时保留点数到位置列表的映射
只保留牌堆最上面那一张牌的信息
why: 直方图让枚举和评分在 25 个点数桶上完成，位置列表只在真正执行移动时使用。它把问题压到必要状态。
why_en: A value histogram captures scoring structure while position lists let the final move call use actual coordinates.
whenOtherWins: 如果规则包含位置奖励、相邻约束或花色约束，纯点数直方图可能丢掉必要信息。
options_en: Serialize every position into a string and compare them pairwise by brute force.
Build a 100x100 matrix indexed by position coordinates.
Build a value-count histogram, plus a value-to-positions map for later lookup.
Keep only the information for the single top card of the deck.
tradeoff: 按点数压缩的直方图表示 vs 保留全部位置坐标的表示

termDefinitions.meaning: 按值分桶计数的数组，例如 hist[8] 记录点数为 8 的牌还剩几张。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A histogram is a value-indexed count array, e.g. hist[8] tracks how many cards of value 8 remain.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把每个点数映射到拥有该点数的所有实体牌位置的列表，用来在选定点数后取回真实坐标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: pos_by_value maps each card value to the list of grid positions holding that value, used to recover real coordinates once a value triple is chosen.

optionExplanations: 把位置序列化成字符串再逐一比较，既没有压缩状态也没有加速查找，反而比直接算点数和更慢。
100x100 矩阵是按位置对建的存储，规模和位置空间一样大，完全没解决状态过细的问题。
对，点数直方图把枚举和评分压到 25 个桶上完成，配合 pos_by_value 映射，真正执行移动时再取回具体坐标。
只保留牌堆最上面一张牌会丢掉几乎所有网格状态，连基本的三元组查找都做不了。
optionExplanations_en: Serializing positions into strings and comparing them pairwise neither compresses state nor speeds up lookup — it's slower than just summing values directly.
A 100x100 position-pair matrix is exactly as large as position space itself — it doesn't fix the over-fine-state problem at all.
Right — a value histogram runs enumeration and scoring on just 25 buckets, while the pos_by_value map recovers actual coordinates only when a move is played.
Keeping only the deck's top card discards nearly the entire grid state — you couldn't even do basic triple lookup with it.

q: 填空：优化测试中不同点数个数 V = {{25}}，值三元组枚举约检查 {{325}} 类组合。
q_en: Fill in: in the optimization test, the number of distinct values V is {{25}}, and value-triple enumeration checks about {{325}} combination classes.
text: 优化测试中不同点数个数 V = {{25}}，值三元组枚举约检查 {{325}} 类组合。
why: 不同值只有 V=25 种；两两不同值组合最多 C(25,2)=300 种，加上 25 种三值相同的情况，一共约 325 类要检查，这远小于位置级候选的规模，是后续评分变快的直接原因。
why_en: With only V=25 distinct values, there are at most C(25,2)=300 distinct-value pairs plus 25 same-value cases, about 325 patterns total — far fewer than positional candidates, which is exactly why scoring gets cheap.
scenario: 把三元组枚举从 100 个位置压缩到按点数分桶后，你要估算这个更小状态空间里要检查多少组候选点数组合。
scenario_en: After compressing triple enumeration from 100 positions into value buckets, estimate how many candidate value-combination classes the smaller state space must check.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从 n 个元素里选 k 个、不计顺序的方案数，读作「n 选 k」。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: C(n, k), read n-choose-k, counts how many unordered ways there are to pick k items from n.

q: histogram lookahead 每回合复杂度用 V 表示是哪一项？
q_en: What is the per-turn complexity of histogram lookahead in terms of V?
options: O(V)
why: 候选数量是 O(V^2)，每个候选再花 O(V^2) 重新统计，相乘就是 O(V^4)；V=25 时这个常数完全可接受。
why_en: Candidate count and rescoring cost are both O(V^2), so multiplying them gives O(V^4), which is cheap once V is only 25.
scenario: histogram lookahead 每回合要枚举 O(V^2) 个值候选，再对每个候选做一次 O(V^2) 的重新评分，V=25 是不同点数的个数。
scenario_en: Histogram lookahead enumerates O(V^2) value candidates each turn, then rescoring each candidate also costs O(V^2); V=25 is the number of distinct card values.
options_en: O(V)

termDefinitions.meaning: 描述算法运行时间或空间随输入规模 n 增长的上界，例如 O(n^3) 表示操作数大致按 n 的三次方增长。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Big-O notation describes the upper-bound growth rate of an algorithm's time or space as input size n grows, so O(n^3) means the work grows roughly as the cube of n.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在真正执行一个候选移动前，先模拟它的后果并打分，用来比较哪个候选更好。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Lookahead simulates a candidate move's consequences and scores it before committing, so candidates can be compared.

optionExplanations: 错，这只算了一层枚举，漏了候选评分那一层 O(V^2)。
错，这只是候选数量那一层，没把每个候选还要重新评分的成本乘进去。
错，指数级在这里没有依据，候选数和评分成本都是关于 V 的多项式，不是指数增长。
对，O(V^2) 个候选乘以每个候选 O(V^2) 的重新统计，正好是 O(V^4)，V=25 时这个常数很小。

tradeoff: 一层值空间评分的成本 vs 更深搜索的边际收益

termDefinitions.meaning: 在真正执行一个候选移动前，先模拟它的后果并打分，用来比较哪个候选更好。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Lookahead simulates a candidate move's consequences and scores it before committing, so candidates can be compared.

termDefinitions.meaning: 游戏引擎里固定的常量，三张牌的点数必须加起来等于它，一局游戏内它不会改变。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TARGET_SUM is the engine's fixed constant that three card values must sum to, and it never changes mid-game.

optionExplanations: 多步 lookahead 在很多博弈类题目里都是合法且常见的技巧，这里只是没必要，不代表它不合法。
一步评分靠的是直方图计数，点数重复只是让某个桶的计数大于 1，处理起来没有额外困难。
TARGET_SUM 是个固定常量，不会限制你能不能再模拟一步，模拟深度是设计选择，不是被约束卡死的。
对，1000 个种子测下来平均、最小、最大回合数都已经是 33（理论天花板），再加深搜索只是多花成本换不到收益。
optionExplanations_en: Multi-step lookahead is a legal, common technique in plenty of game-like problems — it's just unnecessary here, not disallowed.
One-step scoring runs on histogram counts; a repeated value just means one bucket's count is above 1, no extra difficulty there.
TARGET_SUM is just a fixed constant; it doesn't limit how many steps you can simulate — search depth is a design choice, not something the constraint blocks.
Right — across 1,000 seeds the average, min, and max turn counts already hit 33 (the theoretical ceiling), so going deeper only adds cost for negligible gain.

q: 直方图原地减一评分后，如果忘了加回来，会造成什么后果？
q_en: What happens if the histogram is decremented in place for scoring and never restored?
options: 后续候选会在被污染的库存计数上评分，可能选出错误的移动
程序的运行速度一定会变得更快，而且结果完全不受影响
目标和的数值会因此自动降低到不合理的地步
只会影响程序打印输出结果时的显示顺序而已
why: 原地 mutation 的收益伴随状态恢复风险。每个候选都必须从同一个当前局面出发评分。
why_en: In-place scoring is fast but only correct if every mutation is restored before the next candidate.
options_en: Later candidates get scored against a polluted count, so the solver may pick the wrong move.
The program's speed is guaranteed to improve with results completely unaffected.
The target sum's value automatically drops to an unreasonable level.
It only ever affects the display order when the program prints its output.

termDefinitions.meaning: 直接修改已有数据结构而不复制新副本，省内存分配，但要小心把状态恢复原样。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: In-place mutation edits the existing data structure directly instead of copying it, saving allocation cost but requiring careful state restoration.

optionExplanations: 对，忘了加回来会让下一个候选的计数比真实库存少，后续每个候选都在一个越来越失真的局面上被打分。
少加回一步操作不会让程序变快，反而会让计数状态跟真实局面脱节，属于纯粹的 bug，不是优化。
TARGET_SUM 是引擎常量，跟 hist 计数是否恢复完全无关，不会被这个 bug 影响。
被污染的计数会直接改变评分结果、进而改变 Solver 实际选出的三元组，影响的是行为而不只是打印顺序。
optionExplanations_en: Right — forgetting to restore leaves the next candidate's counts lower than reality, so every later candidate gets scored on an increasingly wrong board.
Skipping the restore step doesn't speed anything up — it just drifts the counts away from the true board state; it's a bug, not an optimization.
TARGET_SUM is an engine constant unrelated to whether hist counts get restored; this bug can't touch it.
Polluted counts directly change the score, which changes which triple the Solver actually picks — it affects behavior, not just print order.

q: Card Game breakdown 的通用经验有哪些？
q_en: What general lessons does the Card Game breakdown teach?
options: 当位置信息比规则实际需要的状态更细时，先找可压缩的表示
只要用上了 3-sum，后续的评分成本就一定无关紧要
优化不一定是更深搜索，有时是同一个 lookahead 换到更小状态上执行
评分应该反映剩余的选择空间，而不只是当前这步合不合法
why: 这题的关键是表示、评分和压缩。3-sum 是有用局部优化，但不是最终瓶颈的解法。
why_en: The broad lesson is to score future flexibility in the smallest representation that preserves the needed structure.
options_en: When position carries more detail than the rules actually need, look for a compressible representation first.
As long as you use 3-sum, downstream scoring cost is guaranteed to be irrelevant.
Optimizing isn't always deeper search — sometimes it's the same lookahead run on a smaller state.
Scoring should reflect the remaining choice space, not just whether the current move is legal.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种三数之和的经典模式：固定一个数，用哈希表在近似线性时间内找另外两个数的组合，把三重枚举降到平方级。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: 3-sum fixes one value and uses a hash map to find the other two in near-linear time, cutting a cubic triple-enumeration down to quadratic.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在真正执行一个候选移动前，先模拟它的后果并打分，用来比较哪个候选更好。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Lookahead simulates a candidate move's consequences and scores it before committing, so candidates can be compared.

optionExplanations: 对，这题的位置身份对求和规则来说是多余细节，先压缩成点数直方图才是解开瓶颈的关键一步。
错，3-sum 只是加速了找候选这一步，后面对每个候选重新评分的成本完全没有解决，正是它超时的原因。
对，最终解法用的还是同一个「移除后数剩余三元组」的 lookahead，只是换到点数空间上跑，而不是搜得更深。
对，只判断合法性的 first-found 正是这题里表现最差的策略，评分必须看这步棋留下多少后续选择。
optionExplanations_en: Right — positional identity is extra detail the sum rule doesn't need; compressing to a value histogram first is the move that actually unblocks the bottleneck.
Wrong — 3-sum only speeds up finding candidates; it does nothing about the cost of rescoring each one, which is exactly why that version times out.
Right — the final solver reuses the same 'count remaining triples after removal' lookahead, just run in value space instead of searching deeper.
Right — legality-only first-found is exactly the weakest strategy in this problem; scoring has to look at how much choice a move leaves behind.

scenario: 规则变化：除了点数和，三张牌还必须在网格上形成相邻形状。
scenario_en: Rule change: besides summing to the target, the three cards must also form an adjacent shape on the grid.
q: 原来的点数直方图方案会遇到什么问题？
q_en: What problem would the original value-histogram approach hit under the changed rule?
options: 它会没办法统计每个点数各自剩下的数量
它丢掉了位置的邻接关系，没法判断新的形状约束
它会把目标和 TARGET_SUM 自动改成 15
它会自动退化成完整博弈树回溯这种搜索方式
why: 表示压缩必须保留决策需要的信息。新规则让位置成为必要状态，不能再完全合并同点数牌。
why_en: A histogram is only valid while positional information is irrelevant to legality and scoring.
whenOtherWins: 在原题这种只看点数和数量的规则下，直方图正好保留了必要信息。
options_en: It would be unable to count how many cards of each individual value remain.
It discards positional adjacency, so it cannot check the new shape constraint.
It would automatically change the TARGET_SUM constant to 15.
It would automatically degrade into a full game-tree backtracking search.
tradeoff: 表示压缩省状态 vs 丢弃的信息可能是新规则需要的

termDefinitions.meaning: 按值分桶计数的数组，例如 hist[8] 记录点数为 8 的牌还剩几张。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A histogram is a value-indexed count array, e.g. hist[8] tracks how many cards of value 8 remain.

termDefinitions.meaning: 游戏引擎里固定的常量，三张牌的点数必须加起来等于它，一局游戏内它不会改变。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TARGET_SUM is the engine's fixed constant that three card values must sum to, and it never changes mid-game.

optionExplanations: 统计点数数量正是直方图最擅长的事，这不是它在新规则下会出问题的地方。
对，直方图只保留了点数计数，把「牌在网格哪个位置」这个信息压掉了，而新规则恰恰要看位置是否相邻。
TARGET_SUM 是引擎里的固定常量，规则变化不会让表示方式自动改写它的数值。
表示不够用会逼你重新设计状态（比如加回位置信息），不会自动切换成完整博弈树回溯这种搜索策略。
optionExplanations_en: Counting how many cards of each value exist is exactly what a histogram is good at — that's not where it breaks under the new rule.
Right — the histogram only keeps value counts and discards where a card sits on the grid, but the new rule specifically needs to check positional adjacency.
TARGET_SUM is a fixed engine constant; a rule change doesn't cause any representation to silently rewrite its value.
An insufficient representation forces you to redesign state (like adding position back), not automatically fall back to full game-tree backtracking.

q: 把 3-sum 位置评分超时的因果链排成正确顺序。
q_en: Put the timeout chain for 3-sum position scoring in the correct order.
steps: 每个合法候选都要模拟移除并重新统计剩余局面的三元组
总操作量乘上 33 回合和 30 个 trial 后超过时间限制
3-sum 把找候选降到 O(n^2)，产生约 2500 个满局候选
评分仍在 100 个位置组成的位置空间里执行
why: 第二版的问题不是三元组找不到，而是候选评分太贵。状态空间没缩小，lookahead 就付不起。
why_en: The timeout comes from scoring many positional candidates, not from failing to find triples quickly.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种三数之和的经典模式：固定一个数，用哈希表在近似线性时间内找另外两个数的组合，把三重枚举降到平方级。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: 3-sum fixes one value and uses a hash map to find the other two in near-linear time, cutting a cubic triple-enumeration down to quadratic.

termDefinitions.meaning: 描述算法运行时间或空间随输入规模 n 增长的上界，例如 O(n^3) 表示操作数大致按 n 的三次方增长。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Big-O notation describes the upper-bound growth rate of an algorithm's time or space as input size n grows, so O(n^3) means the work grows roughly as the cube of n.

scenario: 你要在面试中指出这个题属于 Data Structure Design 模式的原因。
scenario_en: In an interview, you need to explain why this problem fits the Data Structure Design pattern.
q: 为什么这题属于 Data Structure Design 模式？
q_en: Why is this a Data Structure Design problem?
options: 因为按行业惯例，所有数据结构设计题目都必须统一用链表来实现
因为题目额外要求把最终计算出来的输出格式化成 JSON 文本
换成直方图后，核心操作变成少量 map/array 计数而不是扫描位置组合
因为这道题的规则明确禁止使用任何形式的排序或比较相关操作
why: 算法思想没有变成完全不同的问题，而是数据表示让同样的评分便宜了很多。这正是数据结构设计的价值。
why_en: The data-structure move is replacing positional scans with compact count lookups.
whenOtherWins: 如果 n 很小，直接位置枚举更容易写且足够快。
options_en: Because industry convention supposedly requires every data-structure-design problem to be implemented with a linked list.
Because the problem additionally requires formatting the final, fully computed output as JSON text.
Switching to a histogram turns the core operation into a handful of map/array count lookups instead of scanning position combinations.
Because this problem's rules explicitly forbid using any form of sorting or comparison-related operation.
tradeoff: 紧凑计数表示 vs 反复扫描位置组合的表示

termDefinitions.term: Data Structure Design（数据结构设计模式）
termDefinitions.meaning: HelloInterview 归类的编码面试模式：通过改变数据的表示方式而不是算法思路本身，让同样的操作变便宜。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Data Structure Design is a coding-interview pattern where changing how data is represented, not the algorithmic idea itself, makes the same operation cheaper.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按值分桶计数的数组，例如 hist[8] 记录点数为 8 的牌还剩几张。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A histogram is a value-indexed count array, e.g. hist[8] tracks how many cards of value 8 remain.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种轻量级的文本数据交换格式，常用键值对表示结构化数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: JSON is a lightweight text format for structured data, typically written as key-value pairs.

optionExplanations: Data Structure Design 模式不限定具体用哪种结构，这题用的是数组/哈希表，跟链表没有关系。
题目里没有 JSON 格式化这个要求，输出就是位置坐标，这个选项凭空加了个不存在的约束。
对，从扫描一百个位置的组合改成读少量 map/array 计数，正是「换表示让同一个操作变便宜」这个模式的典型例子。
题目从没禁止排序，值三元组枚举里 v1<=v2<=v3 本身就是一种排序约束。
optionExplanations_en: The Data Structure Design pattern doesn't mandate any specific structure — this problem uses arrays/hash maps, nothing to do with linked lists.
There's no JSON-formatting requirement anywhere in this problem — the output is just position coordinates; this option invents a constraint that isn't there.
Right — going from scanning position combinations to reading a handful of map/array counts is a textbook case of changing the representation to make the same operation cheap.
The problem never bans sorting — the v1<=v2<=v3 constraint in value-triple enumeration is itself a form of ordering.

q: 填空：值三元组枚举通过计算 {{v3 = TARGET_SUM - v1 - v2}} 来避免第三层循环。
q_en: Fill in: value-triple enumeration avoids the third loop by computing {{v3 = TARGET_SUM - v1 - v2}}.
text: 值三元组枚举通过计算 {{v3 = TARGET_SUM - v1 - v2}} 来避免第三层循环。
why: 无论在位置空间还是值空间，用补数思想都能省掉一层枚举；直方图版本进一步把枚举范围从位置数 n 缩到不同值数 V，让这层补数计算更便宜。
why_en: Computing the complement removes an entire loop in either position or value space, and the histogram version further shrinks that loop's range from n positions down to V distinct values.
scenario: 在值空间枚举 (v1, v2, v3) 时，你已经固定了 v1 和 v2，要推导第三个值该怎么算才能避免再开一层循环。
scenario_en: In value-space enumeration of `(v1, v2, v3)`, you have already fixed `v1` and `v2`; derive the third value without opening another loop.

termDefinitions.meaning: 游戏引擎里固定的常量，三张牌的点数必须加起来等于它，一局游戏内它不会改变。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TARGET_SUM is the engine's fixed constant that three card values must sum to, and it never changes mid-game.

q: 为什么“找三元组更快”不能自动让平均回合数达到 33？
q_en: Why does faster triple finding not automatically raise the average turn count to 33?
options: 查找速度越快，规则合法性判断反而会越容易跟着出错
3-sum 这种查找方式会因此禁止某些合法三元组
查找速度快慢就只会影响默认的小网格局面，跟大局面无关
平均回合数由当前选择对后续局面的影响决定，不只是由查找速度决定
why: 优化目标是清掉尽可能多的牌。查找器再快，如果仍选坏移动，也会卡在 31 回合附近。
why_en: Move quality, not finder speed alone, determines how many turns the solver survives.
options_en: Faster lookup would somehow make the rule-legality checking logic more error-prone along with it.
Using 3-sum as the lookup method would forbid certain otherwise-legal triples.
Lookup speed would only ever matter on the small default grid, never on the larger optimization board.
Average turn count depends on how the current pick affects the rest of the board, not just on lookup speed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种三数之和的经典模式：固定一个数，用哈希表在近似线性时间内找另外两个数的组合，把三重枚举降到平方级。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: 3-sum fixes one value and uses a hash map to find the other two in near-linear time, cutting a cubic triple-enumeration down to quadratic.

optionExplanations: 错，查找速度和规则正确性是两回事，快查找不会让合法性判断变得更容易出错。
错，3-sum 只是换了个更快的方式找同样的候选集合，不会漏掉任何合法三元组。
错，查找速度的影响跟网格大小无关，10x10 优化局面同样会受它影响，不只限于默认小网格。
对，回合数取决于选出的三元组会不会孤立掉后续需要的牌，查找器再快，选坏了照样会卡在 31 回合左右。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — lookup speed and rule correctness are unrelated; a faster finder doesn't make legality checks any more error-prone.
Wrong — 3-sum just finds the same candidate set faster; it doesn't exclude any legal triple.
Wrong — lookup speed's impact isn't tied to grid size; the 10x10 optimization board is affected just as much, not only the small default grid.
Right — turn count hinges on whether the chosen triple strands cards other triples need; even a fast finder still stalls around 31 turns if it keeps picking badly.

q: 把直方图思路类比 counting sort 是为了强调什么？
q_en: What is the point of comparing the histogram idea to counting sort?
options: 用「值域小」这个结构特征换掉通用的位置比较，牺牲泛化性换取速度
所有排序算法都必须先玩一局纸牌游戏
直方图这种表示一定能解决任何 NP-hard 问题
比较排序在任何场景下都永远不能用
why: counting sort 利用小值域，直方图 lookahead 利用小点数域。两者都把通用表示换成更贴合问题结构的表示。
why_en: The counting-sort analogy highlights trading generality for a compact value-domain representation.
options_en: It trades generality for speed by exploiting a small value domain instead of generic positional comparison.
Every sorting algorithm must first play a round of this card game.
A histogram representation can solve any NP-hard problem.
Comparison sort can never be used in any scenario.
tradeoff: 利用小值域换速度 vs 保留通用性但更慢的位置/比较排序

termDefinitions.meaning: 利用值域较小这一点，把元素按值分桶计数再展开，从而避免逐对比较排序。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Counting sort exploits a small value range by bucketing elements by value and expanding the buckets, avoiding pairwise comparisons.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按值分桶计数的数组，例如 hist[8] 记录点数为 8 的牌还剩几张。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A histogram is a value-indexed count array, e.g. hist[8] tracks how many cards of value 8 remain.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一类目前没有已知多项式时间算法、且至少和 NP 中最难问题一样难的问题。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NP-hard problems are at least as hard as the hardest problems in NP, with no known polynomial-time algorithm.

optionExplanations: 对，counting-sort 只靠值域小这一点就能跳过逐对比较，直方图评分同样靠点数域只有 25 种来跳过逐位置枚举，两者都是拿泛化性换速度。
这是个荒谬的字面联想，类比只是借用「利用小值域」这个结构思想，跟真的玩纸牌游戏毫无关系。
直方图只是在这道题的值域小这个特殊结构下有效，不是能解决任意 NP-hard 问题的通用武器。
比较排序在值域很大或元素类型不可枚举时仍然常用甚至唯一可行，这里只是说它在这道题不是最优选择。
optionExplanations_en: Right — counting sort skips pairwise comparison because the value range is small, and the histogram skips positional enumeration for the same reason with only 25 distinct values; both trade generality for speed.
That's a nonsensical literal reading — the analogy only borrows the 'exploit a small value range' idea, nothing about literally playing this card game.
A histogram only helps because this specific problem has a small value domain — it's not a universal fix for arbitrary NP-hard problems.
Comparison sort is still common and often the only option when the value range is huge or unenumerable — this analogy only says it isn't optimal for this particular problem.

scenario: 你在朴素枚举里对 `grid.keys()` 排序后再枚举组合。
scenario_en: In the naive enumerator, you sort `grid.keys()` before enumerating position combinations.
q: 对 `grid.keys()` 排序主要带来什么？
q_en: What is the main benefit of sorting `grid.keys()` before enumeration?
options: 这样排序能保证一定找到全局最优的那个三元组
让 first-found 每次的行为都是确定的，便于测试和复现
这样排序能把整体时间复杂度降到 O(log n) 级别
这样排序能彻底消除点数重复出现的情况
why: 排序位置让枚举顺序稳定，但不能改善选择质量。first-found 仍然可能选到糟糕移动。
why_en: Sorting positions makes naive enumeration deterministic but not strategic.
whenOtherWins: 如果你希望打破固定顺序偏置，可以在候选评分后再使用随机或更强 tie-break，而不是依赖 first-found。
options_en: Sorting this way guarantees finding the globally optimal triple.
It makes first-found's behavior deterministic every time, which helps testing and reproducibility.
Sorting this way brings overall time complexity down to O(log n).
Sorting this way eliminates repeated values entirely.
tradeoff: 确定性/可复现 vs 选择质量本身没有变好

termDefinitions.meaning: 遇到第一个满足条件的候选就直接使用，不比较其他候选的优劣。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: First-found means taking the very first candidate that satisfies the condition, without comparing it against any other candidates.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同样的初始状态和同样的走法序列，结果每次都完全一致，没有随机成分。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A deterministic game produces the exact same outcome every time from the same initial state and move sequence, with no randomness.

optionExplanations: 排序只固定了枚举顺序，first-found 依然是找到第一个合法解就返回，跟全局最优毫无关系。
对，排序让每次运行都按同一个位置顺序枚举，first-found 每次挑到的三元组完全一致，方便写测试和复现 bug。
排序 keys 本身要花时间，枚举三元组的复杂度仍然是三重穷举，不会降到对数级。
重复点数依然会出现在排序后的列表里，排序只决定谁先被看到，不会让重复值消失。
optionExplanations_en: Sorting only fixes enumeration order; first-found still returns the first legal answer it hits, with no connection to global optimality.
Right — sorting makes every run enumerate positions in the same order, so first-found always lands on the same triple, which makes tests and bug repro reliable.
Sorting the keys costs its own time, and triple enumeration is still a cubic brute force afterward — nowhere near logarithmic.
Repeated values still appear in the sorted list; sorting only decides who gets seen first, it doesn't make duplicates disappear.

深度耗尽但无人获胜得 0
棋盘未满但深度耗尽时必须继续搜索到满盘

why_en: The baseline scorer maps RED wins, YELLOW wins, and unresolved leaves to +1, -1, and 0.
options_en: RED already has four in a row scores +1.
YELLOW already has four in a row scores -1.
Depth runs out with no winner scores 0.
If the board isn't full when depth runs out, the search must keep going until the board is full.

对，深度用完还看不出胜负时，朴素规则干脆给 0，当作未知处理。

Right — YELLOW connecting four mirrors that as -1, since scores are always from RED's perspective.
Right — when depth runs out with nothing resolved, the baseline rule just scores it 0 as unknown.
Wrong — once depth runs out, the rule returns 0; it can't blow the depth budget by forcing a search to a full board.

optionExplanations: 对，根节点还要记住是哪一列产生了最佳分数，子树只需要往上传一个分数。

q: 为什么必须先检查 winner，再检查 depth？

否则 `valid_moves` 会变慢
否则不能撤销落子

codeSample:
winner = self.board.check_winner()
if winner == Player.RED: return WIN_SCORE
if winner == Player.YELLOW: return -WIN_SCORE
if depth == 0 or self.board.is_full(): return 0

q: 最合适的实现方式是什么？

q: 填空：alpha 是 maximizer 当前保证的最好分数，beta 是 {{minimizer}} 当前保证的最好分数。
q_en: Fill in: alpha is the maximizer's best guaranteed score, and beta is the {{minimizer}}'s best guaranteed score.
text: alpha 是 maximizer 当前保证的最好分数，beta 是 {{minimizer}} 当前保证的最好分数。
why: alpha-beta 通过上下界判断剩余孩子是否还可能影响根节点选择。不能影响答案的子树会被跳过。
why_en: Alpha and beta track bounds that tell the search when remaining children cannot affect the result.

termDefinitions.meaning: maximizer 在当前路径上已经保证能拿到的最好分数（下界）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Alpha is the best score the maximizer is already guaranteed on the current search path.

termDefinitions.meaning: minimizer 在当前路径上已经保证能拿到的最好分数（上界）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Beta is the best score the minimizer is already guaranteed on the current search path.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在 minimax 上加两个边界值，一旦证明某分支不会影响根节点的选择就直接跳过。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Alpha-beta pruning adds two bound values to minimax and skips any branch proven unable to change the root's choice.

q: alpha-beta 剪枝为什么是 sound 的？
q_en: Why is alpha-beta pruning sound?
options: 它只跳过对手已经不会允许、或当前方已经不会选择的分支
它随机跳过大约一半的叶子节点，所以结果平均是正确的
它悄悄改变了 minimax 本身使用的评分规则
它只在整个棋盘都已经填满时才会运行
why: 剪枝条件只在某分支已不可能改善上层选择时触发。因此结果与完整 minimax 一致，只是少算。
why_en: Alpha-beta pruning skips only subtrees that cannot change the minimax choice.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Alpha[alpha best max] --> Test{alpha >= beta}
  Beta[beta best min] --> Test
  Test -->|yes| Prune[Prune rest]
  Test -->|no| Search[Search child]
options_en: It only skips branches the opponent would never allow, or that the current side would never choose.
It randomly skips about half the leaf nodes, so the result is correct on average.
It quietly changes the scoring rule minimax itself uses.
It only ever runs once the entire board has already filled up.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在 minimax 上加两个边界值，一旦证明某分支不会影响根节点的选择就直接跳过。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Alpha-beta pruning adds two bound values to minimax and skips any branch proven unable to change the root's choice.

optionExplanations: 对，剪枝只跳过已经证明不会被对手允许、或不会被当前方选中的分支，结果和完整搜索一致。
错，把剪枝理解成随机跳过就丢掉了它的正确性证明，alpha-beta 不是靠概率对的。
错，剪枝完全没有动评分函数，跳过的分支本来就不会影响最终选择。
错，剪枝在整棵搜索树的任何节点都可能触发，不是等棋盘满了才生效。
optionExplanations_en: Right — pruning only skips branches already proven the opponent would never allow, or the current side would never pick, so the result matches full minimax.
Wrong — treating pruning as random skipping throws away its correctness proof; alpha-beta isn't right by probability.
Wrong — pruning never touches the scoring function; the skipped branches simply couldn't have changed the final choice.
Wrong — pruning can trigger at any node throughout the search tree, not only once the board is full.

q: alpha-beta 的剪枝判断为什么使用 `alpha >= beta` 而不是只用 `alpha > beta`？

options_en: When they are equal, letting the opponent search further still cannot improve the current side's result.
When the two bounds are equal, the code must first copy the board.
The two bounds being equal means this board is already full.
Writing it as strict greater-than would cause a syntax error.

termDefinitions.meaning: maximizer 在当前路径上已经保证能拿到的最好分数（下界）。

q: Connect Four 中最自然的走法排序是什么？
q_en: What is the most natural move ordering in Connect Four?
options: 随机顺序且每层不同
只尝试满列

options_en: Center-first: 3, 2, 4, 1, 5, 0, 6.
Left to right: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6.
Random order that differs at every level.
Only try columns that are already full.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在 minimax 上加两个边界值，一旦证明某分支不会影响根节点的选择就直接跳过。

optionExplanations: 对，中心列参与的四连线组合最多，先搜它能更快收紧 alpha/beta、更早触发剪枝；如果有立即胜/防守这类战术信号，那些应该排得更靠前。

O(log b).

A fixed-depth search cannot undo a simulated move.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在 minimax 上加两个边界值，一旦证明某分支不会影响根节点的选择就直接跳过。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Alpha-beta pruning adds two bound values to minimax and skips any branch proven unable to change the root's choice.

optionExplanations: 对，不同局面需要的深度和展开程度都不一样，固定深度总会在某些局面上要么看不够远、要么跑得太慢。
错，alpha-beta 只跳过不影响结果的分支，合法走法集合本身没有被改变。
错，中心列只是通常更强的先验排序，不代表它在任何局面下都是正确答案。
错，撤销落子是 undo_move 的职责，跟搜索用不用固定深度没有关系。
optionExplanations_en: Right — both the depth needed and how open a position is can vary, so any fixed depth will eventually be either too shallow or too slow somewhere.
Wrong — alpha-beta only skips branches that can't change the result; the set of legal moves itself is untouched.
Wrong — the center column is just a usually-stronger ordering prior, not a guaranteed correct answer on every position.
Wrong — undoing a move is undo_move's job, unrelated to whether the search uses a fixed depth.

scenario: API 没给深度参数，只给每次调用约 2 秒；不同局面需要不同深度。
scenario_en: The API gives no depth parameter, only about two seconds per call, and different boards need different depths.
q: 比固定深度更贴合题意的策略是什么？
q_en: What strategy fits the task better than fixed depth?
options: 迭代加深：逐层完成搜索，预算快不够时返回最深完整结果
不管时间预算，永远死板地搜索到固定的深度 42
每次调用都只做深度 1 的搜索，从不加深
每一层都随机挑个时间点停止，返回当时递归里剩下的分数
why: 题目真正问的是给定时间内返回好列。迭代加深把深度问题转成预算问题，并保留随时可返回的 best-so-far。
why_en: Iterative deepening turns a depth choice into a time-budgeted search with a completed best move ready.
whenOtherWins: 如果平台明确给定固定深度且不限制时间，单次固定深度搜索更简单。
diagram:
flowchart LR
  D1[depth 1 done] --> D2[depth 2 done]
  D2 --> D3[depth 3 done]
  D3 --> Budget{time left}
  Budget --> Return[return deepest best]
options_en: Iterative deepening: complete one full depth at a time, and return the deepest completed result when the budget is about to run out.
Ignore the time budget entirely and always rigidly search to a fixed depth of 42.
Only ever search depth 1 on every call, never going deeper.
Stop at a random point in every level and return whatever score the recursion happens to be holding.
tradeoff: 迭代加深匹配时间预算 vs 固定深度搜索

termDefinitions.meaning: 从浅到深逐层完整搜索，每层结束都留一个可直接返回的当前最佳走法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Iterative deepening searches depth by depth from shallow to deep, keeping a returnable best move after each completed depth.

termDefinitions.meaning: 本次搜索必须停止的绝对时间点，由起始时间加预算算出。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The deadline is the absolute time by which the search must stop, computed from the start time plus the budget.

optionExplanations: 对，迭代加深逐层搜完再决定要不要加深，预算快用尽就直接返回已完成的最深结果，正好匹配「只给时间不给深度」的接口；如果平台反过来明确给定深度且不限时间，单次固定深度搜索会更简单。
错，不看时间硬搜到深度 42 完全忽略了 2 秒预算，大概率直接超时。
错，只做深度 1 连基础的两步威胁都看不到，远远不够。
错，随机停止返回的是未完成迭代的中间分数，可靠性没有保证，比迭代加深的「完整层」原则差很多。
optionExplanations_en: Right — iterative deepening finishes one full depth before going deeper, and returns the deepest completed result once the budget is nearly gone, which fits an interface that gives you time but not depth; if the platform instead gave a fixed depth with no time limit, a single fixed-depth search would be simpler.
Wrong — always searching to depth 42 regardless of the clock ignores the 2-second budget and will very likely time out.
Wrong — depth 1 alone can't even see a two-ply threat, which is nowhere near enough.
Wrong — stopping at a random point returns a half-finished iteration's score, with no reliability guarantee, unlike iterative deepening's completed-depth discipline.

q: 迭代加深为什么可以“优雅截断”？
q_en: Why can iterative deepening stop cleanly?
options: 每完成一个深度都有一个可返回的最佳列
下一层开始前可以估算是否还够时间
它永远不会重复计算任何节点
它不需要 alpha-beta
why: 完整迭代之间的边界是安全停止点。重复浅层搜索是成本，但 alpha-beta 的几何增长让这个成本可接受。
why_en: Iterative deepening can stop between completed iterations while retaining the deepest reliable move.
options_en: Every completed depth leaves a returnable best column.
Before the next depth starts, you can estimate whether there is still enough time.
It never recomputes any node twice.
It does not need alpha-beta.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从浅到深逐层完整搜索，每层结束都留一个可直接返回的当前最佳走法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Iterative deepening searches depth by depth from shallow to deep, keeping a returnable best move after each completed depth.

optionExplanations: 对，每完成一层完整搜索，就留下一个当下可信的最佳列，可以随时安全返回。
对，在开始下一层之前先估算能不能跑完，是它能安全截断的关键。
错，迭代加深每次都从深度 1 重新搜起，浅层节点会被重复计算，这正是它的已知代价。
错，迭代加深本身不排斥 alpha-beta，两者通常配合使用来减少这份重复计算。
optionExplanations_en: Right — every completed depth leaves behind a currently trustworthy best column that's safe to return.
Right — estimating whether there's time before starting the next depth is exactly what makes a clean stop possible.
Wrong — iterative deepening restarts from depth 1 every time, so shallow nodes get recomputed; that's a known cost of the technique.
Wrong — iterative deepening doesn't exclude alpha-beta; the two are normally paired to cut down that recomputation.

q: 文章中的迭代加深用什么粗略规则预测下一层是否能跑完？
q_en: What rough rule does the iterative-deepening implementation use to predict whether the next depth will finish?
options: 把上一层耗时乘以约 4
假设下一层一定是 0ms
只看当前棋盘的第一列
把剩余时间除以 1000
why: 有效分支因子约 3 到 4，乘 4 是保守估计。宁可少开一层，也不要启动必然超时的一层。
why_en: The implementation predicts the next iteration as roughly four times the last completed one.
scenario: 迭代加深每层开始前要预测下一层是否还能在预算内跑完，才决定要不要继续加深。
scenario_en: Before each iterative-deepening level starts, the solver predicts whether the next depth can still finish inside the budget.
options_en: Multiply the last completed depth's time by roughly 4.
Assume the next depth will always take 0ms.
Only look at the board's first column.
Divide the remaining time by 1000.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每个节点平均可展开的子节点数，Connect Four 里最多是 7（列数）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The branching factor is the average number of children per search node, at most 7 in Connect Four.

optionExplanations: 对，有效分支因子大约是 3 到 4，用「上一层耗时 × 4」做保守预测，宁可少加一层也不启动必超时的迭代。
错，假设下一层是 0ms 完全忽略了搜索会随深度显著变慢的事实。
错，只看第一列的耗时无法代表整层搜索的总开销，预测会严重失真。
错，剩余时间除以 1000 是和分支因子无关的算术，不能预测下一层实际要花多久。
optionExplanations_en: Right — the effective branching factor is roughly 3 to 4, so multiplying the last depth's time by 4 is a conservative predictor, better to skip a depth than launch one that's guaranteed to time out.
Wrong — assuming the next depth takes 0ms ignores that search time grows noticeably with depth.
Wrong — timing just the first column can't represent the cost of a whole depth's search; the prediction would be badly off.
Wrong — dividing remaining time by 1000 is arithmetic unrelated to the branching factor, and can't predict how long the next depth actually takes.

scenario: 你想给迭代加深加时间预算，考虑在递归深处发现超时就直接返回。
scenario_en: You want to add a time budget to iterative deepening and are considering returning immediately from deep recursion when time runs out.
q: 文章为什么反对在递归内部随意中断？
q_en: Why does the article avoid arbitrary interruption inside recursion?
options: 递归中途跳出容易漏掉配对的 undo_move，弄脏棋盘状态
递归函数内部完全无法读取系统时间
超时检查会把 alpha-beta 变成广度优先搜索
在递归内部中断会自动让答案更准确
why: 回溯依赖每次 drop 都有匹配 undo。预算检查放在完整迭代之间，避免半路逃逸破坏状态。
why_en: Stopping inside recursion risks bypassing undo calls and corrupting the board.
whenOtherWins: 如果实现了异常安全的 try/finally 撤销或不可变棋盘，内部 deadline 检查可以更安全。
options_en: Bailing out mid-recursion easily skips a paired undo_move and corrupts the board state.
The recursion has no way to read the system clock at all.
A timeout check would turn alpha-beta into breadth-first search.
Interrupting inside the recursion automatically makes the answer more accurate.
tradeoff: 在完整迭代之间检查预算 vs 在递归内部随时中断

termDefinitions.meaning: 原地修改棋盘的落子与撤销函数，用于回溯而不必复制整个棋盘。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: drop_disc and undo_move mutate the board in place so backtracking avoids copying the whole board.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按层展开、逐层访问的搜索方式，不带边界剪枝。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Breadth-first search (BFS) expands a tree level by level with no pruning.

termDefinitions.meaning: 本次搜索必须停止的绝对时间点，由起始时间加预算算出。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The deadline is the absolute time by which the search must stop, computed from the start time plus the budget.

optionExplanations: 对，回溯要求每次 drop 都配一次 undo，递归中途随意跳出很容易漏掉某次撤销、弄脏棋盘状态；如果用 try/finally 保证撤销一定执行，或者棋盘本身不可变，内部检查就能更安全。
错，递归函数内部完全可以读系统时间，这不是限制的来源。
错，超时检查跟搜索顺序无关，不会把深度优先的 alpha-beta 变成广度优先。
错，中断搜索只是提前止损，不会让返回的分数或走法变得更准确。
optionExplanations_en: Right — backtracking depends on every drop being paired with an undo; bailing out mid-recursion easily skips one and corrupts the board; with a try/finally that guarantees the undo runs, or an immutable board, an internal check would be safer.
Wrong — a recursive function can absolutely read the system clock; that's not what's stopping it.
Wrong — a timeout check has nothing to do with search order; it wouldn't turn depth-first alpha-beta into breadth-first.
Wrong — interrupting the search only cuts losses early; it doesn't make the returned score or move any more accurate.

q: 填空：代码用内部预算 {{1.5 秒}}，给外部 {{2 秒}} 测试上限留余量。
q_en: Fill in: the code uses an internal {{1.5-second}} budget to leave margin under the external {{2-second}} test cap.
text: 代码用内部预算 {{1.5 秒}}，给外部 {{2 秒}} 测试上限留余量。
why: 测试墙钟包含语言运行、函数调用和预测误差。内部预算略低能降低超时风险。
why_en: An internal 1.5-second budget leaves margin under the external two-second cap.
scenario: 测试对每次调用外部限时 2 秒；内部搜索要留出安全边际，防止语言开销和预测误差导致真实超时。
scenario_en: The external test cap is 2 seconds per call; the internal search needs a safety margin for language overhead and prediction error.

termDefinitions.meaning: 程序实际运行经过的真实时间，不是 CPU 占用时间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Wall-clock time is the real elapsed time a program takes to run, not CPU time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 本次搜索必须停止的绝对时间点，由起始时间加预算算出。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The deadline is the absolute time by which the search must stop, computed from the start time plus the budget.

scenario: 两个分支都能赢，但一个更快；或者两个分支都要输，但一个能拖更久。
scenario_en: Two branches both win but one wins sooner, or two branches both lose but one delays the loss longer.
q: 终局分数中加入 depth 微调的目的是什么？
q_en: Why add a depth adjustment to terminal scores?
options: 偏好更快的胜利和更慢的失败
让平局比胜利更好
禁用 transposition table
改变合法列集合
why: 深度微调只做同类结果的 tie-break，不应压过胜负本身。WIN_SCORE 足够大就是为这个服务。
why_en: Depth-adjusted terminal scores prefer faster wins and slower losses without making a win worse than a draw.
whenOtherWins: 如果只需要胜负分类而不关心路线快慢，可以不做这个 tie-break。
options_en: Prefer a faster win and a slower loss.
Make a draw score better than a win.
Disable the transposition table.
Change the set of legal columns.
tradeoff: 按深度微调终局分 vs 只用二元 +1/-1

termDefinitions.meaning: 代码里表示"必胜/必败"的极值分数常量，让胜负分和普通分数拉开差距。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: WIN_SCORE is the constant score used for a guaranteed win or loss, set far apart from ordinary scores.

optionExplanations: 对，给终局分数按深度微调，会让搜索偏好更快能赢的分支、更慢才输的分支，同时不压过胜负本身。
错，深度微调的幅度远小于 WIN_SCORE，平局分数不会反超真正的胜利。
错，这段评分逻辑跟要不要用 transposition table 完全无关。
错，深度微调只改变终局分数的大小，不会影响哪些列是合法的。
optionExplanations_en: Right — nudging terminal scores by depth makes the search prefer branches that win sooner and lose later, without ever outweighing win/loss itself.
Wrong — the depth adjustment is far smaller than WIN_SCORE, so a draw score can never overtake an actual win.
Wrong — this scoring logic has nothing to do with whether a transposition table is used.
Wrong — the depth adjustment only changes the size of the terminal score, not which columns are legal.

q: 为什么“只有迭代加深 + alpha-beta”仍会在深度 9 位置上失败？
q_en: Why does “iterative deepening + alpha-beta only” still fail on the depth-9 position?
options: 第 9 层单独约 1.9 秒，跑了会超预算；不跑又看不到那步棋
迭代加深这套技术根本没办法处理 YELLOW 一方的走棋顺序
迭代加深这套技术完全没办法配合中心优先的列排序使用
迭代加深会把所有搜索到的叶子节点都固定评分为 +1
why: ID 解决了预算接口问题，但重复计算仍然让最深一层太贵。需要缓存重复局面。
why_en: Iterative deepening alone still recomputes too much, making the depth-nine iteration too expensive.
options_en: Depth 9 alone takes about 1.9 seconds, which blows the budget if run, but skipping it misses the winning column.
Iterative deepening simply has no way to handle YELLOW's move order.
Iterative deepening simply cannot be paired with center-first column ordering.
Iterative deepening scores every leaf node it searches as a fixed +1.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从浅到深逐层完整搜索，每层结束都留一个可直接返回的当前最佳走法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Iterative deepening searches depth by depth from shallow to deep, keeping a returnable best move after each completed depth.

optionExplanations: 对，光是深度 9 这一层就要约 1.9 秒，跑了大概率超预算，不跑又看不到那步制胜棋，这是纯迭代加深卡住的真正原因。
错，迭代加深跟走棋方是 RED 还是 YELLOW 没有关系，它对双方一视同仁地逐层搜索。
错，迭代加深和中心优先排序完全可以搭配使用，两者不冲突。
错，叶子评分由评分函数决定，迭代加深本身不会把所有叶子都固定成 +1。
optionExplanations_en: Right — depth 9 alone takes about 1.9 seconds, so running it likely blows the budget, and skipping it means missing the winning move; that's the actual bottleneck for plain iterative deepening.
Wrong — iterative deepening treats RED and YELLOW the same way; it has nothing to do with move order by side.
Wrong — iterative deepening and center-first ordering work together fine; there's no conflict between them.
Wrong — leaf scoring is decided by the scoring function; iterative deepening itself doesn't force every leaf to +1.

scenario: 搜索树里不同落子顺序可能到达完全相同的列栈局面。
scenario_en: Different move orders in the search tree can reach exactly the same column-stack board position.
q: 应该加入什么优化？
q_en: What optimization should be added?
options: 加 transposition table 缓存已评估局面的分数
把负责回溯的 undo_move 这个撤销函数整个删掉
只把根节点最终选中的那一列缓存起来，其余都不缓存
把 alpha 和 beta 这两个边界值都强制固定成 0
why: 同一局面后续子树相同，第二次遇到可直接复用分数。Connect Four 中交换不同列的落子顺序很容易形成 transposition。
why_en: A transposition table memoizes board positions reached by multiple move orders.
whenOtherWins: 如果搜索空间几乎没有重复状态，TT 的内存和哈希成本可能不划算。
diagram:
flowchart LR
  PathA[3 then 4] --> State[Same board]
  PathB[4 then 3] --> State
  State --> Cache[TT score]
options_en: Add a transposition table that caches the score of positions already evaluated.
Delete undo_move, the function backtracking depends on, entirely.
Only cache the single column the root ends up choosing, and nothing else.
Force both the alpha and beta bounds to be permanently fixed at 0.
tradeoff: 缓存重复局面换空间 vs 每次都重新计算

termDefinitions.meaning: 把已经算过的局面分数缓存起来，之后再遇到同一局面直接返回缓存值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A transposition table caches the score of a position already evaluated so a later visit can return it directly.

termDefinitions.meaning: 原地修改棋盘的落子与撤销函数，用于回溯而不必复制整个棋盘。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: drop_disc and undo_move mutate the board in place so backtracking avoids copying the whole board.

termDefinitions.meaning: maximizer 在当前路径上已经保证能拿到的最好分数（下界）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Alpha is the best score the maximizer is already guaranteed on the current search path.

termDefinitions.meaning: minimizer 在当前路径上已经保证能拿到的最好分数（上界）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Beta is the best score the minimizer is already guaranteed on the current search path.

optionExplanations: 对，不同落子顺序常会到达同一个局面，加 transposition table 缓存已评估分数，第二次遇到直接复用；但如果搜索空间几乎不重复，缓存的内存和哈希开销可能不划算。
错，删掉 undo_move 会破坏回溯本身，跟处理重复局面完全不是一回事。
错，只缓存根节点选的那一列，无法复用子树里反复出现的重复局面，收益极小。
错，把 alpha、beta 都固定成 0 会彻底破坏剪枝逻辑，不是应对重复局面的办法。
optionExplanations_en: Right — different move orders often reach the same position, so a transposition table caching already-evaluated scores lets you reuse them next time; but if the search space rarely repeats, the memory and hashing overhead may not pay off.
Wrong — deleting undo_move would break backtracking itself, which is unrelated to handling repeated positions.
Wrong — caching only the root's chosen column can't reuse the repeated positions that show up deep in the subtree, so the benefit is minimal.
Wrong — pinning both alpha and beta to 0 would wreck the pruning logic entirely; that's not how you handle repeats.

q: transposition table 的正确 cache key 至少需要包含哪些信息？
q_en: What information must a transposition-table cache key include?
options: 棋盘列栈状态
剩余搜索深度
轮到哪一方走
搜索开始的系统时间
why: 同一棋盘在不同深度或不同走棋方下不是同一个搜索问题。系统时间不是局面语义的一部分。
why_en: A correct transposition key includes board state, remaining depth, and side to move.
options_en: The column-stack state of the board.
The remaining search depth.
Which side is about to move.
The wall-clock time the search started.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把棋盘状态编码成一个稳定字符串，用作缓存表的 key。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: state_key encodes the board into a stable string used as a cache key.

optionExplanations: 对，棋盘的列栈状态本身就是局面的核心标识，缓存 key 必须包含它。
对，剩余深度不同意味着搜索到的信息量不同，同一棋盘在不同深度下不能共用一个缓存值。
对，轮到谁走决定了这个节点是 maximizer 还是 minimizer，缺了它两种角色会被混在一起。
错，搜索开始的系统时间跟局面语义无关，把它编进 key 只会让本该命中的缓存失效。
optionExplanations_en: Right — the board's column-stack state is the core identity of a position, so the key must include it.
Right — different remaining depth means different amounts of lookahead were done, so the same board at different depths can't share a cache entry.
Right — side to move decides whether this node is the maximizer or minimizer, so leaving it out would conflate the two roles.
Wrong — the wall-clock time the search started has nothing to do with a position's meaning; baking it into the key would just make valid hits miss.

q: 如果 transposition table 的 key 不包含剩余深度，最大风险是什么？
q_en: What is the main risk if a transposition-table key omits remaining depth?
options: 浅层的 0 分会污染深层搜索，漏掉更深的胜负
所有缓存查找都会永远命中率为 0
棋盘状态将完全无法被序列化
中心列会从此再也不能被尝试
why: 深度 2 的未知不等于深度 6 的未知。缓存必须区分搜索到多深的分数。
why_en: A shallow score cannot safely stand in for a deeper search result.
options_en: A shallow-search 0 can pollute a deeper search, hiding a win or loss that is one more ply away.
Every cache lookup would permanently have a 0% hit rate.
The board state could no longer be serialized at all.
The center column could never be tried again.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把棋盘状态编码成一个稳定字符串，用作缓存表的 key。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: state_key encodes the board into a stable string used as a cache key.

optionExplanations: 对，深度 2 搜出来的「未知」和深度 6 搜出来的「未知」含义不同，key 里少了深度，浅层的 0 分会被当成深层结果复用，漏掉更深的胜负。
错，缺深度只会让缓存命中「错误」的分数，而不是彻底命中不了。
错，序列化棋盘和 key 里要不要带深度是两件事，互不影响。
错，这跟中心列排序完全无关，中心列依然会照常被尝试。
optionExplanations_en: Right — a depth-2 'unknown' and a depth-6 'unknown' mean different things; without depth in the key, a shallow 0 gets reused as if it were a deeper result, hiding a win or loss further out.
Wrong — omitting depth causes wrong hits, not zero hits — lookups would still succeed, just with stale scores.
Wrong — serializing the board and whether depth is part of the key are unrelated concerns.
Wrong — this has nothing to do with move ordering; the center column would still be tried as usual.

q: 如果 cache key 不包含 side-to-move，会出现什么语义错误？

棋盘的列数会平白多出一列变成 8
alpha-beta 剪枝会自动退化成纯贪心

why: 轮到谁走直接决定可选动作的价值和 max/min 角色。棋盘格子相同也不能合并。
why_en: The same board with a different player to move has a different game tree.
options_en: A RED-to-move and a YELLOW-to-move version of the same board would share one score, even though their search trees differ.
The board would gain an extra column and become 8 wide.
Alpha-beta pruning would automatically degrade into plain greedy search.
Every position's result would turn into a draw.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在 minimax 上加两个边界值，一旦证明某分支不会影响根节点的选择就直接跳过。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Alpha-beta pruning adds two bound values to minimax and skips any branch proven unable to change the root's choice.

optionExplanations: 对，同一个棋盘格局在 RED 走和 YELLOW 走时对应完全不同的搜索树，key 里缺了走棋方会让两者错误共享一个分数。
错，缓存 key 只是内部标识符，不会反过来改变棋盘本身的列数。
错，这跟剪枝逻辑退化成贪心毫无关系，alpha-beta 的剪枝条件不依赖 TT key。
错，缓存 key 缺字段最多导致复用错误分数，不会让所有局面都变成平局。
optionExplanations_en: Right — the same board layout with RED versus YELLOW to move has an entirely different search tree; missing side-to-move in the key wrongly shares one score across both.
Wrong — a cache key is just an internal identifier; it can't reach back and change how many columns the board has.
Wrong — this has nothing to do with alpha-beta degrading into greedy search; its cutoff condition doesn't depend on the TT key.
Wrong — a missing key field at worst reuses a wrong score; it doesn't turn every position's result into a draw.

q: 填空：先下列 3 再下列 4，和先下列 4 再下列 3，可能到达 {{相同的列栈局面}}。

text: 先下列 3 再下列 4，和先下列 4 再下列 3，可能到达 {{相同的列栈局面}}。
why: 路径不同不代表状态不同。TT 利用的是状态决定未来，而不是路径决定未来。
why_en: Different move orders can transpose into the same position, whose future search is identical.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把棋盘状态编码成一个稳定字符串，用作缓存表的 key。

scenario: 你要为 Connect Four 局面构造稳定、跨语言容易实现的棋盘 key。

q: 文章中的 `state_key` 主要编码了什么？

options: 每一列从底到当前高度的棋子序列，并用分隔符连接
当前系统时间和随机种子
上一次搜索的 alpha beta 值

why_en: A Connect Four board is fully determined by the token stack in each column.
whenOtherWins: 如果游戏允许洞或任意格放置，就需要编码完整二维网格，而不是只编码列栈。
options_en: The token sequence in each column from bottom to current height, joined with a separator.
The current system time and a random seed.
The alpha and beta values from the previous search.
The indices of every leaf that has already been pruned.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把棋盘状态编码成一个稳定字符串，用作缓存表的 key。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: state_key encodes the board into a stable string used as a cache key.

optionExplanations: 对，重力规则下每列的棋子序列就完整决定了棋盘，按列拼接、用分隔符隔开就是一个稳定的状态标识；如果游戏允许任意格放置，就得编码整张二维网格才够。
错，系统时间和随机种子跟局面本身无关，编进 key 只会让相同局面被误判成不同状态。
错，alpha/beta 是搜索过程中的边界值，不是棋盘状态的一部分。
错，已剪枝叶子的编号跟这个局面长什么样完全无关。
optionExplanations_en: Right — under gravity, each column's token sequence fully determines the board, so joining them with a separator gives a stable state key; if the game allowed placing in arbitrary cells, you'd need to encode the full 2D grid instead.
Wrong — system time and a random seed have nothing to do with the position itself; baking them in would make the same board look like different states.
Wrong — alpha and beta are bounds from the search process, not part of the board's state.

scenario: 你在一次 `find_best_move` 内做迭代加深，从深度 1 搜到更深。
scenario_en: Inside one find_best_move call, iterative deepening searches from depth 1 to deeper levels.
q: transposition table 应该如何管理？
q_en: How should the transposition table be managed?
options: 本次调用开始时新建，跨本次各深度迭代复用
每进入一个递归节点就清空一次缓存
永久存到磁盘，且不区分是哪个根局面
只允许在搜索深度为 1 时使用
why: 跨迭代复用让深层搜索吃到浅层留下的缓存。每次顶层调用重新建表则控制内存和复杂度。
why_en: The table should live across iterative-deepening depths within one move search.
whenOtherWins: 生产级引擎可能保留跨回合固定大小缓存并做淘汰，但面试题里本次调用内缓存更简单。
options_en: Create it once at the start of this call, and reuse it across every depth of this call's iterative deepening.
Clear the cache every time a recursive node is entered.
Persist it to disk forever, without distinguishing which root position it came from.
Only allow it to be used at search depth 1.
tradeoff: 单次调用内复用 vs 跨回合持久化缓存

termDefinitions.meaning: 把已经算过的局面分数缓存起来，之后再遇到同一局面直接返回缓存值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A transposition table caches the score of a position already evaluated so a later visit can return it directly.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从浅到深逐层完整搜索，每层结束都留一个可直接返回的当前最佳走法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Iterative deepening searches depth by depth from shallow to deep, keeping a returnable best move after each completed depth.

optionExplanations: 对，在这次 find_best_move 开始时新建一张表，让浅层迭代留下的分数被深层迭代复用，调用结束就丢弃，内存和复杂度都可控；生产级引擎可能会跨回合保留带淘汰策略的缓存，但这里没必要。
错，每进一个节点就清空缓存，等于每次都白建了表，完全拿不到复用收益。
错，永久存磁盘又不区分根局面，会让不同局面的分数互相污染。
错，只在深度 1 用缓存，恰恰跳过了最需要复用的深层重复局面。
optionExplanations_en: Right — build a fresh table at the start of this find_best_move call so shallower iterations' scores get reused by deeper ones, then discard it when the call ends, keeping memory and complexity bounded; a production engine might keep an evicting cache across turns, but that's unnecessary here.
Wrong — clearing the cache on every recursive node means the table gets rebuilt for nothing, with zero reuse benefit.
Wrong — persisting to disk forever without distinguishing the root position would let scores from different positions contaminate each other.
Wrong — restricting the cache to depth 1 skips exactly the deep, repeated positions that benefit from reuse the most.

q: transposition table 的主要代价是什么？
q_en: What is the main cost of a transposition table?
options: 内存随访问过的唯一局面数量增长
它会让搜索结果不再等价于 minimax
它禁止 alpha-beta 剪枝
它把时间预算变成无限
why: TT 用空间换时间。受 1.5 秒预算限制时表大小可控，生产系统通常会加容量上限和淘汰策略。
why_en: A transposition table trades memory for avoiding repeated subtree evaluations.
options_en: Memory grows with the number of unique positions visited.
It makes the search result no longer equal to plain minimax.
It disables alpha-beta pruning.
It turns the time budget into an unlimited one.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把已经算过的局面分数缓存起来，之后再遇到同一局面直接返回缓存值。

optionExplanations: 对，transposition table 是空间换时间，内存占用随访问过的不重复局面数量线性增长。

q_en: Why handle winner/depth termination before looking up the normal TT key?
options: 终局和深度耗尽已有直接分数，先返回更简单也避免缓存空叶子
TT 这种基于字典的缓存表根本不能用元组当 key 存储
winner 检查按规定只被允许在根节点运行一次

scenario: 你要说明 Connect Four 四版解法的工程演进。

termDefinitions.meaning: 对抗搜索算法：我方节点取子节点最大值，对手节点取子节点最小值，交替进行。

q: 把 minimizer 节点触发 alpha-beta 剪枝的逻辑排成正确顺序。
q_en: Put the minimizer-node alpha-beta cutoff logic in the correct order.
steps: minimizer 已经找到一个足够低的 child 分数，使 beta 降低

q: 朴素评分里，为什么“深度耗尽但无人胜”和“满盘平局”都给 0？

两者都代表 RED 已经赢
两者都代表 YELLOW 已经赢
因为 0 是唯一允许的返回值

why_en: The baseline scorer treats unresolved depth leaves and true draws as neutral because neither has a winner.
options_en: Neither has a clear winner to point at under this simple scoring rule.
Both represent RED already winning.
Both represent YELLOW already winning.
Because 0 is the only value the function is allowed to return.

optionExplanations: 对，深度耗尽的未知局面和真正的满盘平局都没有明确赢家，朴素评分干脆把两者都归为中性的 0。
错，RED 赢会直接命中 +1 这条终局规则，不会落到这个 0 分支。

错，评分函数并不是只能返回 0，胜负分支照样能返回 +1/-1。
optionExplanations_en: Right — an unresolved depth-exhausted position and a genuine full-board draw both lack a clear winner, so the baseline scorer lumps them into neutral 0.
Wrong — a RED win hits the +1 terminal rule directly; it never falls into this 0 branch.
Wrong — likewise a YELLOW win maps to -1 and never reaches this branch either.
Wrong — the scoring function isn't limited to returning 0; the win/loss branches still return +1/-1.

不管轮到哪一方走，根节点永远选分数最大的那一列
不看当前局面是什么，强制固定返回中心那一列
直接跳过对手这一方的视角，完全不做对抗搜索
why: 评分始终从 RED 视角定义。YELLOW 想让 RED 分数尽可能低，所以根节点也要最小化。
why_en: When YELLOW is to move, the root should minimize the RED-perspective score.
whenOtherWins: 如果评分改成“当前玩家视角”，根节点 max/min 约定也要随之调整。
options_en: Treat YELLOW as the minimizer and pick the column with the lowest score.
No matter whose turn it is, the root always picks the highest-scoring column.
Ignore what the current position actually looks like and always return the center column.
Skip the opponent's side of the perspective entirely and do no adversarial search at all.
tradeoff: 根节点角色随走棋方切换 vs 永远最大化

termDefinitions.meaning: minimax 中永远选分数最小分支的一方，本文里是 YELLOW。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The minimizer always picks the branch with the lowest score; in this article that is YELLOW.

termDefinitions.meaning: minimax 中永远选分数最大分支的一方，本文里是 RED。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The maximizer always picks the branch with the highest score; in this article that is RED.

optionExplanations: 对，评分始终站在 RED 视角，轮到 YELLOW 时它想把这个分数压到最低，所以根节点要当 minimizer 选最低分那列；如果评分改成「当前玩家视角」，根节点的 max/min 约定要跟着换。
错，永远选最大分数会让 YELLOW 走出对 RED 最有利的棋，完全违背了它自己的目标。
错，固定返回中心列完全不看局面，连基础的对抗搜索都没做。
错，跳过对手视角等于放弃了 minimax 的核心结构，根节点也就没有决策依据了。
optionExplanations_en: Right — scoring is always defined from RED's perspective, and YELLOW wants that score as low as possible, so at the root it should act as minimizer and pick the lowest-scoring column; if scoring switched to 'current player's perspective,' the root's max/min convention would have to flip too.
Wrong — always picking the highest score would make YELLOW play the move best for RED, the exact opposite of its own goal.
Wrong — always returning the center column ignores the position entirely, skipping adversarial search altogether.
Wrong — skipping the opponent's perspective throws away minimax's core structure, leaving the root with no basis for a decision.

q: 搜索每一层生成 moves 时，应考虑哪些实现细节？
q_en: What implementation details matter when generating moves at each search level?
options: 只包含未满列
按中心优先顺序排列合法列
每层都允许向任意行直接落子
在每个尝试后撤销落子
why: 合法性、排序和撤销是搜索正确且高效的基本条件。任意行落子违反重力规则。
why_en: Each search node should generate playable columns in a useful order and undo every simulated move.
options_en: Only include columns that are not yet full.
List legal columns in center-first order.
Allow dropping directly into any row on every level.
Undo the simulated move after every trial.
optionExplanations: 对，只生成未满的列，本身就是重力规则决定的合法性约束。
对，按中心优先排列合法列能让 alpha-beta 更早收紧边界，提升剪枝效率。
错，任意行直接落子违反了 Connect Four 的重力规则，根本不是合法走法。
对，每次试探后必须撤销落子，保证回溯不会污染上层节点看到的棋盘状态。
optionExplanations_en: Right — only generating columns that aren't full is exactly the legality constraint gravity imposes.
Right — center-first ordering of legal columns tightens alpha-beta's bounds sooner, improving pruning.
Wrong — dropping directly into any row violates Connect Four's gravity rule; it isn't a legal move at all.
Right — undoing the move after every trial is what keeps backtracking from leaving a corrupted board for ancestor nodes.

scenario: 迭代加深在预算内不断加深，但你仍希望有一个绝对上限避免异常无限循环。
scenario_en: Iterative deepening keeps going while time allows, but you still want an absolute ceiling to avoid abnormal runaway depth.
q: 文章中的 `MAX_DEPTH_CAP = 42` 代表什么思路？
q_en: What idea does `MAX_DEPTH_CAP = 42` represent?
options: 棋盘总共 42 格，深度不会超过剩余 ply 数，这是防御性上限
规定每次调用必须搜索满整整 42 秒
被错误地当成棋盘一共有 42 列
被误解成 transposition table 只能存 42 条
why: 7x6 棋盘总共 42 格。预算通常先停止，cap 是防御性上界。
why_en: The depth cap is a defensive upper bound tied to the maximum number of board cells.
whenOtherWins: 如果棋盘尺寸或规则变化，cap 应跟最大可能 ply 数一起调整。
options_en: The board has 42 cells total, so depth never needs to exceed the remaining plies; it is a defensive upper bound.
Every call must search for a full 42 seconds.
The board is mistakenly assumed to have 42 columns.
The transposition table is mistakenly assumed to hold only 42 entries.
tradeoff: 防御性硬上限 vs 由预算/deadline 主导何时停止

termDefinitions.meaning: 迭代加深允许搜索的深度硬上限，防止异常情况下无限加深。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: MAX_DEPTH_CAP is the hard ceiling on how deep iterative deepening may search, guarding against a runaway loop.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对抗搜索里的半步——一方走一次算一个 ply，不是双方各走一次的整回合。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A ply is one half-move by a single player in adversarial search, not a full round for both sides.

termDefinitions.meaning: 本次搜索必须停止的绝对时间点，由起始时间加预算算出。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The deadline is the absolute time by which the search must stop, computed from the start time plus the budget.

optionExplanations: 对，7x6 棋盘一共 42 格，深度不可能超过剩余空格数，这个上限是防止异常情况下无限加深的防御性硬顶；如果棋盘尺寸变了，这个上限也要跟着调整。
错，42 指的是格子数量，不是秒数，时间预算另有内部的 1.5 秒设置。
错，棋盘的列数固定是 7，42 说的是总格数（7 列 x 6 行），不是列数。
错，transposition table 的容量跟这个深度上限常量完全无关。
optionExplanations_en: Right — the 7x6 board has 42 cells total, so depth can never exceed the remaining cell count; this cap is a defensive ceiling against runaway deepening in edge cases; if the board size changed, the cap would need to change with it.
Wrong — 42 refers to a cell count, not seconds; the time budget is a separate internal 1.5-second setting.
Wrong — the board always has 7 columns; 42 is the total cell count (7 columns times 6 rows), not a column count.
Wrong — the transposition table's capacity has nothing to do with this depth-cap constant.

q: 为什么 move ordering 和 alpha-beta 是配套优化？
q_en: Why do move ordering and alpha-beta work as paired optimizations?
options: 先看到好走法会更早收紧 alpha/beta，从而更早剪掉后续分支
走法排序会实际改变 minimax 最终算出的真实答案
alpha-beta 剪枝只能处理已经预先排好序的字符串
如果不给走法排序，代码就没办法检查是否有赢家
why: 剪枝发生在找到足够强的界之后。好候选越早出现，界越早收紧。
why_en: Good move ordering makes alpha-beta cut sooner by tightening bounds earlier.
options_en: Seeing a good move earlier tightens alpha/beta sooner, so later branches get cut off earlier.
Move ordering actually changes the true answer minimax ends up computing.
Alpha-beta pruning can only operate on strings that have already been pre-sorted.
Without move ordering, the code has no way to check whether there's a winner.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在 minimax 上加两个边界值，一旦证明某分支不会影响根节点的选择就直接跳过。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Alpha-beta pruning adds two bound values to minimax and skips any branch proven unable to change the root's choice.

optionExplanations: 对，越早遇到强候选，alpha/beta 边界收紧得越快，后面的分支就能更早被证明无用而剪掉。
错，走法排序只影响搜索到答案的速度，不会改变 minimax 本该得到的真实分数。
错，alpha-beta 处理的是棋盘落子，不是字符串排序，这个说法完全不成立。
错，赢家检查跟走法有没有排序无关，任何顺序下都会照常执行。
optionExplanations_en: Right — the sooner a strong candidate is found, the sooner alpha/beta tighten, so later branches get proven useless and cut earlier.
Wrong — move ordering only affects how fast the search reaches the answer, not the true minimax score it converges to.
Wrong — alpha-beta operates on board moves, not sorted strings; that claim doesn't hold up at all.
Wrong — the winner check runs regardless of move ordering; it doesn't depend on moves being sorted.

scenario: 你需要在 Phase 3 的 2 秒上限内处理 mate@3、mate@5、mate@7、mate@9，且不知道当前局面需要多深。
scenario_en: You must handle mate@3, mate@5, mate@7, and mate@9 within Phase 3's 2-second cap, without knowing how deep the current board needs.
q: 最适合提交的组合是哪一个？
q_en: Which combination is the best submission choice?
options: 迭代加深 + 剪枝 + 中心排序 + 缓存表
朴素 minimax，固定搜索到第 6 层
alpha-beta 剪枝，固定搜索到第 8 层
不做搜索，永远只返回中心列
why: 最终组合同时解决正确性、剪枝、预算适配和重复局面复用。其它方案至少在一个局面上错或超时。
why_en: The final combination is the only one that adapts depth while keeping deep searches cheap enough.
whenOtherWins: 如果测试只包含浅层战术，固定深度 alpha-beta 可能更简单且足够。
diagram:
flowchart LR

flowchart LR

options_en: Iterative deepening + alpha-beta pruning + center-first ordering + a transposition table.
Naive minimax fixed to depth 6.
Alpha-beta pruning fixed to depth 8.
No search at all, always return the center column.
tradeoff: 四项优化叠加 vs 任一单项固定深度方案

termDefinitions.meaning: 从浅到深逐层完整搜索，每层结束都留一个可直接返回的当前最佳走法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Iterative deepening searches depth by depth from shallow to deep, keeping a returnable best move after each completed depth.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在 minimax 上加两个边界值，一旦证明某分支不会影响根节点的选择就直接跳过。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Alpha-beta pruning adds two bound values to minimax and skips any branch proven unable to change the root's choice.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把已经算过的局面分数缓存起来，之后再遇到同一局面直接返回缓存值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A transposition table caches the score of a position already evaluated so a later visit can return it directly.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把列按中心优先排好的顺序常量：3,2,4,1,5,0,6。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CENTER_FIRST is the column-order constant that tries the center column before the edges.

optionExplanations: 对，迭代加深负责匹配预算，alpha-beta 加中心排序负责剪枝，缓存表负责复用重复局面，四者叠加才能同时兼顾正确、够深、够快；如果测试只包含浅层战术，固定深度 alpha-beta 可能已经够用。
错，朴素 minimax 固定第 6 层在深度 9 的强制胜局面上直接看不到胜利。
错，alpha-beta 固定第 8 层同样会漏看只有深度 9 才能发现的强制胜。
错，完全不搜索、只返回中心列放弃了任何对抗判断，连基础战术都保证不了。
optionExplanations_en: Right — iterative deepening matches the time budget, alpha-beta plus center ordering handles pruning, and the cache reuses repeated positions; stacking all four is what covers correctness, depth, and speed together; if the tests only covered shallow tactics, fixed-depth alpha-beta alone might already be enough.
Wrong — naive minimax fixed at depth 6 simply can't see the win on the depth-9 forced-win position.
Wrong — alpha-beta fixed at depth 8 likewise misses the forced win that only appears at depth 9.
Wrong — never searching and always returning the center column gives up on any adversarial reasoning, not even guaranteeing basic tactics.

q: transposition table 相比 alpha-beta 的作用差异是什么？
q_en: How does a transposition table differ from alpha-beta?
options: alpha-beta 跳过必然无用子树，TT 复用已经算过的相同局面
alpha-beta 负责序列化棋盘，TT 负责判断胜负
两者完全相同
TT 会替代 minimax 的 max/min 逻辑
why: 一个是边界剪枝，一个是记忆化。它们优化的是不同来源的重复工作，可以叠加。
why_en: Alpha-beta prunes provably irrelevant branches, while a transposition table memoizes repeated states.
options_en: Alpha-beta skips subtrees that provably cannot help; a transposition table reuses positions already scored.
Alpha-beta serializes the board while a transposition table judges the winner.
The two are entirely identical.
A transposition table replaces minimax's max/min logic.
tradeoff: 边界剪枝（alpha-beta） vs 记忆化复用（transposition table）

termDefinitions.meaning: 在 minimax 上加两个边界值，一旦证明某分支不会影响根节点的选择就直接跳过。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Alpha-beta pruning adds two bound values to minimax and skips any branch proven unable to change the root's choice.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把已经算过的局面分数缓存起来，之后再遇到同一局面直接返回缓存值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A transposition table caches the score of a position already evaluated so a later visit can return it directly.

optionExplanations: 对，alpha-beta 靠边界证明跳过不会影响结果的分支，TT 靠记忆化复用之前算过的相同局面，两者优化的是不同来源的重复工作。
错，序列化棋盘和判断胜负分别是 state_key 和 check_winner 的职责，跟这两项优化的分工不对应。
错，一个是剪枝、一个是记忆化，作用机制完全不同，不能说完全相同。
错，TT 只是缓存分数，minimax 的 max/min 交替逻辑照常运行，没有被替代。
optionExplanations_en: Right — alpha-beta uses bound proofs to skip branches that provably can't matter, while a TT memoizes positions already scored; they optimize two different sources of repeated work.
Wrong — serializing the board and judging the winner are state_key's and check_winner's jobs respectively, not how these two optimizations actually split responsibilities.
Wrong — one is pruning, the other is memoization; the mechanisms are completely different, so they aren't the same thing.
Wrong — a TT just caches scores; minimax's alternating max/min logic keeps running exactly as before, unreplaced.

q: Connect Four breakdown 的四个核心工程动作是什么？
q_en: What are the four core engineering moves in the Connect Four breakdown?
options: 搜索整棵对抗树来建立正确模型
用 alpha-beta 跳过对手不会允许的子树
用迭代加深匹配固定时间预算
用 transposition table 复用多路径到达的局面
why: 文章最后把这四步作为对抗搜索的通用阶梯。真正的提交是它们的组合。
why_en: The transferable ladder is minimax, pruning, budgeted deepening, and transposition caching.
options_en: Search the entire adversarial tree to establish a correct baseline.
Use alpha-beta to skip subtrees the opponent would never allow.
Use iterative deepening to fit a fixed time budget.
Use a transposition table to reuse positions reached by multiple move orders.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在 minimax 上加两个边界值，一旦证明某分支不会影响根节点的选择就直接跳过。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Alpha-beta pruning adds two bound values to minimax and skips any branch proven unable to change the root's choice.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从浅到深逐层完整搜索，每层结束都留一个可直接返回的当前最佳走法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Iterative deepening searches depth by depth from shallow to deep, keeping a returnable best move after each completed depth.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把已经算过的局面分数缓存起来，之后再遇到同一局面直接返回缓存值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A transposition table caches the score of a position already evaluated so a later visit can return it directly.

optionExplanations: 对，先用完整 minimax 把「对抗搜索该怎么建模」这件事做对，是后面所有优化的正确性基线。

optionExplanations_en: Right — establishing full minimax first gets the adversarial model correct, and everything after builds on that correctness baseline.
Right — alpha-beta then skips branches already proven the opponent would never allow or the current side would never pick.

q: 在深度不足的强制胜局面里，为什么 solver 可能回退到默认排序选列？

错，合法列的判断只依赖棋盘状态本身，跟有没有 transposition table 无关。
错，TT 至多是额外的哈希开销，不会让搜索本身指数级变慢。
错，TT 只缓存分数，不会改变棋盘的落子规则或胜负判定。
optionExplanations_en: Right — a TT's payoff grows with depth and repeated positions; a shallow tree capped at depth 2 has little repetition, so plain alpha-beta is already enough; but in this article's depth-9 iterative-deepening case, a TT is the optimization that decides whether the budget is met.
Wrong — determining legal columns depends only on the board state itself, unrelated to whether a transposition table exists.
Wrong — a TT adds at most some hashing overhead; it doesn't make the search itself exponentially slower.
Wrong — a TT only caches scores; it doesn't change the board's drop rules or how a win is determined.

q: 为什么文章选择每次 `find_best_move` 新建 TT，而不是无限跨回合保留？
q_en: Why does the article create a fresh TT for each `find_best_move` call instead of keeping one forever across turns?
options: 简单控制内存；上一回合的大多数搜索局面对新根未必有用
跨迭代复用不合法
Python 字典只能用一次
新建 TT 会让所有缓存命中率为 100%
why: 面试题只要求单次给定局面返回列。本次调用内复用价值很高，跨调用保留则增加内存管理复杂度。
why_en: A per-call table captures most useful reuse while keeping memory management simple.
options_en: It keeps memory management simple; most of last turn's positions are unlikely to recur off the new root anyway.
Reusing it across iterations is not legal.
A Python dictionary can only be used once.
Rebuilding it would make every cache lookup a 100% hit.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把已经算过的局面分数缓存起来，之后再遇到同一局面直接返回缓存值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A transposition table (TT) caches the score of a position already evaluated so a later visit can return it directly.

optionExplanations: 对，每次调用重新建表能简单地控制内存占用，而且上一回合围绕旧根局面搜到的大多数状态，对新的根局面未必还有复用价值。
错，同一次调用内的跨迭代复用完全合法，正是这里推荐的做法。
错，Python 字典可以反复读写，「只能用一次」是编造的限制。
错，新建的表是空的，第一次查找必然全部落空，命中率恰恰是从 0 开始的。
optionExplanations_en: Right — rebuilding the table each call keeps memory simple, and most positions explored around last turn's root aren't necessarily reusable from the new root.
Wrong — reuse across iterations within the same call is exactly what's recommended here; there's nothing illegal about it.
Wrong — a Python dict can be read and written repeatedly; 'usable only once' is a made-up restriction.
