whenOtherWins: 若雨夜是核心运营场景(如夜间网约车),排除出 ODD 会砍掉主要业务,此时应优先投入定向采数与重训把该切片救回 ODD,而非直接放弃。
options: 无视切片结果,把雨夜也写进 ODD,反正整体指标达标
缩小 ODD 声明范围但照旧在雨夜运营,声明和实际不一致
把雨夜排除出 ODD(该条件下不自动驾驶),或改进模型至达标后再纳入
干脆不声明 ODD,让系统在所有条件下都开,简化合规流程
options_en: Ignore the slice result and write rain-night into the ODD anyway since overall metrics pass.
Shrink the declared ODD but keep operating at rain-night anyway, so the declaration and reality diverge.
Exclude rain-night from the ODD (no autonomous driving in that condition), or improve the model until it passes and then include it.
Skip declaring an ODD altogether and let the system drive in all conditions to simplify compliance.
optionExplanations: 错;把已知失败的条件写进 ODD 是虚假声明,出事就是明确的合规与责任问题。
错;声明和实际运营不一致等于欺骗监管,雨夜照跑=在已知不安全条件下运营。
对;ODD 就是诚实划出'我们在哪些条件下保证安全';达不到就排除或先修好,这是合规正解。
错;不声明 ODD 反而违规,NHTSA 恰恰要求声明并证明域内表现,不声明=无法上路。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — writing a known-failing condition into the ODD is a false declaration and a clear compliance and liability problem when it fails.
Wrong — a declaration that diverges from real operation deceives regulators; still running at rain-night means operating in a known-unsafe condition.
Correct — the ODD honestly delimits which conditions you guarantee safe; if you cannot meet it, exclude or fix first, the compliant answer.
Wrong — skipping the ODD is itself non-compliant; NHTSA requires declaring it and proving in-domain performance, so no declaration means no road approval.

termDefinitions.meaning: 美国国家公路交通安全管理局,监管车辆安全,要求 AV 声明运行设计域。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NHTSA (National Highway Traffic Safety Administration) is the U.S. vehicle-safety regulator that requires AVs to declare an operational design domain.

termDefinitions.meaning: 运行设计域:系统被声明为安全运行的条件集合(天气/光照/道路等),须证明域内表现。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ODD (Operational Design Domain) is the set of conditions (weather, lighting, roads) a system is declared safe to operate in, with in-domain performance to be proven.

scenario: 面试到收尾,面试官问你怎么定位这套评估+安全流水线在项目里的角色。
scenario_en: Wrapping up, the interviewer asks how you frame the whole evaluation-plus-safety pipeline's role in the project.
q: 该把整套评估/安全流水线定位成什么?
q_en: How should you frame the entire evaluation/safety pipeline?
why: 把它定位成产出'可审计的合规证据'(audit-ready compliance artifacts):切片指标、fail-safe 触发记录、降级行为文档,天生就是 ISO 26262/EU AI Act/NHTSA 要的证据,而不是事后补的额外工作。这体现 Staff+ 的合规意识。
why_en: Frame it as producing audit-ready compliance artifacts — slice metrics, fail-safe trigger logs, degraded-mode docs — which are the evidence ISO 26262 / EU AI Act / NHTSA require, not an afterthought.
tradeoff: 评估即合规证据(一次投入两处受益) vs 评估只为调模型(合规再另做,重复劳动)
whenOtherWins: 在纯研究原型、无上路计划时,评估可以只服务模型迭代、不必产出合规证据;一旦面向真实道路部署,就必须按合规证据来设计。
options: 定位成纯粹的模型调优工具,只为提升 mAP,合规等上线前再单独补
定位成产出可审计合规证据的流水线:切片指标、fail-safe 日志、降级文档天生满足法规要求
定位成一次性验收测试,过了就不用再跑,部署后无需持续评估
定位成营销材料,用漂亮的整体准确率对外宣传产品有多安全
options_en: Frame it as a pure model-tuning tool only for raising mAP, with compliance patched separately before launch.
Frame it as a pipeline producing audit-ready compliance artifacts: slice metrics, fail-safe logs, and degraded-mode docs that inherently satisfy regulations.
Frame it as a one-time acceptance test that need not rerun after passing, with no ongoing post-deployment evaluation.
Frame it as marketing material, using a pretty overall accuracy to advertise how safe the product is.
optionExplanations: 错;把合规当上线前另补,等于重复造证据,还容易发现流程不满足要求时来不及。
对;让评估的产物直接=法规要的证据,一次投入同时服务模型改进与合规审计,是 Staff+ 的整合思路。
错;分布漂移会让一次性验收过期,安全评估必须持续跑,不是过一次就完。
错;拿整体准确率做营销恰恰是本课批判的'掩盖尾部失败',与安全评估精神相反。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — patching compliance before launch duplicates evidence work and risks discovering too late that the process fails requirements.
Correct — making the evaluation's outputs themselves the evidence regulators require serves both model improvement and audit in one investment, the Staff+ integrated view.
Wrong — distribution shift makes a one-time acceptance expire; safety evaluation must run continuously, not once and done.
Wrong — marketing an overall accuracy is precisely the 'hide the tail failures' anti-pattern this lesson criticizes, against the spirit of safety evaluation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 可提交给监管审计的文档与数据(切片指标、fail-safe 日志、降级行为记录)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Compliance artifacts are auditable documents and data submittable to regulators, such as slice metrics, fail-safe logs, and degraded-mode records.

scenario: 1 万辆车做目标检测，要求 30+ FPS、端到端 <50ms 延迟；有人提议把推理放云端以省车载硬件成本。
scenario_en: 10,000 vehicles run object detection at 30+ FPS with sub-50ms end-to-end latency; someone proposes cloud inference to save on-board hardware cost.
q: 安全关键的检测推理该放边缘还是云端？
q_en: Should safety-critical detection inference run at the edge or in the cloud?
why: 放边缘：云端往返凭物理就要 50–200ms，100km/h 时车 100ms 走约 2.8m，是几米的盲开；车载前向 <10ms 才守得住 <50ms 预算。边缘推理是安全需求，不是性能优化。
why_en: Run at the edge: a cloud round-trip physically costs 50–200ms, and at 100 km/h the car travels ~2.8m per 100ms of blind driving, so on-device inference under 10ms is what holds the sub-50ms budget.
tradeoff: 边缘(低延迟+断网可用，但车载硬件贵) vs 云端(硬件便宜，但往返延迟+断网全瞎)
diagram:
flowchart LR C[相机帧] --> E["边缘推理
<10ms"] E --> P[规划/刹车] C -.可选.-> N["云端往返
50-200ms"] N -.太慢.-> P
whenOtherWins: 非安全关键、可容忍延迟的任务(车队分析、离线重训、地图更新)放云端更划算——无需塞进车载算力预算。
options: 放边缘：车载前向 <10ms，守住 <50ms 预算；云端往返 50–200ms 会造成几米盲开，边缘是安全需求
放云端：集中算力更强、检测更准，延迟可以靠 5G 优化到忽略不计
放云端：车载硬件太贵，省下来的钱可覆盖偶尔断网的风险
各一半：安全关键帧走云端复核，普通帧走边缘，兼顾准确与成本
options_en: At the edge: an on-device forward pass under 10ms holds the sub-50ms budget, while a 50–200ms cloud round-trip means meters of blind driving, so edge is a safety requirement.
In the cloud: centralized compute is stronger and more accurate, and latency can be optimized to negligible with 5G.
In the cloud: on-board hardware is too expensive, and the savings cover the risk of occasional network loss.
Split it: send safety-critical frames to the cloud for review and normal frames to the edge, balancing accuracy and cost.
optionExplanations: 对；感知到执动的时间预算是硬物理约束，只有车载 <10ms 前向能达标，这是安全底线不是优化项。
错；5G 也压不掉传播+排队+回传的 50ms+ 往返，且这假设永远联网，隧道/郊区一断就全瞎。
错；拿安全换硬件成本是本末倒置，断网时云端方案是整感知失效，不是'偶尔小概率'。
错；把安全关键帧送云端恰恰把最不能等的帧放到最慢路径上，方向完全反了。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — perception-to-actuation time is a hard physical budget only an on-device sub-10ms pass can meet; this is a safety floor, not an optimization.
Wrong — even 5G cannot erase the 50ms+ round-trip of propagation, queuing, and return, and it assumes constant connectivity that tunnels and rural areas break.
Wrong — trading safety for hardware cost is backwards; on a network loss the cloud design is total perception failure, not an 'occasional small chance'.
Wrong — sending safety-critical frames to the cloud puts the least-waitable frames on the slowest path, exactly the wrong direction.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在车载加速器上本地跑模型前向，不经网络，延迟低且断网可用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Edge inference runs the model's forward pass locally on the on-board accelerator, with no network, giving low latency and offline availability.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每秒处理帧数；30+ FPS 意味着每帧检测预算约 33ms 以内。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FPS (Frames Per Second) is frames processed per second; 30+ FPS means roughly a 33ms budget per frame.

scenario: 有人坚持云端推理，说'延迟只是工程优化问题'。你要用物理量级把这条路堵死。
scenario_en: Someone insists on cloud inference, claiming 'latency is just an engineering optimization.' You must close that door with physical orders of magnitude.
q: 为什么云端往返延迟在 AV 上是硬物理约束，不是能优化掉的？
q_en: Why is cloud round-trip latency a hard physical limit for AVs, not something you can optimize away?
why: 云端往返约 50–200ms（传播+排队+回传，不是 SQL 能调掉的）。100km/h≈28m/s，100ms 就多走约 2.8m 盲开——几米内可能撞人。车载前向 <10ms 才能把感知到执动压进 <50ms 预算。
why_en: A cloud round-trip is ~50–200ms of propagation, queuing, and return, so at 100 km/h (~28 m/s) 100ms is ~2.8m of blind driving, which on-device sub-10ms inference avoids.
options: 延迟只受服务器负载影响，扩容加机器就能降到接近 0，不算物理约束
云端往返约 50–200ms 是物理下限，100km/h 下 100ms≈2.8m 盲开；车载 <10ms 才守住 <50ms 预算
延迟主要来自模型太大，把模型压小放云端就能达到 <10ms 往返
只要用 UDP 代替 TCP，往返延迟就能压到 1ms 以内，云端完全可行
options_en: Latency depends only on server load, so scaling out to near-zero is possible and it is not a physical limit.
A cloud round-trip is ~50–200ms as a physical floor; at 100 km/h that 100ms is ~2.8m of blind driving, and only on-device sub-10ms holds the sub-50ms budget.
Latency mostly comes from a big model, so shrinking it in the cloud reaches a sub-10ms round-trip.
Just use UDP instead of TCP and the round-trip drops under 1ms, making cloud fully viable.
optionExplanations: 错；加机器减的是排队，减不掉光速传播+回传，几十毫秒的往返是物理下限不是负载问题。
对；把往返毫秒数乘以车速就得到盲开距离，几米内就可能撞人，所以必须车载低延迟推理。
错；模型再小，网络往返本身就 50ms 起步，压模型压不掉传播时延。
错；UDP 省的是握手/重传开销，改不了物理传播距离带来的往返延迟。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — adding machines cuts queuing but not light-speed propagation and return; a tens-of-ms round-trip is a physical floor, not a load issue.
Correct — multiply round-trip milliseconds by vehicle speed to get blind-driving distance; meters can mean hitting someone, so on-device low-latency inference is required.
Wrong — however small the model, the network round-trip alone starts at ~50ms; shrinking the model cannot remove propagation delay.
Wrong — UDP saves handshake/retransmit overhead but cannot change the round-trip latency set by physical distance.

termDefinitions.meaning: 请求发出到响应回来的总时间，含传播、排队、处理、回传，跨网络有物理下限。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Round-trip latency is the total time from request to response, including propagation, queuing, processing, and return, with a physical floor over a network.

scenario: 车会开进隧道、郊区、恶劣天气，蜂窝网络时断时续；有人仍想让感知依赖云端。
scenario_en: Vehicles enter tunnels, rural areas, and bad weather where cellular drops intermittently, yet someone wants perception to depend on the cloud.
q: 网络不可靠对'云端感知'方案意味着什么后果，怎么缓解？
q_en: What does unreliable connectivity mean for cloud-dependent perception, and how do you mitigate it?
why: 蜂窝在隧道/郊区/坏天气会断，云端依赖的感知一断网就是整感知失效，违反 ISO 26262 的可用性要求。边缘方案在断网时仍本地推理、优雅降级；只有车载硬件也坏了才退到冗余传感器。
why_en: Cellular fails in tunnels, rural areas, and bad weather, so cloud-dependent perception becomes total failure on a drop, violating ISO 26262 availability, whereas edge inference degrades gracefully.
options: 断网只会让检测稍微变慢，云端方案仍能本地缓存结果继续安全行驶
网络问题可以靠双 SIM/多运营商彻底解决，云端感知没有可用性风险
断网=整感知失效，违反 ISO 26262 可用性；边缘方案本地推理优雅降级才是解
断网时让车立刻急停即可，不需要边缘推理，简单可靠
options_en: A drop only slows detection slightly, and the cloud design can locally cache results and keep driving safely.
Network issues are fully solved by dual-SIM/multi-carrier, so cloud perception has no availability risk.
A drop equals total perception failure, violating ISO 26262 availability; the fix is edge inference that degrades gracefully.
On a drop, just have the car emergency-stop immediately, so no edge inference is needed and it is simple and reliable.
optionExplanations: 错；云端方案本地没有推理能力，断网不是'变慢'而是没有检测结果可用，等于瞎开。
错；多运营商减少但消不掉隧道/郊区/天气造成的断连，可用性风险仍在，不能作为安全依据。
对；把感知放边缘，断网时车仍能本地检测、优雅降级，符合功能安全的可用性要求。
错；高速上无脑急停本身制造追尾风险，且频繁断网会让车寸步难行，不是可靠方案。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — the cloud design has no local inference, so a drop is not 'slower' but no detection at all, equivalent to blind driving.
Wrong — multi-carrier reduces but cannot eliminate drops from tunnels, rural areas, and weather; the availability risk remains and cannot ground safety.
Correct — putting perception at the edge lets the car keep detecting and degrade gracefully on a drop, meeting functional-safety availability.
Wrong — reflexive emergency stops at speed create rear-end risk, and frequent drops would paralyze the car, so it is not a reliable design.

termDefinitions.meaning: 部分能力失效时系统退到更保守但仍安全的模式，而非彻底失效。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Graceful degradation is falling back to a more conservative but still-safe mode when part of the system fails, rather than failing outright.

termDefinitions.meaning: 功能安全标准对安全相关功能'在需要时必须可用'的要求，禁止单点断网致整体失效。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ISO 26262 availability is the functional-safety requirement that safety functions must be available when needed, forbidding a single network loss from causing total failure.

scenario: 既要边缘的低延迟安全推理，又想利用云端的大算力做训练和车队分析。
scenario_en: You want the edge's low-latency safety inference plus the cloud's large compute for training and fleet analytics.
q: 混合架构里，云和边各自该负责什么？
q_en: In a hybrid architecture, what should cloud and edge each own?
why: 云=大脑：训练、评估、车队分析、模型准备（不吃实时预算）。边=反射：安全关键的检测推理放车载，<10ms 守延迟、断网仍工作。按'能不能等'切分——能等的上云，不能等的下边。
why_en: Cloud is the brain — training, evaluation, fleet analytics, model prep — and edge is the reflex running safety-critical inference on-device, split by what can wait versus what cannot.
tradeoff: 云做慢而重的(训练/分析) vs 边做快而关键的(实时安全推理)
whenOtherWins: 若某分析任务不影响实时驾驶(如夜间离线重训、聚合指标)，放云端更省车载算力；把它塞进边缘反而挤占实时推理预算。
options: 云负责所有推理决策，边只做数据采集上传，最大化利用云端算力
边负责一切，云只是备份存储，避免任何联网依赖
云=大脑(训练/评估/车队分析/模型准备)，边=反射(安全关键实时推理，<10ms、断网可用)
云边各跑一份完整推理，实时投票取多数，追求最高准确率
options_en: The cloud owns all inference decisions and the edge only collects and uploads data, maximizing cloud compute.
The edge owns everything and the cloud is just backup storage, avoiding any network dependency.
Cloud is the brain (training, evaluation, fleet analytics, model prep) and edge is the reflex (safety-critical real-time inference, sub-10ms, offline-capable).
Cloud and edge each run a full inference and vote in real time for the highest accuracy.
optionExplanations: 错；把推理决策放云端就回到高延迟+断网全瞎的老问题，违背边缘安全推理的前提。
错；边缘扛不动训练和全车队分析，把这些也压给车载既浪费又不现实，云的价值被丢掉。
对；按实时性切分职责，安全推理在边、慢重计算在云，各取所长又不互相拖累。
错；实时向云端要一份推理再投票，等于把最慢路径拉进关键决策，延迟和断网风险都回来了。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — putting inference decisions in the cloud reverts to high latency plus total blindness on a drop, against the premise of edge safety inference.
Wrong — the edge cannot handle training and fleet-wide analytics; forcing those on-device is wasteful and unrealistic and throws away the cloud's value.
Correct — splitting by real-time need puts safety inference at the edge and heavy compute in the cloud, playing to each strength without dragging the other.
Wrong — asking the cloud for an inference to vote in real time pulls the slowest path into critical decisions, bringing back latency and network risk.

termDefinitions.term: hybrid edge-cloud / 混合边云架构
termDefinitions.meaning: 把实时安全推理放边缘、把训练与车队级分析放云端的分工架构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hybrid edge-cloud architecture puts real-time safety inference at the edge and training plus fleet-level analytics in the cloud.

scenario: 要把检测模型塞进车载加速器，硬件有明确的体积和功耗信封。
scenario_en: You must fit the detection model into the on-board accelerator with a hard size and power envelope.
q: 车载边缘部署的模型有哪些硬约束，来自哪里？
q_en: What hard constraints bind an on-board edge model, and where do they come from?
why: 车载加速器有物理信封：模型量化后需 ≤约 200MB 才装得进、功耗要落在约 30–75W 内。这两个是硬件给定的上限（不是可调优的软目标），直接决定必须做压缩（蒸馏+量化+剪枝）。
why_en: The on-board accelerator has a physical envelope: a quantized model must be roughly ≤200MB and power must sit in a ~30–75W band, which forces compression.
options: 模型可以任意大，只要云端能存下；功耗无所谓，车有的是电
唯一约束是准确率，体积和功耗在车载上都不受限
量化后模型需 ≤约 200MB 装进加速器、功耗约 30–75W，是硬件信封，逼着做压缩
只要模型 <10GB 就行，功耗上不封顶，随便堆算力
options_en: The model can be any size as long as the cloud can store it, and power is irrelevant since the car has plenty.
The only constraint is accuracy; size and power are unconstrained on-vehicle.
A quantized model must be roughly ≤200MB to fit the accelerator and draw ~30–75W — a hardware envelope that forces compression.
Anything under 10GB is fine, power is uncapped, and you can pile on compute freely.
optionExplanations: 错；车载不是云，加速器的显存/存储和功耗是死的，模型必须适配这个信封。
错；准确率固然重要，但体积和功耗是先决的硬门槛，装不进去谈何准确率。
对；≤200MB 和 30–75W 是硬件给定上限，决定了必须蒸馏+量化+剪枝把模型压进信封。
错；车载功耗有散热和电池预算上限，不可能'上不封顶'，这条严重低估了约束。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — the vehicle is not the cloud; the accelerator's memory/storage and power are fixed, so the model must fit this envelope.
Wrong — accuracy matters but size and power are prerequisite hard gates; if it does not fit, accuracy is moot.
Correct — ≤200MB and 30–75W are hardware-given ceilings that force distillation plus quantization plus pruning to fit the envelope.
Wrong — on-board power has thermal and battery ceilings and cannot be 'uncapped'; this badly underestimates the constraint.

termDefinitions.meaning: 硬件允许的功耗范围(此处约 30–75W)，受散热与电池预算限制，超了会过热或掉电。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A power envelope is the allowed power range (here ~30–75W) bounded by cooling and battery budget; exceeding it overheats or drains the vehicle.

scenario: 云端训练出的大检测模型准确但太大，要压进 ≤200MB 的车载加速器，且尽量少掉精度。
scenario_en: The cloud-trained big detector is accurate but too large; it must fit a ≤200MB on-board accelerator while losing as little accuracy as possible.
q: 把模型压进边缘的标准手段组合是什么？
q_en: What is the standard toolkit to compress a model for the edge?
why: 标准三件套：知识蒸馏（大 teacher 教小 student，保住精度）+ INT8 量化（权重/激活降到 8 位，省内存加速）+ 结构化剪枝（删整通道/层，减体积）。三者叠加把大模型压进加速器信封。
why_en: The standard trio is knowledge distillation (teacher trains a small student), INT8 quantization (8-bit weights/activations), and structured pruning (drop whole channels), combined to fit the accelerator envelope.
tradeoff: 压缩(装进边缘、提速) vs 精度(尤其尾部类可能退化，要逐切片复测)
whenOtherWins: 若加速器算力充裕、模型本就小到能装下，就不必激进压缩——过度压缩会不成比例地伤稀有类，得不偿失。
options: 只做知识蒸馏就够了，量化和剪枝会破坏精度，绝不采用
把模型原样上传云端，用云端算力实时推理，无需任何压缩
只加大 batch size 提高吞吐，模型体积不变照样能装进加速器
知识蒸馏(teacher→student)+INT8 量化+结构化剪枝三者叠加，压进加速器信封
options_en: Knowledge distillation alone is enough; quantization and pruning wreck accuracy and should never be used.
Upload the model as-is to the cloud and run real-time inference there, needing no compression.
Just raise batch size for throughput; the model size stays the same and still fits the accelerator.
Combine knowledge distillation (teacher→student), INT8 quantization, and structured pruning to fit the accelerator envelope.
optionExplanations: 错；单靠蒸馏往往压不到信封内，量化/剪枝配合使用得当精度损失可控，不该一刀切排除。
错；上云推理就是本课否掉的高延迟+断网全瞎方案，压缩正是为了留在边缘。
错；加大 batch 改吞吐不改模型体积，装不进的还是装不进，答非所问。
对；蒸馏保精度、量化省内存、剪枝减体积，三者互补把大模型压进 ≤200MB 的信封。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — distillation alone often cannot reach the envelope; with care, quantization/pruning keep accuracy loss manageable, so a blanket exclusion is wrong.
Wrong — cloud inference is exactly the high-latency, blind-on-drop design this lesson rejects; compression exists to stay at the edge.
Wrong — bigger batches change throughput not model size; what does not fit still does not fit, missing the point.
Correct — distillation preserves accuracy, quantization saves memory, pruning cuts size, together fitting the big model into the ≤200MB envelope.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用大 teacher 模型的软输出训练小 student 模型，让小模型逼近大模型精度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Knowledge distillation trains a small student model on a large teacher's soft outputs so the student approaches the teacher's accuracy.

termDefinitions.meaning: 成通道/层地删掉冗余结构（而非零散权重），直接缩小模型并利于硬件加速。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Structured pruning removes whole channels or layers of redundancy (not scattered weights), directly shrinking the model and helping hardware acceleration.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把权重和激活从 FP32 降到 8 位整数，省约 4 倍内存并提速，略损精度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: INT8 quantization lowers weights and activations from FP32 to 8-bit integers, saving ~4x memory and speeding up at a small accuracy cost.

q: 把 AV 检测模型的 OTA 更新流水线按安全顺序排列：
q_en: Order the AV detector OTA update pipeline by its safety-gated sequence:
scenario: 1 万辆车要在不进服务站的前提下定期更新检测模型，每一步都带安全门禁。
scenario_en: 10,000 vehicles must periodically update the detector without service-center visits, with a safety gate at each step.
steps: 金丝雀部署到 1–5% 车队，新旧模型 shadow mode 并行（不影响驾驶）
云端训练+全切片评估，必须过每类 FNR 阈值
验证门禁：任一关键切片回归（如行人 FNR 上升）→ 自动叫停
why: 先云端训练+全切片评估过门槛，再金丝雀 1–5% shadow 跑，接着验证门禁发现关键切片回归就自动叫停，最后分档渐进放量。每辆车还在副槽保留旧模型，可无网回滚。比普通 A/B 更严，因为坏更新会造成实体伤害。
why_en: Train and slice-evaluate in the cloud, canary to 1–5% in shadow mode, auto-halt at the validation gate on any critical-slice regression, then progressively roll out with checkpoints.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  T[云端训练+切片评估] --> C[金丝雀 1-5% shadow] --> V{关键切片回归?}
  V -->|是| H[自动叫停/回滚]
  V -->|否| R[渐进放量 10→100%]

termDefinitions.meaning: 空中下发更新：不进服务站、通过网络远程推送新模型/固件到车辆。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: OTA (Over-The-Air) delivers updates remotely over the network to vehicles without a service-center visit.

termDefinitions.meaning: 先把新版本推给一小部分车队(1–5%)观察，无恙再放量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A canary deploy pushes the new version to a small fleet slice (1–5%) to observe before wider rollout.

termDefinitions.meaning: 新模型与旧模型并行运行、只记录不接管驾驶，用于安全对比。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Shadow mode runs the new model alongside the old, only logging and not controlling driving, for a safe comparison.

scenario: OTA 金丝雀阶段聚合指标显示：新模型总体 mAP 微升，但'行人'切片 FNR 上升了。
scenario_en: In the OTA canary stage, aggregate metrics show the new model's overall mAP ticks up but the pedestrian-slice FNR rises.
q: 验证门禁该如何反应？
q_en: How should the validation gate react?
why: 自动叫停：AV 的坏更新造成实体伤害，门槛必须比普通 A/B 更严。任一关键切片回归（行人 FNR 上升）就自动 halt，不看总体 mAP 是否好看——总体涨掩盖不了致命切片退化。
why_en: Auto-halt: a bad AV update causes physical harm, so any critical-slice regression like rising pedestrian FNR halts rollout regardless of overall mAP.
options: 总体 mAP 升了就放行，行人切片的小幅回归下个版本再看
自动叫停：行人 FNR 上升是关键切片回归，AV 坏更新会造成实体伤害，门槛比普通 A/B 更严
把行人切片从验证指标里去掉，让门禁只看总体 mAP，避免误报叫停
手动等一周观察，如果没有事故报告就继续放量
options_en: Ship because overall mAP rose; revisit the small pedestrian-slice regression next version.
Auto-halt: rising pedestrian FNR is a critical-slice regression, and a bad AV update causes physical harm, so the bar is stricter than normal A/B.
Drop the pedestrian slice from the validation metrics so the gate only sees overall mAP and avoids false-halt.
Manually wait a week and keep rolling out if no accident reports come in.
optionExplanations: 错；总体涨掩盖不了行人切片退化，放行等于把已知的致命回归推给全车队。
对；关键切片回归即自动叫停，实体伤害的代价决定门槛必须比推荐系统的 A/B 严得多。
错；删掉行人切片是把安全门禁蒙上眼，正好放过最不能放过的回归。
错；靠'没有事故报告'当放行依据是等出人命，主动门禁的意义就是别等到事故。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — an overall rise cannot mask the pedestrian-slice regression; shipping pushes a known fatal regression to the whole fleet.
Correct — a critical-slice regression triggers auto-halt, and the cost of physical harm makes the bar far stricter than a recommender's A/B.
Wrong — dropping the pedestrian slice blinds the safety gate and lets through exactly the regression you must never allow.
Wrong — using 'no accident reports' as a release criterion waits for casualties; a proactive gate exists precisely so you do not wait for accidents.

termDefinitions.meaning: 放量前的自动检查点：任一关键切片指标回归就阻断并回滚，不看总体是否变好。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A validation gate is an automatic checkpoint before rollout that halts and rolls back on any critical-slice regression, regardless of overall gains.

scenario: 一次 OTA 更新在某些车上表现异常，需要立刻回退，但此刻这些车可能正好没有网络。
scenario_en: An OTA update misbehaves on some vehicles and must revert immediately, but those vehicles may have no connectivity at that moment.
q: 该怎么设计回滚，才能在失败当下不依赖网络？
q_en: How should rollback be designed so it does not depend on connectivity at failure time?
why: 每辆车在副槽（secondary slot）保留上一版模型，回滚只是本地切回旧槽，失败当下不需要联网。这把'回退'从一次网络下载变成一次本地开关，断网也能自救。
why_en: Keep the prior model in a secondary slot on every vehicle so rollback is a local switch to the old slot, needing no network at failure time.
tradeoff: 本地双槽(占存储但断网可回滚) vs 依赖云端重推(省存储但失败时可能无网)
whenOtherWins: 若设备存储极其紧张、且能保证回滚时段一定有网（如车库充电时统一回退），才考虑不常驻旧模型、靠云端重推——但会牺牲失败当下的即时性。
options: 回滚时从云端重新下载旧模型，简单且不占车载存储
每辆车在副槽常驻上一版模型，回滚=本地切回旧槽，失败当下无需联网
出问题就让车停在原地等联网，联网后再决定是否回退
不保留旧模型，回滚就是重新训练一个新模型推下去
options_en: On rollback, re-download the old model from the cloud — simple and uses no on-board storage.
Keep the prior model resident in a secondary slot on every vehicle, so rollback is a local switch to the old slot needing no network at failure time.
On a problem, park the car and wait for connectivity, then decide whether to revert.
Keep no old model; rollback means training a fresh model and pushing it down.
optionExplanations: 错；失败当下可能正好断网，靠云端重下就回不了滚，等于没有回退能力。
对；旧模型常驻本地副槽，回退是即时本地切换，与网络无关，才是安全的回滚设计。
错；出问题却停等联网，把车卡在危险状态，回退时机被网络绑架。
错；重新训练要几小时到几天，完全来不及做即时回滚，方向不对。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — the failure moment may coincide with a network drop, so re-downloading cannot roll back, leaving no revert capability.
Correct — the old model resident in a local secondary slot makes revert an instant local switch independent of the network, the safe rollback design.
Wrong — parking and waiting for connectivity strands the car in a dangerous state, letting the network dictate revert timing.
Wrong — retraining takes hours to days, far too slow for an instant rollback, the wrong direction.

termDefinitions.meaning: 车载保留上一版模型的存储槽，回滚时本地切换，无需重新下载。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A secondary slot is on-board storage holding the previous model version so rollback is a local switch without re-downloading.

scenario: OTA 下发几百 MB 的模型时，下载可能中断、文件可能损坏，而车可能正在行驶。
scenario_en: When OTA pushes a few-hundred-MB model, the download can break, files can corrupt, and the car may be driving.
q: OTA 不是原子操作，落地时要注意哪些点？
q_en: OTA is not atomic — what must you handle when landing the update?
why: OTA 非原子：要能处理断点续传/部分下载，用 checksum 校验完整性再启用，且只在车安全时（停放/静止）才切换激活模型。绝不能在行驶中把感知模型换到一个半下载/损坏的版本。
why_en: OTA is not atomic, so handle partial downloads, verify integrity via checksums, and only swap the active model when the vehicle is safe (parked or stationary).
options: 下载完立刻热切换，无论车在不在行驶，越快生效越安全
只要网络快，部分下载和损坏就不会发生，不用额外校验
处理部分下载/断点续传，用 checksum 校验完整性，只在车停放/静止时才切换激活模型
把模型拆成极小分片逐帧替换，行驶中边开边换即可
options_en: Hot-swap the moment download finishes, driving or not; the faster it takes effect the safer.
As long as the network is fast, partial downloads and corruption never happen, so no extra verification is needed.
Handle partial downloads/resume, verify integrity with a checksum, and only swap the active model when the vehicle is parked or stationary.
Split the model into tiny shards and replace them frame by frame while driving.
optionExplanations: 错；行驶中热切感知模型，一旦换到半成品就是行驶中失去检测，恰恰最危险。
错；网络再快也可能中断，跳过校验会把损坏模型当好模型加载，赌不起。
对；先校验完整、再挑安全时机切换，把'非原子更新'的风险隔离在不影响驾驶的时刻。
错；逐帧替换让模型处于半新半旧的不一致状态，比整包切换更危险，且实现不现实。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — hot-swapping the perception model while driving means losing detection mid-drive if it swaps to a half-baked build, the most dangerous case.
Wrong — however fast the network, it can still drop; skipping verification loads a corrupt model as if good, an unaffordable gamble.
Correct — verify integrity first, then swap only at a safe moment, isolating the non-atomic update's risk to when it cannot affect driving.
Wrong — frame-by-frame replacement leaves the model in an inconsistent half-old-half-new state, more dangerous than a whole swap and unrealistic to implement.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对下载内容算一个摘要并与预期比对，用来检测传输损坏或不完整。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A checksum is a digest computed over downloaded content and compared to an expected value to detect corruption or incompleteness.

termDefinitions.meaning: 要么完整生效、要么完全不生效，中间不留半成品状态；OTA 本身不满足，需人为保证。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An atomic update either fully applies or not at all with no half-done state; OTA is not inherently atomic and must be engineered to behave so.

scenario: 要在生产中监控检测模型的分布漂移，需要几条互补信号来区分'真实世界变了'和'硬件坏了'。
scenario_en: To monitor detector distribution shift in production, you need complementary signals to tell 'the world changed' from 'the hardware broke'.
q: 监控分布漂移应该看哪些互补信号？(多选)
q_en: Which complementary signals should you watch for distribution shift? (multiple)
why: 三条互补信号：①预测分布（置信度、类别频率、框尺寸随时间变化）②上游数据质量（脏镜头/歪 LiDAR，看亮度直方图、清晰度、传感器健康）③下游反馈（规划器频繁推翻检测或急停）。三者一起才能区分真实漂移与硬件故障。
why_en: Three complementary signals: prediction distribution, upstream data quality (dirty cameras/misaligned LiDAR), and downstream feedback (planner overriding detections), which together separate real shift from hardware faults.
options: 预测分布：置信度、类别频率、框尺寸随时间的变化
上游数据质量：亮度直方图、清晰度、传感器健康遥测（脏镜头/歪 LiDAR）
下游反馈：规划器推翻检测或在检测报'无障碍'时触发急停
车载娱乐系统的用户点击率随时间的变化
options_en: Prediction distribution: confidence scores, class frequencies, and box sizes over time.
Upstream data quality: brightness histograms, sharpness, and sensor-health telemetry (dirty cameras/misaligned LiDAR).
Downstream feedback: the planner overriding detections or triggering emergency stops when the detector reported no obstacle.
The infotainment system's user click-through rate over time.
optionExplanations: 对；预测分布变化（如某区域行人检测骤减而车流未变）是输入漂移的第一手信号。
对；把硬件脏污/失准和真实世界变化分开，靠的是上游数据质量遥测，避免误判。
对；规划器频繁纠正或急停，是'检测其实漏了但置信度没体现'的下游证据。
错；娱乐系统点击率和检测分布漂移毫无关系，属于无关业务指标。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — a change in prediction distribution (e.g. pedestrian detections dropping in a region with unchanged traffic) is first-hand evidence of input drift.
Correct — separating hardware dirt/misalignment from real-world change relies on upstream data-quality telemetry to avoid misattribution.
Correct — frequent planner corrections or emergency stops are downstream evidence that detection actually missed even though confidence did not show it.
Incorrect — infotainment click-through has nothing to do with detection distribution shift; it is an unrelated business metric.

termDefinitions.meaning: 生产数据分布随时间偏离训练分布(新天气/新场景/传感器变化)，导致模型静默退化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Distribution shift is production data drifting away from the training distribution over time (new weather, scenes, sensor changes), causing silent model degradation.

scenario: 一辆车在雾里置信度骤降 vs 500 辆车同区域同时置信度骤降，你要判断这是不是真的漂移。
scenario_en: One vehicle's confidence drops in fog vs 500 vehicles dropping in the same region at once — you must decide if it is real drift.
q: '车队规模'如何给漂移检测提供统计功效？
q_en: How does fleet scale give drift detection statistical power?
why: 单车在雾里置信度掉只是轶事（可能个体噪声）；500 辆同区域一起掉才有统计显著性=真漂移。车队规模把'偶发个例'累积成'可信信号'，所以要在车队层面持续算每切片指标，越过阈值就触发定向采数。
why_en: One vehicle dropping is an anecdote (possible noise), while 500 dropping in one region is statistically significant real drift, so fleet scale turns noise into a trustworthy signal.
options: 单车样本就够判漂移，车队规模只是冗余，不增加可信度
车队越大噪声越多，反而更难判断漂移，应只看单车信号
单车掉分是轶事(可能噪声)，500 辆同区域同时掉才统计显著=真漂移；车队规模把个例变可信信号
只要有一辆车报异常就立即全车队回滚，规模只用来加快回滚
options_en: A single vehicle's sample suffices to judge drift; fleet scale is just redundancy and adds no confidence.
A bigger fleet has more noise and makes drift harder to judge, so watch only single-vehicle signals.
One vehicle's drop is an anecdote (possible noise), while 500 in one region dropping together is statistically significant real drift; fleet scale turns anecdotes into a trustworthy signal.
As soon as one vehicle reports an anomaly, roll back the whole fleet; scale is only for faster rollback.
optionExplanations: 错；单车可能只是脏镜头或偶发遮挡，样本量不足以把它和真实漂移区分开。
说反了；样本越多个体噪声越会被平均掉，聚合信号反而更清晰，不是更糊。
对；大数定律下，同区域大量车同时同向变化几乎排除偶然，是真分布漂移的可信证据。
错；单车异常远不足以触发全车队回滚，那会因个体噪声频繁误动作，规模的价值是提供统计功效。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — a single vehicle may just have a dirty lens or a one-off occlusion; the sample is too small to separate it from real drift.
Backwards — more samples average out individual noise, making the aggregate signal clearer, not blurrier.
Correct — by the law of large numbers, many vehicles in one region changing the same way at once nearly rules out chance, credible evidence of real drift.
Wrong — a single anomaly is far too little to roll back the whole fleet and would misfire on noise; scale's value is providing statistical power.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从数据中可靠检出真实效应(此处真漂移)的能力，样本量越大功效越高。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Statistical power is the ability to reliably detect a real effect (here true drift) from data; larger samples give higher power.

scenario: 某区域连续两周行人置信度下降 15%，其他类别稳定；团队靠人每周看一次 dashboard。
scenario_en: A region shows a 15% pedestrian-confidence drop over two weeks while other classes stay stable; the team eyeballs a dashboard weekly.
q: 生产监控该怎么设计才够格？
q_en: How should production monitoring be designed to be adequate?
why: 监控必须是带告警的自动化流水线：持续算每切片指标，切片 FNR/置信度越阈值就自动触发定向采数喂下一轮训练，严重时联动 OTA。靠人每周看 dashboard 太慢，漂移在两次查看之间就可能酿成事故。
why_en: Monitoring must be an automated pipeline with alerting that continuously computes per-slice metrics and auto-triggers targeted data collection, and OTA if severe, not a weekly human dashboard.
tradeoff: 自动化流水线(持续+及时联动) vs 人工周报(便宜但滞后、漏检漂移)
diagram:
flowchart LR
  M[持续算每切片指标] --> A{越阈值?}
  A -->|否| M
  A -->|是| D[自动触发定向采数] --> R[喂下一轮训练]
  A -->|严重| O[联动 OTA 更新]
whenOtherWins: 在早期原型或车队极小、无实时安全后果时，人工周报可作为低成本起点；一旦规模化上路就必须自动化。
options: 维持人工每周看 dashboard，成本低、够用，出问题再人工处理
带告警的自动化流水线：持续算每切片指标，越阈值自动触发定向采数，严重时联动 OTA
只在用户投诉后才启动排查，没投诉说明系统没问题
关掉切片监控只看总体 mAP，减少告警噪声，简化运维
options_en: Keep a weekly human dashboard — cheap and adequate; handle problems manually when they arise.
An automated pipeline with alerting: continuously compute per-slice metrics, auto-trigger targeted data collection on threshold breach, and escalate to OTA if severe.
Only investigate after user complaints; no complaints means the system is fine.
Turn off slice monitoring and watch only overall mAP to cut alert noise and simplify ops.
optionExplanations: 错；每周一看的滞后窗口里漂移可能已酿成事故，安全系统等不起人工节奏。
对；持续计算+阈值告警+自动联动采数/OTA，把漂移从被发现变成被自动响应，才配得上安全场景。
错；等投诉等于等事故，安全监控必须主动，不能靠外部反馈驱动。
错；关掉切片监控正好瞎在尾部漂移上，总体 mAP 恰恰是掩盖切片退化的那个指标。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — in the lag between weekly looks, drift may already cause an accident; a safety system cannot wait on a human cadence.
Correct — continuous computation plus threshold alerting plus auto-escalation to collection/OTA turns drift from discovered into auto-responded, worthy of a safety setting.
Wrong — waiting for complaints is waiting for accidents; safety monitoring must be proactive, not driven by external feedback.
Wrong — turning off slice monitoring blinds you exactly to tail drift, and overall mAP is the very metric that masks slice degradation.

termDefinitions.term: targeted data collection / 定向采数
termDefinitions.meaning: 针对表现下滑的切片(区域/条件)有选择地收集新数据，喂给下一轮训练闭环。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Targeted data collection selectively gathers new data for the slice (region/condition) that is degrading, feeding the next training loop.

q: 把'生产 → 数据 → 评估 → OTA'的闭环按顺序排列：
q_en: Order the closed loop of production to data to evaluation to OTA:
scenario: Staff+ 把部署框成一个与真实世界共同演化的闭环系统，而非一次性上线。
scenario_en: At Staff+, deployment is framed as a closed loop co-evolving with the world, not a one-time launch.
steps: 某切片 FNR 越阈值 → 触发对该切片的定向数据采集
生产车队持续跑，监控每切片指标发现分布漂移
用新数据重训+全切片评估，过安全门禁
经金丝雀+验证门禁的 OTA 把新模型推回车队
why: 闭环：车队生产暴露漂移→定向采集失败切片数据→重训并过切片门禁→OTA 推回车队，再进入下一轮。部署不是终点，而是持续与世界共同演化的系统，这是 Staff+ 的整合视角。
why_en: The loop: production reveals drift, drift triggers targeted collection, retraining passes slice gates, and OTA pushes back to the fleet, making deployment a system that co-evolves with the world.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  P[生产车队监控] --> S[漂移触发定向采数] --> T[重训+切片评估] --> O[OTA 推回车队] --> P

termDefinitions.meaning: 生产监控的产出反馈回数据采集与再训练，模型随真实世界持续演化的自强化循环。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A closed loop feeds production monitoring back into data collection and retraining, a self-reinforcing cycle where the model co-evolves with the world.

scenario: 面试同一道 AV 部署题，L4、L5、Staff+ 候选人答的深度差别很大。
scenario_en: On the same AV deployment question, L4, L5, and Staff+ candidates answer at very different depths.
q: L4、L5、Staff+ 在这道部署题上的关键分野是什么？
q_en: What is the key distinction among L4, L5, and Staff+ on this deployment question?
why: 分野是'整合'不是'更多知识'：L4 说端上推理/量化/定期重训（对但浅）；L5 加边vs云权衡、分阶段 OTA+金丝雀、置信度漂移监控；Staff+ 再加车队级每切片指标、自动合规产物、车载双模型自动回滚，并框成生产→采数→评估→OTA 的闭环。
why_en: The gap is integration, not more knowledge: L4 names on-device inference/quantization, L5 adds edge-vs-cloud and staged OTA with monitoring, and Staff+ frames it all as a fleet-scale closed loop with auto rollback and compliance artifacts.
tradeoff: 罗列更多技术点(L4) vs 把技术点整合成闭环系统(Staff+)
options: 分野在于 Staff+ 知道更冷门的算法，L4 只是没学过那些模型
分野在于 Staff+ 用更贵的硬件，和答题思路无关
分野是整合度：L4 点技术点(浅)，L5 加权衡+分阶段 OTA，Staff+ 框成车队级闭环+自动回滚+合规产物
分野在于 L4 更关注延迟，Staff+ 完全不管延迟只谈业务
options_en: The gap is that Staff+ knows more obscure algorithms and L4 just never learned those models.
The gap is that Staff+ uses more expensive hardware, unrelated to how they answer.
The gap is integration: L4 lists techniques (shallow), L5 adds trade-offs plus staged OTA, and Staff+ frames a fleet-scale closed loop with auto rollback and compliance artifacts.
The gap is that L4 cares about latency while Staff+ ignores latency and only talks business.
optionExplanations: 错；本课明确说差距不是'更多知识'，而是把已知点整合成系统的能力。
错；分野是思维层次不是硬件预算，同样硬件下 Staff+ 也能给出更整合的设计。
对；从罗列技术到整合成'生产→采数→评估→OTA'闭环并带自动回滚/合规，是层级跃迁的实质。
错；Staff+ 恰恰把延迟当安全约束的一部分整合进来，不是不管延迟。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — the lesson explicitly says the gap is not 'more knowledge' but the ability to integrate known points into a system.
Wrong — the distinction is level of thinking, not hardware budget; on the same hardware Staff+ still gives a more integrated design.
Correct — moving from listing techniques to integrating a production-to-collection-to-evaluation-to-OTA loop with auto rollback and compliance is the substance of the level jump.
Wrong — Staff+ actually integrates latency as part of the safety constraint rather than ignoring it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把单点技术组织成相互衔接的闭环系统的能力，是高级别与初级别的核心区别。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Integration is the ability to organize point techniques into an interlocking closed-loop system, the core difference between senior and junior levels.

scenario: 要向团队一图讲清'为什么安全推理必须在边缘'，需要把边缘和云端在多个维度上并排比较。
scenario_en: To show the team in one view why safety inference must be at the edge, compare edge and cloud side by side across dimensions.
q: 在延迟、断网失效模式、ISO 26262 这几个维度上，边缘和云端怎么比？
q_en: On latency, outage failure mode, and ISO 26262, how do edge and cloud compare?
why: 边缘：5–50ms 本地、断网优雅降级、满足 ISO 26262 可用性，但车载硬件贵、模型受 ≤200MB/功耗约束、更新靠复杂 OTA。云端：100–500ms 往返、断网整感知失效、不满足可用性，但硬件便宜、模型不受限、换模型即时。安全维度上边缘完胜。
why_en: Edge is 5–50ms on-device, degrades gracefully offline, and meets ISO 26262 availability but has costly hardware and OTA updates; cloud is 100–500ms, fails totally offline, and does not meet availability though hardware is cheap and swaps are instant.
tradeoff: 边缘(安全维度全胜：延迟/可用性) vs 云端(成本与更新便利，但断网全瞎)
options: 两者在安全维度基本等价，选谁只看硬件成本
云端在延迟和断网失效上都更优，因为服务器算力强
边缘 5–50ms 本地、断网优雅降级、满足 ISO 26262；云端 100–500ms、断网整感知失效、不满足可用性
边缘唯一优势是省流量，延迟和可用性其实和云端一样
options_en: They are roughly equivalent on safety, so choose purely by hardware cost.
Cloud is better on both latency and outage failure because servers have stronger compute.
Edge is 5–50ms on-device, degrades gracefully offline, and meets ISO 26262; cloud is 100–500ms, fails totally offline, and does not meet availability.
Edge's only advantage is saving bandwidth; its latency and availability are actually the same as cloud.
optionExplanations: 错；安全维度上两者天差地别——延迟和断网可用性差一个数量级，不能只看成本。
说反了；服务器再强也压不掉物理往返，断网时云端是整感知失效，安全维度是云端劣势。
对；边缘在延迟、断网降级、可用性三条安全维度全胜，代价是硬件成本和更新复杂度，取舍清晰。
错；边缘的核心优势正是低延迟和断网可用，把它贬成'只省流量'完全看错了取舍轴。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — the safety dimensions differ enormously; latency and offline availability are an order of magnitude apart, so cost alone cannot decide.
Backwards — however strong the servers, they cannot erase the physical round-trip, and on a drop cloud is total perception loss, a cloud weakness on safety.
Correct — edge wins on latency, offline degradation, and availability, at the cost of hardware and update complexity, a clear trade-off.
Wrong — edge's core advantages are low latency and offline availability; reducing it to 'saving bandwidth' misreads the trade-off axis.

termDefinitions.term: outage failure mode / 断网失效模式
termDefinitions.meaning: 网络中断时系统的行为：边缘优雅降级(本地仍推理)，云端整感知失效。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The outage failure mode is how the system behaves on a network drop: edge degrades gracefully with local inference while cloud loses all perception.

scenario: 检测器对某障碍报'无、置信度也不低'，但规划器却频繁在该位置触发急停或推翻检测。
scenario_en: The detector reports 'no obstacle' with not-low confidence, yet the planner keeps triggering emergency stops there or overriding the detection.
q: 为什么下游反馈能抓到置信度分数漏掉的检测失败？
q_en: Why can downstream feedback catch detection failures that confidence scores miss?
why: 置信度只反映模型对自己输出的自信，抓不到'自信地漏检'。规划器推翻检测或在检测报无障碍时急停，等于另一条独立信号在说'这里其实有东西'——下游行为暴露了置信度看不见的静默漏检。
why_en: Confidence only reflects the model's self-certainty and misses confident misses, while the planner overriding or emergency-stopping is an independent signal that something is really there.
options: 因为规划器能重新跑一遍检测模型，比原检测更准
因为下游反馈就是置信度的另一种叫法，本质是同一个信号
置信度只反映模型自信、抓不到'自信地漏检'；规划器推翻/急停是独立信号，暴露静默漏检
因为急停一定意味着检测出错，规划器从不会误触发
options_en: Because the planner re-runs the detection model and is more accurate than the original detector.
Because downstream feedback is just another name for confidence, essentially the same signal.
Confidence only reflects self-certainty and misses confident misses; the planner overriding or emergency-stopping is an independent signal exposing silent misses.
Because an emergency stop always means detection erred, and the planner never misfires.
optionExplanations: 错；规划器不是重跑检测，它用运动/轨迹等其他线索，是不同来源的独立证据。
错；下游反馈来自规划器行为，和检测头的置信度是两个独立信号，不是同一个。
对；独立信号才能戳破'高置信度的漏检'，这正是只看置信度监控的盲区。
错；规划器也可能误触发(如噪声)，所以要聚合多次、结合车队统计，不能单次就判死。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — the planner does not re-run detection; it uses other cues like motion and trajectory, an independent source of evidence.
Wrong — downstream feedback comes from planner behavior, a separate signal from the detection head's confidence, not the same one.
Correct — only an independent signal can pierce a high-confidence miss, exactly the blind spot of confidence-only monitoring.
Wrong — the planner can also misfire (e.g. on noise), so aggregate over many events and fleet statistics rather than condemning on one.

termDefinitions.meaning: 感知的下游模块(规划/控制)的行为信号，如推翻检测或急停，可暴露置信度看不见的漏检。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Downstream feedback is behavioral signal from perception's consumers (planning/control), like overriding detections or emergency stops, revealing misses confidence cannot see.

scenario: 面试里你决定把'边缘推理'讲成什么，会直接影响面试官对你级别(L4 vs L5/Staff+)的判断。
scenario_en: In the interview, how you frame 'edge inference' directly shapes the interviewer's read of your level (L4 vs L5/Staff+).
q: 该把'边缘推理'框成什么，才显出高级别？
q_en: How should you frame 'edge inference' to signal seniority?
why: 框成安全需求，不是性能优化：边缘不是'为了快一点'，而是断网/延迟物理约束下守住功能安全与 ISO 26262 可用性的必需。这个措辞体现监管意识，是 L5/Staff+ 与 L4 的分水岭。
why_en: Frame edge inference as a safety requirement, not a performance optimization: it is required to meet functional safety and ISO 26262 availability under latency and outage physics, which signals regulatory awareness.
tradeoff: 框成安全需求(显监管意识，L5/Staff+) vs 框成性能优化(显浅，L4)
whenOtherWins: 对非安全关键的推理(如车内推荐、语音助手)，把边缘当性能/成本优化来讲是恰当的——只有安全关键感知才必须框成硬需求。
options: 框成一个性能优化：边缘能让检测快一点，锦上添花
框成省成本手段：本地推理省了云端带宽和调用费
框成安全需求：断网/延迟物理约束下守住功能安全与 ISO 26262 可用性的必需，体现监管意识
框成实现细节：放边缘只是工程偏好，和安全或级别无关
options_en: Frame it as a performance optimization: edge makes detection a bit faster, a nice-to-have.
Frame it as cost savings: local inference saves cloud bandwidth and call fees.
Frame it as a safety requirement: required to meet functional safety and ISO 26262 availability under latency/outage physics, signaling regulatory awareness.
Frame it as an implementation detail: edge is just an engineering preference, unrelated to safety or level.
optionExplanations: 错；说成'快一点'把硬安全约束降格为可选优化，正是 L4 的浅层框法。
错；省成本是次要收益，主线是断网时不能失去感知，成本框法错过了安全本质。
对；把边缘定位成满足功能安全/可用性的硬需求，直接展现监管与安全意识，是高级别信号。
错；边缘对安全关键感知绝非可有可无的偏好，它是达标的前提，框成细节就答漏了重点。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — calling it 'a bit faster' demotes a hard safety constraint to an optional optimization, exactly the shallow L4 framing.
Wrong — cost savings is a secondary benefit; the main line is not losing perception on a drop, and the cost framing misses the safety essence.
Correct — positioning edge as a hard requirement for functional safety and availability directly shows regulatory and safety awareness, a senior signal.
Wrong — for safety-critical perception edge is not an optional preference but a prerequisite to comply, so framing it as a detail misses the point.

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统在故障存在时仍避免不可接受风险的能力，AV 领域由 ISO 26262 规范。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Functional safety is a system's ability to avoid unacceptable risk even under faults, governed for AVs by ISO 26262.

q: 把视觉搜索的核心处理管线按查询时的先后排序：
q_en: Order the core visual-search pipeline as it runs at query time:
scenario: 用户上传一张照片，要在 10 亿图索引上 <200ms 返回相似/可购买结果。
scenario_en: A user uploads a photo and must get similar/shoppable results in under 200ms over a billion-image index.
steps: ANN 近似最近邻检索，从十亿向量里快速取回 top-k 候选
把上传图编码成 embedding 向量
在小得多的 top-k 上做多模态重排(视觉+文本信号)
全程受 <200ms 延迟预算约束，超时要降级
why: 管线：先把查询图编码成 embedding→用 ANN 在十亿级向量里近似检索 top-k→在小候选集上多模态重排→整条链受 <200ms 预算约束。框架决策会级联到每个下游选择。
why_en: Encode the query image to an embedding, retrieve top-k via ANN over a billion vectors, re-rank the small candidate set with multi-modal signals, all under a sub-200ms budget.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  U[上传图] --> E[生成 embedding] --> A["ANN 检索 top-k"] --> R[多模态重排] --> O[结果]

termDefinitions.meaning: 把图像编码成的定长数值向量，语义相近的图在向量空间里距离近。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An embedding is a fixed-length numeric vector encoding an image so semantically similar images are close in vector space.

termDefinitions.meaning: 近似最近邻检索：牺牲少量召回换数量级提速，在十亿向量里可行。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ANN (Approximate Nearest Neighbor) search trades a little recall for orders-of-magnitude speedup, making billion-vector retrieval feasible.

scenario: 接到'用户传照片，看相似结果或可购买商品'的题，你还没画任何框图。
scenario_en: Given 'user uploads a photo, sees similar results or shoppable products,' before you draw any box.
q: 开局第一步最该先做什么？
q_en: What should you pin down first?
why: 先明确并说清你解的是 image-to-image(感知相似)还是 image-to-product(语义商品匹配)，以及为什么。混淆二者是最常见的候选人错误——框架决策会级联到索引语料、训练信号、指标、失败模式每一处。
why_en: First state which formulation you are solving — image-to-image (perceptual similarity) or image-to-product (semantic product matching) — and why, because conflating them is the most common mistake and cascades into every downstream choice.
tradeoff: 先定问题表述再画框(下游一致) vs 直接堆模型(表述含糊、指标打架)
whenOtherWins: 若产品需求已在题面写死(如纯电商'找同款购买')，可略过表述选择、直接按 image-to-product 展开，但仍要一句话点明。
options: 先明确解的是 image-to-image 还是 image-to-product 并说明理由，再画框图
先选定 CNN 还是 ViT 编码器，模型定了再谈需求
先把 ANN 索引结构(HNSW/IVF)选好，检索是核心
先估算 GPU 数量和成本，产能定了再设计
options_en: First state whether you are solving image-to-image or image-to-product and why, then draw the boxes.
First pick the encoder (CNN vs ViT); once the model is set, discuss requirements.
First choose the ANN index structure (HNSW/IVF), since retrieval is the core.
First estimate GPU count and cost; once capacity is set, design the system.
optionExplanations: 对；表述是一切下游的锚——语料、训练信号、指标、失败模式都由它决定，不先定就会各说各话。
错；编码器是实现细节，表述没定就选模型，等于不知道要匹配什么就先造匹配器。
错；索引结构服务于检索目标，目标(感知相似还是商品匹配)未定，选 HNSW/IVF 没有依据。
错；成本估算是产能准备，回答不了'我们到底在匹配什么'这个框架问题。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — the formulation is the anchor for everything downstream — corpus, training signal, metrics, failure modes all follow it — so without it the design talks past itself.
Wrong — the encoder is an implementation detail; picking a model before the formulation is building a matcher before knowing what to match.
Wrong — the index structure serves the retrieval goal; with the goal (perceptual vs product) unset, choosing HNSW/IVF has no basis.
Wrong — cost estimation is capacity prep and cannot answer the framing question of what you are actually matching.

termDefinitions.meaning: 以感知相似为目标：找视觉上像的图(如 Pinterest Lens 探索)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Image-to-image targets perceptual similarity: find visually alike images, like Pinterest Lens explore.

termDefinitions.meaning: 以语义商品匹配为目标：把查询图对到目录里的具体可购买商品(如 Amazon StyleSnap)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Image-to-product targets semantic product matching: map the query image to a specific shoppable catalog item, like Amazon StyleSnap.

scenario: 同一张'红色皮包'照片，图搜图和图搜商品要的东西不一样，训练信号和索引语料也不同。
scenario_en: For the same red-leather-bag photo, image-to-image and image-to-product want different things, with different training signals and index corpora.
q: image-to-image 与 image-to-product 在目标、语料、训练信号上有何区别？
q_en: How do image-to-image and image-to-product differ in objective, corpus, and training signal?
why: 图搜图=感知相似，语料是网络爬图，用视觉对比损失，指标是视觉相关性 precision@k；图搜商品=语义商品匹配，语料是结构化目录(带价格/库存)，用跨模态对比损失训练图-商品对，指标是购买转化/命中率。二者失败模式也不同。
why_en: Image-to-image is perceptual similarity over web-crawled images with a visual contrastive loss and precision@k, while image-to-product is semantic matching over a structured catalog with cross-modal contrastive loss and purchase conversion.
tradeoff: 感知相似(视觉对比损失/网络图) vs 语义商品匹配(跨模态对比损失/目录)
options: 两者只是索引大小不同，目标、训练信号、指标完全一样
图搜图用跨模态损失，图搜商品用纯视觉损失，正好相反
图搜图=感知相似/网络图/视觉对比损失/precision@k；图搜商品=语义匹配/目录/跨模态对比损失/购买转化
图搜商品不需要索引语料，直接实时比对全网商品即可
options_en: They differ only in index size; objective, training signal, and metrics are identical.
Image-to-image uses cross-modal loss and image-to-product uses pure visual loss — exactly reversed.
Image-to-image is perceptual similarity / web images / visual contrastive loss / precision@k; image-to-product is semantic matching / catalog / cross-modal contrastive loss / purchase conversion.
Image-to-product needs no index corpus; just compare against all web products in real time.
optionExplanations: 错；恰恰相反，目标不同导致训练信号和指标全都不同，这正是不能混淆的原因。
说反了；图搜商品才需要跨模态对齐(图对商品文本)，图搜图用视觉对比损失。
对；每一维都由表述决定，这张对照表就是'混淆表述会级联出错'的具体展开。
错；十亿级商品实时全比对不可行，必须建结构化目录索引，这条既错又违背延迟预算。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — on the contrary, different objectives make the training signal and metrics differ throughout, which is exactly why they must not be conflated.
Backwards — image-to-product is the one needing cross-modal alignment (image to product text), while image-to-image uses a visual contrastive loss.
Correct — every dimension follows from the formulation, and this table is the concrete unfolding of how conflating formulations cascades into errors.
Wrong — real-time full comparison over a billion products is infeasible; a structured catalog index is required, so this is both wrong and against the latency budget.

termDefinitions.term: cross-modal contrastive loss / 跨模态对比损失
termDefinitions.meaning: 在图-商品(或图-文)成对样本上训练，把匹配对拉近、非匹配对推远，对齐两种模态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cross-modal contrastive loss trains on paired image-product (or image-text) samples, pulling matches together and pushing non-matches apart to align the two modalities.

termDefinitions.meaning: 返回前 k 个结果里相关的比例，衡量图搜图的视觉相关性质量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Precision@k is the fraction of the top-k results that are relevant, measuring image-to-image visual relevance quality.

scenario: 上线后指标显示：视觉相似结果的 precision@10 很高，但购买转化几乎为零。
scenario_en: In production, precision@10 on visually similar results is high, but purchase conversion is near zero.
q: 这个指标组合说明系统哪里错了？
q_en: What does this metric combination reveal is wrong?
why: 高感知精度+零转化=用错了表述：系统按 image-to-image(视觉相似)优化，但业务目标其实需要 image-to-product(语义商品匹配)。视觉上像不等于是用户想买的那件具体商品，症状就是像但不成单。
why_en: High perceptual precision with zero conversion is the telltale sign of the wrong formulation: it was optimized for image-to-image but the objective needs image-to-product matching.
options: 编码器太弱，换更大的模型就能同时提升 precision 和转化
ANN 召回不够，加大 top-k 就能把转化拉起来
按 image-to-image 优化了，但业务目标需要 image-to-product：视觉像≠是想买的那件商品
延迟太高导致用户流失，优化到 <200ms 转化自然回升
options_en: The encoder is too weak; a bigger model would raise both precision and conversion.
ANN recall is insufficient; increasing top-k would lift conversion.
It was optimized for image-to-image, but the objective needs image-to-product: visually similar is not the specific item the user wants to buy.
Latency is too high causing churn; optimizing to sub-200ms would restore conversion.
optionExplanations: 错；precision@10 已经很高说明视觉匹配没问题，换大模型只会更像，转化仍上不去。
错；召回更多视觉相似图只会加深'像但不对款'的问题，不解决表述错配。
对；症状(高精度零转化)直指表述用错，要引入语义商品匹配而非继续优化视觉相似。
错；延迟高会普遍降体验，但不会造出'精度高却零转化'这种表述性错配的特征信号。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — high precision@10 shows visual matching is fine; a bigger model only makes results more alike while conversion stays flat.
Wrong — recalling more visually similar images deepens the 'similar but wrong item' problem and does not fix the formulation mismatch.
Correct — the symptom (high precision, zero conversion) points squarely at the wrong formulation, needing semantic product matching, not more visual similarity.
Wrong — high latency hurts experience broadly but does not produce the signature of a formulation mismatch, high precision with zero conversion.

termDefinitions.meaning: 真实用户照片(光照/背景/遮挡多变)与干净目录图之间的分布差异，图搜商品必须跨越它。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The domain gap is the distribution difference between real user photos (varied lighting, backgrounds, occlusion) and clean catalog images that image-to-product must bridge.

scenario: 线上 recall 尚可，但 CTR 偏低：用户看到结果却很少点击。
scenario_en: Online recall is acceptable but CTR is low: users see results yet rarely click.
q: recall 可接受但 CTR 低，最该加哪个设计杠杆？
q_en: With acceptable recall but low CTR, which design lever should you add?
why: recall 够说明候选检回来了，CTR 低是排序不吸引人→这是重排问题：加第二阶段重排器，用多模态信号(文本元数据、用户历史)把更相关的往前排。CTR 衡量结果的吸引力/相关性。
why_en: Acceptable recall means candidates are retrieved, so low CTR is a ranking problem: add a second-stage re-ranker using multi-modal signals like text metadata and user history.
tradeoff: 加重排器(修排序、提 CTR) vs 动检索(recall 已够，动它无益)
whenOtherWins: 若 recall 本就不足(候选里根本没有相关项)，先修检索/召回，加重排器也排不出不存在的好结果。
options: 加第二阶段重排器，用文本元数据、用户历史等多模态信号把更相关的往前排
放宽 ANN 阈值召回更多候选，用数量弥补点击率
换更大的图像编码器，让 embedding 更准
缩短延迟预算到 <100ms，让结果出得更快
options_en: Add a second-stage re-ranker using multi-modal signals like text metadata and user history to surface more relevant items first.
Loosen the ANN threshold to recall more candidates, compensating click-through with volume.
Swap in a bigger image encoder for more accurate embeddings.
Shorten the latency budget to sub-100ms so results appear faster.
optionExplanations: 对；recall 已够、点击不行=排序问题，重排器用多模态信号重新排，是对症的杠杆。
错；召回更多不解决'排得不吸引人'，只会把更多平庸结果堆上来，CTR 还是低。
错；embedding 更准提升的是检索，recall 本就可接受，问题在排序不在编码。
错；更快出结果不改变结果本身是否相关，CTR 低是相关性排序问题不是速度问题。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — with recall fine but clicks poor, it is a ranking problem, and a re-ranker with multi-modal signals is the on-target lever.
Wrong — recalling more does not fix 'ranked unattractively' and just piles on mediocre results, keeping CTR low.
Wrong — better embeddings improve retrieval, but recall is already acceptable; the problem is ranking, not encoding.
Wrong — faster results do not change whether results are relevant; low CTR is a relevance-ranking issue, not speed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 结果被点击的比例，衡量结果的吸引力与相关性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CTR (Click-Through Rate) is the fraction of results clicked, measuring their attractiveness and relevance.

termDefinitions.term: second-stage re-ranker / 第二阶段重排器
termDefinitions.meaning: 在检索出的 top-k 上再打分排序的模型，融合视觉+文本+用户信号提升相关性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A second-stage re-ranker rescores the retrieved top-k, fusing visual, text, and user signals to improve relevance.

scenario: CTR 很高(用户爱点)，但购买转化率低：点得多、买得少。
scenario_en: CTR is high (users click a lot) but purchase conversion is low: many clicks, few buys.
q: 高 CTR 但低转化，该加哪个上游模块？
q_en: With high CTR but low conversion, which upstream module should you add?
why: 高 CTR 说明结果吸引点击，但低转化=相关性对不上真实购买意图。在上游加意图分类模块，把查询路由到正确的索引(如'找同款买'路由到商品索引，'找灵感'路由到探索索引)，消除意图错配。
why_en: High CTR with low conversion is a relevance-to-intent mismatch, so add an upstream intent-classification module that routes the query to the correct index.
tradeoff: 上游意图分类(对齐意图、修转化) vs 继续调重排(只提点击、不解意图错配)
whenOtherWins: 若 CTR 本身也低，问题在排序相关性而非意图路由，此时先加重排器；意图分类解决的是'点得多买得少'的意图错配。
options: 继续加大重排器权重，把更吸引点击的结果排更前
在上游加意图分类模块，把查询路由到正确的索引，消除相关性-意图错配
放宽阈值降低 zero-result rate，让更多结果出现
换更快的 ANN，让转化路径响应更快
options_en: Keep increasing the re-ranker weight to push more click-attractive results to the top.
Add an upstream intent-classification module that routes the query to the correct index, removing the relevance-to-intent mismatch.
Loosen thresholds to lower zero-result rate so more results appear.
Switch to a faster ANN so the conversion path responds quicker.
optionExplanations: 错；CTR 已高，继续优化点击只会加剧'点得多买得少'，转化根因是意图错配不是点击不足。
对；意图分类把查询导向对的索引(购买 vs 探索)，让结果匹配真实意图，直击低转化根因。
错；zero-result 不是这里的瓶颈，放阈值反而引入更多不相关结果，转化更差。
错；更快的 ANN 不改变结果是否匹配购买意图，速度救不了意图错配。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — CTR is already high, and optimizing clicks further worsens 'many clicks, few buys'; the root cause is intent mismatch, not too few clicks.
Correct — intent classification routes the query to the right index (buy vs explore) so results match true intent, hitting the low-conversion root cause.
Wrong — zero-result is not the bottleneck here, and loosening thresholds injects more irrelevant results, hurting conversion.
Wrong — a faster ANN does not change whether results match purchase intent; speed cannot fix an intent mismatch.

termDefinitions.term: purchase conversion rate / 购买转化率
termDefinitions.meaning: 产生交易的会话比例，视觉商品搜索的最终营收指标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Purchase conversion rate is the fraction of sessions with a transaction, the ultimate revenue metric for visual product search.

termDefinitions.meaning: 上游判断用户查询意图(购买/探索/审核)并路由到对应索引的模块。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Intent classification is an upstream module that infers the query intent (buy/explore/moderate) and routes it to the matching index.

scenario: zero-result rate 偏高：大量查询没有任何结果越过阈值返回。
scenario_en: Zero-result rate is high: many queries return nothing above threshold.
q: zero-result rate 高，通常怎么修？
q_en: How do you typically fix a high zero-result rate?
why: 高 zero-result 通常是 embedding 覆盖有缺口或过滤太激进→加 ANN 回退层(fallback tiers)：主索引没命中就退到更宽松的索引/阈值再检一次，兜住覆盖。zero-result rate 衡量索引覆盖+embedding 泛化。
why_en: High zero-result usually means embedding gaps or over-aggressive filtering, so add ANN fallback tiers that re-search a looser index/threshold when the primary misses.
tradeoff: 加回退层(提覆盖、降 zero-result) vs 收紧阈值(高精度但更多空结果)
whenOtherWins: 若高 zero-result 是安全/NSFW 过滤误杀合法内容造成的，应先调过滤器阈值，而不是加回退层把不该出的也放出来。
options: 加 ANN 回退层：主索引未命中就退到更宽松索引/阈值再检一次，兜住覆盖
直接返回随机热门结果，保证每个查询都有东西显示
提高相似度阈值，让结果更精准，zero-result 自然下降
关闭意图分类，减少一层过滤
options_en: Add ANN fallback tiers: on a primary miss, re-search a looser index/threshold to cover the query.
Just return random popular results so every query shows something.
Raise the similarity threshold for more precise results, which lowers zero-result.
Turn off intent classification to remove a filtering layer.
optionExplanations: 对；回退层在主索引失手时用更宽松的检索兜底，直接补覆盖缺口，是对 zero-result 的对症修法。
错；返回随机热门是掩盖空结果不是修覆盖，会毁掉相关性和信任。
说反了；提高阈值会让更多查询过不了线，zero-result 只会更高不是更低。
错；意图分类不是 zero-result 的成因，关掉它反而可能把查询导错索引，覆盖更差。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — fallback tiers catch primary misses with a looser search, directly filling the coverage gap, the on-target fix for zero-result.
Wrong — returning random popular items masks empty results rather than fixing coverage and destroys relevance and trust.
Backwards — raising the threshold makes more queries fail the bar, so zero-result rises, not falls.
Wrong — intent classification is not the cause of zero-result; turning it off may misroute queries to the wrong index, worsening coverage.

termDefinitions.meaning: 没有任何结果越过阈值的查询比例，衡量索引覆盖与 embedding 泛化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Zero-result rate is the fraction of queries with no result above threshold, measuring index coverage and embedding generalization.

termDefinitions.term: ANN fallback tiers / ANN 回退层
termDefinitions.meaning: 主索引未命中时依次退到更宽松索引/阈值再检的多级兜底策略。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ANN fallback tiers are staged back-offs that re-search progressively looser indexes/thresholds when the primary index misses.

scenario: 工程师想同时把 zero-result rate、precision、CTR 都做到最好，调一个阈值。
scenario_en: An engineer wants to simultaneously maximize zero-result rate, precision, and CTR by tuning one threshold.
q: 为什么这些指标会互相拉扯，调一个阈值救不了全部？
q_en: Why do these metrics pull against each other so one threshold cannot optimize all?
why: 阈值有内在张力：放松阈值→更多查询有结果，zero-result 降，但混进不相关项，precision/CTR 降；收紧阈值→结果更准，但更多查询变空，zero-result 升。所以是权衡不是同时最优，要按指标层级取舍。
why_en: Relaxing the threshold lowers zero-result but admits irrelevant items and cuts precision/CTR, while tightening does the reverse, so it is a trade-off, not a simultaneous optimum.
tradeoff: 放松阈值(降 zero-result 但降精度) vs 收紧阈值(升精度但升 zero-result)
options: 只要模型够好，一个阈值可以让三个指标同时最优，不存在张力
放松阈值降 zero-result 但混入不相关项降 precision/CTR；收紧则相反——是权衡不能同时最优
三个指标其实同向变化，调阈值时一起升或一起降
阈值只影响延迟，不影响这些质量指标
options_en: With a good enough model, one threshold optimizes all three at once; there is no tension.
Relaxing the threshold lowers zero-result but admits irrelevant items cutting precision/CTR, while tightening reverses it — a trade-off, not a joint optimum.
The three metrics actually move together, rising or falling as one when you tune the threshold.
The threshold only affects latency, not these quality metrics.
optionExplanations: 错；再好的模型也改变不了阈值的方向性张力，放宽和收紧对覆盖与精度的作用天然相反。
对；阈值一头连覆盖一头连精度，动一边必然牺牲另一边，所以要靠指标层级决定取舍点。
说反了；zero-result 与 precision/CTR 恰恰反向，同向是错误直觉。
错；阈值直接决定哪些结果算数，深刻影响覆盖与精度，不只是延迟。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — no model removes the threshold's directional tension; relaxing and tightening inherently act oppositely on coverage and precision.
Correct — the threshold links coverage on one side and precision on the other, so moving one sacrifices the other, and a metric hierarchy sets the operating point.
Backwards — zero-result and precision/CTR move oppositely; treating them as co-directional is the wrong intuition.
Wrong — the threshold decides which results count and deeply affects coverage and precision, not just latency.

termDefinitions.meaning: 结果被接受所需的最低相似度分；放松增覆盖降精度，收紧反之。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The similarity threshold is the minimum score a result needs to be accepted; loosening raises coverage and lowers precision, tightening does the opposite.

q: 把视觉搜索的指标层级从'门槛'到'终极目标'排序：
q_en: Order the visual-search metric hierarchy from gating to ultimate objective:
scenario: L5+ 要把三个业务指标讲成一个层级，而不是并列可互换。
scenario_en: At L5+ you present the three business metrics as a hierarchy, not interchangeable equals.
steps: CTR：结果有没有用(吸引点击、相关)
zero-result rate：功能能不能用(有没有结果返回)
购买转化率：有没有达成业务目标(产生交易)
why: 层级：zero-result rate 先把关功能可用性(连结果都没有就无从谈起)→CTR 衡量结果是否有用→购买转化衡量是否达成业务目标。CTR/转化又能反哺重排器训练形成正循环，但前提是上游检索先surface出足够候选。
why_en: Zero-result rate gates whether the feature works at all, CTR measures usefulness, and purchase conversion measures the business objective, forming a hierarchy.
diagram:
flowchart TB Z["zero-result rate
功能可用性(门槛)"] --> C["CTR
结果有用性"] --> P["购买转化
业务目标"]

termDefinitions.meaning: 把指标按'先决门槛→有用性→终极目标'分层，而非并列互换，指导优化优先级。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A metric hierarchy layers metrics as gating prerequisite, usefulness, and ultimate objective rather than interchangeable equals, guiding optimization priority.

scenario: 要在 10 亿张图上做检索，有人提议直接暴力精确比对查询向量和每一个索引向量。
scenario_en: For retrieval over a billion images, someone proposes brute-force exact comparison of the query vector against every index vector.
q: 十亿级向量的规模，对检索方案意味着什么？
q_en: What does billion-vector scale imply for the retrieval approach?
why: 1B × 256 维 float32 ≈ 1TB 原始向量(10^9 × 256 × 4 字节)。每次查询暴力扫十亿向量在 <200ms 内不可行→必须用 ANN(HNSW/IVF)，牺牲少量召回换数量级提速。这个量级直接否掉暴力精确检索。
why_en: 1B × 256-dim float32 is about 1TB of raw vectors, and brute-force scanning a billion per query cannot fit sub-200ms, so ANN (HNSW/IVF) is required.
options: 十亿向量不大，暴力精确检索在 <200ms 内完全可行，无需 ANN
1B×256维 float32≈1TB，暴力扫十亿向量装不进 <200ms→必须用 ANN 牺牲少量召回换数量级提速
只要把向量降到 8 维，暴力检索就能达标，不需要专门索引
规模问题靠加机器线性扩展即可，单次查询延迟不受影响
options_en: A billion vectors is small; brute-force exact search fits sub-200ms easily, so no ANN is needed.
1B×256-dim float32 is about 1TB, and brute-force scanning a billion per query cannot fit sub-200ms, so ANN is required, trading a little recall for orders-of-magnitude speedup.
Just reduce vectors to 8 dimensions and brute force meets the budget without a special index.
Scale is solved by adding machines linearly; single-query latency is unaffected.
optionExplanations: 错；十亿向量单查询暴力比对是十亿次距离计算，远超 200ms，量级上就不可行。
对；把维度×字节×条数一乘就知道是 TB 级，暴力检索延迟爆表，只能上 ANN 近似。
错；砍到 8 维会严重损失表达力、召回崩塌，是拿相关性换速度的错误取舍。
错；加机器能分片但单次查询仍要在分片里检索，延迟不会因加机器自动达标。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — brute-forcing a billion vectors per query is a billion distance computations, far over 200ms, infeasible at this scale.
Correct — multiplying dims × bytes × count gives terabytes, brute-force latency blows up, so ANN approximation is the only way.
Wrong — cutting to 8 dims cripples expressiveness and collapses recall, a wrong trade of relevance for speed.
Wrong — adding machines shards data but each query still searches within shards; latency does not auto-comply by adding machines.

termDefinitions.term: brute-force exact search / 暴力精确检索
termDefinitions.meaning: 把查询向量和每一个索引向量都算一遍距离取最近，精确但在十亿级不可行。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Brute-force exact search computes the distance to every index vector for the exact nearest neighbors, precise but infeasible at billion scale.

scenario: 决定十亿级向量索引结构，主要候选是 HNSW 和 IVF(常配 PQ)。
scenario_en: Choosing the billion-scale vector index structure, the main candidates are HNSW and IVF (often with PQ).
q: HNSW 和 IVF 作为 ANN 索引，共同点和取舍是什么？
q_en: As ANN indexes, what do HNSW and IVF share and trade off?
why: 两者都是 ANN，用牺牲少量召回换数量级提速。HNSW=分层可导航小世界图，图上贪心跳转找近邻，检索快、内存占用高；IVF=倒排文件把向量聚成簇、只搜相关簇，常配 PQ 压缩省内存，适合超大规模但需调 nprobe。选型看内存预算与召回-延迟目标。
why_en: Both are ANN trading a little recall for huge speedup; HNSW is a navigable small-world graph (fast, memory-heavy) while IVF clusters vectors and searches only relevant clusters (memory-friendly with PQ, needs nprobe tuning).
tradeoff: HNSW(图检索快但吃内存) vs IVF+PQ(省内存、超大规模但要调 nprobe)
options: 两者都是精确检索，区别只是实现语言不同
HNSW 和 IVF 都是 ANN 用少量召回换提速；HNSW 图检索快但吃内存，IVF+PQ 省内存适合超大规模但要调 nprobe
HNSW 是暴力检索的别名，IVF 才是 ANN
IVF 检索一定比 HNSW 更准，因为它搜索所有簇
options_en: Both are exact search, differing only in implementation language.
Both HNSW and IVF are ANN trading a little recall for speed; HNSW's graph search is fast but memory-heavy, while IVF+PQ is memory-friendly for huge scale but needs nprobe tuning.
HNSW is another name for brute force, and only IVF is ANN.
IVF is always more accurate than HNSW because it searches all clusters.
optionExplanations: 错；两者都是近似(ANN)不是精确，且区别在数据结构与内存-召回取舍，不是语言。
对；同为 ANN 但走不同路：图 vs 倒排聚簇，内存与调参代价不同，按预算和目标选。
错；HNSW 是图结构的 ANN，不是暴力检索，这条把概念搞反了。
错；IVF 恰恰只搜相关的少数簇(nprobe 控制)以提速，搜所有簇就退化成暴力了。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — both are approximate (ANN), not exact, and they differ in data structure and memory-recall trade-off, not language.
Correct — both are ANN but take different routes, graph vs inverted clusters, with different memory and tuning costs, chosen by budget and target.
Wrong — HNSW is a graph-based ANN, not brute force; this reverses the concept.
Wrong — IVF deliberately searches only a few relevant clusters (controlled by nprobe) for speed; searching all clusters degenerates to brute force.

termDefinitions.meaning: 分层可导航小世界图：在近邻图上贪心跳转找最近邻，检索快、内存占用较高。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HNSW (Hierarchical Navigable Small World) is a layered proximity graph where greedy hops find nearest neighbors, fast but memory-heavy.

termDefinitions.meaning: 倒排文件索引：把向量聚成簇，查询只搜最相关的若干簇(nprobe)，常配 PQ 压缩。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: IVF (Inverted File Index) clusters vectors and searches only the most relevant clusters (nprobe) per query, often with PQ compression.

termDefinitions.meaning: 乘积量化：把向量切段各自量化压缩，大幅省内存、加速距离近似计算。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PQ (Product Quantization) splits vectors into sub-segments and quantizes each, sharply cutting memory and speeding approximate distance computation.

q: 按 <200ms 预算，把各阶段耗时从大到小排(哪个是主导成本)：
q_en: Order the sub-200ms budget stages from largest to smallest cost:
scenario: 要把 <200ms 预算分配到管线各阶段，先认清哪个阶段最吃时间。
scenario_en: Allocating the sub-200ms budget across pipeline stages, first see which stage dominates.
steps: 重排：10–30ms(多模态打分、业务规则过滤)
embedding 推理：10–50ms GPU(通常是主导成本，ResNet/ViT/CLIP)
ANN 检索：1–10ms(HNSW 遍历 / IVF+PQ 查表)
why: embedding 推理 10–50ms 通常是主导成本→重排 10–30ms→ANN 检索 1–10ms 最快。剩余给上传+预处理(缩放/归一化)+网络序列化。认清 embedding 是大头，优化才有的放矢(如换更小编码器/批处理)。
why_en: Embedding inference (10–50ms) usually dominates, then re-ranking (10–30ms), then ANN retrieval (1–10ms) which is fastest, with the remainder for upload/preprocess/network.
diagram:
flowchart LR E["embedding 10-50ms
主导"] --> R["重排 10-30ms"] --> A["ANN 1-10ms"]

termDefinitions.meaning: 端到端总延迟上限(此处 <200ms)拆分到各阶段的分配，指导每段该压到多少。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A latency budget is the end-to-end latency ceiling (here <200ms) allocated across stages, guiding how much each must be squeezed to.

scenario: 团队想升级/重训 embedding 模型以提升召回，索引里已有十亿条旧向量。
scenario_en: The team wants to retrain/upgrade the embedding model to improve recall, with a billion old vectors already indexed.
q: 重训 embedding 模型会带来什么运营风险，怎么缓解？
q_en: What operational risk does retraining the embedding model create, and how to mitigate?
why: embedding drift：新模型的查询向量和旧索引向量落在不同空间、不可比→必须对十亿级语料全量重建索引(耗时数天)。缓解：embedding 版本化、并行构建新索引、蓝绿部署切换，避免在线中断。
why_en: Embedding drift makes new query vectors incompatible with old indexed vectors (spaces misalign), forcing a multi-day full re-index, mitigated by versioning, parallel builds, and blue-green deployment.
tradeoff: 升级 embedding(提召回) vs 全量重建十亿索引(耗时数天、需蓝绿切换)
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Q[新查询向量] -. 空间不对齐 .-> O[旧索引向量]
  N[并行建新索引 v2] --> BG{蓝绿切换}
  O --> BG
  BG --> S[无缝上线]
options: 重训后新旧向量自动兼容，直接替换模型即可，无需重建索引
只有查询侧受影响，索引不用动，混用新旧向量也没问题
新查询向量与旧索引向量空间不对齐→须全量重建十亿索引(数天)；缓解靠版本化+并行建库+蓝绿部署
重训只影响精度不影响索引，索引结构与模型版本无关
options_en: After retraining, new and old vectors are automatically compatible, so just swap the model with no re-index.
Only the query side is affected; the index stays put and mixing new and old vectors is fine.
New query vectors misalign with old indexed vectors, forcing a full multi-day re-index of a billion, mitigated by versioning, parallel builds, and blue-green deployment.
Retraining only affects accuracy, not the index; index structure is independent of model version.
optionExplanations: 错；不同模型产出不同向量空间，新查询向量对旧索引不可比，混用会检索错乱。
错；查询侧变了索引侧不变=两套空间硬比，相似度失真，混用恰恰是问题本身。
对；空间错配逼出全量重建，蓝绿+版本化+并行建库让重建在后台完成再无缝切换，避免停服。
错；索引里存的正是某版模型的向量，模型换代必然要求索引跟着重建，二者强相关。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — different models produce different vector spaces; new query vectors are incomparable to the old index and mixing causes garbled retrieval.
Wrong — changing the query side but not the index means two spaces compared head-on, distorting similarity; mixing is exactly the problem.
Correct — the space mismatch forces a full rebuild, and blue-green plus versioning plus parallel builds let it finish in the background then switch seamlessly, avoiding downtime.
Wrong — the index stores a specific model version's vectors, so a model change necessarily requires rebuilding the index; they are tightly coupled.

termDefinitions.meaning: 重训 embedding 模型使向量空间改变，旧索引向量与新查询向量不再可比。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Embedding drift is when retraining the embedding model shifts the vector space so old indexed vectors no longer align with new query vectors.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在后台建好新索引(绿)后与旧索引(蓝)瞬时切换，实现无停机上线与快速回退。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Blue-green deployment builds the new index (green) alongside the old (blue) and switches instantly, giving zero-downtime cutover and fast rollback.

scenario: 面试要给'十亿级索引'一个可信的行业锚点，说明这不是纸上谈兵。
scenario_en: You want a credible industry anchor for 'billion-scale index' to show it is not hypothetical.
q: '十亿级图像索引'的现实量级锚点是什么，说明什么？
q_en: What is a real-world anchor for a billion-image index, and what does it establish?
why: Pinterest 索引 50 亿+ 图像，是十亿级检索的真实行业锚点(不是推导值)。它说明该规模是生产常态，直接迫使采用 ANN 与十亿级索引架构，而非把'十亿'当纸面假设。
why_en: Pinterest indexes 5B+ images, a real industry anchor establishing that billion-scale is a production norm that forces ANN and billion-scale index architecture.
options: 行业里最大也就百万级图像，十亿是过度设计
Pinterest 索引 50 亿+ 图像，是十亿级检索的真实锚点，说明该规模是生产常态、逼着上 ANN
十亿只是理论上限，实际系统从不会超过十万级
图像数量和索引架构无关，多少张都用同一套暴力检索
options_en: The industry maxes out at millions of images; a billion is over-engineering.
Pinterest indexes 5B+ images, a real anchor establishing that billion-scale is a production norm forcing ANN.
A billion is only a theoretical ceiling; real systems never exceed hundreds of thousands.
Image count is unrelated to index architecture; any count uses the same brute-force search.
optionExplanations: 错；主流视觉搜索早已十亿级，把它当过度设计是严重低估现实规模。
对；50 亿+ 的真实锚点把'十亿'从假设变成生产常态，直接决定必须用 ANN 与专门索引架构。
错；恰恰相反，生产系统常态就在十亿级以上，十万级是玩具规模。
错；数量级直接决定能否暴力检索，十亿级下暴力不可行,架构必须随规模变。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — mainstream visual search is already billion-scale, so calling it over-engineering badly underestimates reality.
Correct — the 5B+ anchor turns 'a billion' from hypothesis into a production norm that directly mandates ANN and a dedicated index architecture.
Wrong — on the contrary, production systems routinely exceed a billion; hundreds of thousands is toy scale.
Wrong — the order of magnitude directly decides whether brute force is possible; at a billion it is infeasible, so architecture must scale with size.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对十亿量级向量建索引以支持检索，Pinterest 达 50 亿+，是行业真实规模。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Billion-scale indexing builds an index over a billion-order vectors for retrieval; Pinterest reaches 5B+, a real industry scale.

scenario: Staff+ 面试里，要把视觉搜索定位成公司级能力，而不是一个孤立功能。
scenario_en: In a Staff+ interview, you position visual search as a company-level capability, not an isolated feature.
q: Staff+ 视角下，视觉搜索该被框成什么？
q_en: At Staff+, how should visual search be framed?
why: 框成平台能力：一套共享 embedding 基础设施服务发现/购物/审核多个场景；多索引架构(目录索引+网络索引并行查询)；带量化重建成本的 embedding 版本化；把离线 recall@k→在线 CTR→季度营收串成指标层级。这体现从功能到平台的整合思维。
why_en: Frame it as a platform capability on shared embedding infra serving discovery/shopping/moderation, with a multi-index architecture querying catalog and web indexes in parallel and a metric hierarchy from recall@k to CTR to revenue.
tradeoff: 平台能力(共享 embedding、多索引、指标层级) vs 单点功能(只做一条查询流)
whenOtherWins: 在早期 MVP、只需验证单一图搜图场景时，做成单一功能更快落地；平台化在多场景复用和规模化时才回本。
options: 框成一个独立小功能：只做图搜图一条查询流，够用就行
框成平台能力：共享 embedding 基础设施服务发现/购物/审核，多索引并行，指标层级串到营收
框成一次性项目：上线后不再演化，不需要版本化或多索引
框成纯模型问题：把精力全放在训练更大的编码器上
options_en: Frame it as a standalone mini-feature: just one image-to-image query flow, good enough.
Frame it as a platform capability: shared embedding infra serving discovery/shopping/moderation, multi-index in parallel, metric hierarchy tied to revenue.
Frame it as a one-off project: no evolution after launch, no versioning or multi-index needed.
Frame it as a pure model problem: put all effort into training a bigger encoder.
optionExplanations: 错；只做一条查询流是 L4 视角，错过了共享基础设施与多场景复用的平台价值。
对；共享 embedding+多索引并行+recall→CTR→营收的层级，正是从功能上升到平台的 Staff+ 整合。
错；embedding drift 与业务演化决定它必须持续版本化，一次性项目框法站不住。
错；本课明确说多数人过度准备模型层、准备不足 scoping，纯模型框法正踩这个坑。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — one query flow is the L4 view and misses the platform value of shared infra and multi-scenario reuse.
Correct — shared embeddings plus parallel multi-index plus a recall-to-CTR-to-revenue hierarchy is exactly the Staff+ integration from feature to platform.
Wrong — embedding drift and business evolution require ongoing versioning, so a one-off framing does not hold.
Wrong — the lesson explicitly says most people over-prepare the model layer and under-prepare scoping, and a pure-model framing walks into that trap.

termDefinitions.meaning: 并行查询多个专用索引(如商品目录索引+网络图索引)再融合结果，服务不同意图。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A multi-index architecture queries multiple specialized indexes in parallel (e.g. catalog and web) and fuses results to serve different intents.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把某功能建成可被多场景(发现/购物/审核)复用的共享基础设施，而非孤立特性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A platform capability builds a function as shared infrastructure reusable across scenarios (discovery/shopping/moderation) rather than an isolated feature.

scenario: 团队想用点击/购买数据反哺重排器训练，形成越用越准的正循环。
scenario_en: The team wants click/purchase data to feed re-ranker training, forming a virtuous cycle that improves with use.
q: 这个'正循环'成立的前提是什么？
q_en: What is the precondition for this virtuous cycle to hold?
why: CTR/转化数据能反哺重排器训练形成正循环，但前提是上游检索先 surface 出足够多的相关候选——没有好候选，就没有有意义的点击信号可学，循环空转。所以检索召回是这个飞轮的入口闸门。
why_en: CTR/conversion data can train the re-ranker in a virtuous cycle only if upstream retrieval first surfaces enough relevant candidates, otherwise there is no meaningful click signal to learn from.
options: 只要有用户流量，循环就自动成立，和检索质量无关
前提是上游检索先 surface 出足够相关候选，否则没有有意义的点击信号可学，飞轮空转
前提是把延迟压到 0，用户才会产生足够点击
前提是关闭 zero-result 兜底，只留最相关的一个结果
options_en: Any user traffic makes the cycle self-sustaining, regardless of retrieval quality.
The precondition is that upstream retrieval first surfaces enough relevant candidates, else there is no meaningful click signal to learn from and the flywheel spins empty.
The precondition is driving latency to zero so users generate enough clicks.
The precondition is disabling zero-result fallback and keeping only the single most relevant result.
optionExplanations: 错；有流量但候选都不相关，点击数据也是噪声，学不出更好的排序，循环无从建立。
对；重排器只能在检索给的候选里重排，候选里没有好结果，反哺信号就无价值，检索召回是入口闸门。
错；延迟为 0 不可能也非关键,循环的瓶颈是候选相关性不是速度。
错；只留一个结果反而扼杀探索与点击多样性，采不到足够训练信号，与正循环相悖。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — with traffic but irrelevant candidates, click data is noise that cannot teach better ranking, so the cycle never forms.
Correct — the re-ranker can only reorder the candidates retrieval gives it; without good ones the feedback signal is worthless, making retrieval recall the entry gate.
Wrong — zero latency is impossible and not the point; the cycle's bottleneck is candidate relevance, not speed.
Wrong — keeping a single result kills exploration and click diversity, starving training signal, against the virtuous cycle.

termDefinitions.meaning: 线上点击/购买数据反哺重排器训练、模型再改善体验的自强化循环，需上游召回足够候选。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A virtuous cycle feeds online click/purchase data back into re-ranker training so the model improves the experience, requiring upstream recall to surface enough candidates.

scenario: 图搜商品要把用户随手拍的真实照片(杂乱光照/背景/遮挡)对到干净的目录商品图。
scenario_en: Image-to-product must map a user's casual real photo (messy lighting, background, occlusion) to a clean catalog product image.
q: 为什么图搜商品必须跨越'域差'，不跨越会怎样？
q_en: Why must image-to-product bridge a domain gap, and what happens if it does not?
why: 真实照片和目录图分布不同(光照/背景/遮挡差异)=域差。若 embedding 只在干净目录图上学，遇到真实照片就对不准，检回视觉相近但错款的结果。要用真实-目录成对数据做跨模态/域适应训练来跨越它。
why_en: Real photos and catalog images have different distributions (lighting, background, occlusion), so an embedding trained only on clean catalog images misaligns on real photos and returns similar-looking wrong products.
tradeoff: 用真实-目录成对数据训练(跨域但贵) vs 只用干净目录图(便宜但真实照片对不准)
options: 域差不存在，只要分辨率一致，真实照片和目录图对模型没区别
真实照片与目录图分布不同(光照/背景/遮挡)；只学目录图会在真实照片上对不准、检回错款
跨越域差只需把用户照片调成黑白，消除颜色差异即可
域差只影响延迟不影响准确率，压缩预处理就能解决
options_en: There is no domain gap; as long as resolution matches, real photos and catalog images look the same to the model.
Real photos and catalog images have different distributions (lighting/background/occlusion); training only on catalog images misaligns on real photos and returns wrong products.
Bridging the gap just needs converting user photos to grayscale to remove color differences.
The domain gap only affects latency, not accuracy, and compressing preprocessing solves it.
optionExplanations: 错；分辨率一致解决不了光照/背景/遮挡带来的分布差异，域差是真实存在的核心难点。
对；分布不一致会让 embedding 空间对不齐，必须用真实-目录成对数据训练来弥合，否则错款频出。
错；转黑白丢信息更糟，域差是多因素分布差异，不是单一颜色问题。
错；域差是准确率(匹配对不对)问题，不是延迟问题，预处理压缩救不了。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — matching resolution does not fix the distribution difference from lighting/background/occlusion; the domain gap is a real core difficulty.
Correct — a distribution mismatch misaligns the embedding space, so real-photo-to-catalog paired training is needed to bridge it, or wrong products keep appearing.
Wrong — grayscale discards information and worsens it; the gap is a multi-factor distribution difference, not a single color issue.
Wrong — the domain gap is an accuracy (correct-match) problem, not latency, so preprocessing compression cannot solve it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 让模型在源域(干净目录图)学到的能力迁移到目标域(真实用户照片)的训练技术。
