optionExplanations: 对高维表格特征来说，这类基于随机切分树的方法计算高效、不用假设特定的数据分布，适合拿来做元数据和基础活动特征的第一道快速筛查。
autoencoder 更适合复杂序列模式，成本远超「快速筛查」这个目标所需。
人工逐个审查在数十亿账号规模下完全不可扩展。
多模态 LLM 面向内容理解，不适合结构化的元数据特征。
optionExplanations_en: Isolation forest is efficient on high-dimensional tabular features without needing a strong distribution assumption, making it a good first-pass screen for metadata and basic activity features.
Autoencoders suit complex sequential patterns better, at a compute cost far beyond what a quick screen needs.
Manually reviewing every account one by one doesn't scale at billions of accounts.
A multimodal LLM targets content understanding, a poor fit for structured metadata features.

q: autoencoder 做异常检测相比 isolation forest 的优势是什么？
why: autoencoder 学习压缩重构正常行为，重构误差大代表异常；比 isolation forest 更贵，也有学会重构一切的「病理」风险。
why_en: Autoencoders can capture complex sequential and contextual patterns that isolation forests miss, at the cost of higher compute and the risk of learning to reconstruct anomalies too well.
options: 能捕捉更复杂的序列/上下文重构模式
成本永远比 isolation forest 更低
不需要定义任何重构损失
不会把异常也重构出来
tradeoff: autoencoder 的复杂模式表达力 vs isolation forest 的计算效率

termDefinitions.meaning: 学习压缩再重建正常数据，重建误差大的账号更可能异常。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An autoencoder learns to compress and reconstruct normal data, and a large reconstruction error flags an account as anomalous.

options_en: It can capture more complex sequential/contextual reconstruction patterns.
It is unconditionally cheaper than an isolation forest.
It needs no reconstruction loss defined at all.
It never ends up reconstructing anomalies too.
q_en: What advantage does an autoencoder have over isolation forest for anomaly detection?
optionExplanations: 压缩再重建正常行为是自编码器的强项，能捕捉基于随机切分树的筛查方法抓不住的复杂序列/上下文模式，代价是更贵。
实际成本关系是反的：跑一次自编码器通常比那种基于随机切分树的筛查方法更贵。
设计重构损失恰恰是用好 autoencoder 的关键难点。
学会把异常也重构得很好，正是 autoencoder 的已知病理风险。
optionExplanations_en: An autoencoder learns to compress and reconstruct normal behavior, catching complex sequential/contextual patterns isolation forest misses—at higher cost.
The cost relationship is actually reversed—autoencoders usually cost more than isolation forests.
Designing the reconstruction loss is exactly the hard part of using an autoencoder well.
Learning to reconstruct anomalies too well is a known pathology risk for autoencoders.

q: 更合理的异常检测组合方式是什么？
why: 级联利用 isolation forest 的效率做第一道筛查，再用 autoencoder 深查复杂模式，融合分数按置信度组合两者结果。
why_en: A cascaded setup uses isolation forests for cheap first-pass screening and autoencoders for deeper checks on complex sequential patterns, then combines their scores.
scenario: 你既要便宜筛查，又要捕捉复杂的协调行为。
options: isolation forest 先筛，再深入复核
只用成本最贵的那一个模型直接跑全量账号
只依赖纯随机抽样的方式来筛查异常账号
彻底放弃整个异常检测这一处理环节
whenOtherWins: 如果流量很小且序列异常是唯一目标，可以直接用 autoencoder。
tradeoff: 级联组合的成本效率 vs 单一方法各自的局限
options_en: Isolation forest screens first, then a deeper recheck.
Run only that single most expensive model directly on every account.
Rely purely on a random-sampling approach alone to screen for anomalies.
Drop the entire anomaly-detection processing step altogether.
q_en: What is the better way to combine anomaly detectors?
scenario_en: You need cheap first-pass screening and still want to catch complex coordinated behavior.
optionExplanations: 用基于随机切分树的方法先便宜地筛一遍，再用更贵的自编码模型深查复杂协调模式，融合两者结果，兼顾成本和表达力。
全量账号跑最贵的模型，计算成本不可持续。
随机抽样不是针对性筛查，抓不住真正的异常。
放弃异常检测等于丢了发现新型未知 bot 模式的渠道。
optionExplanations_en: Screening cheaply with isolation forest first, then running autoencoders on the flagged subset for complex coordinated patterns, balances cost against expressive power.
Running the most expensive model on every account is an unsustainable compute cost.
Random sampling isn't targeted screening, so it misses real anomalies.
Dropping anomaly detection entirely gives up the channel for finding new, unknown bot patterns.

q: 为什么不能把所有「行为异常」的账号都当成 bot？
why: 异常只是调查信号，还要结合 bot 造成的实际伤害和人工验证，否则会误伤行为独特但合法的边缘真实用户。
why_en: Anomaly scores are just a signal for investigation, not proof of harm, so they must be combined with evidence of actual bot impact before any action is taken.
options: 业务关心造成 harm 的异常，而非单纯「奇怪」
异常一定百分之百都代表恶意的攻击行为
异常检测在实践中完全不会产生任何误报
行为奇怪的账号不需要任何形式的保护
options_en: The business cares about harmful anomalies, not just weirdness.
An anomaly is always, one hundred percent, a malicious attack.
Anomaly detection in practice never produces any false positive.
Accounts that behave unusually deserve no protection of any kind.
q_en: Why not treat every behaviorally unusual account as a bot?
optionExplanations: 业务真正关心的是造成伤害的异常，「行为奇怪」只是调查线索，还要结合实际伤害证据和人工验证才能定性。
很多合法用户的行为在统计上也会显得异常，不能直接等同恶意。
isolation forest 和 autoencoder 都会产生误报。
把奇怪等同该被处置，会误伤只是行为独特的合法边缘用户。
optionExplanations_en: The business really cares about anomalies that cause harm—'looking weird' is just an investigation lead that still needs harm evidence and human verification.
Plenty of legitimate behavior also looks statistically unusual, so anomaly doesn't equal malice.
Both isolation forests and autoencoders produce false positives.
Treating unusual as disposable ends up harming legitimate users who simply behave differently.

q: 按合理顺序排列 bot 检测系统主流程。
why: 先构造多源特征，再用轻模型省计算，重模型处理高风险集合，最后由动作层按置信度执行。
why_en: The bot pipeline gathers multi-source features, filters cheaply with a light model, scores the suspicious subset deeply, then applies calibrated actions.
steps: 根据校准风险采取封禁/降权/限流
轻量模型筛出可疑账号
收集活动、图、内容和元数据特征
重图序列模型深度评分
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Features[Activity graph content meta] --> Light[Light model]
  Light --> Heavy[Heavy score]
  Heavy --> Cal[Calibration]
  Cal --> Actions[Ban demote limit]
q_en: Put the main bot-detection system flow in the right order.

q: 按正确顺序排列 bot 主模型训练策略。
why: 预训练先学平台结构，融合后再定义监督目标，最后用稀缺高质量标签微调与校准。
why_en: The training path pretrains graph and sequence encoders, aligns them, applies an impact-weighted objective, and fine-tunes with trusted labels.
steps: 用调查员标签微调并校准
图侧和序列侧自监督预训练
融合图/序列表示并做对齐
设计影响加权 BCE
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Pre[Self-supervised pretrain] --> Fuse[Graph sequence fusion]
  Fuse --> Loss[Impact-weighted BCE]
  Loss --> Fine[Fine-tune labels]
  Fine --> Cal[Calibrate]
q_en: Put the main bot-model training strategy in the right order.

scenario: 面试官说帖子可以包含文字、图片、视频，但为了控制这轮面试的范围，先只处理文字和图片。
q: 这轮 harmful content 系统设计的输入范围是什么？
options: 只处理文本，图片和视频完全忽略
处理所有模态包括视频，范围不能缩小
处理文本和图片，视频先搁置为后续扩展
只处理图片，文本交给关键词过滤
options_en: Only process text; ignore images and video entirely.
Process every modality including video; the scope cannot shrink.
Process text and images; defer video to a future extension.
Only process images; hand text off to keyword filtering.
why: 面试官已经明确把范围收窄到文本+图片，视频留作未来扩展；把这层约束原样带进设计比自行扩大范围更准确。
why_en: The interviewer explicitly scoped this design to text and images, with video deferred, so the system should match that stated boundary.
optionExplanations: 文本仍是一等输入，不能被忽略。
题目已经明确表态先不做视频。
match，这是面试官给定的范围。
文本同样是主信号，不能只靠关键词。
optionExplanations_en: Text is still a first-class input and cannot be dropped.
The interviewer already scoped video out for this round.
This matches the boundary the interviewer stated.
Text is a primary signal too, not just keyword filtering.
q_en: What input modalities are in scope for this harmful-content design?
scenario_en: The interviewer says posts may contain text, images, and video, but this round should only handle text and images to keep scope controlled.

q: 设计 harmful content 系统前，应向面试官确认哪些关键约束？（多选）
options: 帖子涉及哪些模态、政策覆盖哪些违规类型
命中后能做的动作：删除、降权还是送人工审核
误删和漏判各自的代价，以及多大 precision 才能自动删除
每天发帖量和 harmful 内容的大致占比
options_en: Which modalities posts include and which violation types the policy covers.
What actions are available on a hit: removal, demotion, or human review.
The cost of false positives versus false negatives, and what precision unlocks auto-removal.
Daily post volume and roughly how prevalent harmful content is.
why: 这四类问题决定模型阈值、标注策略、serving 方式和评估口径，缺一个都会让设计假设站不住。
why_en: These four clarifying questions fix the modality scope, available actions, error costs, and scale that the rest of the design depends on.
optionExplanations: 决定模型输入形状和政策标签体系。
决定动作系统要支持哪几种响应。
决定自动删除的 precision guardrail 怎么定。
决定推理成本和类别不平衡的严重程度。
optionExplanations_en: It fixes the model's input modalities and policy taxonomy.
It fixes which actions the system must support.
It sets the precision guardrail for automated removal.
It sets inference cost and how severe the class imbalance is.

termDefinitions.meaning: 删除的内容里，真正有害的比例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Precision is the fraction of removed content that is actually harmful.

q_en: Which constraints should you clarify before designing a harmful-content system? (Select all that apply.)

scenario: 面试官说自动删除前，删除的内容里至少 95% 必须真的有害；模型置信度本身不能直接当作这个百分比。
q: 这个 95% precision guardrail 对自动删除路径意味着什么？
options: 只要模型自己给出的置信度分数达标，就可以直接上线自动删除
阈值要用验证集实测校准，别把 confidence 当 precision
precision 这道门槛只卡人工审核队列，跟能不能自动删除完全无关
只要精确率达到 95%，后续就可以不必再持续监控误删率
options_en: Ship auto-removal the moment the model's own confidence score crosses the threshold.
Calibrate the threshold on a validation set instead of trusting raw confidence.
This precision bar only gates the human-review queue, not whether auto-removal can fire.
Once precision reaches 95%, there is no more need to keep monitoring the false-removal rate.
why: confidence 是模型自己给的分数，precision 是拿验证/回放数据测出来的比例，两者必须分开校准。
why_en: Model confidence and empirical precision are different things, so the removal threshold must be calibrated against held-out labeled data, not just trusted confidence scores.

termDefinitions.meaning: 自动执行某个动作前必须达到的最低精确率门槛。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A precision guardrail is the minimum precision an automated action must meet before it is allowed to fire.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型对自己预测结果的打分，不等于实测精确率。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Confidence is the model's own score for a prediction, which is not the same as measured precision.

termDefinitions.meaning: 被自动删除的内容里，真正违规或有害的比例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Precision is the share of automatically removed content that is truly violating or harmful.

q_en: What does the 95% precision guardrail imply for auto-removal?
scenario_en: Before auto-removal, at least 95% of removed content must truly be harmful; raw model confidence cannot be treated as that percentage.
optionExplanations: 置信度只是模型自己打的分数，没拿留出数据验证过，直接当上线门槛并不可靠。
对，这道门槛得用带标签的验证集实测校准，不能只信任模型自己给的分数。
guardrail 同样管着自动删除这条路径，不会因为还有人工审核队列就被豁免。
95% 只是校准那一刻测出的结果，线上分布会漂移，误删率仍要持续盯着。
optionExplanations_en: Confidence is only the model's own score, never checked against a labeled sample, so shipping on it alone is unreliable.
Right call — calibrate this threshold on a labeled validation set instead of trusting the model's own score.
This guardrail also governs the auto-removal path — a separate human queue doesn't exempt it.
95% is only a snapshot from calibration time; the online distribution drifts, so the false-removal rate still needs ongoing monitoring.

scenario: 面试官说平台每天大约有 1B 条新帖子，harmful 内容占比不到 1%。
q: 这个日发帖规模对系统设计最直接的影响是什么？
options: 可以对所有帖子跑最贵的模型，不用考虑成本
harmful 内容占比低，绝对数量也可以忽略
可以把审核放到每月批处理一次
推理成本、级联过滤和缓存必须成为核心设计
options_en: Run the most expensive model on every post since cost doesn't matter.
Since the harmful rate is low, the absolute volume can be ignored.
Batch moderation once a month is sufficient.
Inference cost, cascading filters, and caching must be core design pieces.
why: 1B/day 让单帖推理成本被放大到十亿级别，即使 harmful 占比 <1%，绝对数量依然很大，必须靠级联和缓存控制成本。
why_en: At roughly a billion posts a day, per-post inference cost is multiplied at massive scale, so cascading filters and caching become central even though harmful content is under one percent.

termDefinitions.meaning: 先用便宜的轻量模型过滤大部分内容，只把可疑的送进昂贵的重模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A cascading filter uses a cheap model to screen most content and only escalates suspicious cases to an expensive model.

q_en: What is the main design impact of this daily post volume?
scenario_en: The platform receives roughly 1B new posts per day, and harmful content is under 1% of posts.
optionExplanations: 1B/day 规模下，每条都跑最贵模型会让总推理成本失控，必须靠分级过滤省钱。
占比虽低于 1%，但乘以 1B 基数后绝对数量仍是百万级，不能当作可以忽略。
有害内容会持续曝光扩散，等一个月批处理会让伤害在这期间无限累积。
对，十亿级流量下这三块必须优先投入设计，否则成本或延迟会先撑不住。
optionExplanations_en: At a billion posts a day, running the priciest model on everything blows up total inference cost; tiering is what keeps it affordable.
Under 1% of a billion posts is still millions of items a day — far too many to wave away as negligible.
Harmful content keeps spreading while it's live; waiting a month for batch review lets the damage pile up.
Right — at billion-scale traffic these three have to be core design pieces, or cost and latency both break.

scenario: 你要给 harmful content 系统定义一个业务目标，而不是直接用模型 accuracy。
q: 最终应该选哪个业务目标？
options: 最大化删除的帖子总数量，完全不管这些帖子内容到底是不是真的违反了平台政策规定
最大化分类 accuracy 这个笼统的整体统计指标，完全不去看用户实际受到的伤害本身
在满足误删 precision guardrail 前提下，最小化 harmful 内容的观看量
只盯着减少人工审核队列这一件事的工作量，完全不管用户实际受到的曝光伤害有多大
options_en: Maximize the number of posts removed, regardless of whether they actually violate stated policy.
Maximize the aggregate classification accuracy metric instead of looking at real user harm itself.
Minimize views of harmful content, subject to a precision guardrail.
Only reduce the human-review workload, regardless of how much exposure harm users actually experience.
why: 用户受到的伤害是有害内容被看到的次数，不是模型分数；按 views 加权还能优先拦住可能爆红的内容。
why_en: The real harm is exposure, not model score, so weighting by views prioritizes catching content before it goes viral, subject to a precision guardrail.
whenOtherWins: 如果业务是纯人工队列排序场景，目标可能更偏向人工审核效率和 SLA。
tradeoff: 曝光量最小化 vs 误删率上限
optionExplanations: 会鼓励过度 flag，牺牲正常用户体验。
accuracy 在类别不平衡下会失真。
对齐真实伤害，且有精确率兜底。
忽略了用户实际受到的曝光伤害。
optionExplanations_en: It rewards over-flagging and hurts legitimate users.
Accuracy is distorted under heavy class imbalance.
It aligns with real user harm and keeps a precision floor.
It ignores the exposure harm users actually experience.

termDefinitions.meaning: 业务目标之外附加的硬性约束，防止优化跑偏。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A guardrail is a hard constraint layered on top of the main objective to keep optimization from going too far.

q_en: Which business objective should this harmful-content system optimize?
scenario_en: You need to define a business objective for a harmful-content system, not just optimize model accuracy.

q: 为什么“删除最多内容”是坏目标？
options: 会让人工审核队伍立刻消失
会鼓励过度 flag，产生大量误删正常内容
会自动满足 precision guardrail
会让 harmful 曝光量降到 0 且没有代价
options_en: It would make the human review team disappear immediately.
It rewards over-flagging and produces heavy false removal of benign content.
It automatically satisfies the precision guardrail.
It would drop harmful exposure to zero at no cost.
why: 分类问题天然有 FP/FN 权衡；只看删除数量的目标会鼓励模型宁可错杀，伤害正常表达。
why_en: Classification always trades off false positives and negatives, so optimizing for raw removal count rewards over-flagging benign content.
optionExplanations: 目标本身不影响人力配置。
删除量目标没有精确率约束。
删得越多，precision 通常越低不是越高。
现实中删除必然伴随误删代价。
optionExplanations_en: This objective does not touch staffing directly.
Raw removal count has no precision constraint attached.
More removals usually push precision down, not up.
Removal always carries some cost of over-flagging in practice.
q_en: Why is “remove as much content as possible” a bad objective?

q: 为什么用 harmful views 而不只是 harmful posts 数量？
options: 曝光越多伤害越大，能优先抓传播广的内容
views 比 posts 更容易做到 100% 标注
posts 数量在业务上无法统计
views 和用户体验完全无关
options_en: More views mean more harm, so it prioritizes widely-spread content.
Views are easier to label completely than posts.
The business cannot count the number of posts.
Views have nothing to do with user experience.
why: 同一条 harmful 帖子，被看 100 万次比被看 0 次伤害大得多，用曝光量能优先处理正在扩散的内容。
why_en: A harmful post seen a million times causes far more harm than one seen zero times, so weighting by views prioritizes content that is actively spreading.
optionExplanations: 直接对齐真实伤害的大小。
标注成本和曝光量无关，说法夸大。
posts 数量本身是可统计的日志量。
views 正是伤害规模的代理指标。
optionExplanations_en: It directly tracks the real magnitude of harm.
Labeling cost is unrelated to view count; this overstates the benefit.
Post counts are simple loggable numbers, not unknowable.
Views are exactly the proxy for how much harm occurred.
q_en: Why optimize harmful views instead of just harmful post count?

q: harmful content 为什么会随时间更容易判断？
options: 帖子发布后内容本身会随时间自动变得更清晰易懂
模型参数会在部署后随时间自动更新到更准确
曝光后用户的举报、隐藏、评论等行为提供了额外信号
图片本身的分辨率会随时间自动提升变清楚
options_en: Post content automatically becomes clearer and easier to read over time.
Model parameters silently improve in accuracy over time after deployment.
User reports, hides, and comments after exposure add extra signal.
Image resolution automatically increases and gets clearer over time.
why: 刚发布时只有内容和作者特征；曝光后用户的负面反应会提供新的行为信号，让判断变容易，这也是要支持 re-trigger 的原因。
why_en: At publish time only content and author features exist, but user reactions after exposure add behavioral signal that makes classification easier over time.
optionExplanations: 内容本身不会随时间改变。
模型不会自动重训，需要显式触发。
这正是行为信号带来的额外证据。
分辨率是固定的，不会随时间提升。
optionExplanations_en: The content itself does not change over time.
Models do not silently retrain; retraining must be triggered.
This is exactly the extra evidence behavioral signals add.
Image resolution is fixed and does not improve over time.
q_en: Why does harmful content become easier to judge over time?

q: harmful content 的核心 ML 建模目标是什么？
options: 多分类：判断具体违规类型
回归：预测帖子会被举报几次
排序：给帖子按有害程度排名返回列表
二分类：判断帖子是否 harmful
options_en: Multi-class: identify the specific violation type.
Regression: predict how many reports a post will get.
Ranking: return a list of posts sorted by harm level.
Binary classification: decide whether a post is harmful.
why: 主分类器先输出一个二元 harmful 风险分数，类型细分和排序都是后续的辅助任务，不是核心 ML 目标。
why_en: The core ML task is a binary harmful-or-not classification; type breakdown and ranking are auxiliary, not the primary objective.
optionExplanations: 类型细分是辅助 head，不是核心目标。
举报次数是特征来源，不是主任务。
没有需要返回排序列表的产品需求。
校准层和动作系统都建在这个二分类之上。
optionExplanations_en: Type breakdown is an auxiliary head, not the core objective.
Report counts are a feature source, not the primary task.
There is no product need for a ranked list here.
The calibration and action layers are built on top of this binary task.
q_en: What is the core ML modeling objective for harmful content?

q: 按正确顺序排列 harmful content 高层流程。
why: 先触发模型评分，再校准到可执行概率，最后按阈值采取不同风险动作。
why_en: The moderation pipeline triggers classification, calibrates the harmfulness score, and then applies removal, demotion, or review actions.
steps: 校准分数以满足 precision guardrail
帖子创建或行为更新触发分类
动作系统删除、降权或送人工审核
多模态分类器输出 harmful 分数
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Trigger[Post or update] --> Model[Multimodal score]
  Model --> Cal[Calibrate]
  Cal --> Action[Remove demote review]

termDefinitions.meaning: 把模型原始分数调整成可信赖的概率，使其对应实际精确率。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Calibration adjusts a model's raw score into a trustworthy probability that matches real-world precision.

q_en: Put the high-level harmful-content pipeline in the correct order.

q: 初始 50k 标注集（约 50% harmful / 50% benign）对训练意味着什么？
options: 可以直接把这批数据当成线上真实分布来训练和评估模型，不用再调整
适合初始训练，但评估和阈值仍要按线上 <1% 的真实占比来标定
五万条标注数据规模太小，对起步训练完全没有任何价值可言
只能用来训练图片编码器这一个组件，没法训练完整的分类器
options_en: Treat this whole batch directly as the true online distribution for both training and evaluation work.
Good for initial training, but evaluation and thresholds must still match the true under-1% online rate.
Fifty thousand labeled examples is far too small to have any real training value at all.
Only useful for training the image encoder component, never the full classifier itself.
why: 50/50 的平衡集比线上分布更适合起步训练，但线上 harmful 远低于 1%，评估和阈值必须按真实占比校准，不能直接套用。
why_en: The fifty-fifty balanced set is good for bootstrapping training, but evaluation and thresholds must still be calibrated to the true under-one-percent online prevalence.
optionExplanations: 50/50 平衡集和线上 <1% 分布差很远。
平衡集适合起步，评估仍需按真实占比校准。
5万条标注对起步训练已经足够有用。
标注集覆盖文本和图片，不止图片。
optionExplanations_en: A fifty-fifty set is far from the real under-one-percent online mix.
It is fine for bootstrapping, but evaluation still needs true-prevalence calibration.
Fifty thousand labeled examples are plenty for bootstrapping.
The labels cover text and images, not only images.
q_en: What does the initial 50k balanced labeled set mean for training?

scenario: 你想用公开 NSFW 数据集增强训练。
q: 使用公开 NSFW 数据集扩充训练集时，必须注意什么？
options: 它缺少平台特有的行为/作者特征，且可能带来分布或政策偏差
它标注的违规定义一定和平台政策完全一致，不用检查
它规模够大，可以完全替代平台自己的线上标注
把它加进训练集不需要做任何额外评估就能直接用
options_en: It lacks platform-specific behavior and author features, and may introduce distribution or policy bias.
Its violation definitions are guaranteed to match the platform's policy exactly, no need to check.
It is large enough to fully replace the platform's own online labeling effort.
Adding it to training requires no extra evaluation before use.
why: 外部数据能扩展覆盖面，但它没有平台特有的行为/作者特征，标签政策也可能和本平台不同，需要验证是否真的帮到目标任务。
why_en: External datasets widen coverage but lack platform-specific signals and may use a different labeling policy, so their benefit must be validated before trusting them.
whenOtherWins: 如果公开数据和平台政策高度一致，且只用于预训练内容 encoder，风险会小很多。
tradeoff: 扩大内容覆盖 vs 引入分布/政策偏差
optionExplanations: 外部标签体系和平台政策未必对齐。
不同平台的违规定义通常不完全一致。
它替代不了平台特有的行为/作者信号。
混入偏差数据必须先验证再上线。
optionExplanations_en: External label taxonomies rarely match the platform's policy exactly.
Violation definitions differ across platforms.
It cannot replace platform-specific behavior and author signals.
Biased external data must be validated before use.

termDefinitions.meaning: Not Safe For Work，指不适合工作场合公开查看的敏感内容标签。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NSFW stands for not safe for work, a label for sensitive content unsuitable for public or workplace viewing.

q_en: What must you watch out for when adding a public NSFW dataset?
scenario_en: You want to use a public NSFW dataset to expand the training set.

scenario: 有害内容模式随时间变化，初始 50k 标签逐渐过时。
q: 为应对数据漂移，应优先收集什么样的新标签？
options: 永远只用最初那批 50k 数据
持续收集新鲜的 hard case 和边界样本
只标注明显 harmful 的样本
只标注明显 benign 的样本
options_en: Keep using only the original fifty-thousand-example batch forever.
Continuously collect fresh hard and boundary-case examples.
Only label obviously harmful examples.
Only label obviously benign examples.
why: 有害内容的模式会随时间漂移，模型最需要的是容易被误判的新鲜难例，而不是重复简单样本。
why_en: Harmful content patterns drift over time, so the model benefits most from fresh hard and boundary cases, not more easy repeats.
tradeoff: 标注成本 vs 边界质量
optionExplanations: 旧数据无法覆盖新出现的模式。
难例最能改善模型的判断边界。
只标明显样本学不到边界在哪。
同上，缺少边界信息。
optionExplanations_en: Stale data cannot cover newly emerging patterns.
Hard cases teach the model where its decision boundary is weak.
Only-obvious labels teach nothing about the boundary.
Same problem — no boundary information.
q_en: What fresh labels should you collect first to handle data drift?
scenario_en: Harmful-content patterns change over time, so the initial 50k labels are becoming stale.

q: 用户举报在训练中最适合扮演什么角色？
options: 完全等价于人工标注给出的真值标签
可以直接当作模型内部的参数来使用
高量但有噪声的 proxy label，适合辅助任务
和分类任务完全无关，只是前端展示用的事件
options_en: Treat it as exactly equivalent to human-labeled ground truth.
Use it directly as an internal parameter of the model.
A high-volume but noisy proxy label suited for an auxiliary task.
A frontend-only event completely unrelated to the classification task.
why: 举报量远大于人工标签（约千万级 vs 5万级），但可能是误报或对抗，适合当辅助信号而不是主任务真值。
why_en: Reports vastly outnumber human labels but can be mistaken or adversarial, so they work best as an auxiliary weak-supervision signal, not ground truth.
optionExplanations: 举报会被恶意或误解使用，不等于真值。
举报是数据信号，不是模型内部参数。
量大但噪声高，正是 proxy label 的定义。
举报直接和帖子是否有害相关。
optionExplanations_en: Reports can be adversarial or mistaken, so they are not ground truth.
Reports are a data signal, not internal model parameters.
High volume but noisy is exactly the definition of a proxy label.
Reports are directly related to whether a post is harmful.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不是真实标签，但和真实标签相关、可以用来近似监督信号的替代标签。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A proxy label is not the true label but correlates with it closely enough to serve as an approximate supervision signal.

q_en: What role should user reports play in training?

q: 文章为什么提到用户评论可用于自监督？
options: 用帖子预测评论能让模型学到更有用的帖子表示
评论内容永远是准确的 harmful 标签
评论只能用于前端展示，不能进模型
预测评论会替代图片特征提取
options_en: Predicting comments from posts helps the model learn richer post representations.
Comment content is always an accurate harmful label.
Comments can only be shown in the UI, never fed into the model.
Predicting comments would replace image feature extraction.
why: “恶心”这类评论不总是可靠标签，但用帖子预测评论这个自监督任务能让模型学到比单纯预测标签更丰富的语义表示。
why_en: Comments are not always reliable labels, but training a model to predict comments from posts self-supervises richer semantic representations than label prediction alone.
optionExplanations: 这是自监督表示学习的核心价值。
同一句评论可能出现在无害语境里。
评论文本可以作为训练信号进模型。
预测评论是补充信号，不是替代图片特征。
optionExplanations_en: This is the core value of self-supervised representation learning.
The same comment can appear in a harmless context too.
Comment text can be used as a training signal inside the model.
Predicting comments supplements image features, it does not replace them.
q_en: Why can user comments be useful for self-supervision?

q: 线上 harmful 占比 <1% 时，直接按原始分布训练的最大风险是什么？
options: precision 会自动变成 100%，不用再管误判
标注数据会因此自动变多，标注成本降低
阈值调优从此会变得完全不再必要
模型学会几乎全判 benign，accuracy 虚高
options_en: Precision automatically becomes 100%, so misclassification no longer matters.
Labeled data automatically increases and labeling cost drops.
Threshold tuning becomes completely unnecessary from then on.
The model learns to predict almost always benign while accuracy looks high.
why: 类别极度不平衡时，全判 benign 也能拿到 99% accuracy，这个假象掩盖了模型其实没学到 harmful 的判别能力。
why_en: With extreme class imbalance, always predicting benign still yields near-99% accuracy, hiding the fact the model never learned to discriminate harmful content.
optionExplanations: 全判 benign 时 precision 反而没有意义。
训练策略不会凭空增加标注数据。
阈值调优在不平衡场景下更关键。
这正是类别不平衡制造的准确率假象。
optionExplanations_en: Precision is meaningless when the model always predicts benign.
A training strategy does not conjure more labeled data.
Threshold tuning becomes more critical under imbalance, not less.
This is exactly the accuracy illusion class imbalance creates.
q_en: What is the biggest risk of training directly on the under-1% online distribution?

q: harmful content 的一等内容输入包括哪些？（多选）
options: 帖子正文和 hashtags 等文本
附加图片集合
可从图片/文本学到的多模态语义
数据库主键自增值
options_en: Post body text and hashtags.
The collection of attached images.
Multimodal semantics learned jointly from image and text.
The database auto-increment primary key.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  Post[Post] --> Text[Text and hashtags]
  Post --> Images[Attached images]
  Text --> Semantic[Multimodal semantics]
  Images --> Semantic
  Semantic --> Classifier[Harm classifier]
why: 政策判断主要依赖内容本身：文本和图片是一等输入，模型再从两者学习跨模态语义；数据库自增 ID 不携带任何语义信号。
why_en: Policy judgments mostly depend on the content itself, so text and images are first-class inputs and the model also learns cross-modal semantics from them, while a database auto-increment ID carries no semantic signal.
optionExplanations: 文本承载政策相关的直接语义信号。
图片同样是判断违规的一等信号。
跨模态语义补足单一模态漏掉的组合违规。
自增主键只是存储标识，无语义信息。
optionExplanations_en: Text carries direct semantic signal relevant to policy.
Images are equally a first-class signal for violations.
Cross-modal semantics catch combined violations either modality misses alone.
An auto-increment key is just a storage id with no semantics.
q_en: Which first-class content inputs belong in a harmful-content model? (Select all that apply.)

q: 为什么这是多模态分类问题？
options: 只需要读取用户 ID 就能判断
标签可能取决于文本、图片，以及二者的组合
只需要一张数值表格就能判断
模型只需要输出一个排序列表
options_en: Only the user ID needs to be read to decide.
The label can depend on text, images, or their combination.
Only one numeric feature table is needed to decide.
The model only needs to output a ranked list.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Text[Text meaning] --> Fuse[Joint reasoning]
  Image[Image meaning] --> Fuse
  Fuse --> Harm[Harm label]
  Text -. alone may miss .-> Harm
  Image -. alone may miss .-> Harm
why: 单看图片可能无害，配上特定文字才违规，反之亦然；模型必须能学习跨模态交互，而不只是各模态独立判断。
why_en: An image can be benign alone but harmful paired with certain text, and vice versa, so the model must learn cross-modal interaction rather than judging each modality separately.
optionExplanations: 用户 ID 只是作者先验，不含内容语义。
这正是多模态问题的定义。
数值表格丢失了文本和图片本身的语义。
任务是二分类，不是排序输出。
optionExplanations_en: A user ID is only an author prior with no content semantics.
This is exactly the definition of a multimodal problem.
A numeric table loses the actual text and image semantics.
The task is binary classification, not producing a ranked list.
q_en: Why is this a multimodal classification problem?

scenario: 帖子刚发时内容模型分数低，但快速收到大量 hides 和负面评论。
q: 系统应该如何利用这类快速变化的行为信号？
options: 把行为特征当 fast-moving signals，并在关键事件后 re-trigger 分类
忽略发布后出现的所有行为反应和用户信号，只信任发布那一刻的初始内容分数，之后永远不再更新
不管初始内容分数当时有多低，都统一排队等人工审核团队一个月后再处理
只反复用最初上传的那张原始图片重新打分，完全不看任何行为方面的新证据
options_en: Treat behavior as fast-moving signals and retrigger classification on key events.
Ignore every bit of post-publish behavior and trust only the frozen initial content score forever.
Queue everything uniformly for a full month of human review regardless of the initial score.
Keep rescoring only the original uploaded image forever, ignoring any behavioral evidence.
why: 行为反馈能补足内容模型的盲点，尤其是曝光后才显现的用户反应，因此需要在关键事件后重新触发分类。
why_en: Behavioral feedback fills gaps that content alone misses, especially reactions that only appear after exposure, so classification should retrigger on important behavioral events.
whenOtherWins: 如果帖子几乎没有曝光，缺少行为信号时仍要主要依赖内容和作者特征判断。
tradeoff: 更快发现晚熟违规 vs re-trigger 带来的额外计算和训练对齐成本
optionExplanations: 这正是行为信号存在的意义。
忽略行为会漏掉曝光后才显现的违规。
人工队列容量有限，不能作为主路径。
只看原图会漏掉行为透露的新证据。
optionExplanations_en: This is exactly what behavioral signals are for.
Ignoring behavior misses violations that only surface after exposure.
Human review capacity is limited and cannot be the primary path.
Only looking at the original image misses evidence behavior reveals.
q_en: How should the system use these fast-changing behavioral signals?
scenario_en: A post has a low content-model score at publish time, but quickly receives many hides and negative comments.

q: negative_reactions_per_view 这类比例，为什么在低曝光时需要平滑？
options: 曝光少时这个比例根本没法算出任何数值
平滑处理会把所有原始信号都直接删掉
曝光少时比例会因为分母小而极不稳定，容易误判
views 在这个特征公式里完全不重要
options_en: The ratio simply cannot be computed at all when there are so few views logged.
Smoothing would erase every bit of the original signal, leaving nothing useful.
With few views the ratio is unstable because the denominator is small.
Views do not matter at all in this feature's underlying formula design.
why: 一个帖子刚发布时分母（views）很小，一两次负反馈就能把比例推到极端；Bayesian averaging 用先验把小分母拉回合理范围。
why_en: When a post has very few views, one or two negative reactions can swing the ratio to an extreme, so Bayesian averaging pulls low-denominator ratios back toward a sane prior.
optionExplanations: 分子分母都在，是能算的，只是不稳定。
平滑是压低极端值，不是清空信号。
小分母下少量事件就能左右比例。
views 正是这个比例的分母来源。
optionExplanations_en: Numerator and denominator both exist; it is unstable, not incomputable.
Smoothing tempers extreme values, it does not erase the signal.
With a tiny denominator, a few events can swing the ratio wildly.
Views are exactly the denominator this ratio is built on.
q_en: Why should ratios like negative reactions per view be smoothed at low exposure?

termDefinitions.meaning: 用先验值和真实观测混合，避免小分母比例被一两个事件推到极端。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Bayesian averaging blends a prior with observed data so a tiny denominator cannot swing a rate to an extreme.

scenario: 你要为 harmful content 构造稳定的负反馈率特征。
q: 这段平滑公式的设计目的是什么？
codeSample: smoothed_rate = (negative_events + prior_rate * C) / (views + C)
options: 训练一个 ViT 图像编码器
用先验把小分母的行为比例拉向稳定值
对模型输出分数做后校准
给线上流量做 A/B 分流
options_en: Train a ViT image encoder.
Pull low-denominator behavioral ratios toward a stable prior.
Post-calibrate the model's output score.
Split online traffic for an A/B test.
why: 分子加先验、分母加常数 C，让曝光少的帖子比例被拉向全局先验，曝光变多后数据自然主导。
why_en: Adding a prior to the numerator and a constant C to the denominator pulls low-view ratios toward a global prior, letting real data dominate once views accumulate.
whenOtherWins: 当帖子已经积累大量曝光时，加不加平滑结果都很接近，直接用原始比例也可以。
tradeoff: 小样本稳定性 vs 曝光量增多后数据主导的灵敏度
optionExplanations: 公式和图像编码结构完全无关。
prior_rate 和常数 C 正是这个作用。
这是特征工程，不是分数校准层。
公式里没有流量分桶逻辑。
optionExplanations_en: The formula has nothing to do with an image encoder.
The prior_rate and constant C do exactly this.
This is feature engineering, not a score-calibration layer.
There is no traffic-bucketing logic in the formula.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用一个先验信念把小样本估计拉向更合理的值，避免极端分母失真。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Bayesian averaging blends a small-sample estimate with a prior belief so a tiny denominator cannot distort the result.

q_en: What is this smoothing formula designed to do?
scenario_en: You need a stable negative-feedback-rate feature for harmful-content ranking.

q: 作者特征为什么有用？
options: 部分账号的历史和信誉能提供发布 harmful 内容的先验
作者特征不管在什么场景下都永远比内容特征更重要
有了作者特征以后，就可以把内容特征彻底丢弃不看
作者特征天生就不需要按活跃度做任何归一化处理
options_en: Some accounts' history and reputation give a prior on posting harmful content.
Creator features always outweigh content features no matter the situation or scale.
Once you have creator features, content features can be dropped and ignored entirely.
Creator features never need normalizing by activity level under any circumstance.
why: 长期行为、社群、举报历史和账号异常都能提供先验，但它是内容判断的补充，不能替代内容本身。
why_en: Long-term behavior, community, report history, and account anomalies provide a useful prior, but they supplement content judgment rather than replace it.
optionExplanations: 历史信誉正是先验的来源。
内容特征仍是最直接的判断信号。
丢弃内容特征会漏掉大多数违规证据。
不归一化会让活跃用户的统计量失真。
optionExplanations_en: History and reputation are exactly where the prior comes from.
Content features remain the most direct evidence.
Dropping content features would miss most violation evidence.
Without normalization, active users' stats get distorted.
q_en: Why are creator features useful?

scenario: 你要向面试官解释作者 embedding 和实时行为特征这两类信号为什么要一起用。
q: 作者 embedding 与实时行为特征在互补关系上，核心区别维度是什么？
options: 两者完全等价，训练好其中一个就能互相替代另一个
embedding 只能表达单次孤立事件，完全无法沉淀长期历史
实时特征只能靠离线批量更新，永远做不到近实时
embedding 表达慢而丰富的历史画像，实时特征表达快而噪的近期变化
options_en: The two signals are fully equivalent, so training one makes the other completely redundant forever.
An embedding can only express a single isolated event and never accumulated history at all.
Real-time features can only ever be updated in offline batches, never near-real-time.
Embeddings hold a slow, rich history; real-time features carry fast, noisy signals about right now.
why: embedding 是长期平均画像，捕捉不到突变；举报数、登录国家等实时 tally 更新快但噪声也更大，两者互补才完整。
why_en: Embeddings capture rich long-term profiles but miss sudden shifts, while real-time tallies like reports or login countries update fast but are noisier, so combining both gives a fuller picture.
tradeoff: 历史画像的丰富度 vs 近期突变的响应速度
optionExplanations: 二者速度和噪声特性完全不同。
embedding 聚合的是长期平均行为。
实时 tally 的意义正是能快速更新。
这正是二者互补关系的核心。
optionExplanations_en: The two differ sharply in update speed and noise.
An embedding aggregates long-term average behavior.
The whole point of real-time tallies is fast updates.
This is exactly the core of their complementary relationship.

termDefinitions.term: contextual features / 实时上下文特征
termDefinitions.meaning: 围绕当前时刻统计的快速变化信号，如近期登录国家数、举报数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Contextual features are fast-changing signals tallied around the current moment, such as recent login-country count or report count.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把用户或内容表示成一个稠密数值向量，方便模型计算和比较。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An embedding represents a user or piece of content as a dense numeric vector that a model can compute and compare with.

q_en: What core dimension separates creator embeddings from real-time behavior features?
scenario_en: You need to explain why creator embeddings and real-time behavior features should be used together.

scenario: 老账号历史 embedding 很正常，但突然从多个国家登录并发布异常内容。
q: 哪些特征能补住 embedding 的盲点，及时发现账号异常？
options: 只用长期 embedding 这一个信号就够了，完全不用别的
只看账号注册年龄这一个静态属性，别的都不用管
实时账号上下文，如登录国家数、近期举报量、发帖突增
完全不看任何行为信号，只靠内容本身来判断是否异常
options_en: Rely on the long-term embedding alone and nothing else, no matter what changed.
Only look at the one static signal of account registration age and ignore all the rest.
Real-time account context, such as login-country count, recent reports, and posting bursts.
Ignore behavioral signals entirely and judge the account only by its content.
why: 长期 embedding 滞后于账号被盗这类突变，实时 tally（登录国家、举报量、发帖频率）能快速暴露异常状态。
why_en: Long-term embeddings lag behind sudden shifts like account compromise, so real-time tallies of login countries, reports, and posting bursts expose the anomaly quickly.
whenOtherWins: 如果没有近期异常且内容本身清晰违规，长期 embedding 加内容模型仍是主信号。
tradeoff: 捕捉突发异常的灵敏度 vs 实时特征的噪声
optionExplanations: embedding 更新慢，跟不上突变。
账号年龄不反映近期是否被盗。
这些实时信号正好捕捉突发异常。
完全不看行为会错过所有突变线索。
optionExplanations_en: Embeddings update slowly and lag behind sudden change.
Account age says nothing about a recent compromise.
These real-time signals are exactly what catches a sudden anomaly.
Ignoring behavior entirely misses every compromise clue.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把用户历史行为压缩成的一个稠密向量表示。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An embedding is a dense vector representation that compresses a user's historical behavior.

q_en: Which features fill the blind spot of embeddings and catch account anomalies quickly?
scenario_en: An older account has a normal historical embedding, but suddenly logs in from multiple countries and posts unusual content.

scenario: 你要给 harmful content 建一个简单 baseline。
q: 给 harmful content 建一个简单基线模型，合理选择是？
options: 直接上全量多模态 Transformer，把它当作第一版基线模型
对数值和 embedding 特征跑 Logistic Regression
只按帖子 ID 是奇数还是偶数来分类，别的都不看
把所有内容都送人工审核，完全不训练任何模型
options_en: Ship a full multimodal Transformer straight away as the very first baseline.
Run logistic regression over numeric and embedding features.
Classify purely by whether the post ID happens to be odd or even, nothing else.
Send everything to human review and skip training a model entirely.
why: Logistic regression 快、可解释、容易更新，能当复杂模型的地板线，虽然它学不到特征间的隐式依赖。
why_en: Logistic regression is fast, explainable, and easy to update, making it a solid floor baseline, even though it cannot implicitly model dependencies between features.
whenOtherWins: 如果内容模态是主要信号且已有预训练 encoder，late fusion 或多模态模型会比这个基线强得多。
tradeoff: 训练/上线速度 vs 无法建模跨特征依赖
optionExplanations: 作为第一版直接上重模型会拖慢迭代。
地板线要求便宜、可解释、能快速上线。
帖子 ID 奇偶和是否 harmful 无关。
全人工在 1B/day 规模下不可行。
optionExplanations_en: Shipping the heavy model first slows down iteration.
A floor baseline needs to be cheap, explainable, and quick to ship.
Post ID parity has nothing to do with harm.
All-human review is infeasible at a billion posts a day.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用向量表示的用户或内容特征，可以直接喂进简单模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Embedding features are vector-represented user or content signals that can be fed directly into a simple model.

q_en: What is a reasonable simple baseline for harmful-content modeling?
scenario_en: You need to build a simple baseline for harmful-content detection.

q: 单独训练文本模型和图片模型、再用 max-pooling 合并的主要缺点是什么？
options: 捕捉不到文本和图片之间的细粒度交互
完全不能复用任何预训练模型
推理成本一定比统一模型更贵

options_en: It cannot capture fine-grained interaction between text and image.
It cannot reuse any pretrained model at all.

why_en: An image alone can look benign but become harmful once paired with specific text, and two independent models that only combine at the end miss that cross-modal combination.

两个独立模型都能直接复用预训练权重。
两个轻模型往往比一个大模型更便宜。

scenario: 团队需要比独立模型更强，但还想复用预训练 text/image encoder 并控制复杂度。
q: 成本可控时，harmful content 更合适的模型架构是？
options: 只用关键词规则做过滤，完全不训练任何统计模型来判断
Late fusion：分别编码后拼接行为/用户特征，进 MLP
放弃所有预训练权重，从零端到端训练整个多模态大模型
只看作者账号年龄这一项静态属性，完全不看帖子内容本身
options_en: Only use keyword-based rules to filter, with no statistical model trained at all.
Late fusion: encode separately, concatenate behavior and user features, then an MLP.
Throw away every pretrained weight and train the whole multimodal model from scratch.
Only look at the author's account age and ignore the post content entirely.
why: Late fusion 复用预训练的文本/图片 encoder，把 embedding 和行为/用户特征拼接后过一个 MLP，实现简单、易维护，但跨模态交互被压缩到最后一层。
why_en: Late fusion reuses pretrained text and image encoders, concatenates their embeddings with behavioral and user features into an MLP, staying simple and maintainable while cross-modal interaction is limited to the final layer.
whenOtherWins: 如果细微的跨模态违规模式是核心难点，统一的多模态 Transformer 更可能赢。
tradeoff: 复用预训练 encoder 的可维护性 vs 跨模态交互只发生在最后一层
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Text[Text encoder] --> Join[Concatenate]
  Image[Image encoder] --> Join

  Creator[Creator features] --> Join
  Join --> MLP[MLP score]
optionExplanations: 关键词规则学不到语义组合。
复用 encoder 又能接入表格特征。
从零训练成本和风险都太高。
作者年龄丢掉了内容本身的证据。
optionExplanations_en: Keyword rules cannot learn semantic combinations.
It reuses pretrained encoders while still ingesting tabular features.
Training from scratch is too costly and risky here.
Author age throws away the content evidence itself.

scenario: 内容有文本和图片交互，质量要求高，团队可处理计算复杂度。
q: 质量优先时，harmful content 主模型架构应选什么？
options: 只用单独的文本模型，完全不处理图片
只用 GBDT 树模型处理所有原始图文输入
多模态 Transformer，让各模态通过注意力交互

options_en: Use only a separate text model and skip images entirely.
Use only a GBDT tree model to process the raw image and text inputs.
A multimodal Transformer where modalities interact through attention.
Rely only on user report counts, with no content model at all.
why: 多模态 Transformer 让文本、图片和表格特征通过注意力互相交互，最有机会捕捉复杂的跨模态违规模式，代价是计算成本和复杂度更高。
why_en: A multimodal Transformer lets text, image, and tabular features interact through attention, giving the best shot at catching complex cross-modal violations at the cost of higher compute and complexity.
whenOtherWins: 如果延迟/成本极端紧张，轻量 late fusion 或级联前置模型会更适合。
tradeoff: 跨模态注意力带来的检测质量 vs 计算成本和复杂度
diagram:
flowchart LR

GBDT 不擅长处理原始图文序列。
注意力机制正是跨模态交互的载体。
举报计数只是弱监督信号，不是主模型。
optionExplanations_en: A text-only model throws away all image evidence.
GBDT is not built to process raw image and text sequences.
Attention is exactly the mechanism for cross-modal interaction.
Report counts are only a weak-supervision signal, not a primary model.

q: Lightweight Update Network 的作用是什么？
options: 每次帖子行为一变化，就重新编码所有图片、重跑一遍完整 ViT 主模型
在行为特征更新时，把新表格信号和缓存的内容 embedding 快速合并
取代主模型的整个训练过程，成为流水线里唯一的训练环节
只负责压缩和归档系统日志文件这类杂活，跟推理完全无关
options_en: Re-encode every image by rerunning the full ViT backbone whenever behavior changes.
Merge fresh tabular signals with the cached content embedding when behavior updates.
Replace the main model's entire training process and become the pipeline's only training step.
Only handle log compaction and archiving chores, completely unrelated to inference.

它是 serving 时的轻量合并，不是训练流程。

q: 多个 classification heads 的价值是什么？

It makes gradients conflict so badly the model cannot converge at all.
It completely replaces every human-annotated label.
It is merely a UI decoration field for the frontend to display.
why: 多任务头能预测 harmful、报告率等相关目标，共享底层表示、增强学习效果，还能提供额外的诊断信号；线上只用主任务头做动作。
why_en: Multiple heads let the model predict harmful and report-related targets from a shared representation, which improves learning and adds diagnostics, though only the primary head drives production actions.
optionExplanations: 共享表示和多任务诊断正是它的价值。
多头训练不会让模型无法收敛。
辅助头依赖标签，不能替代标签本身。
分类头输出的是模型分数，不是 UI。

Multi-head training does not prevent the model from converging.

Classification heads output model scores, not UI elements.

q: 为什么不能简单用原始 views 直接作为 loss 权重？
options: views 在业务上没有意义
views 根本无法被记录
views 幂律分布，少数爆款内容会支配梯度
所有帖子的 views 都相同
options_en: Views have no business meaning.
Views cannot be logged at all.
Views are power-law distributed, so a handful of viral posts dominate the gradient.
Every post has the same number of views.
why: 少数内容的 views 可能上亿、大多数是 0，如果直接用原始 views 加权，梯度会被这些极端样本主导，训练变得不稳定。

optionExplanations: views 正是业务目标要优化的量。
views 是可以直接从日志记录的。
幂律分布正是不稳定的根源。
views 差异巨大，远非相同。

Views can be logged directly from the system.
The power-law distribution is exactly the source of instability.
Views vary enormously, far from being equal.

q_en: Why not use raw views directly as a loss weight?

scenario: 你要把 harmful views 业务目标纳入训练但避免爆款支配。
q: 这段伪代码体现的是什么设计？
codeSample:
view_weight = min(log(1 + views), c)
L_primary = BCE(y_true, y_pred) * view_weight
options: InfoNCE 对比学习
Platt scaling 后校准
Isolation forest 异常检测
截断的 log view-weighted BCE
options_en: InfoNCE contrastive retrieval training.
Platt scaling for post-hoc calibration.
Isolation forest anomaly detection.
Capped log view-weighted binary cross-entropy.
why: log(1+views) 压缩了 views 的幂律尺度，min(..., c) 再封顶，让高曝光样本更重要但不会让单个爆款控制训练。
why_en: log(1+views) compresses the power-law scale of views, and the min cap prevents any single viral post from dominating the training signal.
whenOtherWins: 如果业务不按曝光加权，而是每条内容同等处理，普通 BCE 更直接。
tradeoff: 让高曝光样本更重要 vs 避免单个爆款样本支配训练
optionExplanations: 代码里没有正负样本对比结构。
Platt scaling 是校准分数，不是加权 loss。
代码和异常检测算法结构不同。
log 加 cap 正是这段代码的两个操作。
optionExplanations_en: There is no positive/negative pair contrastive structure here.
Platt scaling calibrates scores, it does not weight a loss.
The code does not match an anomaly-detection algorithm.
The log term and the cap are exactly the two operations in this code.

termDefinitions.meaning: Binary Cross-Entropy，二分类最常用的损失函数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: BCE stands for binary cross-entropy, the standard loss for binary classification.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种对比学习损失，用正负样本对训练表示。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: InfoNCE is a contrastive learning loss that trains representations from positive and negative pairs.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种后校准方法，用简单模型把原始分数映射成概率。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Platt scaling is a post-hoc calibration method that maps raw scores into probabilities.

q: view-weighted loss 有什么反馈循环风险？
options: 生产环境的 views 会自动变得完全无偏，不用特别处理
模型提前删除内容，会让训练数据缺少这些帖子本应获得的 views
删除的帖子越多，剩下标签的质量就自动变得越好
这种反馈循环下完全不需要任何 holdout 集
options_en: Production views automatically become fully unbiased with no special handling.
Early removal means training data lacks the views those posts would have earned.
The more posts get removed, the better the remaining labels automatically get.
No holdout set is ever needed under this feedback loop.
why: 生产模型一旦提前删除内容，这些帖子就不会再产生真实曝光，训练数据里的 view 分布会被系统自己的动作污染，需要 holdout 或反事实建模来校正。
why_en: Once the production model removes content early, those posts never accumulate the views they would have gotten, so the training view distribution is biased by the system's own actions and needs a holdout or counterfactual correction.
optionExplanations: 系统自身动作正是偏差的来源。
这正是反馈循环偏差的机制。
删得多只会让偏差更严重。
没有 holdout 就无法校正这个偏差。
optionExplanations_en: The system's own actions are exactly the source of the bias.
This is exactly the mechanism of the feedback-loop bias.
Removing more content only makes the bias worse.
Without a holdout there is no way to correct this bias.

scenario: 你有少量真值标签和大量用户报告率信号。
q: 如何在训练中利用大量的用户报告率信号？
options: 把报告率当成和人工标签一样可靠的唯一真值来训练模型
增加一个 report-rate 预测辅助 head，和主任务加权联合训练

Ignore report data entirely and train only on the fifty thousand human labels.

why_en: Report rates are noisy but abundant, so using them as an auxiliary task helps the model learn more robust representations while the primary task still stays anchored by high-quality harmful labels.
whenOtherWins: 如果报告被严重恶意操纵，辅助权重 beta 应该调低，或先做去偏清洗。

optionExplanations: 报告本身可能是恶意或误报。
辅助 head 正好利用规模又不主导训练。
忽略掉了一个规模很大的弱监督来源。
报告完全可以作为训练信号使用。
optionExplanations_en: Reports themselves can be malicious or mistaken.
An auxiliary head uses the scale without dominating training.
This throws away a large-scale weak-supervision source.
Reports can absolutely be used as a training signal.

scenario_en: You have a small amount of trusted labels and a large amount of user report-rate signal.

q: 为什么 harmful 类型不应该简单 softmax 成单一类别？

harmful 的各个类别总是互斥的

Softmax cannot mathematically be used for classification.
Multi-label modeling has no real value here.
The harmful categories are always mutually exclusive.
why: 暴力、仇恨、恐怖主义等类别经常同时出现在一条内容里，softmax 强制互斥会丢信息，多标签 head 更贴近现实且有诊断价值。
why_en: Categories like violence, hate speech, and terrorism often co-occur in the same content, so a softmax's mutual-exclusivity assumption loses information, while multi-label heads match reality and add diagnostic value.
tradeoff: softmax 单标签的简单性 vs 多标签 head 覆盖类别重叠
optionExplanations: 类别重叠正是拒绝 softmax 的原因。
softmax 本身完全能用于分类任务。
多标签能区分重叠类型，很有意义。
现实中类别经常同时成立，并不互斥。
optionExplanations_en: Category overlap is exactly why softmax is rejected here.
Softmax works perfectly fine for classification in general.
Multi-label modeling meaningfully distinguishes overlapping types.
In reality categories often co-occur; they are not mutually exclusive.

scenario: 1B posts/day，主模型是昂贵多模态 Transformer。
q: 在 1B posts/day、主模型是重多模态 Transformer 的前提下，serving 应该怎么降本？
options: 每条帖子都完整跑一遍最贵的重模型，且完全不做任何缓存
把所有审核都改成每月批处理一次，放弃实时响应
量化 + encoder 缓存 + 轻量蒸馏模型做两阶段过滤
放弃自动化，把所有内容都送进人工审核队列
options_en: Run the full expensive model on every post with absolutely no caching.
Switch all moderation to a once-a-month batch job, giving up real-time response.
Combine quantization, encoder caching, and a distilled two-stage filter.
Give up automation entirely and route everything to human review.
why: 规模要求先用蒸馏出的轻模型过滤明显安全的内容，缓存重复的文本/图片编码，再用量化压缩重模型的计算，三者组合才能撑住十亿级日流量。
why_en: At this scale, a distilled light model filters obviously safe content first, encoder outputs get cached for repeats, and quantization shrinks the heavy model's compute, and combining all three is what makes billion-scale serving affordable.
whenOtherWins: 如果只有小流量的高风险队列，直接用重模型加人工审核也可能可行。
tradeoff: 组合优化换来的吞吐 vs 引入的额外工程复杂度

flowchart LR

  Light --> Safe[Likely safe]
  Light --> Hard[Hard cases]
  Hard --> Heavy[Heavy model]
  Heavy --> Action[Action]
optionExplanations: 全量跑重模型且不缓存在这个规模下不可行。
月度批处理无法满足及时干预的需求。
三种手段组合正好覆盖不同的成本来源。
全人工在这个规模下完全不现实。
optionExplanations_en: Running the heavy model on everything with no cache is infeasible at this scale.
Monthly batching cannot support timely intervention.
The three techniques together cover different sources of cost.
All-human review is completely unrealistic at this scale.

scenario_en: The platform handles 1B posts per day, and the main model is an expensive multimodal Transformer.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把模型权重或激活用更低精度表示，降低推理成本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Quantization stores weights or activations at lower precision to reduce inference cost.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用大模型训练小模型，让小模型学到接近大模型的行为。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Distillation trains a smaller model to mimic a larger model.

termDefinitions.meaning: 缓存文本或图片 encoder 输出，重复内容不再重新编码。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An encoder cache stores text or image encoder outputs so repeated content does not need to be encoded again.

q: 为什么 harmful content 可以缓存 encoder 输出？
options: 缓存能直接提高人工标注的准确率和质量
相同图片、文本或内容未变时，可以复用之前算过的昂贵编码
缓存可以完全替代模型的训练过程本身
缓存只能用在关系型数据库这一层，跟模型推理无关
options_en: Caching directly improves the accuracy and quality of human labeling.
When an image, text, or post is unchanged, its expensive encoding can be reused.
Caching can completely replace the model's training process itself.
Caching can only be used at the relational database layer, unrelated to inference.
why: 病毒式转发的图片、重复的短语、或者同一帖子被重触发时，直接复用之前的 encoder 输出能显著减少重复计算。
why_en: Viral reposted images, repeated phrases, or the same post being retriggered can all reuse a previous encoder output, cutting redundant computation significantly.
optionExplanations: 缓存和标注质量是两回事。

Reusing the encoding of repeated content is exactly the benefit.
Caching applies at inference time, not to training.
What is cached here is the model's intermediate output.

scenario: 帖子创建时轻模型低分，但后来收到大量举报。
q: inference 系统应该支持什么样的重新评分机制？
options: 基于关键行为事件 re-trigger，并复用缓存的内容 embedding
只在帖子刚创建的那一刻评分一次，之后无论发生什么都不再变化
不管初始分数当时多低，永远都只等人工审核给出最终结果
每次 re-trigger 时都把所有历史举报特征全部清空重置归零
options_en: Retrigger on key behavioral events, reusing the cached content embedding.
Score only once right at creation and never change it no matter what happens next.
Always wait for a final human verdict no matter how low the initial score is.
Reset and wipe all historical report features clean on every single retrigger.
why: 行为特征会随时间变化，系统必须在举报、异常曝光等关键事件后重新评分；缓存内容 embedding 能让重触发的成本可控。
why_en: Behavioral features change over time, so the system must rescore after key events like reports or unusual view spikes, and caching the content embedding keeps that retriggering affordable.
whenOtherWins: 如果业务只要求发布前审核，后续行为 re-trigger 就不是主路径。
tradeoff: 及时捕捉晚熟违规 vs re-trigger 带来的额外调度和计算

optionExplanations: 缓存 embedding 让重触发成本可控。

optionExplanations_en: Caching the embedding keeps retriggering affordable.

q: harmful 内容被系统早早删除，会给训练带来什么问题？
options: 训练集里可用的人工标签数量会因为这个机制自动变得又多又全
线上真实的误删率也会因为这套机制自动变得越来越低、越来越好
带行为数据的 positive 样本变少，模型可能误学「有行为=benign」
校准层因此从此彻底不再需要，可以直接从整条 serving 流水线里永久删掉
options_en: The number of usable human labels in training automatically grows larger because of this effect.
The real online false-removal rate automatically drops lower and lower because of this mechanism.
Positive examples with behavioral data shrink, so the model may learn that behavior implies benign.
The calibration layer becomes completely unnecessary and can be dropped from the whole pipeline.
why: 系统提前删除了 harmful 内容，这些帖子就没机会积累行为数据；训练集里带行为特征的正例变少，模型可能反过来学到「有行为反馈=benign」的错误结论。
why_en: Because the system removes harmful content early, those posts never accumulate behavioral data, so positive examples with behavioral features shrink and the model can wrongly learn that having behavioral signal implies benign.
optionExplanations: 早删不会凭空产生更多标签。
误删率不会因为这个机制自动下降。
这正是 positive suppression 的机制。
校准层反而因为重复触发更需要小心。
optionExplanations_en: Early removal does not conjure more labels.
The false-removal rate does not automatically drop from this.
This is exactly the positive-suppression mechanism.
The calibration layer needs more care here, not less, due to repeated retriggers.

options_en: Score in parallel, act on one model, and importance-sample labels across score bands.
Randomly sample just 100 pieces of content no matter how rare harmful content actually is.
Fully switch all production traffic to the candidate model at once with no extra labeling.

harmful 占比太低时，随机抽样方差太大估计不准。

why: 两个模型会标记不同区域的内容，必须额外标注才能比较；用分数做 importance sampling 能在 harmful <1% 的情况下用更少标签降低方差。
why_en: The two models flag different regions of content, so comparing them needs fresh labels, and score-based importance sampling reduces the variance of that rare-class estimate with fewer labels.
whenOtherWins: 如果动作风险很低，可以先用 shadow mode 收集样本，再进入正式动作实验。

这两个指标正好对齐质量和 guardrail。

scenario: 某些用户群体误删率明显高于其他群体。
q: 发现某些用户群体误删率明显更高时，评估应该怎么做？
options: 只看总体 PR-AUC 这一个汇总数字，完全不拆分任何用户群体
直接把误删率高的那个群体的样本从训练数据里删掉

why_en: Aggregate metrics average away harm to specific groups, so slicing precision and recall by user group, language, or region is what surfaces hidden disparities.
whenOtherWins: 如果没有可靠的群体属性，仍可以按语言、地区、内容类型等代理维度切片。
tradeoff: 切片评估的额外工作量 vs 发现被总体指标掩盖的群体伤害

Deleting samples does not fix the model's underlying bias.
Uniformly lowering thresholds worsens both precision and recall.

scenario: 你想表达主 harmful 标签和用户报告率的多任务学习。

codeSample:
L_primary = BCE(harm_label, harm_score) * min(log(1 + views), c)
L_reports = MSE(report_rate, predicted_report_rate)
L = alpha * L_primary + beta * L_reports
options: 矩阵分解做协同过滤推荐排序，和这里的分类任务完全无关联
ANN 近似最近邻召回算法，专门用于向量检索召回这类场景

whenOtherWins: 如果报告质量极差或被大量滥用，beta 权重应调低，或先做去偏清洗。

The code involves no vector retrieval.

Evaluation no longer needs any human labeling.
The precision guardrail stops mattering.
why: 要知道多少曝光是 harmful，必须持续抽样标注内容或曝光数据，这个标注成本推动了 proxy metric 和 importance sampling 的使用。
why_en: Knowing how many views were harmful requires ongoing sampled labeling of content or impressions, and that labeling cost is exactly why proxy metrics and importance sampling get used.
optionExplanations: 持续标注正是曝光估计所需要的成本。
views 本身是可以直接记日志的。
标注曝光量恰恰需要持续人工参与。
guardrail 依然是自动删除的硬约束。
optionExplanations_en: Ongoing labeling is exactly the cost needed to estimate exposure.
Views themselves can be logged directly.
Estimating harmful views needs continued human labeling.
The guardrail is still a hard constraint on auto-removal.
q_en: Why does optimizing harmful views make evaluation harder?

scenario: 用户报告既可能是真实有害，也可能是观点不合的恶意举报。
q: 训练和评估中应如何对待用户报告这个信号？
options: 当作和人工标注完全等价的真值
作为噪声代理信号，结合人工标签做校准和去偏
完全丢弃所有报告数据
直接用报告率替代 precision 指标
options_en: Treat it as exactly equivalent to human-labeled ground truth.
Use it as a noisy proxy signal, calibrated and debiased against human labels.
Discard all report data entirely.
Use report rate directly in place of the precision metric.
why: 报告有规模价值，但可能是恶意举报或用户误解政策产生的噪声，合理做法是当辅助信号，用高质量标签做校准和去偏。
why_en: Reports offer scale but can be noisy from adversarial or mistaken reporters, so the right approach is to treat them as an auxiliary signal calibrated and debiased against trusted labels.
whenOtherWins: 如果某类报告来自高可信的专业审核队列，可以适当提高它的权重。
tradeoff: 利用报告的规模优势 vs 报告本身的噪声和对抗性
optionExplanations: 报告可能是恶意或误解政策产生的。
校准去偏正是处理噪声代理信号的方法。
丢弃会浪费一个规模很大的信号来源。
报告率本身有偏，不能直接顶替 precision。
optionExplanations_en: Reports can be adversarial or based on a misunderstanding of policy.
Calibrating and debiasing is exactly how to handle a noisy proxy signal.
Discarding it wastes a large-scale signal source.
Report rate is itself biased and cannot directly stand in for precision.
q_en: How should training and evaluation treat user reports?
scenario_en: User reports may indicate real harm, but they may also be malicious reports from people who simply disagree.

q: staff-level harmful content 答案通常应更关注什么？
options: 把大部分面试时间都花在只列出最基础的几个特征上
从头到尾只报告一个笼统的 accuracy 数字，别的都不提
标注瓶颈、复杂的多模态取舍、反馈循环，并主动提出 deep dive
刻意避免讨论任何和成本相关的问题，绕着走
options_en: Spend most of the interview time only listing the most basic obvious features.
Report nothing but a single vague accuracy number and never elaborate any further.
Labeling bottlenecks, complex multimodal tradeoffs, feedback loops, and proactive deep dives.
Deliberately steer the conversation around and avoid any cost-related questions entirely.
why: 资深候选人会快速带过基础部分，把时间花在最影响系统成败的数据标注瓶颈、模型取舍和反馈循环上，并主动引导深入讨论。
why_en: Senior candidates move quickly through the basics and spend their time on the labeling bottleneck, hard modeling tradeoffs, and feedback loops that most affect the system's success, proactively steering deep dives.
optionExplanations: 只讲基础显示不出资深候选人的深度。
单一 accuracy 数字掩盖了权衡细节。
这正是资深候选人被期待展示的深度。
回避成本讨论会显得考虑不周全。
optionExplanations_en: Sticking to basics does not show senior-level depth.
A single accuracy number hides the real tradeoffs.
This is exactly the depth senior candidates are expected to show.
Avoiding cost discussion looks like incomplete reasoning.
q_en: What should a staff-level harmful-content answer focus on?

scenario: YouTube 式视频平台的 Up Next 推荐：用户正在看一个视频时，系统要在旁边实时展示接下来推荐播放的视频列表。
q: 为什么当前正在观看的视频要作为 Up Next 排序的核心特征，而不能只依赖用户的长期兴趣画像？
options: 长期画像存储成本太高，系统负担不起
当前视频最直接反映此刻的意图，长期画像跟不上会话内的兴趣切换
当前视频的画质参数决定了排序结果
长期画像只对新用户有效，老用户必须完全换成当前视频特征
why: Up Next 是强上下文场景：用户刚表现出的兴趣比几周前积累的长期画像更能预测下一步。两者应结合，当前视频权重更高。
why_en: The video someone is watching right now signals their immediate intent far more directly than a slow-moving long-term profile.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Current[Current video] --> Rank[Up Next ranker]
  Session[Session history] --> Rank
  Profile[Long-term profile] --> Rank
options_en: Long-term profiles are too expensive to store, so the system can't afford them
The current video most directly reflects intent right now; a long-term profile can't keep up with in-session shifts
The current video's encoding quality determines the ranking
Long-term profiles only work for new users; returning users must switch entirely to current-video features
q_en: Why should the video someone is currently watching be a core feature for Up Next ranking, instead of relying only on their long-term interest profile?
scenario_en: On a YouTube-style video platform's Up Next panel, the system must show a live list of next-video recommendations while the user is watching.
optionExplanations: 存储成本不是决定因素——就算全存得起，长期画像更新慢仍跟不上当下兴趣切换。
当前视频是这一刻意图最直接的信号，比几周前攒的长期画像更新更快。
画质参数是编码属性，不是意图信号，把它当排序依据是把问题跑偏了。
当前视频特征对新老用户都同样重要，不是只有新用户才需要它。
optionExplanations_en: Storage cost isn't the real constraint — even if profiles were cheap to store, they'd still update too slowly to catch in-session shifts.
The current video is the most direct signal of intent right now, updating far faster than a long-term profile ever could.
Encoding quality is a technical video attribute, not an intent signal, so using it for ranking misses the point.
Current-video features matter for both new and returning users, not just newcomers.

scenario: 面试官给出约束：视频库约 1B 条、日活约 1B 用户、每次只展示约 5 个推荐位、从用户打开视频到展示 Up Next 列表只有约 250ms。
q: 这组规模和延迟约束最直接排除了哪种架构？
options: 先用候选生成把 1B 条缩小到几万，再逐级排序到 5 个
对每次请求都用一个重排序模型给全部 1B 条视频打分，再取分最高的 5 个
把候选生成结果和视频 embedding 提前离线算好、在线只做少量计算
用便宜的树模型先把候选量级从万级压到百级
why: 哪怕每条视频只花 1 微秒打分，1B 条也要 1 秒，远超 250ms 预算；必须先分阶段缩小候选，而不是对全库跑重模型。
why_en: Even at one microsecond per video, scoring one billion videos would take about a second, far more than the 250-millisecond budget, so a single full-catalog pass is impossible.
options_en: Shrink one billion candidates down to a few tens of thousands first, then rank down to five in stages
Score all one billion videos with a single heavy ranker on every request, then keep the top five
Precompute candidate-generation results and video embeddings offline, and do little compute online
Use a cheap tree model to shrink candidates from ten-thousands down to hundreds first

termDefinitions.meaning: 把实体映射成一个稠密向量，向量距离反映相似度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An embedding maps an entity to a dense vector whose distance reflects similarity.

q_en: Given this scale and latency budget, which architecture does it rule out most directly?
scenario_en: The interviewer sets the constraints: about 1B videos, about 1B daily active users, roughly 5 recommendation slots shown at once, and only about 250ms from opening a video to showing the Up Next list.
optionExplanations: 候选生成本来就该做粗筛，把 1B 降到几万，这类分阶段设计正是延迟预算允许的做法。
对全部候选逐条跑重模型，光是打分耗时就冲到秒级，跟展示预算完全不在一个量级，是最先被约束卡死的架构。
预计算和缓存把大部分开销挪到线上请求之前，不占用 250ms 的在线预算，是被允许的。
树模型便宜到能在毫秒级筛掉大部分候选，不违反延迟约束，也是可行的一环。
optionExplanations_en: Shrinking candidates from 1B down to tens of thousands is exactly what staged funnels are for, and it fits the latency budget.
Scoring every candidate with the heavy model alone pushes total scoring time into the seconds range, nowhere near the serving budget, so it's the first architecture the constraint rules out.
Precomputing and caching moves most of the cost off the online request path, so it doesn't eat into the 250ms budget.
Cheap tree models can filter most candidates in milliseconds without breaking the latency constraint.

scenario: 你要为 Up Next 推荐定义业务目标；如果单纯优化点击率，标题党和夸张缩略图会被算法鼓励。
q: 作为业务目标，应该优化下面哪一个？
options: 最大化点击率，不管点击后的行为
只最大化广告曝光，不顾用户体验
最大化质量调整后的观看时长
只最大化平均视频时长本身
whenOtherWins: 如果产品是导航型搜索（用户想尽快找到答案并离开），快速完成任务可能比拉长观看时长更重要。
why: 质量调整后的 watch time 能兼顾平台收入和用户满意，避免只追点击或鼓励低质量的沉迷内容。
why_en: Quality-adjusted watch time balances platform revenue and user satisfaction better than raw click-through rate.
tradeoff: 点击率的可测量性 vs 质量调整后 watch time 的长期一致性
options_en: Maximize click-through rate, regardless of what happens after the click
Maximize ad impressions only, regardless of user experience
Maximize quality-adjusted watch time
Maximize average video length by itself
q_en: As the business objective, which of these should you optimize for?
scenario_en: You are defining the business objective for Up Next; if you optimize purely for click-through rate, clickbait titles and exaggerated thumbnails get rewarded by the algorithm.
optionExplanations: 只看点击率会把标题党、夸张缩略图训练成赢家，掩盖点击后满意度差的问题。
只顾广告曝光会牺牲用户体验，长期只会赶走用户、反噬广告库存本身。
质量调整后的观看时长把满意度和参与度都算进去，能同时兼顾平台收入和用户长期体验。
只看平均时长会鼓励硬拉长视频、甚至靠冗余内容凑时长，不代表真实满意度。
optionExplanations_en: Optimizing raw CTR alone trains the system to reward clickbait and exaggerated thumbnails, even when post-click satisfaction is bad.
Maximizing ad exposure alone sacrifices user experience, which eventually drives users away and hurts ad inventory itself.
Quality-adjusted watch time folds in satisfaction alongside engagement, balancing platform revenue with users' long-term experience.
Optimizing raw average video length just rewards padding videos out longer, without reflecting real satisfaction.

q: 为什么 CTR（点击率）不适合作为唯一的业务目标？
options: CTR 的埋点实现成本太高，难以稳定采集
CTR 会鼓励点击诱饵，点击后满意度差也照样得分
CTR 在数学上永远等于用户留存率
CTR 只能用于视频分类任务，不能用于排序
why: 用户可能被夸张缩略图吸引点击，但点击后很快离开。推荐系统要看点击后的满意度和长期效果，而不只是有没有点。
why_en: CTR alone can reward clickbait because it ignores what happens after the click, such as the user leaving immediately.

termDefinitions.meaning: 点击率，展示中被点击的比例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CTR is the click-through rate, the fraction of impressions that get clicked.

options_en: CTR is too expensive to instrument reliably
CTR rewards clickbait because it still scores well even when post-click satisfaction is poor
CTR is mathematically always equal to retention
CTR can only be used for video classification, not ranking
q_en: Why is CTR (click-through rate) a poor choice as the sole business objective?
optionExplanations: 埋点成本不是问题所在，CTR 真正的缺陷是它完全不管点击后用户满不满意。
CTR 只看有没有点，夸张缩略图能骗来点击，但用户点完可能秒退。
CTR 和留存率是两个独立指标，数学上不存在必然相等的关系。
CTR 是一个通用的参与度信号，同样能用在排序而不只是分类任务。
optionExplanations_en: Instrumentation cost isn't the issue — CTR's real flaw is that it ignores whether users were satisfied after clicking.
CTR only counts whether someone clicked; a misleading thumbnail can win the click even if the user bounces right after.
CTR and retention are separate metrics with no mathematical guarantee of ever being equal.
CTR is a general engagement signal that ranking can use too, not something limited to classification.

q: 如果把观看时长（watch time）本身当成唯一优化目标，最大的风险是什么？
options: 系统会完全无法记录观看时长
可能推成瘾、低质量或偏长的视频，损害长期满意度和创作者生态
watch time 只对短视频平台有意义
watch time 会让系统必然更公平地分配曝光
why: 观看时长是不错的 proxy，但不是全部：纯优化它会偏向成瘾内容或更长视频，需要质量、满意度和多样性作为约束。
why_en: Raw watch time can promote addictive or unnecessarily long videos even when long-term user satisfaction actually suffers.
options_en: The system would be completely unable to record watch time
It can push addictive, low-quality, or overly long videos, hurting long-term satisfaction and the creator ecosystem
Watch time is only meaningful for short-video platforms
Watch time necessarily makes exposure more fairly distributed
q_en: If raw watch time itself is treated as the sole optimization target, what is the biggest risk?
optionExplanations: 系统完全能记录观看时长，问题不在能不能测，而在只优化它会带偏内容。
纯拉长观看时长会把成瘾但低质、或单纯注水变长的视频顶上去，伤害长期满意度和创作者生态。
watch time 对长短视频平台都适用，不是短视频独有的概念。
只优化时长不会让曝光更公平，反而可能让占用时间多的内容垄断推荐位。
optionExplanations_en: Watch time is easy to record — the risk isn't measurement, it's that optimizing it alone skews what gets recommended.
Pure watch-time optimization can push addictive-but-low-quality or artificially padded videos to the top, hurting long-term satisfaction and the creator ecosystem.
Watch time is a meaningful signal on both long- and short-form platforms, not just short video.
Optimizing for length alone doesn't make exposure fairer — it can let time-hogging content dominate recommendation slots.

q: 一个更完整的视频推荐业务目标通常要同时平衡哪几方利益？（多选）
options: 用户满意度
创作者的可持续成长
平台的广告收入与整体健康
只服务当前最热门的那批内容
why: 推荐系统同时影响用户、创作者和平台三方，过度优化任何一方都可能长期损害其余两方。
why_en: Recommendation objectives usually balance user satisfaction, creator sustainability, and platform health together.
options_en: User satisfaction
Sustainable creator growth
Platform ad revenue and overall health
Serving only the current most popular content
q_en: A more complete video-recommendation business objective usually has to balance which parties' interests at the same time? (select all)
optionExplanations: 用户满意度差，推荐再精准也留不住人，是最基本的一方利益。
只讨好用户、不给创作者成长空间，供给端会枯竭、内容生态跟着萎缩。
平台收入和系统健康决定这套推荐能不能长期运营下去，不是纯慈善指标。
只服务当前最热门内容会让长尾创作者失去曝光机会，牺牲另外两方利益。
optionExplanations_en: If users aren't satisfied, no amount of ranking precision keeps them around — it's the most basic stakeholder.
Serving only users while starving creators of growth eventually dries up the content supply itself.
Ad revenue and platform health determine whether the whole system can keep running long-term, not just a nice-to-have.
Only serving currently-hot content starves long-tail creators of exposure, sacrificing the other two stakeholders.

q: 给定用户、当前正在看的视频和会话上下文，Up Next 推荐的 primary ML objective 应该是什么？
options: 判定当前账号是否为自动机器人账号
给候选排序，预测其长期满意度和参与度贡献
为视频内容自动生成字幕文本
压缩视频缩略图的文件体积大小
why: 系统要预测点击、观看、分享、回访等未来行为，再用 value model 把这些预测汇总成排序价值。
why_en: The primary ML objective is ranking candidate videos by predicted contribution to long-term engagement given the user, current video, and session.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Gen[10k candidates] --> Light[Light ranker]
  Light --> Keep[Keep top hundreds]
  Light --> Drop[Drop obvious misses]
  Keep --> Heavy[Heavy ranker]
options_en: Determine whether the current account is an automated bot account
Rank candidates by predicting their contribution to long-term satisfaction and engagement
Automatically generate caption text for video content
Compress the file size of video thumbnails
q_en: Given a user, the video they are currently watching, and session context, what should the primary ML objective for Up Next be?
optionExplanations: 判断账号是否为机器人是风控任务，和 Up Next 的排序目标完全不是一回事。
排序模型要预测候选视频对长期满意度和参与度的贡献，再据此给候选打分排序。
自动生成字幕是内容处理任务，不属于排序模型要解决的问题。
压缩缩略图文件体积是存储/传输优化，跟排序目标没有关系。
optionExplanations_en: Detecting whether an account is a bot is a trust-and-safety task, unrelated to Up Next's ranking objective.
The ranker needs to predict each candidate's contribution to long-term satisfaction and engagement, then score and order candidates on that.
Auto-generating captions is a content-processing task, not something the ranking objective is solving.
Shrinking thumbnail file size is a storage/delivery optimization, unrelated to the ranking objective.

q: value model 在这套多阶段视频推荐系统里承担什么角色？
options: 完全替代候选生成层，直接从原始视频库里挑视频
把多个预测头组合成一个业务排序分
只负责统计数据库查询延迟
只在训练缩略图分类模型时使用
why: 重 ranker 会同时预测多种结果，value model 决定如何按业务目标把这些预测加权汇总成最终排序分。
why_en: A value model combines multiple predicted outcomes into one business-aligned ranking score used for the final ordering.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Cand[Hundreds of candidates] --> Features[Full features]
  Features --> Interact[Cross interactions]
  Interact --> Heads[CTR watch satisfaction]
  Heads --> Score[Final score]

termDefinitions.meaning: 把多个预测头输出按业务权重汇总成一个排序分数的模块。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A value model combines several predicted signals into one business-weighted ranking score.

options_en: Fully replace the candidate-generation layer and pick videos straight from the raw catalog
Combine several prediction heads into one business ranking score
Only track database query latency
Only get used for training a thumbnail classifier
q_en: What role does the value model play in this multi-stage video recommendation system?
optionExplanations: value model 不做候选筛选，它工作在重 ranker 已经打完分之后。
多个预测头各自输出一个信号，value model 是把这些信号按业务权重汇总成最终排序分数的那一层。
统计数据库查询延迟是运维监控的事，不是 value model 的职责。
value model 用在线上排序阶段，不是训练缩略图分类器的工具。
optionExplanations_en: The value model doesn't do candidate filtering — it works after the heavy ranker has already scored things.
Several prediction heads each output one signal, and the value model is the layer that combines them into a single business-weighted ranking score.
Tracking database query latency is an ops-monitoring concern, not something the value model does.
The value model operates in online ranking, not as a tool for training a thumbnail classifier.

q: 大规模视频推荐系统几乎都采用多阶段（候选生成→轻排→精排→重排）架构，而不是单一模型端到端处理，主要原因是什么？
options: 无法对十亿候选全部跑重模型，须逐级缩小候选集
多阶段架构训练起来天然更简单
单阶段架构在数学上无法训练收敛
多阶段架构纯粹是为了让架构图更完整
why: 候选生成先圈定可能相关的视频，轻 ranker 保召回降规模，重 ranker 追求质量，reranker 再调整整体 slate。
why_en: Large-scale recommendation uses multiple stages because scoring billions of items with the heaviest model is computationally infeasible within the latency budget.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Billion[1B videos] --> Gen[Generators]
  Gen --> Light[Light ranker]
  Light --> Heavy[Heavy ranker]
  Heavy --> Slate[Reranker slate]
options_en: It is infeasible to run a heavy ranker over billions of candidates, so the set must shrink in stages
A multi-stage architecture is naturally simpler to train
A single-stage architecture cannot mathematically converge during training
A multi-stage architecture exists purely to make the diagram look complete
q_en: Large-scale video recommenders almost always use a multi-stage architecture (candidate generation → light ranking → heavy ranking → reranking) instead of one end-to-end model. Why?
optionExplanations: 十亿候选全跑重模型算力扛不住，必须先用便宜阶段缩小候选集再上贵模型。
多阶段架构其实要训练和维护好几个模型，整体训练复杂度更高，不是更简单。
单阶段架构在数学上完全能收敛，问题出在算力和延迟，不是可训练性。
分阶段是延迟和成本约束逼出来的工程选择，不是为了让架构图好看。
optionExplanations_en: Running a heavy model over a billion candidates just isn't affordable, so cheaper stages have to funnel the pool down first.
Multi-stage systems actually mean training and maintaining several models, which is more complex overall, not simpler.
Single-stage architectures can converge mathematically just fine — the real blocker is compute and latency, not trainability.
Staging is an engineering response to latency and cost constraints, not something done to make the architecture diagram look complete.

scenario: 视频库有上亿条，但重排序阶段在线只能接收几万个候选。
q: 候选生成层应该如何设计？
options: 只依赖全站热门榜单，不做任何个性化召回
用一个重排序模型直接对全库视频逐条打分
多路并行 generator：订阅、热门、个性化召回都覆盖
每次请求随机抽样少量视频充当候选，跳过召回逻辑
whenOtherWins: 如果产品只需要全站趋势榜（不追求个性化），单一热门 generator 可能就足够。
why: 多个 generator 各自覆盖不同的召回假设，能避免单一路径漏掉高质量候选；有限上下文的 generator 还可以预计算缓存。
why_en: Candidate generation should combine multiple parallel sources so that no single path misses a whole class of good candidates.
tradeoff: 召回覆盖面 vs 在线计算和维护成本
diagram:
flowchart TD
  G[Candidate generators] --> Sub[Subscriptions]
  G --> Similar[Similar videos]
  G --> Popular[Trending]
  G --> Vector[Personalized ANN]
  G --> Fresh[Fresh content]
options_en: Rely only on a single platform-wide trending list, with no personalized retrieval
Use one heavy reranking model to score every video in the catalog one by one
Run multiple parallel generators covering subscriptions, trending, and personalized retrieval
Randomly sample a handful of videos as candidates on every request, skipping retrieval logic
q_en: How should the candidate-generation layer be designed?
scenario_en: The video catalog has on the order of a billion items, but the reranking stage can only accept on the order of tens of thousands of candidates online.
optionExplanations: 只靠全站热门榜会让所有用户看到同样的东西，完全放弃个性化召回。
用重排序模型对全库逐条打分早就超出候选生成阶段能承受的延迟和算力。
订阅、热门、个性化各开一路 generator，任何一路看走眼时其他路径还能兜住，比单一来源更抗漏召回。
随机抽样候选完全跳过了召回逻辑，等于放弃了个性化和相关性。
optionExplanations_en: Relying only on a global trending list shows every user the same thing, abandoning personalization entirely.
Scoring the entire library with a reranking model already blows past the latency and compute this stage can afford.
Running separate generators for subscriptions, trending, and personalization means one path missing something doesn't sink the whole pool — more resilient than a single source.
Randomly sampling candidates skips recall logic altogether, giving up personalization and relevance.

q: 哪一类 candidate generator 更容易被预计算和缓存？
options: 依赖用户当前完整会话上下文、每次都要重新计算的实时个性化 generator
上下文有限或相对通用的 generator，例如全站热门榜、订阅作者的最新视频
每次请求都需要调用重排序模型的 generator
只能由人工每天挑选的候选列表
why: 上下文少或变化慢的结果可以提前算好存起来，降低在线延迟；高度个性化、实时的 generator 缓存难度更高。
why_en: Candidate generators with limited or slow-changing context are the ones that are easiest to precompute and cache.
options_en: A real-time personalized generator that depends on the user's full current session and recomputes every time
Generators with limited or fairly generic context, like the platform trending list or an author's newest uploads
A generator that must call the heavy ranker on every request
A candidate list that can only be curated by humans every day
q_en: Which kind of candidate generator is easiest to precompute and cache?
optionExplanations: 依赖完整会话上下文的实时 generator 每次输入都在变，没法提前缓存。
上下文少或变化慢的 generator（全站热门、订阅最新视频）结果可以提前算好存起来。
每次都调重排序模型的说法本身不成立，那是精排阶段的活，不是候选生成层。
人工挑选候选无法规模化，也不是候选生成的正常形态。
optionExplanations_en: A realtime generator tied to the full session context changes on every request, so there's nothing stable to precompute.
Generators with limited or slow-changing context — sitewide trending, an author's newest uploads — can be computed ahead of time and cached.
Calling the reranking model on every request describes the heavy-ranking stage, not what candidate generators do.
Manually curated candidates can't scale and aren't how candidate generation normally works.

scenario: 在做特征设计时你发现某个信号（比如“视频与用户历史兴趣的语义相似度”）能有效预测视频是否会被喜欢，但目前的候选生成层并没有覆盖这一类视频。
q: 这对候选生成层的设计提出了什么要求？
options: 既然是有效信号，重 ranker 自己就能把这类视频找出来
必须新增一个按该信号召回视频的 generator
这类信号只在训练阶段有用，和候选生成层无关
候选生成层的设计和特征质量没有关系
whenOtherWins: 如果候选池已经全量覆盖一个很小的目录，就不需要为每个信号单独建一个 generator。
why: ranker 只能给已经被召回的候选打分，如果没有 generator 覆盖某个信号对应的视频，这个信号再有效也发挥不了作用。
why_en: If a signal predicts relevance, a candidate generator must retrieve videos from that signal's region, because rankers can only score items that were already retrieved.
tradeoff: 为每个高价值信号新增 generator 的召回收益 vs 候选生成层的复杂度和维护成本
options_en: Since it's a valid signal, the heavy ranker alone can surface these videos on its own
A new generator must be added that retrieves videos using this signal
This kind of signal is only useful during training and has nothing to do with candidate generation
Candidate-generation design has nothing to do with feature quality
q_en: What does this imply about how the candidate-generation layer should be designed?
scenario_en: While designing features you find a signal — semantic similarity between a video and the user's historical interests — that predicts whether a video will be liked, but the current candidate-generation layer doesn't retrieve videos along that dimension at all.
optionExplanations: 重 ranker 只能给候选池里已有的视频打分，池子外面的视频它连看都看不到。
召回阶段没圈到的视频压根进不了候选池，排序模型再强也无从谈起给它打分。
训练阶段和线上召回用的是同一批信号，不存在只在训练有用的说法。
候选生成层的召回假设直接决定哪些信号能被利用，两者密切相关。
optionExplanations_en: The heavy ranker can only score videos that are already inside the candidate pool — anything outside it, the ranker never even sees.
A video the recall stage never pulls in can't reach the candidate pool at all, so no matter how strong the ranker is, it never gets a chance to score it.
The same signal used at training time is the one used online, so there's no such thing as a training-only signal.
The candidate layer's recall assumptions directly decide which signals can even be used — the two are tightly linked.

q: 轻量 ranker（light ranker）在多阶段推荐里的主要优化目标是什么？
options: 完全替代 re-ranking/slate 层的多样性控制
对最终少量候选做最精细的打分
高召回、低延迟，把候选量级从万级降到百级
只负责记录请求日志
why: 轻 ranker 是一个计算优化层，宁可保留可疑的好视频，也不要在这一层过早误杀。
why_en: The lightweight ranker is a high-recall, low-latency filter that shrinks the candidate set before the heavy ranker runs.
options_en: Fully replacing the diversity control done at the re-ranking/slate layer
Doing the finest-grained scoring on the last small batch of candidates
High recall, low latency, shrinking candidates from ten-thousands down to hundreds
Only logging requests
q_en: What is the light ranker's primary optimization target in a multi-stage recommender?
optionExplanations: 多样性控制是 reranking/slate 层的活，轻 ranker 不负责这个。
对少量候选做最精细打分是重 ranker 的工作，轻 ranker 追求的是速度不是精细。
轻 ranker 是计算优化层，用高召回、低延迟把候选量级从万级降到百级。
只记录请求日志是基础设施职责，不是轻 ranker 的优化目标。
optionExplanations_en: Diversity control belongs to the re-ranking/slate stage, not the light ranker.
Scoring a small candidate set with maximum precision is the heavy ranker's job — the light ranker optimizes for speed, not precision.
The light ranker is a compute-optimization layer aiming for high recall and low latency, cutting candidates from tens of thousands down to hundreds.
Just logging requests is an infrastructure concern, not what the light ranker optimizes for.

q: 重 ranker（heavy ranker）相比轻 ranker，主要多做了什么？
options: 用完整特征和更复杂的交互对少量候选精确评分
把候选量级从百级进一步扫描回全库规模
只返回一份固定的全站热门榜
只负责把候选结果写入缓存
why: 候选数被轻 ranker 降低后，重模型才有算力预算去用序列建模、交叉特征和多任务头追求排序质量。
