termDefinitions.meaningEn: Decorator wraps an object to add behavior at runtime without modifying the original class, and multiple decorators can be stacked.

optionExplanations: 对，新类型加进来时，创建判断都收在一个地方，调用方代码完全不用改。
Observer 管的是状态变化后通知订阅者，这里的核心动作是「造哪个类」，跟通知无关。
State Machine 管的是同一对象在不同状态下能做什么，这里没有状态转移，只有创建判断。
Decorator 是在已有对象外面叠加行为，这里的问题是「该造哪个类」，还没到叠加行为那一步。
optionExplanations_en: Right — one place decides which concrete notifier to build, so adding a new type still leaves callers depending only on the Notification interface.
Observer is about reacting to a subject's state changes, not about picking which class to instantiate.
A state machine governs what's allowed per state; there's no state transition here, just a creation choice.
Decorator layers behavior on an object you already have; this problem is about which class to make in the first place.

scenario: 你想把通知类型到具体对象的映射集中管理。
scenario_en: You want to centrally manage the mapping from a notification type string to a concrete object.
q: 这段代码最像哪种模式？
q_en: Which pattern does this code snippet most resemble?
options: Observer
Simple Factory
Decorator
State Machine
options_en: Observer
Simple Factory
Decorator
State Machine
why: 这是日常说的 Simple Factory，不是更复杂的 GoF Factory Method；面试中通常这样实现就够了。
why_en: This is the practical Simple Factory form that centralizes which concrete notification object to create, not the more complex GoF Factory Method.
whenOtherWins: 如果每个创建者子类都要自己决定产品类型，那才接近 GoF Factory Method。
tradeoff: 一个静态方法集中判断 vs 用子类重写工厂方法（GoF Factory Method）

termDefinitions.meaning: 日常说的工厂模式：一个静态方法按类型字符串返回对应实例，比 GoF Factory Method 简单。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A simple factory is a static method that returns the right instance based on a type string, simpler than the GoF Factory Method.

termDefinitions.meaning: GoF 版本的工厂模式：用子类重写工厂方法来决定产品类型，比 Simple Factory 更复杂，面试很少需要。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Factory Method is the GoF version where subclasses override a factory method to decide the product type; it is more complex and rarely needed in interviews.

termDefinitions.meaning: 《设计模式》一书四位作者的合称，该书 1994 年为 C++/Smalltalk 定义了 23 个经典设计模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GoF stands for the four authors of the 1994 book Design Patterns, which cataloged 23 classic patterns.

termDefinitions.meaning: 行为型模式：让多个订阅者通过统一接口，在一个 subject 状态变化时收到通知。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Observer lets multiple subscribers receive notifications through one common interface whenever a subject's state changes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 结构型模式：用包装对象在不修改原类的前提下叠加行为，可按运行时条件组合多层。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Decorator wraps an object to add behavior at runtime without modifying the original class, and multiple decorators can be stacked.

termDefinitions.meaning: 行为型模式（也叫 State pattern）：把对象在每个状态下允许的行为和转移规则，分别封装到独立的状态类里。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A state machine (State pattern) encapsulates the actions allowed and the transition rules for each state into its own state class.

optionExplanations: 这段代码没有订阅者列表也没有通知逻辑，跟 Observer 的职责对不上。
对，一个静态方法按类型字符串返回对应通知对象——这就是面试里的 Simple Factory 写法。
代码里没有对已有对象做包装叠加，Decorator 描述的是另一种结构。
这里没有状态和转移规则，只是按 type 字符串一次性选类，不是状态机。
optionExplanations_en: There's no subscriber list or notification call here, so this isn't Observer's job.
Right — one static method returns the matching notification object by type string, which is exactly what people mean by Simple Factory.
Nothing here wraps an existing object to add behavior, so this isn't Decorator's shape.
There's no state or transition rule, just a one-time class choice by type string — not a state machine.

scenario: HTTP request 对象有 URL、method、headers、body 等很多可选配置，构造函数参数会又长又容易传错。
scenario_en: An HTTP request object has many optional parts (URL, method, headers, body), and a single constructor with all of them would be long and error-prone.
q: 哪个模式可能有帮助？
q_en: Which pattern is likely to help here?
options: Observer
Builder
Facade
Singleton
options_en: Observer
Builder
Facade
Singleton
why: Builder 让复杂对象一步步配置，并在 build 时校验必填字段，适合可选字段多、构造细节杂的对象。
why_en: Builder fits complex object construction with many optional fields and validation at build time.
whenOtherWins: Python 中很多时候用 dataclass 默认值、关键字参数或字典更简单，不需要专门的 Builder。
tradeoff: 分步构造+build 时校验 vs 单个长参数构造函数的简单性
codeSample:
req = (HttpRequest.Builder()
    .url("https://api.example.com")
    .method("POST")
    .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
    .build())
# build() 校验 url 是必填项，缺失就抛 ValueError

termDefinitions.meaning: 行为型模式：让多个订阅者通过统一接口，在一个 subject 状态变化时收到通知。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Observer lets multiple subscribers receive notifications through one common interface whenever a subject's state changes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 创建型模式：把复杂对象的构造拆成一连串方法调用，最后用 build() 统一校验必填字段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Builder constructs a complex object step by step through chained calls and validates required fields in a final build() call.

termDefinitions.meaning: 结构型模式：用一个简单入口协调并隐藏一组复杂子系统的内部细节。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Facade offers one simple entry point that coordinates and hides the internal details of a more complex subsystem.

termDefinitions.meaning: 创建型模式：保证一个类在进程内只有一个实例，并提供全局访问点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Singleton guarantees a class has only one instance within the process and exposes a global access point to it.

termDefinitions.meaning: Python 的语法糖装饰器，能自动生成构造函数、__repr__ 等样板代码，常用来替代 Builder。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A dataclass is a Python decorator that auto-generates boilerplate such as the constructor and __repr__, often replacing Builder.

optionExplanations: 这里没有订阅关系，问题是怎么把一堆可选字段拼成一个对象，跟通知无关。
对，字段多且可选，Builder 让你一步步配置，最后 build() 时统一检查必填项。
Facade 是隐藏多个组件协作，这里只是构造一个对象，还没到协调子系统那一步。
Singleton 管的是全局唯一实例，跟这里每次都要新建一个 request 对象没关系。
optionExplanations_en: There's no subscriber relationship here — the problem is assembling one object's optional fields, not notifying anyone.
Right — with many optional parts, Builder lets you configure step by step and checks required fields once at build().
Facade hides coordination across several components; this is just constructing one object, no subsystem to coordinate yet.
Singleton is about one shared instance process-wide, unrelated to building a fresh request object each time.

q: 为什么 Builder 在 Python 里不总是必要？
q_en: Why isn't Builder always necessary in Python?
options: Builder 天生不能支持任何可选字段
Python 关键字参数、默认值和 dataclass 都能替代它
Builder 模式只能在 JavaScript 项目里使用
Python 语法根本不允许创建自定义对象
options_en: Builder inherently cannot support any optional field.
Python keyword arguments, default values, and dataclasses can replace it.
The Builder pattern can only be used in JavaScript projects.
Python syntax does not allow creating custom objects at all.
why: 模式要结合语言习惯；Python 的语言特性经常能用更简单方式解决构造复杂度。
why_en: Builder is less often needed in Python because keyword arguments, defaults, and dataclasses can solve many construction problems.
tradeoff: Builder 的分步校验 vs Python 原生 kwargs/dataclass 的轻量写法

termDefinitions.meaning: 创建型模式：把复杂对象的构造拆成一连串方法调用，最后用 build() 统一校验必填字段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Builder constructs a complex object step by step through chained calls and validates required fields in a final build() call.

termDefinitions.meaning: Python 的语法糖装饰器，能自动生成构造函数、__repr__ 等样板代码，常用来替代 Builder。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A dataclass is a Python decorator that auto-generates boilerplate such as the constructor and __repr__, often replacing Builder.

optionExplanations: 这个说法是错的，Builder 本来就是为可选字段设计的，只是 Python 常有更轻的替代。
对，Python 的关键字参数、默认值和 dataclass 经常就能达到 Builder 想解决的效果。
Builder 是通用的面向对象模式，跟具体语言无关，不是 JavaScript 专属。
Python 完全支持自定义类和对象，这个说法明显不成立。
optionExplanations_en: That's backwards — Builder exists specifically to handle optional fields; Python just often has a lighter alternative.
Right — Python's keyword arguments, defaults, and dataclasses frequently do what Builder was built for.
Builder is a general OO pattern, not tied to any one language, certainly not JavaScript-only.
Python fully supports defining custom classes and objects, so this claim doesn't hold.

scenario: 面试官问“这个 Logger/ConfigManager 要不要做成 Singleton？”
scenario_en: The interviewer asks, "Should this Logger or ConfigManager be a Singleton?"
q: 这时更稳妥的默认回答方向是什么？
q_en: What is the safer default answer in this situation?
options: Python 不能共享对象，所以无所谓
所有共享对象都必须做成 Singleton
谨慎；通常通过构造函数传共享对象更清楚、更好测试
Singleton 能自动解决所有并发问题
options_en: Python cannot share objects, so it does not matter.
Every shared object must be turned into a Singleton.
Be cautious; passing the shared object through the constructor is usually clearer and easier to test.
Singleton automatically solves all concurrency problems.
why: Singleton 隐藏依赖并增加测试难度；除非确实需要全局唯一实例，否则显式构造函数注入更可维护。
why_en: Be cautious with Singleton because explicit constructor injection is usually clearer and easier to test than a hidden global instance.
whenOtherWins: 配置、日志或连接池确实要求进程内唯一实例时，可以讨论 Singleton 或模块级实例。
tradeoff: 显式构造函数注入的可测试性 vs 全局单例的随处可访问
codeSample:
class OrderService:
    def __init__(self, logger):   # 注入，而不是取全局单例
        self.logger = logger

service = OrderService(shared_logger)
# 测试时可以传入一个假 logger，不需要碰全局状态

termDefinitions.meaning: 创建型模式：保证一个类在进程内只有一个实例，并提供全局访问点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Singleton guarantees a class has only one instance within the process and exposes a global access point to it.

termDefinitions.term: constructor injection / 构造函数注入
termDefinitions.meaning: 把共享对象通过构造函数参数传入，而不是让类内部自己创建或获取全局单例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Constructor injection passes a shared object in through the constructor instead of having the class create or fetch a global singleton itself.

optionExplanations: Python 对象随时可以被多处共享，这个前提本身就是错的。
把所有共享对象都做成 Singleton 会到处藏依赖，正好是要避免的坏习惯。
对，显式通过构造函数传入共享对象，测试时换成假对象很容易，也不会藏依赖。
Singleton 本身不处理线程安全，并发问题该用锁或线程安全数据结构解决，不是它自动包办的。
optionExplanations_en: Python objects can be shared anywhere without issue, so that premise is just wrong.
Turning every shared object into a Singleton hides dependencies everywhere — that's the habit to avoid.
Right — passing the shared object in through the constructor keeps the dependency explicit and easy to swap for a fake in tests.
Singleton says nothing about thread safety; concurrency still needs locks or thread-safe data structures, not an automatic fix.

q: Python 中共享单例资源的更自然方式通常是什么？
q_en: What is the more natural way to share a singleton-style resource in Python?
options: 全局字符串拼接
继承所有需要用到它的服务类
每次调用都 new 一个 class-based Singleton
模块级对象，因为模块只加载一次
options_en: Global string concatenation.
Inherit from every service class that needs it.
Call `new` on a class-based Singleton every time it is used.
A module-level object, because a module is only loaded once.
why: Python 模块本身具有单例式加载语义；类式 Singleton 在 Python 里多数时候不符合语言习惯。
why_en: In Python, a module-level object is often the natural singleton because modules are imported once, unlike a class-based Singleton.
tradeoff: 模块级对象的零样板 vs 类式 Singleton 的显式 __new__ 控制
codeSample:
# config.py —— 只会被 import 一次，天然就是单例
settings = {"debug": False}

# usage.py
from config import settings
settings["debug"] = True

termDefinitions.meaning: 直接在 Python 模块顶层创建的对象；模块只会被 import 一次，天然具有单例语义。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A module-level object is created at the top of a Python module; since a module is imported only once, it naturally behaves like a singleton.

termDefinitions.meaning: 创建型模式：保证一个类在进程内只有一个实例，并提供全局访问点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Singleton guarantees a class has only one instance within the process and exposes a global access point to it.

optionExplanations: 字符串拼接跟共享一个对象状态是两回事，这个选项文不对题。
让每个服务类都继承它会把继承关系和共享状态搅在一起，比模块级对象笨重得多。
如果每次调用都 new，那就不是单例了，这个说法自相矛盾。
对，Python 模块只会被 import 一次，模块顶层的对象天然就是单例，不用额外写类。
optionExplanations_en: String concatenation has nothing to do with sharing one object's state — wrong target.
Making every service class inherit from it tangles inheritance with shared state, far heavier than a module-level object.
Calling `new` every time contradicts the idea of a singleton in the first place.
Right — a Python module is imported exactly once, so a top-level object in it is naturally a singleton with no extra class needed.

scenario: 数据源需要在运行时可选叠加加密、压缩、日志等功能，并可能组合多个增强。
scenario_en: A data source needs optional encryption, compression, and logging layered on at runtime, possibly combined in different ways.
q: 哪个模式最合适？
q_en: Which pattern fits this best?
options: Decorator
Factory
Singleton
State Machine
options_en: Decorator
Factory
Singleton
State Machine
why: Decorator 用包装对象在不改原类的情况下叠加功能，避免 LoggedEncryptedCompressedDataSource 这类子类爆炸。
why_en: Decorator layers optional behavior around an object at runtime without creating subclasses for every combination.
whenOtherWins: 如果差异是稳定的预定义类型，而不是运行时可组合增强，普通子类可能更简单。
tradeoff: 运行时可组合叠加 vs 子类爆炸的构造时固定差异

termDefinitions.meaning: 创建型模式：把“该创建哪个具体类”的判断集中到一个方法里，调用方只依赖抽象接口。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A factory centralizes the decision of which concrete class to instantiate, so callers only depend on an abstract interface.

termDefinitions.meaning: 创建型模式：保证一个类在进程内只有一个实例，并提供全局访问点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Singleton guarantees a class has only one instance within the process and exposes a global access point to it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 行为型模式（也叫 State pattern）：把对象在每个状态下允许的行为和转移规则，分别封装到独立的状态类里。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A state machine (State pattern) encapsulates the actions allowed and the transition rules for each state into its own state class.

termDefinitions.meaning: 结构型模式：用包装对象在不修改原类的前提下叠加行为，可按运行时条件组合多层。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Decorator wraps an object to add behavior at runtime without modifying the original class, and multiple decorators can be stacked.

optionExplanations: 对，每种增强包一层，运行时想叠加哪几层就叠加哪几层，不用为每种组合各写子类。
Factory 解决的是「该创建哪个类」，这里是「要不要在已有对象外面加行为」，问题不同。
这里要的是可以叠加、可以移除的行为层，跟保证全局唯一实例没关系。
加密、压缩、日志是可以任意组合的能力，不是互斥的状态，套状态机会强行制造转移规则。
optionExplanations_en: Right — each enhancement is a wrapper layer, so you stack whichever combination you need at runtime without a subclass per combo.
Factory answers which class to build; this problem is whether to add behavior around an object you already have — a different question.
This needs behavior layers you can add or remove, which has nothing to do with guaranteeing one global instance.
Encryption, compression, and logging combine freely; they aren't mutually exclusive states, so forcing a state machine invents transitions that don't exist.

scenario: 你要在 FileDataSource 外面叠加加密和压缩，而 DataSource 调用方不想知道包装细节。
scenario_en: You need to layer encryption and compression on top of a FileDataSource, and callers should not need to know about the wrapping details.
q: 这段使用方式体现什么模式？
q_en: Which pattern does this usage pattern demonstrate?
codeSample:
source = FileDataSource('data.txt')
source = EncryptionDecorator(source)
source = CompressionDecorator(source)
source.write_data('sensitive info')
options: Builder 创建必填字段
Factory 决定创建哪个对象
Decorator 按运行时条件堆叠行为
Observer 通知多个订阅者
options_en: Builder assembling required fields.
Factory deciding which object to create.
Decorator stacking behavior based on runtime conditions.
Observer notifying multiple subscribers.
why: 每个 decorator 包装同一接口并委托给内部对象；调用方仍把它当 DataSource 使用。
why_en: The decorators wrap the same DataSource interface so behavior can be stacked while callers keep using the same abstraction.
whenOtherWins: 如果只需要创建不同具体 DataSource，一次性选择类型用 Factory 更贴切。
tradeoff: 包装叠加、原类不变 vs 一次性创建型判断（Factory）

termDefinitions.meaning: 创建型模式：把复杂对象的构造拆成一连串方法调用，最后用 build() 统一校验必填字段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Builder constructs a complex object step by step through chained calls and validates required fields in a final build() call.

termDefinitions.meaning: 创建型模式：把“该创建哪个具体类”的判断集中到一个方法里，调用方只依赖抽象接口。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A factory centralizes the decision of which concrete class to instantiate, so callers only depend on an abstract interface.

termDefinitions.meaning: 行为型模式：让多个订阅者通过统一接口，在一个 subject 状态变化时收到通知。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Observer lets multiple subscribers receive notifications through one common interface whenever a subject's state changes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 结构型模式：用包装对象在不修改原类的前提下叠加行为，可按运行时条件组合多层。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Decorator wraps an object to add behavior at runtime without modifying the original class, and multiple decorators can be stacked.

optionExplanations: 代码里没有分步配置必填字段再 build 的过程，跟 Builder 的形状不一样。
source 对象已经存在，这里是往外面包一层，不是决定「该 new 哪个类」。
对，EncryptionDecorator、CompressionDecorator 一层层包住 source，同一个接口下叠加行为。
代码里没有订阅者列表，也没有谁在监听 source 的状态变化。
optionExplanations_en: There's no step-by-step required-field assembly ending in a build() call, so this isn't Builder's shape.
The source object already exists here; this is wrapping it, not deciding which class to instantiate.
Right — EncryptionDecorator and CompressionDecorator wrap the source one layer at a time, stacking behavior behind the same interface.
There's no list of subscribers here, and nothing is listening for changes to source's state.

q: Facade 模式的核心是什么？
q_en: What is the core idea of the Facade pattern?
options: 让多个订阅者收到事件通知
保证进程内只有一个全局唯一对象
把复杂对象的构造拆成一步步过程
用简单入口协调并隐藏复杂子系统
options_en: Letting multiple subscribers receive event notifications.
Guaranteeing there is only one global instance within the process.
Breaking a complex object's construction into a step-by-step process.
Using a simple entry point to coordinate and hide a complex subsystem.
why: Facade 常常就是一个 orchestrator：它让调用方调用 Game.make_move，而不用理解 Board、Player 的每个协作细节。
why_en: A facade provides a simple entry point that coordinates a more complex set of internal components.

termDefinitions.meaning: 结构型模式：用一个简单入口协调并隐藏一组复杂子系统的内部细节。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Facade offers one simple entry point that coordinates and hides the internal details of a more complex subsystem.

optionExplanations: 这是 Observer 的职责范围，不是 Facade。
这是 Singleton 的职责范围，Facade 不管实例数量。
这是 Builder 的职责范围，Facade 不负责怎么构造对象。
对，Facade 提供一个简单方法，内部帮你协调好一堆子系统，调用方不用管细节。
optionExplanations_en: That's Observer's job, not Facade's.
That's Singleton's job; Facade has nothing to do with instance count.
That's Builder's job; Facade isn't about how an object gets constructed.
Right — Facade exposes one simple method that coordinates a bunch of subsystems internally, so callers don't touch the details.

scenario: Tic Tac Toe 的 Game 类协调 Board、Player 和 GameState，对外只暴露 make_move 等简单方法。
scenario_en: A Tic Tac Toe Game class coordinates Board, Player, and GameState internally, exposing only simple methods like make_move.
q: 这可以自然地看作哪个模式？
q_en: Which pattern does this naturally resemble?
options: Facade
Singleton
Observer
Builder
options_en: Facade
Singleton
Observer
Builder
why: Game 隐藏了内部协作细节，提供清晰入口，这正是 Facade 的结构，不必刻意点名它。
why_en: The Game orchestrator is naturally a facade because it hides Board and Player coordination behind a simple API.
whenOtherWins: 如果只是单个对象、没有内部复杂协作，就不需要强调 Facade。
tradeoff: 隐藏内部协作细节 vs 让调用方自己组合多个组件

termDefinitions.meaning: 创建型模式：保证一个类在进程内只有一个实例，并提供全局访问点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Singleton guarantees a class has only one instance within the process and exposes a global access point to it.

optionExplanations: 对，Game 把 Board/Player/GameState 的协作细节都藏起来，外部只看到 make_move 这一个入口。

optionExplanations_en: Right — Game hides how Board, Player, and GameState collaborate, exposing just make_move as the entry point.

optionExplanations: 这里要解决的是「运行时换哪种支付算法」，跟全局唯一实例无关。
对，把每种支付方式封装成可互换对象，购物车只认统一的 pay 接口，运行时切换。
没有多个订阅者在等通知，用户选支付方式是一次性决定，不是事件广播。

optionExplanations_en: The question here is which payment algorithm to run at runtime, unrelated to a single global instance.
Right — each payment method becomes a swappable object behind one pay interface, so the cart can switch at runtime.
There's no set of subscribers waiting on a notification; picking a payment method is a one-time choice, not an event broadcast.
A payment method isn't a complex object to assemble piece by piece — it's a choice among ready-made implementations.

q: Strategy 和 Factory 的区别是什么？
q_en: What is the difference between Strategy and Factory?
options: 两者在职责上完全相同，可以互相替换
Strategy 的职责其实是决定创建哪个对象
Factory 的职责其实是处理状态转换规则
Factory 管创建对象，Strategy 管对象行为
options_en: The two have identical responsibilities and are interchangeable.
Strategy's real job is deciding which object to instantiate.
Factory's real job is handling state-transition rules.
Factory decides which object to create; Strategy decides how an existing object behaves.
why: Factory 是创建决策，Strategy 是行为委托和替换；实际设计中常一起出现，factory 创建 strategy。
why_en: Factory chooses what to instantiate, while Strategy chooses which interchangeable behavior to execute.
tradeoff: 创建时刻的判断（Factory） vs 运行时刻的行为替换（Strategy）

optionExplanations: 两者解决的问题不同——一个管创建，一个管行为替换，不能互换。
这把两者职责搞反了，决定创建对象是 Factory 的事。
状态转换规则是 State Machine 的事，跟 Factory 无关。
对，Factory 负责在创建时选类，Strategy 负责让已有对象在运行时换算法。
optionExplanations_en: They solve different problems — one is about creation, the other about swapping behavior — so they aren't interchangeable.
That swaps their jobs; deciding which object to create belongs to Factory.
Transition rules belong to State Machine, not Factory.
Right — Factory picks the class at creation time, while Strategy lets an already-built object swap algorithms at runtime.

scenario: 股票价格变化后，价格显示器、价格提醒和分析模块都需要收到更新，但 Stock 不应知道每个模块具体做什么。
scenario_en: When a stock price changes, a price display, a price alert, and an analytics module all need updates, but Stock should not know what each module does internally.
q: 哪个模式最贴合？
q_en: Which pattern fits this best?
options: Observer
Factory
Singleton
Builder
options_en: Observer
Factory
Singleton
Builder
why: Observer 让多个订阅者对一个 subject 的状态变化作出反应；subject 只调用统一 update，不依赖观察者细节。
why_en: Observer fits when multiple subscribers need to react to one subject's state changes without tight coupling.
whenOtherWins: 如果只有一个固定调用方，直接方法调用可能更简单，不需要 Observer。
tradeoff: 发布者不知道订阅者细节 vs 直接硬编码调用的简单性
diagram:
flowchart LR
  S[Subject] -->|notify| A[Email]
  S -->|notify| B[SMS]
  S -->|notify| C[Analytics]
  D[New observer] -.subscribe.-> S
codeSample:
class Stock(Subject):
    def set_price(self, price):
        self.price = price
        self.notify_observers()   # 通知所有已 attach 的观察者

stock.attach(PriceDisplay())
stock.attach(PriceAlert(150.00))
stock.set_price(155.00)   # 两个观察者都会收到更新

optionExplanations: 对，Stock 只管调用统一的 update 通知，不用知道价格显示器、提醒、分析各自怎么处理。
这里的问题不是创建哪个类，是状态变了之后谁该被告知，跟创建决策无关。

This isn't about which class to instantiate; it's about who gets told after a state change — a different question than creation.
The three modules exist independently; the question is how they get notified, not whether Stock itself is a singleton.
A price update isn't assembling a complex object — it's broadcasting a state change.

scenario: 用户下单后，库存、通知、分析都需要知道订单已创建。
scenario_en: After a user places an order, inventory, notifications, and analytics all need to know the order was created.
q: 什么时候 Observer 会比硬编码三个调用更合适？
q_en: When is Observer a better fit than hard-coding three direct calls?
options: 这里从来就没有事件的概念
无论如何都只有一个固定的副作用
所有模块都必须同步成功，下单才算成立
订阅者会变化，下单逻辑不该认得每个模块
options_en: There is no concept of an event here at all.
There is always exactly one fixed side effect, no matter what.
All modules must succeed synchronously for the order to count at all.
The set of subscribers will change, and order logic shouldn't need to know each module.
why: Observer 解耦事件生产者和多个可变消费者；若副作用固定且必须同步，直接编排可能更清楚。
why_en: Observer helps when the set of side-effect consumers can change and the publisher should not know each one.
whenOtherWins: 如果库存扣减是订单事务的核心一致性步骤，不应只是松散的 observer 副作用。
tradeoff: 解耦、可变订阅者集合 vs 需要同步保证时的直接编排

termDefinitions.meaning: 行为型模式：让多个订阅者通过统一接口，在一个 subject 状态变化时收到通知。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Observer lets multiple subscribers receive notifications through one common interface whenever a subject's state changes.

optionExplanations: 下单本身就是一个可以广播的事件，这个前提说反了。
如果副作用永远只有一个且固定，直接调用反而比 Observer 更简单。
如果所有模块必须同步成功才算下单成功，说明这是强一致性事务，不该只用松耦合的 observer 副作用。
对，订阅者数量会变化、下单逻辑不该认得每个副作用模块时，Observer 的解耦才真正划算。
optionExplanations_en: Placing an order is itself an event that can be broadcast — this premise has it backwards.
If there's always exactly one fixed side effect, a direct call is simpler than adding Observer.
If every module must succeed synchronously for the order to count, that's a strong-consistency transaction, not a loose observer side effect.
Right — Observer's decoupling pays off when the set of subscribers can change and order logic shouldn't know each side-effect module.

scenario: 售货机有 NoCoin、HasCoin、Dispense 等状态；同一个动作在不同状态下行为不同且转移规则复杂。
scenario_en: A vending machine has states like NoCoin, HasCoin, and Dispense, and the same action behaves differently depending on the current state, with complex transition rules.
q: 哪个模式通常是设计中心？
q_en: Which pattern is usually the centerpiece of this design?
options: Builder
State Machine
Factory
Decorator
options_en: Builder
State Machine
Factory
Decorator
why: 状态机把状态、允许动作和转移关系显式化，避免在每个方法里散落巨大的 current_state switch。
why_en: A state machine fits when valid actions and behavior depend heavily on the object's current state.
whenOtherWins: 如果只有一两个简单状态和少量分支，直接 enum + if 可能更符合 KISS。
tradeoff: 每状态一个类、转移显式化 vs 少量状态时 enum+if 的简单直接

q: 设计状态机相关系统时，面试中最好的沟通方式之一是什么？
q_en: When designing a state-machine-based system, what is one of the best ways to communicate it in an interview?

隐藏所有状态，只说结论
画状态图：状态为节点，动作为箭头
只说“用 State Machine 模式”

Hide every state and only state the conclusion.
Draw a state diagram: states as nodes, actions as arrows.
Just say "I'll use the State Machine pattern."
why: 状态图能立即展示允许路径和非法路径；对工作流、游戏和设备类题目，可视化很有帮助。
why_en: A state diagram communicates states and transitions clearly by showing states as nodes and actions as arrows.

只说结论，面试官看不到你有没有想清楚每个状态下哪些动作合法。
对，状态图能让面试官一眼看出哪些转移合法、哪些路径被拒绝。
光说模式名字不能证明你想清楚了具体状态和转移规则，是空口号。
optionExplanations_en: An ER diagram shows table relationships, not states or transition rules — wrong tool.
Stating only the conclusion hides whether you actually worked out which actions are legal in each state.
Right — a state diagram lets the interviewer see at a glance which transitions are legal and which paths get rejected.
Just naming the pattern doesn't prove you worked out the actual states and transitions — it's an empty label.

q: 把选择设计模式的健康顺序排好：
q_en: Put the healthy order for choosing a design pattern in sequence:
steps: 如果某个模式正好降低复杂度，再点名并使用
先理解当前需求和变化点
保持简单结构解决核心问题
避免为了展示知识强行加入模式
why: 模式应服务于需求，不应成为设计起点；先有问题，再有模式。
why_en: Choose patterns after understanding the requirement and only when they reduce real complexity.
tradeoff: 先需求后模式（问题驱动） vs 先挑模式再找地方套用（模式驱动）
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A[real variation?] -->|yes| B[pick pattern]
  A -->|no| C[plain code]
  B --> D[name it briefly]
  D --> E[explain tradeoff]

termDefinitions.meaning: 优先选择能满足需求的最简单设计，不要为了展示知识而增加复杂度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: KISS stands for Keep It Simple, Stupid — prefer the simplest design that satisfies the requirement instead of adding complexity to show off knowledge.

q: 哪些“场景 → 模式”匹配合理？（多选）
q_en: Which "scenario → pattern" mappings are reasonable? (select all)
options: 多个支付算法可切换 → Strategy
所有类都要全局唯一 → Singleton
一个事件通知多个订阅者 → Observer
对象很多可选字段 → Builder
options_en: Multiple swappable payment algorithms → Strategy.
Every class needs to be globally unique → Singleton.
One event notifying multiple subscribers → Observer.
An object with many optional fields → Builder.
why: Singleton 不是默认选项，也不适合“所有类”；它只用于确实需要全局唯一实例的少数资源。
why_en: Strategy, Observer, and Builder map to interchangeable behavior, event subscribers, and complex construction, while Singleton is rare and never applies to every class.
tradeoff: 按场景挑选对应模式 vs 把某一个模式当放之四海皆准的默认项

termDefinitions.meaning: 行为型模式：把同一操作的多种可互换算法封装成对象，运行时可以整体替换。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Strategy encapsulates interchangeable algorithms for the same operation as swappable objects chosen at runtime.

termDefinitions.meaning: 创建型模式：保证一个类在进程内只有一个实例，并提供全局访问点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Singleton guarantees a class has only one instance within the process and exposes a global access point to it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 行为型模式：让多个订阅者通过统一接口，在一个 subject 状态变化时收到通知。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Observer lets multiple subscribers receive notifications through one common interface whenever a subject's state changes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 创建型模式：把复杂对象的构造拆成一连串方法调用，最后用 build() 统一校验必填字段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Builder constructs a complex object step by step through chained calls and validates required fields in a final build() call.

optionExplanations: 对，多种可互换算法在运行时切换，正是 Strategy 要解决的问题。
「所有类都要全局唯一」不成立，Singleton 只用于确实需要唯一实例的少数资源，不是默认项。
对，一次状态变化广播给多个订阅者，正是 Observer 的核心场景。
对，字段多且可选、构造细节杂，正是该考虑 Builder 的信号。
optionExplanations_en: Right — swapping between interchangeable algorithms at runtime is exactly what Strategy solves.
"Every class needs to be globally unique" is false — Singleton is for the rare resource that truly needs one instance, not a default.
Right — one state change fanning out to multiple subscribers is exactly Observer's core scenario.
Right — many optional fields and messy construction details are the cue to reach for Builder.

q: Decorator 和普通子类的关键区别是什么？
q_en: What is the key difference between Decorator and a plain subclass?
options: 两者适用场景完全相同，没有区别
Decorator 的作用只是创建全新对象实例
子类的行为可以在运行时任意堆叠替换
Decorator 适合运行时组合，子类适合固定类型
options_en: The two fit exactly the same scenarios, with no real difference.
Decorator's only job is to create a brand-new object instance.
A subclass's behavior can be stacked and replaced at runtime.
Decorator fits runtime-composable enhancements, while a subclass fits fixed, predefined type differences.
why: 如果功能组合取决于运行时条件，Decorator 更灵活；如果差异固定且简单，子类更直接。
why_en: Decorator fits runtime-composable enhancements, while subclasses fit stable predefined type differences.
tradeoff: 运行时可组合增强（Decorator） vs 编译期固定的类型差异（子类）

termDefinitions.meaning: 结构型模式：用包装对象在不修改原类的前提下叠加行为，可按运行时条件组合多层。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Decorator wraps an object to add behavior at runtime without modifying the original class, and multiple decorators can be stacked.

optionExplanations: 两者的适用场景不同——一个应对运行时可变组合，一个应对固定类型差异，不能划等号。
Decorator 是包装已有对象叠加行为，不是单纯创建一个全新实例。
子类关系在编译期就固定了，没法像 Decorator 那样在运行时任意堆叠替换。
对，功能组合是运行时可变的用 Decorator，类型差异是编译期就定死的用子类。
optionExplanations_en: They don't fit the same scenarios — one handles variable runtime combinations, the other fixed type differences — not the same thing.
Decorator wraps an existing object to add behavior; it isn't just about creating a brand-new instance.
Subclass relationships are fixed at compile time — they can't be stacked and swapped at runtime the way Decorator can.
Right — reach for Decorator when the combination varies at runtime, and for a subclass when the type difference is fixed at compile time.

scenario: 面试官看到你的 Game/OrderService 这类协调类已经把内部组件隐藏得很干净，但你从没提过“Facade”这个词。
scenario_en: The interviewer sees that your Game or OrderService coordinator already hides internal components cleanly, even though you never said the word "Facade".
q: 这种情况下，要不要专门点名说出“Facade”？
q_en: In this situation, do you need to explicitly name the pattern "Facade"?
options: Facade 只能用于图形界面（GUI）
必须点名，否则面试官会认为你不懂设计模式
Facade 已经过时，现代设计里不能再用
不必须，好设计本来就像 Facade，名字不是重点
options_en: Facade can only be used for graphical user interfaces (GUI).
You must name it, or the interviewer will think you don't know design patterns.
Facade is obsolete and cannot be used in modern designs.
Not necessarily; a good design already acts like a Facade, name or no name.
why: Game、OrderService 这类协调类自然隐藏内部复杂度；比起报模式名，展示清晰入口更重要。
why_en: A good orchestrator often already acts as a facade, so the clear API matters more than naming the pattern.
tradeoff: 点名模式术语 vs 直接展示清晰的协调接口本身

termDefinitions.meaning: 结构型模式：用一个简单入口协调并隐藏一组复杂子系统的内部细节。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Facade offers one simple entry point that coordinates and hides the internal details of a more complex subsystem.

optionExplanations: Facade 是通用的结构型模式，服务端协调类、SDK 封装都常见，不限于 GUI。
面试官更在意你有没有设计出清晰的入口，不点名词汇不代表不懂。
Facade 至今仍在广泛使用，orchestrator、SDK 门面都是它的现代形态，不存在过时。
对，好设计本来就已经把内部复杂度藏起来了，报不报模式名字是次要的。
optionExplanations_en: Facade is a general structural pattern — server-side orchestrators and SDK wrappers use it too, not just GUIs.
Interviewers care more about whether you built a clean entry point than whether you said the term out loud.
Facade is still widely used today — orchestrators and SDK facades are its modern form, nothing outdated about it.
Right — a coordinator like Game or OrderService already has Facade's shape; naming it out loud is secondary.

scenario: Domain 对象只有 id、name、type 三个必填字段，没有可选配置，也没有复杂校验。
scenario_en: A domain object has only three required fields (id, name, type), no optional configuration, and no complex validation.
q: 是否需要 Builder？
q_en: Is a Builder needed here?
options: 通常不需要，普通构造函数更简单
必须用 Observer
只能用 Singleton
必须需要，所有对象都要用 Builder
options_en: Usually not; a plain constructor is simpler.
You must use Observer.
You can only use Singleton.
It is always required; every object should use Builder.
why: Builder 解决复杂构造；在简单对象上使用 Builder 会增加样板代码和沟通成本。
why_en: Builder is usually unnecessary for simple objects with a few required fields.
whenOtherWins: 如果后续字段变多且大量可选，再考虑 Builder 或语言内更轻量的替代。
tradeoff: 简单构造函数的最少样板 vs Builder 为将来可选字段预留的扩展性

termDefinitions.meaning: 创建型模式：把复杂对象的构造拆成一连串方法调用，最后用 build() 统一校验必填字段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Builder constructs a complex object step by step through chained calls and validates required fields in a final build() call.

termDefinitions.meaning: 创建型模式：保证一个类在进程内只有一个实例，并提供全局访问点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Singleton guarantees a class has only one instance within the process and exposes a global access point to it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 行为型模式：让多个订阅者通过统一接口，在一个 subject 状态变化时收到通知。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Observer lets multiple subscribers receive notifications through one common interface whenever a subject's state changes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 优先选择能满足需求的最简单设计，不要为了展示知识而增加复杂度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: KISS stands for Keep It Simple, Stupid — prefer the simplest design that satisfies the requirement instead of adding complexity to show off knowledge.

optionExplanations: 对，只有三个必填字段，普通构造函数就够清楚，Builder 反而多一层样板代码。
这里没有状态变化要通知谁，Observer 跟构造一个简单对象无关。
字段少不代表要唯一实例，Singleton 解决的是完全不同的问题。
「所有对象都要 Builder」是过度设计，简单对象硬套 Builder 只会增加维护成本。
optionExplanations_en: Right — with only three required fields, a plain constructor is already clear; Builder would just add boilerplate.
There's no state change to notify anyone about here — Observer has nothing to do with constructing a simple object.
Having few fields doesn't call for a single shared instance — Singleton solves an entirely different problem.
"Every object needs Builder" is overengineering; forcing it onto a simple object only adds upkeep cost.

scenario: 新增 PushNotification 时，你希望除创建逻辑外，发送方代码不变。
scenario_en: When adding PushNotification, you want the sending call sites to stay unchanged except for the creation logic.
q: Factory 方案下通常改哪里？
q_en: Under a Factory approach, what usually needs to change?
options: 直接删掉 Notification 这个抽象接口
把所有通知类型合并进一个巨大 if/else
新增一个通知类，factory 里加一行映射
把每个发送方里的 new 调用都手动改一遍
options_en: Delete the Notification abstraction entirely.
Merge every notification type into one giant if/else.
Add a new notification class and one new mapping line inside the factory.
Manually edit the `new` call at every call site.
why: Factory 把创建变化集中到一处，调用方依赖 Notification 抽象，不需要修改。
why_en: With a factory, adding push notification mainly adds a new implementation and one creation mapping.
whenOtherWins: 如果使用依赖注入容器或注册表，映射可能在配置中完成而不是硬编码 factory。
tradeoff: 改一处 factory 映射 vs 改遍每个调用点的 new

termDefinitions.meaning: 创建型模式：把“该创建哪个具体类”的判断集中到一个方法里，调用方只依赖抽象接口。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A factory centralizes the decision of which concrete class to instantiate, so callers only depend on an abstract interface.

optionExplanations: 删掉抽象接口会让调用方重新依赖具体类，正好是 Factory 想避免的事。
把类型判断摊到调用方去合并成大 if/else，等于把 Factory 集中管理的好处丢掉了。
对，新类型只需要新增一个实现，再在 factory 里加一行映射，调用方代码不用动。
逐个改调用点里的 new，正是没用 Factory 时才会发生的高成本改动。
optionExplanations_en: Deleting the abstraction would make callers depend on concrete classes again — exactly what Factory exists to prevent.
Pushing the type check out into a giant if/else at every call site throws away the whole point of centralizing it in one place.
Right — a new type just needs a new implementation plus one mapping line in the factory; caller code doesn't change.
Editing the `new` call at every site one by one is the costly change a factory is meant to avoid.

scenario: Stock.set_price(price) 后要自动更新多个显示器和提醒器。
scenario_en: After Stock.set_price(price) runs, multiple displays and alerters must update automatically.
q: Subject 最不应该做什么？
q_en: What is the one thing the Subject should avoid doing?
options: 支持 attach/detach
知道每个 observer 的业务细节并硬编码
维护 observers 列表
调用 observer.update
options_en: Supporting attach/detach.
Knowing each observer's business logic and hard-coding the calls.
Maintaining a list of observers.
Calling observer.update.
why: Observer 的价值在于 subject 只知道统一接口，不知道订阅者如何处理事件；硬编码会重新耦合。
why_en: The subject should notify observers through a common interface rather than hard-coding each observer's business logic.
whenOtherWins: 如果只有一个固定后续步骤且必须同步成功，直接调用可能更清楚。
tradeoff: 统一接口通知、subject 不知情 vs 硬编码调用带来的紧耦合

termDefinitions.meaning: 行为型模式：让多个订阅者通过统一接口，在一个 subject 状态变化时收到通知。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Observer lets multiple subscribers receive notifications through one common interface whenever a subject's state changes.

optionExplanations: attach/detach 正是 subject 该提供的能力，不是要避免的事。
对，subject 一旦硬编码每个 observer 的业务逻辑，就重新变回紧耦合，违背了 Observer 想解耦的初衷。
维护订阅者列表是 subject 的本职工作，不是问题所在。
调用统一的 update 接口正是 subject 该做的，不是它该避免的事。
optionExplanations_en: Supporting attach/detach is exactly what a subject should offer, not something to avoid.
Right — once the subject hard-codes each observer's business logic, it's back to tight coupling, defeating the point of decoupling in the first place.
Maintaining the subscriber list is the subject's normal job, not the problem.
Calling a common update method is exactly what a subject should do, not something to avoid.

q: 创建型模式速记中，哪些说法正确？（多选）
q_en: In this creational-pattern cheat sheet, which statements are correct? (select all)
options: Factory：调用方不该关心具体类创建
Observer：逐步构造复杂对象
Builder：对象有很多可选字段或构造细节
Singleton：确实需要全局唯一实例时才考虑
options_en: Factory: callers should not care which concrete class gets created.
Observer: assembling a complex object step by step.
Builder: the object has many optional fields or messy construction details.
Singleton: consider it only when you truly need one global instance.
why: Observer 是行为型事件通知模式，不是创建型构造模式，不属于这张速记。
why_en: Factory, Builder, and Singleton are creational patterns for object creation decisions, complex construction, and rare global uniqueness, unlike Observer.

termDefinitions.meaning: 创建型模式：把“该创建哪个具体类”的判断集中到一个方法里，调用方只依赖抽象接口。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A factory centralizes the decision of which concrete class to instantiate, so callers only depend on an abstract interface.

termDefinitions.meaning: 创建型模式：把复杂对象的构造拆成一连串方法调用，最后用 build() 统一校验必填字段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Builder constructs a complex object step by step through chained calls and validates required fields in a final build() call.

termDefinitions.meaning: 创建型模式：保证一个类在进程内只有一个实例，并提供全局访问点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Singleton guarantees a class has only one instance within the process and exposes a global access point to it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 行为型模式：让多个订阅者通过统一接口，在一个 subject 状态变化时收到通知。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Observer lets multiple subscribers receive notifications through one common interface whenever a subject's state changes.

optionExplanations: 对，调用方不该操心具体类怎么来，这正是 Factory 的定位。
Observer 是行为型模式，管的是事件通知，不是逐步构造对象，不该出现在创建型速记里。
对，可选字段多、构造细节杂时就该想到 Builder。
对，只有真的需要全局唯一实例时才考虑 Singleton，不是默认选项。
optionExplanations_en: Right — callers shouldn't have to care which concrete class gets built, and that's exactly Factory's job.
Observer is a behavioral pattern about event notification, not step-by-step construction — it doesn't belong on this creational list.
Right — many optional fields or messy construction details are the cue for Builder.
Right — only reach for Singleton when you truly need one instance process-wide, not as a default.

q: 结构型模式速记中，哪些说法正确？（多选）
q_en: In this structural-pattern cheat sheet, which statements are correct? (select all)
options: Decorator：运行时叠加可选行为
Strategy：替换算法行为
Facade：隐藏复杂子系统，提供简单入口
Factory：通知订阅者
options_en: Decorator: layers optional behavior on at runtime.
Strategy: swaps out algorithm behavior.
Facade: hides a complex subsystem behind a simple entry point.
Factory: notifies subscribers.
why: Strategy 是行为型模式，Factory 是创建型模式；Decorator 和 Facade 才是这里的结构型例子。
why_en: Decorator layers optional behavior and Facade provides a simple entry point over internal complexity, while Strategy and Factory belong to other categories.

termDefinitions.meaning: 结构型模式：用包装对象在不修改原类的前提下叠加行为，可按运行时条件组合多层。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Decorator wraps an object to add behavior at runtime without modifying the original class, and multiple decorators can be stacked.

termDefinitions.meaning: 行为型模式：把同一操作的多种可互换算法封装成对象，运行时可以整体替换。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Strategy encapsulates interchangeable algorithms for the same operation as swappable objects chosen at runtime.

termDefinitions.meaning: 结构型模式：用一个简单入口协调并隐藏一组复杂子系统的内部细节。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Facade offers one simple entry point that coordinates and hides the internal details of a more complex subsystem.

termDefinitions.meaning: 创建型模式：把“该创建哪个具体类”的判断集中到一个方法里，调用方只依赖抽象接口。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A factory centralizes the decision of which concrete class to instantiate, so callers only depend on an abstract interface.

optionExplanations: 对，运行时给对象叠加可选行为，正是 Decorator 的结构型定位。
换算法是 Strategy 的活，不是拼装对象结构，不该算进这张结构型清单。
对，用一个简单入口隐藏内部一堆组件，正是 Facade 的结构型定位。
决定造哪个类是 Factory 的活，不是通知订阅者，也不该算进这张结构型清单。
optionExplanations_en: Right — layering optional behavior onto an object at runtime is exactly Decorator's structural role.
Strategy is a behavioral pattern about swapping algorithms, not something that belongs on the structural list.
Right — one simple entry point hiding a bunch of internal components is exactly Facade's structural role.
Factory is a creational pattern about which class to build; it doesn't notify subscribers, and it isn't structural either.

q: 行为型模式速记中，哪些说法正确？（多选）
q_en: In this behavioral-pattern cheat sheet, which statements are correct? (select all)
options: Builder：事件通知多个订阅者
Strategy：替换 if/else 为可互换行为
Observer：多个组件响应单个事件
State Machine：行为随当前状态和转移规则变化
options_en: Builder: notifies multiple subscribers of an event.
Strategy: replaces if/else chains with interchangeable behavior.
Observer: multiple components react to a single event.
State Machine: behavior changes with the current state and transition rules.
why: Builder 是创建型模式，不属于行为型速记；Strategy、Observer、State Machine 都处理对象间的行为流。
why_en: Strategy, Observer, and State Machine are behavioral patterns for interchangeable behavior, event notification, and state-dependent behavior, unlike the creational Builder.

termDefinitions.meaning: 创建型模式：把复杂对象的构造拆成一连串方法调用，最后用 build() 统一校验必填字段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Builder constructs a complex object step by step through chained calls and validates required fields in a final build() call.

termDefinitions.meaning: 行为型模式：把同一操作的多种可互换算法封装成对象，运行时可以整体替换。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Strategy encapsulates interchangeable algorithms for the same operation as swappable objects chosen at runtime.

termDefinitions.meaning: 行为型模式：让多个订阅者通过统一接口，在一个 subject 状态变化时收到通知。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Observer lets multiple subscribers receive notifications through one common interface whenever a subject's state changes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 行为型模式（也叫 State pattern）：把对象在每个状态下允许的行为和转移规则，分别封装到独立的状态类里。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A state machine (State pattern) encapsulates the actions allowed and the transition rules for each state into its own state class.

optionExplanations: 一步步拼对象是 Builder 的活，不是通知订阅者，不该算进这张行为型清单。
对，把 if/else 换成可互换的算法对象，正是 Strategy 的行为型定位。
对，一个事件让多个组件各自响应，正是 Observer 的行为型定位。
对，行为随当前状态和转移规则变化，正是 State Machine 的行为型定位。
optionExplanations_en: Builder is a creational pattern about step-by-step construction, not about notifying subscribers — it doesn't belong on the behavioral list.
Right — replacing an if/else chain with swappable algorithm objects is exactly Strategy's behavioral role.
Right — one event triggering reactions in multiple components is exactly Observer's behavioral role.
Right — behavior changing with the current state and its transition rules is exactly State Machine's behavioral role.

scenario: 订单有 CREATED、PAID、SHIPPED、DELIVERED、CANCELLED 状态，动作合法性取决于当前状态。
scenario_en: An order has states CREATED, PAID, SHIPPED, DELIVERED, CANCELLED, and whether an action is legal depends on the current state.
q: 你面试里应优先画什么辅助说明？
q_en: What visual aid should you prioritize drawing in the interview?
options: 状态图：状态是节点，动作是箭头
CDN 边缘节点的拓扑连接图
一张详细的数据库容量估算表格
订单类的继承树深度示意图
options_en: A state diagram: states as nodes, actions as arrows.
A topology diagram of CDN edge nodes.
A detailed database capacity estimation table.
An inheritance-depth diagram of the order class.
why: 状态图能让面试官快速验证转移是否完整，非法路径是否被拒绝。
why_en: A state diagram is the clearest way to show legal order transitions and invalid paths.
whenOtherWins: 如果状态很少且规则简单，文字列出 enum 和转换条件也足够。
tradeoff: 状态图的可视化验证 vs 文字列出 enum+条件的省时

termDefinitions.meaning: 行为型模式（也叫 State pattern）：把对象在每个状态下允许的行为和转移规则，分别封装到独立的状态类里。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A state machine (State pattern) encapsulates the actions allowed and the transition rules for each state into its own state class.

optionExplanations: 对，状态图能让面试官一眼验证哪些转移合法、哪些路径被正确拒绝。
CDN 拓扑图讲的是网络分发结构，跟订单状态转移是两件事。
容量估算表格是系统设计的话术，回答不了「这个状态下能不能做这个动作」。
继承深度讲的是类之间的静态关系，订单状态是运行时会变化的东西，画继承树看不出转移规则。
optionExplanations_en: Right — a state diagram lets the interviewer verify at a glance which transitions are legal and which paths get correctly rejected.
A CDN topology diagram is about network distribution, an entirely different question from order-state transitions.
A capacity table belongs to system-design estimation and can't answer whether an action is legal in a given state.
Inheritance depth describes static class relationships; order state changes at runtime, so a class tree won't show transition rules.

q: 一个 LLD 方案同时强行加入三个以上模式，常见信号是什么？
q_en: If an LLD solution forces in three or more patterns at once, what is that usually a sign of?
options: 说明需求已经完全实现
一定比简单方案更可读
一定是更高级的设计
可能过度工程化，没有从问题本身出发
options_en: It means the requirements are fully implemented.
It is definitely more readable than a simple solution.
It is definitely a more advanced design.
It may be overengineering, not driven by the problem itself.
why: 多数面试设计不用模式或最多一两个；模式数量多通常意味着候选人在展示知识而不是解决问题。
why_en: Using many patterns at once is often a sign of overengineering rather than problem-driven design.

termDefinitions.meaning: 面试中考察类设计、接口划分和模式选择的设计环节，区别于高层架构的 System Design。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LLD stands for Low-Level Design, the interview round that tests class design, interfaces, and pattern choices.

optionExplanations: 模式数量跟需求有没有实现完全是两码事，这个说法没有因果关系。
堆的模式越多，读者要记住的抽象概念越多，通常是更难读而不是更可读。
「更高级」不是客观标准，面试官评价的是设计是否贴合问题，不是模式数量。
对，同时强行塞进三个以上模式，通常说明候选人在展示知识而不是解决眼前的问题。
optionExplanations_en: How many patterns you use has nothing to do with whether the requirements are met — no causal link there.
The more patterns stacked in, the more abstractions the reader has to track — usually harder to read, not easier.
"More advanced" isn't an objective bar; interviewers judge fit to the problem, not pattern count.
Right — forcing in three or more patterns at once is usually a sign of showing off knowledge rather than solving the problem in front of you.

scenario: 路径规划系统支持 fastest、shortest、least_tolls，多种算法可按用户偏好切换。
scenario_en: A route-planning system supports fastest, shortest, and least_tolls modes, with multiple algorithms switchable by user preference.
q: 哪个模式最自然？
q_en: Which pattern is the most natural fit?
options: Builder only
Facade only
Strategy
Singleton
options_en: Builder only
Facade only
Strategy
Singleton
why: 每种路径规划方式都是同一问题的不同算法；Strategy 让调用方选择并委托给当前算法对象。
why_en: Route-planning modes are interchangeable algorithms, which is exactly the Strategy pattern.
whenOtherWins: 如果算法选择只发生在对象创建时，Factory 可以负责创建对应 Strategy。
tradeoff: 运行时可互换算法（Strategy） vs 创建时一次性选定（Factory）

termDefinitions.meaning: 创建型模式：把复杂对象的构造拆成一连串方法调用，最后用 build() 统一校验必填字段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Builder constructs a complex object step by step through chained calls and validates required fields in a final build() call.

termDefinitions.meaning: 结构型模式：用一个简单入口协调并隐藏一组复杂子系统的内部细节。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Facade offers one simple entry point that coordinates and hides the internal details of a more complex subsystem.

termDefinitions.meaning: 创建型模式：保证一个类在进程内只有一个实例，并提供全局访问点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Singleton guarantees a class has only one instance within the process and exposes a global access point to it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 行为型模式：把同一操作的多种可互换算法封装成对象，运行时可以整体替换。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Strategy encapsulates interchangeable algorithms for the same operation as swappable objects chosen at runtime.

termDefinitions.meaning: 创建型模式：把“该创建哪个具体类”的判断集中到一个方法里，调用方只依赖抽象接口。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A factory centralizes the decision of which concrete class to instantiate, so callers only depend on an abstract interface.

optionExplanations: 路径规划算法不是要拼装的复杂对象字段，是要在几种算法里选一种，Builder 不对题。
这里没有一堆子系统需要被隐藏协调，只是同一个操作换不同算法实现。
对，fastest/shortest/least_tolls 是同一问题的可互换算法，正好交给 Strategy 在运行时切换。
选哪种路径算法跟要不要保证全局唯一实例完全无关。
optionExplanations_en: A routing algorithm isn't a set of fields to assemble into a complex object; it's a choice among algorithms, so Builder is off target.
There's no bundle of subsystems to hide and coordinate here — it's the same operation implemented by different algorithms.
Right — fastest, shortest, and least_tolls are interchangeable algorithms for the same problem, exactly what Strategy swaps at runtime.
Which routing algorithm to use has nothing to do with guaranteeing a single global instance.

scenario: 某些请求需要 logging，有些还需要 caching，有些还需要 rate limiting，组合由配置决定。
scenario_en: Some requests need logging, some also need caching, and some also need rate limiting, with the combination decided by configuration.
q: 哪个模式可以避免为每种组合写子类？
q_en: Which pattern avoids writing a subclass for every combination?
options: Decorator
Builder
Singleton
State Machine
options_en: Decorator
Builder
Singleton
State Machine
why: Decorator 可以按配置包裹服务，每层增加一个横切行为；组合数量增长时，比子类爆炸更可控。
why_en: Decorator avoids subclass explosion by stacking configurable behaviors such as logging, caching, and rate limiting.
whenOtherWins: 如果这些行为固定属于不同服务类型，普通组合或子类可能更直接。
tradeoff: 按配置动态叠加横切行为 vs 每种组合各写一个子类

termDefinitions.meaning: 创建型模式：把复杂对象的构造拆成一连串方法调用，最后用 build() 统一校验必填字段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Builder constructs a complex object step by step through chained calls and validates required fields in a final build() call.

termDefinitions.meaning: 创建型模式：保证一个类在进程内只有一个实例，并提供全局访问点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Singleton guarantees a class has only one instance within the process and exposes a global access point to it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 行为型模式（也叫 State pattern）：把对象在每个状态下允许的行为和转移规则，分别封装到独立的状态类里。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A state machine (State pattern) encapsulates the actions allowed and the transition rules for each state into its own state class.

termDefinitions.meaning: 结构型模式：用包装对象在不修改原类的前提下叠加行为，可按运行时条件组合多层。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Decorator wraps an object to add behavior at runtime without modifying the original class, and multiple decorators can be stacked.

optionExplanations: 对，按配置一层层包裹服务，组合数量再多也不用为每种组合各写一个子类。
这里不是在构造一个对象的字段，是在给已有服务叠加横切行为，跟 Builder 无关。
要不要加日志、缓存、限流是每个请求各自的组合，跟全局唯一实例没关系。
logging/caching/rate limiting 可以任意组合共存，不是互斥的状态，套状态机会曲解问题。
optionExplanations_en: Right — wrap the service one configured layer at a time, so no matter how many combinations exist, you never write a subclass per combo.
This isn't assembling an object's fields — it's layering cross-cutting behavior onto a service that already exists, unrelated to Builder.
Whether a request gets logging, caching, or rate limiting is per-request configuration, unrelated to a single global instance.
Logging, caching, and rate limiting can combine freely; they aren't mutually exclusive states, so a state machine misreads the problem.

scenario: 外部调用方要完成 checkout，但内部要协调 cart、payment、inventory、receipt 四个组件。
scenario_en: An external caller needs to complete checkout, while internally four components (cart, payment, inventory, receipt) must be coordinated.
q: 哪个结构能隐藏内部复杂度？
q_en: Which structure hides this internal complexity?
options: checkout 方法永远只返回 None
把内部所有对象字段都设成 public
CheckoutService 作为 Facade 统一入口
调用方自己依次调用 cart/payment/inventory
options_en: Have the checkout method always return None.
Make every internal object field public.
Use CheckoutService as a single Facade entry point.
Let the caller call cart, payment, and inventory itself, one by one.
why: Facade 让调用方使用一个稳定入口，同时内部可以协调多个组件，降低调用方耦合。
why_en: A CheckoutService facade gives callers one stable entry point while coordinating cart, payment, inventory, and receipt internally.
whenOtherWins: 如果调用方本身就是编排层，额外 facade 可能只是多一层转发。
tradeoff: 统一入口隐藏协调细节 vs 调用方自己编排多个组件的透明度

termDefinitions.meaning: 结构型模式：用一个简单入口协调并隐藏一组复杂子系统的内部细节。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Facade offers one simple entry point that coordinates and hides the internal details of a more complex subsystem.

optionExplanations: 返回值形式跟隐不隐藏内部复杂度没关系，答非所问。
把字段全设成 public 反而暴露了内部细节，跟隐藏复杂度正好相反。
对，CheckoutService 提供一个稳定入口，内部帮你协调 cart、payment、inventory、receipt，调用方不用管细节。
让调用方自己依次调用每个组件，正是没有隐藏复杂度、耦合最重的做法。
optionExplanations_en: The return type has nothing to do with whether internal complexity is hidden — wrong angle.
Making every field public exposes internals rather than hiding them — the opposite of what's needed.
Right — CheckoutService gives one stable entry point and coordinates cart, payment, inventory, and receipt internally, so callers skip the details.
Having the caller invoke each component itself is exactly the tightly coupled, nothing-hidden approach to avoid.

q: 把售货机状态流排好：
q_en: Put the vending machine's state flow in the correct order:
steps: Dispense 状态执行 dispense 后回到 NoCoin
NoCoin 状态收到 insert_coin 后进入 HasCoin
HasCoin 状态收到 select_product 后进入 Dispense
NoCoin 状态下 select_product 应提示先投币
why: 先识别非法动作，再按投币、选择、出货、回到初始状态的路径讲清楚。
why_en: The vending machine flow rejects selection without a coin, then moves from coin inserted to product selected to dispensing and back.
tradeoff: 显式拒绝非法动作 vs 只讲正常路径、忽略边界情况

termDefinitions.meaning: 行为型模式（也叫 State pattern）：把对象在每个状态下允许的行为和转移规则，分别封装到独立的状态类里。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A state machine (State pattern) encapsulates the actions allowed and the transition rules for each state into its own state class.

q: 补全模式选择速记：
q_en: Complete the pattern-selection cheat sheet:
text: {{Factory}} 管创建，{{Strategy}} 管可替换行为，{{Observer}} 管事件订阅，{{State Machine}} 管状态转移。
why: 这四个是 LLD 面试里最常见、最容易混淆的模式。
why_en: Factory handles creation, Strategy handles interchangeable behavior, Observer handles event subscribers, and State Machine handles transitions.

termDefinitions.meaning: 创建型模式：把“该创建哪个具体类”的判断集中到一个方法里，调用方只依赖抽象接口。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A factory centralizes the decision of which concrete class to instantiate, so callers only depend on an abstract interface.

termDefinitions.meaning: 行为型模式：把同一操作的多种可互换算法封装成对象，运行时可以整体替换。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Strategy encapsulates interchangeable algorithms for the same operation as swappable objects chosen at runtime.

termDefinitions.meaning: 行为型模式：让多个订阅者通过统一接口，在一个 subject 状态变化时收到通知。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Observer lets multiple subscribers receive notifications through one common interface whenever a subject's state changes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 行为型模式（也叫 State pattern）：把对象在每个状态下允许的行为和转移规则，分别封装到独立的状态类里。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A state machine (State pattern) encapsulates the actions allowed and the transition rules for each state into its own state class.

q: 补全模式使用原则：
q_en: Complete the principle for when to use a pattern:
text: 先解决问题，再命名模式；如果一个模式没有减少真实{{复杂度}}、{{重复}}或{{耦合}}，就不要强行加入。
why: 模式是设计结果的名字，不是设计的起点。
why_en: Name patterns after they solve real complexity, duplication, or coupling rather than forcing them upfront.

q: Amazon Locker 系统最终确定要实现的核心能力有哪些？（多选）
q_en: Which core capabilities are in scope for the Amazon Locker system? (Select all that apply.)
options: 司机按包裹尺寸投递并获得取件码
用户用取件码打开对应格口
取件码 7 天后过期，过期后拒绝取件
系统负责短信或邮件通知用户
why: 系统边界只覆盖 locker 内部的投递、取件和过期判断；通知渠道被明确交给下游系统处理。过期码会被拒绝，但包裹仍占用格口直到工作人员处理。
why_en: The locker system owns deposit, pickup, and expiry handling, but notification delivery is explicitly a downstream system's job.
options_en: The driver deposits by package size and receives a pickup code.
The user opens the matching compartment using the pickup code.
The pickup code expires after seven days and is rejected once expired.
The system is responsible for sending SMS or email notifications.
optionExplanations: 司机按尺寸投递拿到取件码，这是投递流程的起点，属于系统要负责的动作。
取件码就是开对应格口的钥匙，这一步同样在系统职责范围内。
取件码到第 7 天要被拒绝，这条规则也在范围内，但拒绝开门权限不等于格口马上腾空。
容易以为系统还要负责提醒用户，但短信、邮件这类通知渠道被划给了下游系统，locker 只管生成码。
optionExplanations_en: The driver depositing by size and getting a code kicks off the flow — squarely the system's job.
The pickup code is the key to its matching door, also core to what the system owns.
Codes must lapse on day seven — in scope too, but rejecting a lapsed code doesn't instantly free the slot.
It's tempting to assume the system also pings users, but SMS/email alerts are handed to a separate downstream service; the locker just issues the code.

scenario: 面试官问“包裹实体要不要建模”，但系统只根据 small/medium/large 做格口分配。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks whether Package should be modeled, but the system only uses small, medium, and large for slot allocation.
q: 最合适的建模选择是什么？
q_en: What is the best modeling choice?
options: 把 Package 作为完整实体，包含收件人、物流和订单字段
不建 Package 类，把 size 当作 depositPackage 的输入
把 Package 作为 AccessToken 的子类
把 Package 存在每个 Compartment 里并让它生成 token
why: 包裹的物流和客户信息属于外部履约系统，本系统只需要尺寸。没有行为的实体会增加耦合而不提高设计表达力。
why_en: Package does not earn an entity because the locker only needs package size, while shipping details live outside the system.
whenOtherWins: 如果后续要支持同一格口多包裹、包裹 ID 查询、退回流程追踪，Package 才会变成有行为和生命周期的实体。
diagram:
classDiagram
  class Locker
  class Compartment
  class AccessToken
  class Package
  Locker --> Compartment
  Locker --> AccessToken
  Compartment --> Package
options_en: Model Package as a full entity with recipient, shipping, and order fields.
Skip a Package class and pass size as an input parameter to depositPackage.
Make Package a subclass of AccessToken.
Store Package inside every Compartment and let it generate the token.
tradeoff: 把 Package 建成完整实体 vs 把 size 当作方法输入参数

termDefinitions.meaning: 本系统里代表打开某个格口权限的凭证对象，带过期时间和格口引用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An AccessToken is the credential object in this system that represents permission to open one compartment and carries an expiration time.

termDefinitions.meaning: locker 里的一个物理格口，用于存放包裹。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Compartment is one physical storage slot inside the locker that holds a package.

optionExplanations: 如果后续要按包裹追踪状态、支持多包裹查询或退回流程，才值得把 Package 做成带收件人、物流字段的完整实体。
本题里 locker 只用 size 决定格口，把 size 当参数传进 depositPackage 就够，不用额外建实体。
AccessToken 表达的是访问权限，Package 表达的是货物本身，两者语义不同，继承关系会把权限和货物属性混在一起。
格口是可复用的物理容器，把 Package 存进 Compartment 会让 token 生成逻辑和格口耦合，下一次投递还得先清空。
optionExplanations_en: It's only worth making Package a full entity with recipient/shipping fields once you need to track multi-package state or returns.
Here the locker only needs size to pick a compartment, so passing size straight into depositPackage is enough — no extra entity.
AccessToken models access rights, Package models the goods — inheriting one from the other mixes permission logic with cargo attributes.
A compartment is a reusable physical slot; storing Package inside it couples token generation to the slot and forces cleanup before reuse.

q: AccessToken 为什么值得建模成独立实体，而不是普通字符串？
q_en: Why should AccessToken be modeled as its own entity instead of a plain string?
options: 它只是用于生成随机数，和业务完全无关
它代表打开格口的权限，并带有过期时间
它只是用来保存短信通知的发送状态
它只是用来表示包裹的尺寸
why: 取件码不是裸字符串，而是一个有期限的 bearer token。把过期判断放在 AccessToken 上，能让职责和数据对齐。
why_en: AccessToken deserves its own type because it couples the code, expiration, and compartment access right.
options_en: It's only used to generate a random number, unrelated to business logic.
It represents the right to open a compartment, carrying an expiration time.
It's only used to store SMS notification delivery status.
It's only used to represent the package size.

termDefinitions.meaning: 持有即可使用的凭证，谁拿到这个码就能开对应的门，不再额外验证身份。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A bearer token is a credential that grants access to whoever holds it, without further identity checks.

optionExplanations: 随机数生成器不需要建模成实体；这个说法只是想把 AccessToken 拉低成无意义的工具函数。
它绑定的是访问权限和有效期，这两点必须留在同一个对象上才好判断。
短信状态属于通知系统的职责，AccessToken 不应该替下游系统存这份数据。
包裹尺寸决定分配哪个格口，那是 Compartment/Package 关心的事，不是访问凭证要管的。
optionExplanations_en: A random-number generator doesn't need its own entity — this option just tries to shrink AccessToken into a throwaway helper.
It bundles access rights with an expiration, and those two need to live on the same object to be checked together.
SMS status belongs to the notification system; AccessToken shouldn't be the place that stores that data for a downstream service.
Package size decides which compartment to allocate — that's Compartment/Package's concern, not something a credential should track.

q: 补全取件码和包裹占用的语义：
q_en: Complete the meaning of pickup-code validity versus package occupancy:
text: 取件码过期后应被{{拒绝取件}}，但包裹仍然{{物理占用格口}}，直到工作人员取走并清理状态。
why: token 有效性和格口物理占用不是同一个状态。过期只说明用户不能再开门，不说明格口可重新分配。
why_en: Token validity and physical occupancy can diverge, so an expired code does not make the compartment available.

termDefinitions.meaning: 本系统里代表打开某个格口权限的凭证对象，带过期时间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An AccessToken represents permission to open one compartment and carries an expiration time.

q: 判断一个状态该建在哪个类上的核心区分依据是什么？
q_en: What is the key rule for deciding which class should own a piece of state?
options: 状态是不是整数
状态是物理属性还是系统管理的关系
状态会不会出现在 API 返回值里
状态是不是可以缓存
why: 格口是否装着包裹是 Compartment 的物理属性，因此放在 Compartment 上；token 到格口的映射是 Locker 管理的系统关系，因此放在 Locker 上。
why_en: State that is intrinsic to an object, like whether a compartment physically holds a package, belongs on that object, while system-managed relationships belong on the orchestrator.
scenario: 设计 Locker 系统时，你要决定「格口是否被占用」这类状态该建在 Compartment 类自己身上，还是集中放进 Locker 维护的一个 Set/Map 里管理。
scenario_en: When designing the Locker system, you must decide whether occupancy lives on Compartment itself or in a Set/Map owned by Locker.
options_en: Whether the state happens to be an integer.
Whether the state is an intrinsic physical property or a relationship the system manages.
Whether the state shows up in an API response.
Whether the state can be cached.
tradeoff: 内在物理属性放在实体自身 vs 系统管理的关系放在 orchestrator

termDefinitions.meaning: 负责编排整体业务流程、协调多个实体的顶层对象，这里指 Locker。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An orchestrator is the top-level object that coordinates the overall workflow across multiple entities, here the Locker.

optionExplanations: 数据类型（整数/字符串）跟状态该放哪个对象无关，这是一个无关紧要的表面特征。
关键要看这份状态是对象自身固有的物理属性，还是系统在编排时维护的关系——这决定它该长在谁身上。
会不会出现在 API 里是接口设计问题，和状态该建在哪个类上是两件事。
能不能缓存是性能优化的考虑，不能拿来决定状态本该属于谁。
optionExplanations_en: Whether a value is an int or a string says nothing about which object should own it — that's a surface detail.
The real question is whether the state is intrinsic to the object itself or a relationship the orchestrator manages, and that decides where it lives.
Showing up in an API response is an interface-design question, separate from where the state should be modeled.
Cacheability is a performance concern, not a reason to decide who owns a piece of state.

scenario: 你要选择如何表示格口是否可用，且 expired token 仍要保留用于给用户返回“已过期”。
scenario_en: You need to represent compartment availability while still keeping expired tokens so the user can get an expired-code error.
q: 最适合本文范围的可用性状态放在哪里？
q_en: Where should availability state live in this design scope?
options: 完全从 accessTokenMapping 推导，不存 occupied
在 Compartment 上存 occupied/status
在 AccessToken 上存 isCompartmentFree
在 Package 上存 openedDoor
why: 包裹是否还在格口里是物理状态，和 token 是否有效不同步。让 Compartment 管理 occupied 可以避免把过期 token 错当成可用性来源。
why_en: Keeping occupancy on Compartment avoids conflating token lifetime with physical package presence.
whenOtherWins: 如果格口数量巨大且投递极高频，可以维护按尺寸分组的可用队列作为索引，但要承担同步复杂度。
options_en: Derive availability entirely from accessTokenMapping, without storing an occupied field.
Store an occupied or status field on Compartment.
Store an isCompartmentFree flag on AccessToken.
Store an openedDoor flag on Package.
tradeoff: 占用放在 Compartment（物理状态） vs 从 token map 推导（关系状态）

termDefinitions.meaning: Locker 内部维护的 token code 到 AccessToken 对象的查找表。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: accessTokenMapping is the lookup table the Locker keeps from a token code to its AccessToken object.

optionExplanations: 只看 token 是否还在 map 里当可用性来源，会把过期但包裹还在的格口误判成空闲——这里行不通。
包裹在不在格口是格口自身的物理事实，把 occupied 存在 Compartment 上，才不会被 token 的生命周期带偏。
isCompartmentFree 放在 AccessToken 上意味着一个已删除的 token 没法再告诉你格口状态，职责放错了对象。
openedDoor 放在 Package 上假设包裹对象一直存在，但本题范围里 Package 甚至不是独立实体，这个字段没处安放。
optionExplanations_en: Treating token presence in the map as the availability source misjudges a lapsed-but-still-occupied slot as free — doesn't hold up.
Whether a package sits inside a slot is the compartment's own physical fact; keeping occupied there stops it from drifting with token lifetime.
Putting isCompartmentFree on AccessToken means a removed token can no longer report slot state — the responsibility sits on the wrong object.
openedDoor on Package assumes a persistent Package object, but this scope doesn't even model Package as its own entity, so the field has nowhere to live.

q: 按正确顺序排列：为什么不能只从 token map 推导格口占用？
q_en: Put the reasoning in order: why can't occupancy be derived only from the token map?
steps: 如果把过期 token 当作无效并忽略，系统会以为格口空闲。
取件码 7 天后过期，但包裹仍在格口内。
因此 token 有效性不能等价于物理占用。
工作人员清理前，格口不应被重新分配。
why: 这个推理链是本文状态建模的关键。过期 token 仍然需要留在 map 中用于返回正确错误，但格口仍被包裹占着。
why_en: The key reasoning is that expiration changes access rights but not physical occupancy.

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据或凭证的存活时长，过期后应被拒绝或清理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TTL, or Time To Live, is how long a piece of data or a credential stays valid before it must be rejected or cleaned up.

scenario: locker 只有 20-50 个格口，投递量普通，面试要求代码清晰。
scenario_en: The locker has only 20 to 50 compartments, normal deposit volume, and the interview values clear code.
q: getAvailableCompartment 的默认实现应该怎么做？
q_en: What should the default getAvailableCompartment implementation do?
options: 每次扫描 compartments，找同尺寸且未占用的格口
维护三棵平衡树按尺寸和最近使用排序
把所有格口放进一个全局随机池
让 AccessToken 反向扫描寻找空格口
why: 小规模格口下 O(n) 扫描足够，代码简单且单一来源清楚。用队列索引虽可 O(1)，但同步成本不值得。
why_en: For 20 to 50 compartments, a simple scan is clearer and the performance difference is negligible.
whenOtherWins: 当一个站点有成百上千格口且投递极高频时，按尺寸维护可用队列能把查找降到 O(1)。
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A["need size"] --> B["scan compartments"]
  B --> C{"size matches and free?"}
  C -- yes --> D["return compartment"]
  C -- no --> B
  B --> E["none available"]
options_en: Scan compartments each time and return the first matching, unoccupied slot of that size.
Maintain three balanced trees sorted by size and recency.
Put all compartments into one global random pool.
Have AccessToken scan backward to find an empty compartment.
tradeoff: 简单线性扫描 vs 额外索引结构换取更快查找

termDefinitions.meaning: 线性时间复杂度，成本随格口数量等比增长。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: O(n) means linear time complexity: the cost grows proportionally with the number of compartments.

optionExplanations: 20-50 个格口的规模下，线性扫描的耗时差异小到可以忽略，还换来最简单、单一来源的代码。
三棵平衡树能拿到 O(log n) 查找，但要为几十个元素维护三份索引结构，投入产出不成比例。
随机池丢掉了尺寸信息，投递时没法保证拿到的格口尺寸匹配包裹，这条路线直接不满足需求。
AccessToken 应该只管过期判断，让它反向扫描格口会把分配逻辑塞进错误的对象里。
optionExplanations_en: At 20 to 50 compartments, the runtime gap from a linear scan is negligible, and it buys the simplest, single-source code.
Three balanced trees give O(log n) lookup, but maintaining three index structures for a few dozen elements isn't worth the payoff.
A random pool throws away size information, so deposit can no longer guarantee the slot it grabs actually fits the package.
AccessToken should only own expiration logic; making it scan compartments backward shoves allocation into the wrong object.

scenario: 实现投递流程时，司机只提供尺寸，系统要开门并返回取件码。
scenario_en: In the deposit flow, the driver provides only the package size, and the system must open a door and return a pickup code.
q: 这段伪代码最主要表达哪条业务流程？
q_en: Which business flow does this pseudocode primarily express?
codeSample:
depositPackage(size)
    compartment = getAvailableCompartment(size)
    if compartment == null
        throw NoSpace
    compartment.open()
    compartment.markOccupied()
    token = generateAccessToken(compartment)
    accessTokenMapping[token.code] = token
    return token.code
options: 先生成 token，再等用户取件时才分配格口
把过期格口直接释放给司机使用
先分配同尺寸空格口，再开门并生成 token
用同一个 token 打开多个格口
why: 投递流程把格口分配、物理开门、占用标记和 token 映射串起来。返回的是 token code，不需要返回格口号。
why_en: Deposit allocates a matching free compartment, opens it, marks it occupied, stores the token, and returns only the code.
whenOtherWins: 如果生产系统必须确认司机真的放入包裹，应拆成 reserve 和 confirm 两阶段，而不是立即生成 token。
options_en: Generate the token first, and only allocate a compartment once the user later shows up to pick up.
Release a lapsed compartment straight back to the driver.
Allocate a matching free compartment first, then open the door and generate the token.
Use one token to open multiple compartments.
tradeoff: 先分配格口再生成 token vs 先生成 token 再找格口

termDefinitions.meaning: 这里指 AccessToken 的取件码字符串。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Here, token refers to the AccessToken's pickup code string.

optionExplanations: 先发 token 会让凭证在真正拿到格口之前就存在，指向的格口后填，逻辑顺序反了。
过期格口还压着没处理的包裹，直接给司机用等于把别人的包裹让出去。
先按尺寸挑一个空格口，开门、标记占用，再生成并保存 token，返回的只是 code，流程环环相扣。
一个 token 对应一个 compartment 是访问控制的基本前提，一码多门会让谁能开哪扇门变得不可控。
optionExplanations_en: Issuing the token first means the credential exists before a compartment is even attached to it — the order runs backwards.
A lapsed compartment still has an unprocessed package sitting in it; handing it straight to a driver means giving away someone else's package.
Pick a free slot of the right size, open it, mark it occupied, then generate and store the token, returning only the code — every step chains into the next.
One token per compartment is the basic access-control premise; letting one code open many doors makes it impossible to control who can open what.

scenario: depositPackage 成功后格口门已经自动打开，司机站在 locker 前。
scenario_en: After depositPackage succeeds, the compartment door has already opened and the driver is standing at the locker.
q: 返回值为什么只需要 token code？
q_en: Why does the return value only need the token code?
options: 因为 token code 不能被通知系统使用
因为系统不需要保存 token
因为司机不需要知道哪个门，打开的门就是目标格口
因为用户必须自己猜格口号
why: 硬件开门是主要反馈，司机看到开门格口即可放包。token code 被返回给上游或通知系统转交给用户。
why_en: The opened door identifies the compartment physically, so deposit only needs to return the access code.
whenOtherWins: 如果投递不是面对实体柜机完成，而是远程预约格口，返回 compartmentId 或 reservationId 会更合理。
options_en: Because the token code can't be used by the notification system.
Because the system doesn't need to store the token.
Because the driver doesn't need to know which door — the door that opened is the target compartment.
Because the user has to guess the compartment number.
tradeoff: 只返回 token code vs 同时返回格口号
optionExplanations: 通知系统当然要用 token code 转发给用户，这个说法本身就说反了。
系统必须保存 token 才能在 pickup 时查到对应格口，这个前提是错的。
硬件已经把门打开摆在司机面前，谁的门用眼睛就能看到，接口不需要额外把格口对象吐出来。
用户不需要猜——取件时是靠输入取件码让系统去查，不是靠格口号定位。
optionExplanations_en: The notification system needs the token code to forward it to the user — this option gets the direction backwards.
The system must keep the token around to look up the matching compartment at pickup — this premise is wrong.
The hardware already leaves the door open in front of the driver, so the API doesn't need to hand back a compartment object too.
Users don't guess anything — pickup works by entering the code and letting the system look up the slot, not by a compartment number.

scenario: 用户输入取件码，系统需要区分空值、未找到、过期和有效取件。
scenario_en: The user enters a pickup code, and the system must distinguish empty, missing, expired, and valid codes.
q: pickup 的核心顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the core order of the pickup flow?
options: 直接打开所有格口，再检查 token
校验 code 非空、查 token、检查过期，再开门清理状态
只检查格口是否 occupied，不需要 token map
先删除 token，再判断是否过期
why: pickup 是访问控制流程，先拒绝无效或过期 token，再对有效 token 开门并释放格口。顺序错误会产生安全或状态一致性问题。
why_en: Pickup must validate the token before opening the compartment and clearing state.
whenOtherWins: 如果是工作人员维护流程，可以不走用户 token 校验，而通过后台权限打开过期格口。
diagram:
sequenceDiagram
  participant U as User
  participant L as Locker
  participant M as tokenMap
  participant C as Compartment
  U->>L: pickup(code)
  L->>M: find token
  L->>C: open
  L->>C: clear package
  L->>M: remove token
options_en: Open every compartment first, then check the token.
Validate the code isn't empty, look up the token, check expiry, then open the door and clear state.
Only check whether the compartment is occupied, without needing the token map.
Delete the token first, then check whether it had lapsed.
tradeoff: 先校验 token 再开门 vs 先开门再校验
optionExplanations: 跳过校验直接开所有格口，等于把访问控制放在检查之后，顺序整个反了。
先挡掉空输入和查不到的 token，再判断是否过期，最后才碰硬件开门和清理状态，这个顺序把风险判断放在动作前面。
只看 occupied 会漏掉过期但没被清理的格口，也没法给用户返回明确的过期错误。
先删 token 再判断过期，逻辑上已经把证据销毁了，压根没法再检查过期与否。
optionExplanations_en: Skipping validation and opening every door puts access control after the action — the order is backwards.
Reject empty/missing codes first, then check expiry, and only then touch the hardware and clear state, so risk checks happen before any action.
Checking only occupied misses a lapsed-but-uncleaned slot and can't return a clear lapsed-code error to the user.
Deleting the token before checking expiry destroys the evidence you'd need to make that check at all.

scenario: 成功取件后需要防止同一取件码再次开门。
scenario_en: After a successful pickup, the same pickup code must not be able to open the door again.
q: 这段 clearDeposit 代码维护了哪两个状态？
q_en: Which two states does this clearDeposit code maintain?
codeSample:
clearDeposit(accessToken)
    compartment = accessToken.getCompartment()
    compartment.markFree()
    accessTokenMapping.remove(accessToken.getCode())
options: 只把 token 标记为过期，不释放格口
只关闭门，不改变任何内存状态
释放物理格口，并删除 token 映射
把 token 移到 usedTokens 以支持精确错误
why: 成功取件后格口可再分配，token 也不应继续有效。漏掉任一步都会造成可用性或安全状态不一致。
why_en: Successful pickup must free the compartment and remove the token mapping together.
whenOtherWins: 如果产品明确要求区分“已使用”和“从未存在”，可以保留 usedTokens 或在 token 上加使用状态。
options_en: Only mark the token as expired without freeing the compartment.
Only close the door without changing any in-memory state.
Free the physical compartment and remove the token mapping.
Move the token into a usedTokens set to support precise error messages.
tradeoff: 同时释放格口并删除 token vs 只做其中一步
optionExplanations: 只标记过期不释放格口，会让格口永远卡在 occupied，没人能再用它。
只关门不改内存状态，token 依然留在 map 里，同一个码还能再开一次门——安全漏洞。
markFree 释放物理格口，remove 删掉 token 映射，两个状态一起清才不会留下悬空引用。
usedTokens 是没写在这段代码里的额外结构，属于以后想更精确报错时才加的东西。
optionExplanations_en: Only marking it lapsed without freeing the slot leaves the compartment stuck occupied forever, unusable by anyone.
Only closing the door without touching memory state leaves the token in the map, so the same code could open it again — a security hole.
markFree releases the physical slot and remove() deletes the token entry, clearing both together so nothing is left dangling.
usedTokens isn't in this snippet at all; it's an addition you'd only reach for if you wanted a more precise error message later.

q: 补全过期时间规则：
q_en: Complete the expiration-time rule:
text: AccessToken 的 expiration 应设置为生成时刻加 {{7 天}}；isExpired 通常比较 {{now >= expiration}}。
why: 7 天是产品给定的固定 TTL 目标，不是估算公式的结果；它决定 AccessToken 必须自带 expiration 字段并提供 isExpired 判断，而不是把过期逻辑散落在调用方。
why_en: The seven-day window is a given product target rather than a calculated figure, so AccessToken must own an expiration timestamp and expose an isExpired check.
scenario: AccessToken 的过期时间是产品给定的固定目标（7 天），不是从流量或容量推导出来的公式结果；pickup 时必须用它做 isExpired 判断。
scenario_en: AccessToken expiration is a fixed product target of seven days, not a formula derived from traffic or capacity; pickup must use it for isExpired checks.

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据或凭证的存活时长，过期后应被拒绝或清理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TTL, or Time To Live, is how long a piece of data or a credential stays valid before it must be rejected or cleaned up.

scenario: 用户在第 8 天输入原取件码，包裹还没有被工作人员取走。
scenario_en: On day eight, the user enters the original pickup code, and staff has not removed the package yet.
q: 系统应该如何处理？
q_en: How should the system handle this?
options: 直接打开格口，把状态标记为已释放
把错误当成普通无效码，不提示已过期
自动把包裹转移到其它可用格口
返回过期错误，但保留 token 与占用状态
why: 过期码不能开门，但包裹仍占用格口。保留 token 让系统能给出“已过期”的可解释错误。
why_en: An expired pickup should be rejected while keeping the compartment occupied until staff removes the package.
whenOtherWins: 如果安全策略要求不暴露码是否曾经存在，可以把过期和无效都显示为通用错误，但内部仍要保留清理状态。
options_en: Open the compartment directly and mark its state as released.
Treat it as a generic invalid code without mentioning expiry.
Automatically move the package to another available compartment.
Return an expired error, but keep the token and the occupied state.
tradeoff: 保留 token 便于诊断 vs 立即释放格口提高可用性
optionExplanations: 直接开门还标记释放，等于把还没被工作人员处理的包裹直接判给了任何知道旧码的人。
把过期码当普通无效码，用户会以为码打错了，反而找不到该联系谁处理包裹。
自动转移包裹需要机械臂或人工介入，这已经超出基础范围能做到的动作。
返回明确的过期错误，同时格口继续保持占用，等工作人员来处理，这样状态和现实保持一致。
optionExplanations_en: Opening the door and marking it released hands the still-unprocessed package to anyone who still has the old code.
Treating a lapsed code as a generic invalid one leaves the user thinking they mistyped it, with no clue who to contact instead.
Auto-moving the package would need a robotic arm or staff intervention — beyond what this base scope can do.
Return a clear lapsed-code error while the slot stays occupied, so the state matches reality until staff handles it.

scenario: 工作人员要处理所有过期未取包裹，并把它们退回寄件方。
scenario_en: Staff needs to handle all expired, unclaimed packages and return them to the sender.
q: openExpiredCompartments 为什么不应该直接调用 clearDeposit？
q_en: Why shouldn't openExpiredCompartments call clearDeposit directly?
options: clearDeposit 只能删除未过期 token
过期包裹应立即被客户领取
工作人员打开门后仍需实际取走包裹，系统不应提前释放格口
工作人员流程不需要访问 token map
why: 开门只是让工作人员能取包，清理应发生在确认包裹已被物理移除之后。否则系统可能把仍有包裹的格口重新分配。
why_en: Staff opening expired compartments is not the same as confirming the packages were physically removed.
whenOtherWins: 如果 locker 有可靠传感器或工作人员确认 API，可以在确认移除后调用单独的 cleanupExpiredDeposit。
options_en: clearDeposit can only remove tokens that have not expired.
An expired package should be picked up by the customer immediately.
Opening the door still leaves staff to physically remove the package, so the system shouldn't free the slot early.
The staff workflow doesn't need to access the token map.
tradeoff: 开门后立即清理 vs 确认物理移除后再清理
optionExplanations: clearDeposit 没有单独区分 token 是否过期的逻辑，这个限制是编出来的。
过期包裹恰恰是没被客户按时取走才过期的，指望客户马上来是本末倒置。
开门只是给工作人员一个物理接触包裹的机会，真正清理要等确认包裹被搬走之后再做。
工作人员流程照样要靠 token map 找到该打开哪个格口，不能绕开它。
optionExplanations_en: clearDeposit has no logic that singles out lapsed tokens — that limitation is made up for this option.
A lapsed package is lapsed precisely because the customer never came for it in time; expecting them to show up immediately gets it backwards.
Opening the door only gives staff physical access; the actual cleanup should wait until the package is confirmed removed.
The staff workflow still needs the token map to know which compartment to open — it can't skip that lookup.

q: Locker 在本文设计中直接持有哪些状态？（多选）
q_en: Which state does Locker directly hold in this design? (Select all that apply.)
options: 所有 compartments
access token code 到 AccessToken 的映射
每个包裹的配送路线
短信发送队列
why: Locker 是 orchestrator，负责分配格口和 token 查找。配送路线和通知都被排除在系统边界外。
