Network latency can add up to nearly seven seconds, so the authoritative clock must compensate for it.
As long as the client reports its own delay, the server should just accept it.
This kind of delay only affects the visual display, not real elapsed time.
optionExplanations: 错，几秒钟看着小，但在 3 分钟 blitz 里已经够翻转胜负，不能假设可以忽略。
对，170ms 延迟乘以约 40 步能累积到近 7 秒，权威计时因此必须做补偿。
错，客户端可以故意谎报或拖慢延迟数据，照单全收等于把计时权交给对方。
错，这不只是界面显示问题，延迟会真实吃掉玩家的计时预算。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — a few seconds sounds small, but in a 3-minute blitz game that's already enough to flip the result, so it can't be assumed away.
Correct — 170ms times about 40 moves adds up to nearly seven seconds — enough to swing a blitz result — so the server needs to compensate for it, not just track raw elapsed time.
Wrong — a client can lie about or deliberately delay its reported latency, so accepting it as-is hands over timing control.
Wrong — this isn't just a display issue; the delay genuinely eats into a player's real clock budget.

scenario: 服务端仍要权威计时，但希望给高延迟玩家返还部分网络传输时间，同时避免单次网络尖峰污染估计。
scenario_en: The server still owns authoritative timing, but it wants to credit high-latency players for part of network transit time without letting one spike poison the estimate.
q: 最合理的延迟补偿估计方式是什么？
q_en: What is the most reasonable way to estimate latency compensation?
options: 完全相信客户端上报的 playedAt 时间戳
只在玩家输棋后才补偿延迟时间
不管网络状况，给每人固定返还 5 秒
持续用 ping/pong 测 RTT，按中位数一半估算延迟
why: ping/pong 与走子解耦，rolling median 比平均值抗尖峰，用 RTT/2 近似单程传输时间。
why_en: Continuous ping-pong measurement with a rolling median estimates one-way latency while resisting spikes.
whenOtherWins: 若完全不在乎地域公平，可只做普通服务端权威时钟；若无对抗性，客户端本地时间戳更简单。
optionExplanations: 错误。客户端可以伪造时间戳，等于放弃反作弊。
错误。补偿是为了公平计时，不该看比赛结果才决定给不给。
错误。固定值不反映真实网络差异，快网玩家反而占便宜。
对。持续测量而不是靠客户端自报，中位数不怕单次抖动，折半估算能大致抵消传输时间。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — a client can forge its timestamp, giving up anti-cheat protection entirely.
Wrong — compensation exists for fairness in timing, not something decided by who is losing.
Wrong — a flat credit ignores real network differences and overpays players on fast connections.
Correct — measuring continuously instead of trusting a self-report, the median resists single spikes, and halving it roughly cancels the transit time.
options_en: Fully trust the client-reported playedAt timestamp.
Only compensate latency after a player has lost.
Give every player a flat five-second credit regardless of network.
Continuously measure RTT via ping/pong and credit half the median as delay.
tradeoff: 度量并封顶补偿 vs 完全信任客户端或完全不补偿

termDefinitions.meaning: 往返时延，一个请求从发出到收到响应所花的总时间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: RTT, round-trip time, is the total time from sending a request to receiving its response.

termDefinitions.meaning: WebSocket 里用来探测连接和测网络延迟的心跳帧。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Ping/pong are WebSocket heartbeat frames used to probe the connection and measure latency.

termDefinitions.meaning: 取最近若干次采样的中位数，比平均值更抗单次尖峰干扰。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A rolling median is the median of recent samples, which resists a single spike better than an average does.

q: 按 measured RTT 返还时间会引入什么滥用风险？
q_en: What abuse risk does crediting measured RTT introduce?
options: 排行榜无法分页
玩家可以修改服务端 monotonic clock
Redis 会丢掉所有 move log
客户端故意拖延 pong 来抬高 RTT
why: 客户端不能伪造服务端时间戳，但可以慢回 pong，让系统误以为网络很慢；因此补偿必须设置上限。
why_en: A client can inflate measured RTT by delaying pong responses, so latency credit must be capped.
optionExplanations: 错误。分页能力和棋钟补偿机制没有任何关联。
错误。monotonic clock 跑在服务端进程里，客户端根本碰不到。
错误。move log 是走子历史，和延迟补偿完全是两回事。
对。故意慢回 pong 会让系统误判网络慢，从而多拿补偿。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — pagination capability has no connection to the clock-compensation mechanism.
Wrong — the monotonic clock runs inside the server process; a client cannot touch it.
Wrong — the move log is move history, an entirely separate concern from latency compensation.
Correct — deliberately delaying the pong tricks the system into thinking the network is slow, earning extra credit.
options_en: The leaderboard can no longer paginate.
Players can modify the server's monotonic clock.
Redis loses all move logs.
The client deliberately delays its pong to inflate measured RTT.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只会前进、不受系统时间调整影响的计时源。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A monotonic clock only moves forward and is unaffected by system time adjustments.

q: 补全服务端权威且补偿延迟的棋钟公式：
q_en: Fill in the server-authoritative, latency-compensated chess-clock formula:
text: 每步扣时约等于服务端 monotonic clock 的 elapsed 减去估计的 {{median_rtt / 2}}，并对单步返还设置约 {{100ms}} 的上限。
why: 这样在平均意义上减少地域延迟惩罚，同时限制故意抬高 RTT 带来的免费时间。
why_en: Subtracting about half the median RTT with a per-move cap reduces geographic latency bias without granting unlimited free time.

q: 公平棋钟的决策链，正确顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the correct decision chain for a fair chess clock?
steps: 对单步返还设置上限，避免慢 pong 套利
服务端维护权威 remaining_ms 和 last_start_timestamp
用 ping/pong 的 rolling median RTT 估计网络传输
识别普通服务端计时会把网络延迟算进玩家用时
why: 先承认服务端权威计时的公平缺口，再在不放弃权威的前提下估计并封顶补偿。
why_en: The clock design starts by identifying the latency tax, keeps server authority, estimates transit time, and caps abuse.
whenOtherWins: 如果只是非对抗性的休闲计时器，客户端本地时间戳和简单倒计时通常够用。
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A[Server is clock authority]
  B[Measure client latency]
  C[Cap compensation]
  D[Apply move time]
  A --> B --> C --> D

scenario: 全球排行榜只需要取 rating 最高的前 50 名，玩家总数约 1000 万。
scenario_en: The global leaderboard only needs the top 50 players by rating, with about 10 million total players.
q: 这个 top page 的合理基础方案是什么？
q_en: What is a reasonable baseline design for this top page?
options: rating 建 btree 索引，DESC LIMIT 50
每次请求扫描全部玩家再重新排序一遍
让每个客户端各自缓存全量玩家列表
改用对象存储按 rating 命名文件再排序
why: btree 能按 rating 顺序走前几十个索引项，top-N 并不因为总玩家数大就必然慢。
why_en: A btree index can walk the first few highest-rating entries, making top-N cheap even with many players.
whenOtherWins: 若要精确个人排名或极高频 leaderboard reads，Redis sorted set 这样的外部 order-statistics view 更适合。
optionExplanations: 对。btree 按顺序走前几十个索引项就停，跟总玩家数无关。
错误。全表扫描排序是 O(n log n)，玩家越多越慢，白白浪费了索引。
错误。全量列表随时在变，客户端缓存马上过期还占内存。
错误。对象存储没有范围排序能力，文件名排序更是自造复杂度。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — a btree walks the first few dozen ordered entries and stops, independent of total player count.
Wrong — scanning and sorting the whole table is O(n log n) and gets slower as players grow, wasting the index entirely.
Wrong — the full list keeps changing, so a client cache goes stale fast and wastes memory.
Wrong — object storage has no range-sort capability, and filename sorting just invents extra complexity.
options_en: A btree index on rating, DESC LIMIT 50.
Scan every player and re-sort on every single request.
Have every client cache the full player list.
Switch to object storage named by rating and sort by filename.
tradeoff: 索引顺序扫描换 O(1) 起步 vs 全表扫描换实现简单

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据库常用的有序索引结构，能按顺序快速定位数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A btree is a common ordered database index that can quickly locate data in sorted order.

q: 为什么个人 rank 查询比排行榜首页更难？
q_en: Why is personal rank lookup harder than the leaderboard front page?
options: rank 查询要比 top-N 多渲染一次棋盘画面
top-N 查询完全用不上任何数据库索引
COUNT(*) 要数出排在你前面的所有人
个人 rank 只能靠全文搜索引擎才能实现
why: 普通 btree 提供有序遍历，但不直接给第几名；中位玩家可能要数百万条索引项。
why_en: A btree gives order but not ordinal position, so exact rank may require counting millions of higher-rated rows.
optionExplanations: 错误。rank 是纯数值计算，和渲染棋盘毫无关系。
错误。top-N 恰恰是最能用 btree 索引受益的查询。
对。btree 给顺序不给位置，中位玩家要数几百万条索引项。
错误。全文搜索解决的是文本相关性，不是数值排名。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — rank is a pure numeric computation, unrelated to rendering a board.
Wrong — top-N is exactly the query that benefits most from a btree index.
Correct — a btree gives order but not position, so a mid-pack player needs millions of counted entries.
Wrong — full-text search solves textual relevance, not numeric ranking.
options_en: Rank lookup renders one extra board frame compared to top-N.
Top-N cannot use any database index at all.
COUNT(*) has to count everyone ranked above you.
Personal rank can only be implemented with full-text search.
tradeoff: 有序遍历（btree） vs 位置查询（需要 order-statistics 结构）

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据库常用的有序索引结构，能按顺序快速定位数据，但不直接给出位置。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A btree is an ordered database index that can traverse in sorted order but does not directly return an item's position.

scenario: 产品只需要显示「大约第 4200 名」这类近似排名，低成本和简单运维比逐人精确更重要。
scenario_en: The product only needs approximate ranks such as "around 4,200th," so low cost and simple operations matter more than exact per-player rank.
q: 最务实的排名结构是什么？
q_en: What is the most pragmatic ranking structure here?
options: 把某个时刻的 rank 写死进客户端代码
给每个玩家单独开一个消息流通道
每次请求都跑一遍全表 group by
按 rating 分桶维护人数，求高档前缀和
why: 几百个 rating 桶即可常数时间估算排名，更新时把玩家从旧桶移到新桶，代价低但不精确。
why_en: Rating buckets make approximate rank cheap by summing counts in higher buckets, trading exactness for simplicity.
whenOtherWins: 如果产品明确要求精确名次、精确分页和实时 top-N，Redis sorted set 更合适。
optionExplanations: 错误。rank 随时在变，写死进客户端马上就是错的。
错误。消息流通道是顺序投递结构，不适合做计数维护，且每玩家一个也不现实。
错误。group by 全表这么频繁跑，代价比维护桶计数高得多。
对。几百个桶就能常数时间估算排名，代价是近似而非精确。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — rank keeps changing, so hard-coding it into the client is wrong almost immediately.
Wrong — a message stream is an ordered-delivery structure unsuited to maintaining counts, and one per player is unrealistic anyway.
Wrong — running a full-table group by this often costs far more than maintaining bucket counts.
Correct — a few hundred buckets make rank a constant-time estimate, at the cost of exactness.
options_en: Hard-code a rank value into the client.
Give every player their own message-stream channel.
Run a full-table group by on every request.
Keep a per-band player count bucketed by rating and sum the higher bands.
tradeoff: 近似排名换常数时间 vs 精确排名换更重的结构

scenario: 产品要求 1000 万玩家下精确个人 rank 和 top-N，都要在游戏结束后很快更新。
scenario_en: The product requires exact personal rank and top-N for 10 million players, and both should update soon after a game ends.
q: 最合适的外部索引是什么？
q_en: What external index best fits this requirement?
options: Redis sorted set，按 rating 记分排序
Redis list，按更新时间往后追加
Postgres 里存一个 JSONB 数组字段
S3 上给每个玩家存一个文件
why: Redis sorted set 支持 ZREVRANK 和 ZREVRANGE，以 log 级别工作量回答精确排名和 top-N。
why_en: A Redis sorted set answers exact rank and top-N efficiently with playerId members and rating scores.
whenOtherWins: 若只需近似名次，bucket counts 更便宜；若 Redis 只是派生视图，权威数据仍应留在 completed games/Players 中。
optionExplanations: 对。ZREVRANK/ZREVRANGE 都是 O(log n)，精确排名和 top-N 一起解决。
错误。list 只有插入顺序，取不到按 rating 排序的名次。
错误。JSONB 数组不带索引，算排名要整列扫描。
错误。按文件存没有排序能力，找名次要遍历全部文件。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — ZREVRANK and ZREVRANGE are both O(log n), solving exact rank and top-N together.
Wrong — a list only preserves insertion order and cannot give a rating-sorted position.
Wrong — a JSONB array carries no index, so computing rank means scanning the whole column.
Wrong — one file per player has no ordering, so finding rank means scanning every file.
options_en: A Redis sorted set scored by rating.
A Redis list appended in update-time order.
A JSONB array column in Postgres.
One file per player in S3.
tradeoff: sorted set 给精确排名 O(log n) vs 其他结构没有位置查询能力

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis 命令，按分数从高到低返回某个成员的名次。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ZREVRANK is a Redis command that returns a member's rank in descending score order.

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis 命令，按分数从高到低取出一段成员列表。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ZREVRANGE is a Redis command that returns a range of members in descending score order.

numberAnchors.risk: 单主写瓶颈、索引/事务变重

scenario: 需要更新玩家 rating 并查询其 0-based 精确名次，排名按 rating 从高到低。
scenario_en: The system needs to update a player rating and query the player's exact 0-based rank, ordered from highest rating to lowest.
q: 哪组 Redis sorted set 命令符合这个需求？
q_en: Which Redis sorted-set commands match this requirement?
options: ZADD chess:ratings 1820 player42 + ZREVRANK chess:ratings player42
LPUSH chess:ratings player42 + LLEN chess:ratings
HSET chess:ratings player42 1820 + HLEN chess:ratings
SET player42 1820 + SCAN
why: ZADD 更新分数，ZREVRANK 按高分在前返回精确名次；list/hash 无法直接按 score 排名。
why_en: ZADD maintains the score and ZREVRANK returns exact descending rank, which list or hash structures cannot do directly.
whenOtherWins: 若只需要按 playerId 取当前 rating，hash 会更简单；这里需要按 rating 排名。
codeSample:
ZADD chess:ratings 1820 player42
ZREVRANK chess:ratings player42
ZREVRANGE chess:ratings 0 49 WITHSCORES
optionExplanations: 对。第一条命令更新该玩家的 rating 分数，第二条命令直接按降序返回它的名次。
错误。LLEN 只给列表长度，不是某个成员的名次。
错误。hash 能存分数但取不出「第几名」这个位置信息。
错误。SCAN 遍历 key 空间，既慢又给不出排名。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — the first command updates the player's rating score, and the second reads back their descending-order rank directly.
Wrong — LLEN only gives list length, not any member's rank.
Wrong — a hash can store the score but cannot answer 'what position is this'.
Wrong — SCAN walks the keyspace, which is slow and gives no rank at all.
options_en: ZADD the score plus ZREVRANK for the exact rank.
LPUSH plus LLEN on a list.
HSET plus HLEN on a hash.
SET a value plus SCAN the keyspace.
tradeoff: sorted set 原生排名命令 vs 其他结构要自己算位置

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis 命令，按分数从高到低返回某个成员的名次。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ZREVRANK is a Redis command that returns a member's rank in descending score order.

q: 这个内存和写入量级支持什么架构判断？
q_en: What architecture judgment does this memory and write scale support?
options: 1000 万玩家必须单独拆成多个 Redis 集群才够用
GB 级内存和万级 ZADD/s 都在单 Redis 实例的舒适区
这个规模必须换成列式存储才能承载得住
写入量太大，只能靠离线批处理重新计算
why: 10M 成员约 GB 级内存、约 8k ZADD/s 都远低于单实例 Redis 的能力上限；这说明排行榜可以直接复用匹配系统已有的 Redis，不必新增基础设施或分片。
why_en: Ten million members at gigabyte-scale memory and about eight thousand ZADDs per second both sit well inside a single Redis instance's capacity, so the leaderboard can reuse the existing Redis rather than adding new infrastructure.
scenario: 面试官给出这些数字：1000 万玩家的 Redis sorted set 约占 GB 级内存，游戏结束速率约 4k 局/秒（两名玩家各更新一次，约 8k 次 ZADD/s）。
scenario_en: The interviewer gives these numbers: a Redis sorted set for 10 million players takes gigabytes of memory, and finished games arrive around 4k per second, causing about 8k ZADDs per second.
options_en: Ten million players must be split across multiple Redis clusters to keep up.
Gigabyte-scale memory and tens of thousands of ZADDs per second both fit comfortably in a single Redis instance.
This scale must switch to a columnar store to hold up.
The write volume is too high, so it can only be recomputed by offline batch jobs.
optionExplanations: 错，算下来的内存和写入量都还在单实例范围内，还没到必须拆多集群的地步。
对，GB 级内存和万级写入放在一个 Redis 实例里绰绰有余，不用另起新基础设施。
错，列式存储面向大规模分析扫描，不是给这种键值排名结构用的。
错，几千次每秒的写入 Redis 完全实时扛得住，用不着挪到离线批处理。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — the computed memory and write volume both still fit a single instance; nothing here forces a multi-cluster split yet.
Correct — the memory footprint and write rate both sit comfortably inside what one Redis node can handle, so there's no need to add anything new.
Wrong — columnar stores are built for large analytical scans, not this kind of key-value ranking structure.
Wrong — a few thousand writes per second is easily real-time work for Redis; there's no need to push it to offline batch.

q: 用 Redis sorted set 做精确排行榜时，同 rating 玩家如果没有确定性 tie-break，会出现什么问题？
q_en: With a Redis sorted-set leaderboard, what happens if equal-rating players lack a deterministic tie-break?
options: Game Server 会丢连接
无法写入 Redis
不能查询 top 50
分页和名次可能抖动
why: 相同 score 的成员顺序若不稳定，翻页和个人名次会看起来跳动；可在 score 或成员排序中加入确定性 tie-break。
why_en: Equal scores need deterministic tie-breaking or pagination and rank can appear to wobble.
optionExplanations: 错误。这是排行榜问题，和 Game Server 连接毫无关系。
错误。写入照常成功，tie-break 只影响读的顺序。
错误。ZREVRANGE 0 49 依然能查，只是同分内部顺序不确定。
对。同分成员顺序不稳定，翻页时同一个人可能一会儿在这页一会儿在那页。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — this is a leaderboard issue, unrelated to Game Server connections.
Wrong — writes still succeed; tie-breaking only affects read ordering.
Wrong — ZREVRANGE 0 49 still works, only the order within a tie is uncertain.
Correct — unstable ordering among equal scores means the same player can appear on different pages between requests.
options_en: The Game Server drops connections.
Redis writes stop working.
You can no longer query the top 50.
Pagination and rank can appear to wobble.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同分时用来决定先后顺序的额外规则。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A tie-break is an extra rule that decides ordering when scores are equal.

q: 为什么 rating/leaderboard 可以设计成派生视图而不是唯一真相？（多选）
q_en: Why can rating and leaderboard be derived views rather than the only source of truth? (Select all that apply)
options: Game result 持久化后包含计算 ELO 所需信息
每局保存开局 rating 快照，delta 可重算
Players row 和 Redis set 都可以通过幂等 apply/reconcile 修复
rating 只存在内存里，重启后无法恢复
why: 真正不可丢的是已完成对局结果；Players.rating 和 Redis 排行榜是加速读的物化视图，能重放修复。
why_en: Completed game results are the durable source of truth, while player ratings and Redis rankings are materialized views that can be replayed.
optionExplanations: 对。结果一落库，delta 就能随时从这条记录推出来。
对。开局快照让每局的 delta 自包含，不用查别的记录。
对。用 gameId 去重重放，加周期性 reconciliation 就能修复漂移。
错。真正的权威值是已完成对局记录，rating 是可以重建的物化视图。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — once the result is durable, the delta can always be derived from that record.
Correct — the starting snapshot makes each game's delta self-contained, no other record needed.
Correct — idempotent replay keyed by gameId plus periodic reconciliation repairs any drift.
Wrong — the real source of truth is completed game records; ratings are a rebuildable materialized view.
options_en: The persisted game result carries everything needed to compute the ELO delta.
Each game stores a starting-rating snapshot, so its delta can be recomputed.
Both the Players row and the Redis set can be repaired via idempotent apply/reconcile.
Ratings only live in memory and cannot be recovered after a restart.

q: 游戏结束后可靠更新 rating 与排行榜的顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the reliable order for updating rating and leaderboard after a game ends?
steps: 幂等 apply step 更新 Players.rating 和 Redis sorted set
周期性 reconciliation 从 completed games 重算并覆盖派生视图
先把 Game result 持久化为唯一提交点
若 apply 中途失败，用 gameId 去重后重试
why: 提交点应是 Game result；后续物化更新失败也能用 gameId 幂等重试和周期重算修复。
why_en: The game result is the commit point, and materialized rating updates can be idempotently retried and reconciled.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  E[Game ends]
  R[Compute rating delta]
  P[Persist player ratings]
  L[Update leaderboard view]
  E --> R --> P --> L

scenario: 面试官追问 fair play：玩家可能把棋局喂给引擎，但这不是实时走子路径的核心需求。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks about fair play: a player may feed the position into a chess engine, but that is not part of the core real-time move path.
q: 合理的系统边界是什么？
q_en: What is the right system boundary here?
options: 把引擎检测放到实时 move validation 的同步热路径
完全依赖客户端声明没有作弊
把它作为离线 ML/行为分析和人工复核系统
每步都暂停让对手投票
why: 引擎作弊很难从单步实时判定，通常要跨局比较引擎吻合度、用时模式和 rating 历史，再进入复核流程。
why_en: Engine cheating is best handled by offline behavioral and ML analysis across games rather than the synchronous move path.
whenOtherWins: 非法走子和超时必须在实时路径同步校验；反作弊则适合异步分析。
optionExplanations: 错误。单步实时判断根本分不出引擎走法和人类走法，会拖慢热路径又不准。
错误。客户端完全不可信，声明式反作弊等于没有反作弊。
对。跨局比较用时模式、引擎吻合度和 rating 历史，属于异步分析问题。
错误。这会打断实时体验，也不是可靠的作弊判据。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — a single move cannot reliably distinguish engine play from human play, and it would slow the hot path for no accuracy.
Wrong — the client cannot be trusted, so a self-declared claim is not anti-cheat at all.
Correct — comparing time patterns, engine-move agreement, and rating history across games is inherently an offline analysis problem.
Wrong — this breaks the real-time experience and is not a reliable cheat signal anyway.
options_en: Put engine detection on the synchronous real-time move-validation hot path.
Rely entirely on the client's own claim of no cheating.
Treat it as an offline ML and behavioral-analysis system with human review.
Pause every move so the opponent can vote.
tradeoff: 异步跨局分析 vs 同步单步实时判定

scenario: 一盘顶级棋手对局有上万旁观者，旁观者只读且几百毫秒延迟可接受。
scenario_en: A top-player game can have tens of thousands of spectators, and spectators are read-only with a few hundred milliseconds of acceptable delay.
q: 旁观流量应该如何接入？
q_en: How should spectator traffic connect?
options: 旁观流量全部直接连到权威 Game Server
用 pub/sub 或树状广播把只读走子分发给旁观者
允许旁观者也能提交 moveAck
每个旁观者都单独开一份对局副本
why: 旁观是读 fanout，不能拖累 1:1 权威对局服务器；validated moves 可异步广播给只读订阅层。
why_en: Spectating is a read fanout problem, so validated moves should be distributed through pub/sub or a fanout layer instead of burdening the authoritative game server.
whenOtherWins: 若只有两名玩家实时交互，权威 Game Server 直接推送即可，无需额外 fanout 层。
optionExplanations: 错误。上万旁观者直连会拖垮负责校验和计时的权威服务器。
对。旁观是只读扇出，走异步广播层，不占用 1:1 对局的资源。
错误。旁观者不是对局参与方，让他们提交走子确认没有意义还有安全风险。
错误。每人一份副本既浪费资源又没必要，旁观者只需要读同一份广播。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — tens of thousands of direct spectator connections would overwhelm the server that also validates moves and runs clocks.
Correct — spectating is a read fanout, so it belongs on an asynchronous broadcast layer, not the 1:1 game path.
Wrong — spectators are not game participants, so letting them submit move acks is meaningless and risky.
Wrong — a separate copy per spectator wastes resources; spectators only need to read the same broadcast.
options_en: Attach all spectator traffic directly to the authoritative Game Server.
Distribute read-only moves through pub/sub or a tree-shaped fanout.
Let spectators also submit a moveAck.
Give each spectator their own separate game copy.
tradeoff: 只读扇出层承载旁观 vs 权威对局服务器直接扛

termDefinitions.meaning: 把同一份数据广播分发给大量只读订阅者的模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Fanout is the pattern of broadcasting the same data to many read-only subscribers.

q: 完成的棋局归档为什么通常比看起来容易？
q_en: Why is finished-game archiving usually easier than it first looks?
options: 归档必须放在 Redis 内存里永久保存
每盘棋都需要存储完整视频
必须每步保存整张棋盘图片
棋局可以主要表示为短 move sequence 字符串
why: 一盘棋的核心历史就是走子序列；按开局线路查找可先看作对这些序列做前缀范围扫描。
why_en: A finished chess game is mostly its move sequence, which makes archiving compact and prefix-based opening queries natural.
optionExplanations: 错误。归档数据量大且冷，Redis 内存不是合适的长期存储层。
错误。棋局没有视频概念，走子记录本身就足够重放。
错误。逐步截图既浪费存储又不是重放需要的数据形式。
对。走子序列就是几十个字符的字符串，查开局线路是对它做前缀扫描。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — archives are large and cold data, so Redis memory is the wrong long-term storage layer.
Wrong — chess games have no video concept; the move record alone is enough to replay.
Wrong — per-step screenshots waste storage and are not the data shape replay actually needs.
Correct — the move sequence is just a short string, and finding openings is a prefix scan over it.
options_en: Archives must live permanently in Redis memory.
Every game needs a full video recording stored.
Every step needs a full board image saved.
A finished game can mostly be represented as a short move-sequence string.

q: bullet 棋里的 premove 对服务端最关键的要求是什么？
q_en: What is the key server requirement for premove in bullet chess?
options: 对手走子一到就重新校验 premove，合法即用、非法即丢
直接相信客户端已经校验过合法性
把 premove 当成一条普通聊天消息处理
premove 期间禁止一切时钟更新
why: premove 是玩家在未知对手回复前预先提交的意图，服务端必须在真实局面出现后重新判定是否合法。
why_en: A premove is only valid after the opponent's actual move is known, so the server must validate it then and discard it if illegal.
optionExplanations: 对。真实局面出现前 premove 只是意图，必须在那一刻重新判定合法性。
错误。客户端可被修改，服务端不校验等于放弃权威规则。
错误。premove 是要改变棋盘状态的走子指令，不是展示性消息。
错误。premove 应用后仍要正常计时，禁止更新会破坏公平。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — a premove is just intent until the real position appears, so it must be re-validated at that moment.
Wrong — a client can be modified, so skipping server validation abandons authoritative rules.
Wrong — a premove is a command that changes board state, not a display-only message.
Wrong — the clock still needs to run normally once a premove is applied; banning updates breaks fairness.
options_en: Re-validate the premove the instant the opponent's move lands, apply it if legal and discard it otherwise.
Trust that the client already validated it.
Treat the premove as an ordinary chat message.
Ban all clock updates while a premove is queued.

q: 补全实时走子延迟目标：
q_en: Fill in the latency target for real-time move propagation:
text: 在线棋局的走子传播目标是端到端低于 {{200ms}}，因为 bullet/blitz 中每步只有几秒，延迟会直接吃掉玩家棋钟。
why: 这个量级驱动了 WebSocket、内存状态和避免热路径共享存储的设计。
why_en: The sub-200-millisecond target drives the choices of WebSocket, in-memory state, and avoiding shared-store hops on the move path.

scenario: 玩家提交匹配请求后，系统可能要等待另一个合适玩家出现，希望不额外建通知通道也能把 gameId 返回给等待方。
scenario_en: After a player submits a matchmaking request, the system may wait for a suitable opponent and wants to return the gameId to the waiting player without a separate notification channel.
q: 匹配 POST 的合理交互方式是什么？
q_en: What is a reasonable interaction model for the matchmaking POST?
options: 立即返回 pending，让客户端每 50ms 轮询一次
只靠发邮件把 gameId 通知给玩家
长轮询，匹配成功或超时才返回
让客户端自己去扫描等待池找对手
why: 长轮询让已等待的玩家在被配对时直接收到 gameId，避免高频轮询和额外实时通道。
why_en: Long-polling lets a waiting player receive the gameId as soon as a match is found without high-frequency polling or a separate realtime channel.
whenOtherWins: 如果平台已有通用通知 WebSocket，匹配结果也可以走该通道；若等待时间极短，普通请求返回也够用。
optionExplanations: 错误。高频轮询浪费大量请求，还是要额外通道通知配对结果。
错误。邮件延迟太高，完全不适合秒级匹配场景。
对。已等待方的长轮询就是被 claim 时完成的那次请求，不用额外通道。
错误。客户端不该也不能直接访问服务端的匹配池。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — high-frequency polling wastes requests and still needs a separate channel to announce the match.
Wrong — email latency is far too high for a matching flow measured in seconds.
Correct — the waiting side's held long-poll is exactly the request that completes when it gets claimed, no extra channel needed.
Wrong — the client should not and cannot access the server's matching pool directly.
options_en: Return pending immediately and have the client poll every 50ms.
Notify the player of the gameId only by email.
Long-poll and only return once matched or timed out.
Let the client scan the waiting pool itself.
tradeoff: 长轮询零额外通道 vs 高频轮询多请求

termDefinitions.meaning: 客户端发起请求后服务端先不回应，等有结果或超时才返回的模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Long-polling holds a client's request open on the server until there is a result or it times out.

q: 匹配时使用客户端传来的 rating 和读取 Player 记录里的 rating，关键差异是什么？
q_en: What is the key difference between using client-sent rating and reading rating from the Player record?
options: 客户端 rating 快但不可信；服务端 rating 慢一点但可信
两种来源的 rating 完全等价
Player 记录只能给排行榜用，不能拿来匹配
客户端上报的 rating 天然能防作弊
why: rating 影响对手质量，属于可被滥用的数据；服务端可信来源比省一次读更重要。
why_en: Rating affects opponent selection and can be abused, so a trusted server-side rating is worth the lookup.
optionExplanations: 对。省一次读换来的是可被伪造的对手质量，服务端来源更值得那次查询开销。
错误。可信度完全不同，不是等价关系。
错误。Player 记录本就是匹配时读取 rating 的来源。
错误。客户端数据正是最容易被篡改的一环，谈不上防作弊。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — skipping the lookup trades trust for a value that can be forged; a trustworthy server source is worth that extra read.
Wrong — the two differ entirely in trustworthiness, not equivalent at all.
Wrong — the Player record is exactly where matchmaking reads rating from in the first place.
Wrong — client-reported data is the easiest link to tamper with, the opposite of cheat-resistant.
options_en: The client's rating is faster but untrustworthy; the server's rating is a bit slower but trustworthy.
The two sources are completely equivalent.
The Player record can only feed the leaderboard, not matchmaking.
A client-reported rating is naturally cheat-resistant.
tradeoff: 服务端可信来源 vs 客户端更快但可被伪造

q: 赛后更新 ELO 和排行榜时，哪些细节有助于可靠性？（多选）
q_en: Which details help reliability when updating ELO and leaderboard after a game? (Select all that apply)
options: Game 保存双方开局 rating 快照
以 gameId 作为 apply 幂等键
Redis 排行榜可从完成对局重建
只把新 rating 发给客户端，不落库
why: 开局 rating 让 delta 可重算，gameId 去重防止重复应用，Redis 作为派生视图可修复。
why_en: Starting-rating snapshots, gameId idempotency, and rebuildable Redis views make rating updates reliable.
optionExplanations: 对。开局快照让每局 delta 自包含，不用追溯别的记录。
对。用 gameId 去重，重试同一局结果不会重复计入。
对。Redis 只是派生视图，丢了或漂移都能从完成对局重算。
错。不落库等于没有权威记录，一次崩溃就永久丢失这次更新。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — the starting snapshot makes each game's delta self-contained without tracing other records.
Correct — deduping by gameId means retrying the same result never double-counts it.
Correct — Redis is only a derived view, so a lost or drifted set can always be recomputed from completed games.
Wrong — skipping persistence leaves no authoritative record, so one crash permanently loses that update.
options_en: The Game row stores both players' starting-rating snapshot.
gameId is used as the idempotency key for the apply step.
The Redis leaderboard can be rebuilt from completed games.
Only send the new rating to the client without persisting it.

q: 一次完整在线棋局的主路径，正确顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the correct main-path order for one complete online chess game?
steps: Game Server 校验走子、更新内存状态、持久化 move log 并推送
赛后持久化 result，再幂等更新 rating/leaderboard
Matchmaking Service 基于 time control 和 rating 找到对手并创建 Game
两名玩家通过 WebSocket 连到同一台 owner Game Server
why: 产品主线是先匹配成局，再进入同 owner 的实时对局，最后用持久结果驱动排名更新。
why_en: The main path is matchmaking into a game, routing both players to the owner server, validating live moves, and applying post-game ratings.
whenOtherWins: 如果只做离线复盘或题库训练，匹配和实时 owner 路由都可以移出主路径。
diagram:
flowchart TD
  Q[Queue for match]
  G[Create game]
  M[Exchange moves]
  E[End game]
  R[Update rating]
  Q --> G --> M --> E --> R

q: Stripe 类支付系统的核心功能需求包括哪些？（多选）
options: 商户发行股票和期权
商户创建 PaymentIntent 发起收款
用户用信用卡/借记卡付款
商户查看支付状态更新
why: 主线是创建支付意图、处理卡支付、暴露状态；退款、订阅、钱包和 payout 都可以放到范围外。
why_en: The core path is creating a payment intent, processing card payments, and exposing payment status, while refunds and subscriptions stay out of scope.
options_en: The merchant issues company stock and options.
The merchant creates a PaymentIntent to request a charge.
The customer pays with a credit or debit card.
The merchant can view payment status updates.
q_en: Which core functional requirements belong in a Stripe-like payment system? (Select all that apply)
optionExplanations: 发行股票期权是公司融资行为，和收款流程没有关系，不该出现在支付系统的核心需求里。
创建 PaymentIntent 是发起收款的第一步，后续所有支付动作都围绕它展开。
客户用卡完成实际扣款，是收款流程里唯一真正移动资金的一步。
商户查看支付状态，让商户知道该发货还是该重试，是收款闭环里必不可少的一环。
optionExplanations_en: Issuing stock and options is corporate financing, not a checkout flow, so it doesn't belong in the payment system's core requirements.
Creating a PaymentIntent is the first step of a charge, and every later payment action refers back to it.
The customer paying by card is the one step in the flow that actually moves money.
Letting merchants view payment status tells them whether to ship or retry, closing the loop on the charge.

q: 支付系统峰值 10k+ TPS 且促销会突发，最直接支持哪项设计判断？
options: 10k TPS 太小，不需要考虑扩展
Kafka 需要多分区、数据库需要分片等水平扩展手段
可以用单机 MySQL 顶住所有写入无需分片
所有服务都应该保持有状态以简化设计
why: TPS 是每秒事务数；10k+ TPS 表示峰值时每秒有一万多次支付相关事务。这个量级会推动 Kafka 多分区、数据库分片和弹性扩容。
why_en: TPS means transactions per second; 10k-plus TPS is a scale anchor that drives Kafka partitioning, database sharding, and elastic scaling decisions.
tradeoff: 单机简单性 vs 水平扩展能力
whenOtherWins: 若只是内部低频支付后台，单库和少量 worker 可能足够；这里的促销峰值要求先预留水平扩展路径。
scenario: 面试官给出：支付系统峰值约 10,000+ TPS（每秒一万多次支付相关事务），且节假日促销会有突发流量。
options_en: 10k TPS is too small to require any scaling work.
Kafka needs multiple partitions and the database needs sharding to scale horizontally.
A single MySQL instance can absorb all writes without sharding.
Every service should keep local state to simplify the design.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每秒事务数：这里指系统每秒处理的支付创建、确认、状态变更等支付相关事务量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TPS, or transactions per second, is how many payment-related transactions the system processes each second.

termDefinitions.meaning: Kafka 分区：把同一个 topic 拆成多个有序日志，让消费者可以并行处理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Kafka partition is one ordered log inside a topic, allowing parallel consumption across partitions.

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据库分片：把数据按商户、支付意图等键拆到多个数据库节点，分摊写入压力。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Database sharding splits data across nodes by a key such as merchant or payment intent to spread write load.

q_en: What design decision is most supported by a 10k-plus TPS peak with promotion bursts?
scenario_en: The interviewer gives a payment system peak of about 10,000-plus TPS, with holiday promotions creating sudden traffic bursts.
optionExplanations: 把 10k+ TPS 当成小流量会让促销峰值直接打穿数据库和队列，这个量级必须提前做水平扩展设计。
让 Kafka 按多个 partition 并行、数据库按 shard 分散写，两边都留扩展余量，才扛得住促销时的峰值。
单机 MySQL 只有量级远低于此时才够用；10k+ TPS 下它会变成写入热点和单点故障。
让服务保留本地状态会让扩容和故障切换更难，支付服务这种量级更适合无状态水平扩容。
optionExplanations_en: Treating a 10k-plus TPS peak as trivial leaves databases and queues exposed once a promotion bursts, so this scale needs scaling designed in up front.
Running Kafka with several parallel partitions and spreading database writes across shards gives both legs headroom for a promotion peak.
A single MySQL instance only holds up at far lower volume; at 10k-plus TPS it becomes a write hotspot and single point of failure.
Keeping local state on services makes scaling and failover harder; at this volume payment services scale better staying stateless.

numberAnchors.risk: 单主写瓶颈、索引/事务变重

q: 支付系统高层建模中哪些实体是核心？（多选）
options: Merchant，存商户身份、配置和 API key
GameMove，记录棋局走子
PaymentIntent，跟踪一次收款意图的生命周期
Transaction，表示一次具体 money movement/charge attempt
why: Merchant、PaymentIntent、Transaction 足够支撑商户 API、支付流程和状态查询；其他金融对象可后续拆分。
why_en: Merchant, PaymentIntent, and Transaction capture merchant access, payment lifecycle, and concrete money movement.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  M[Merchant]
  PI[Payment Intent]
  T[Transaction]
  N[Payment Network]
  M --> PI
  PI --> T
  T --> N
options_en: Merchant stores business identity, config, and API keys.
GameMove records a move in a board game.
PaymentIntent tracks the lifecycle of one payment intention.
Transaction represents one concrete money-movement or charge attempt.

termDefinitions.meaning: 代表一次收款意图，跟踪从创建到完成的生命周期。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A PaymentIntent represents a merchant's intent to collect a payment and tracks its lifecycle.

termDefinitions.meaning: 代表一次具体的资金移动或扣款尝试，归属于某个 PaymentIntent。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Transaction represents one concrete money-movement attempt tied to a PaymentIntent.

q_en: Which entities are core in the high-level payment-system model? (Select all that apply)
optionExplanations: Merchant 存商户身份、配置和 API key，是发起收款和鉴权都要用到的基础实体。
GameMove 是棋类游戏的走子记录，跟支付系统的收款、结算完全不搭边。
PaymentIntent 跟踪一次收款意图从创建到成功/失败的完整生命周期。
Transaction 记录一次具体的资金移动或扣款尝试，归属于某个 PaymentIntent。
optionExplanations_en: Merchant holds business identity, config, and API keys — the base entity every charge and auth check relies on.
GameMove records a board-game move; it has nothing to do with charging or settling a payment.
PaymentIntent tracks one charge's lifecycle from creation through success or failure.
Transaction records one concrete money-movement attempt tied back to a PaymentIntent.

q: PaymentIntent 和 Transaction 的核心区别是什么？
options: Transaction 是用户账号，PaymentIntent 是商户账号
PaymentIntent 和 Transaction 必须严格一一对应，不能重试
PaymentIntent 管收款生命周期，Transaction 记录资金移动尝试
PaymentIntent 只用于 webhook，不存数据库
why: 一个 PaymentIntent 可关联多次 Transaction，例如失败重试、部分支付或退款扩展；商户看到的是更简单的整体状态。
why_en: A PaymentIntent owns the payment lifecycle while Transactions represent concrete attempts or money movements under it.
options_en: Transaction is the customer account and PaymentIntent is the merchant account.
PaymentIntent and Transaction must map one-to-one and can never be retried.
PaymentIntent owns the payment lifecycle; Transaction records each money-movement attempt.
PaymentIntent is only used for webhooks and is never stored in the database.
tradeoff: 生命周期视图 vs 具体尝试记录
q_en: What is the core difference between a PaymentIntent and a Transaction?
optionExplanations: 误将两个支付流程实体当成账号：Transaction 不是用户账号，PaymentIntent 也不是商户账号。
同一个 PaymentIntent 常常对应多次 Transaction，比如失败重试或部分支付，并不是严格一一对应。
生命周期和具体尝试要分开看：PaymentIntent 管收款全程状态，Transaction 记录每次资金移动尝试。
作为持久化核心记录，PaymentIntent 要写入数据库，并不是只服务于 webhook 的一次性通知。
optionExplanations_en: This mixes up two payment-flow entities with accounts: Transaction is not a customer account, and PaymentIntent is not a merchant account.
One PaymentIntent often maps to several Transactions — failed retries or partial payments — not a strict one-to-one.
Separate the two: PaymentIntent owns the payment lifecycle end to end, and Transaction records each individual money-movement attempt.
As a persisted core record, PaymentIntent is written to the database — it is not just a one-off payload for webhooks.

q: 补全 PaymentIntent 的常见生命周期：
text: PaymentIntent 通常从 {{created}} 开始，进入 {{processing}}，最终变为 {{succeeded}} 或 {{failed}}；更完整系统还会有 authorized/captured/canceled/refunded 等状态。
why: 支付处理是多阶段流程，状态机能把外部网络的异步结果和商户可见状态连接起来。
why_en: Payment processing is a multi-step workflow, so a state machine connects asynchronous network outcomes to merchant-visible status.
diagram:
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> created
  created --> processing
  processing --> succeeded
  processing --> failed
  succeeded --> [*]
  failed --> [*]

termDefinitions.meaning: 用状态和转移规则描述对象生命周期的模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A state machine models an object's lifecycle as a set of states and transitions.

q_en: Fill in the common PaymentIntent lifecycle:

scenario: 商户在结账页开始时想声明要收 2499 美分，币种 usd，并拿到后续支付会引用的 ID。
q: 应该使用哪个 API 语义？
options: GET /payment-intents/{id} 创建 PaymentIntent
DELETE /payment-intents/{id} 创建 PaymentIntent
POST /webhooks 直接扣款
POST /payment-intents 创建 PaymentIntent
why: 创建收款意图是生成新资源，POST /payment-intents 返回 paymentIntentId，后续 charge 和查询都围绕它进行。
why_en: Creating a payment intent is creating a new resource, so POST returns an identifier used by later charge and status calls.
whenOtherWins: 如果只是查询已存在支付状态，GET /payment-intents/{id} 才合适。
options_en: GET /payment-intents/{id} to create a PaymentIntent.
DELETE /payment-intents/{id} to create a PaymentIntent.
POST /webhooks to charge directly.
POST /payment-intents to create a PaymentIntent.
tradeoff: 创建新资源(POST) vs 查询已有状态(GET)
q_en: Which API semantics should be used here?
scenario_en: At checkout start, a merchant wants to declare a 2,499-cent USD charge and receive an ID that later payment calls will reference.
optionExplanations: GET 语义上只读取已有资源，不该拿它去创建新的 PaymentIntent。
DELETE 表示删除资源，语义正好和创建收款意图相反。
/webhooks 是事件通知入口，不是商户发起收款的地方。
声明要收一笔新钱本质是创建资源，POST /payment-intents 返回的 ID 会被后续 charge 和查询复用。
optionExplanations_en: GET is meant to read an existing resource, not create a new PaymentIntent as a side effect.
DELETE means removing a resource, the opposite of creating a payment intent.
/webhooks is an event-notification endpoint, not where a merchant initiates a charge.
Declaring a new charge is creating a resource, so POST /payment-intents returns an ID that later charge and status calls reuse.

scenario: 商户需要知道支付何时成功，以便发货或开通数字服务；轮询可用但希望更实时且少请求。
q: 支付状态变更的行业常见推送方式是什么？
options: 商户注册 webhook，系统在状态变化时向商户服务器 POST 事件
用 WebSocket 持续给客户浏览器推送最新状态
运营每天人工导出并邮件发送一份 CSV 报表
让客户对着付款结果页面截图留证
why: webhook 是 server-to-server 通知，适合商户系统在支付成功/失败时触发业务流程。
why_en: Webhooks are server-to-server notifications that let merchant systems react to payment status changes.
whenOtherWins: 如果只是商户后台偶尔查看状态，GET 查询足够；如果是浏览器 UI 的实时交互，WebSocket/SSE 才更贴合。
options_en: The merchant registers a webhook and the system POSTs events to it on status changes.
Keep pushing the latest status to the customer's browser over WebSocket.
Ops manually exports and emails a CSV report every day.
Have the customer screenshot the payment result page as proof.
tradeoff: 系统间主动推送 vs 客户端实时连接

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务器在事件发生时主动向另一台服务器的 URL 发起 HTTP 请求通知。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A webhook is a server-to-server HTTP callback that fires when an event occurs.

q_en: What is the common industry pattern for pushing payment status changes?
scenario_en: A merchant needs to know when a payment succeeds so it can ship goods or unlock a digital service; polling works but should be more realtime and less chatty.
optionExplanations: 商户注册 webhook 后系统在状态变化时主动 POST 事件，这正是行业标准的服务器间实时通知方式。
WebSocket 是面向浏览器客户端的实时连接，不是给商户后端做系统对系统通知用的。
人工每天导出 CSV 邮件延迟以天计，完全跟不上商户要及时发货或开通服务的需求。
截图是非结构化证据，没法被商户系统自动解析或触发履约动作。
optionExplanations_en: Once a merchant registers a webhook, the system POSTs events on status changes — the industry-standard server-to-server notification.
WebSocket is a realtime channel aimed at browser clients, not a system-to-system notification for merchant backends.
A daily manual CSV export lags by a day, far too slow for a merchant that needs to ship or unlock service promptly.
A screenshot is unstructured evidence that no merchant system can parse or use to trigger fulfillment.

scenario: 所有商户请求进入系统时都需要认证、限流，并路由到 PaymentIntent 或 Transaction 服务。
q: 入口层应承担什么职责？
options: 数据库直接暴露到公网
API Gateway 做认证、限流和路由
Kafka broker 直接解析信用卡表单
Webhook Service 处理所有同步 API
why: API Gateway 是商户 API 的边界，负责横切能力并把业务请求交给内部服务。
why_en: The API gateway is the merchant-facing boundary for authentication, rate limiting, and routing to internal services.
whenOtherWins: 内部服务之间的高吞吐异步事件流应走 Kafka，不应把 API Gateway 当事件日志。
options_en: Expose the database directly to the public internet.
An API gateway handles authentication, rate limiting, and routing.
Have the Kafka broker parse credit-card forms directly.
Have the Webhook Service handle every synchronous API call.
tradeoff: 统一边界能力 vs 服务各自处理横切逻辑

termDefinitions.meaning: 分布式事件流平台，用来异步、按顺序传递事件消息。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Kafka is a distributed event-streaming platform used to pass events asynchronously and in order.

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务器在事件发生时主动向另一台服务器的 URL 发起 HTTP 请求通知。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A webhook is a server-to-server HTTP callback that fires when an event occurs.

q_en: What responsibility should the entry layer own?
scenario_en: Every merchant request entering the system needs authentication, rate limiting, and routing to PaymentIntent or Transaction services.
optionExplanations: 数据库直接暴露公网既没有认证也没有限流，攻击面完全失控。
认证、限流、路由这些横切职责天然属于入口层，API Gateway 正是商户 API 的边界。
Kafka 是异步事件流组件，不该承担解析信用卡表单这种同步业务逻辑。
Webhook Service 是向外投递通知的消费者，不是承接商户同步 API 请求的入口。
optionExplanations_en: Exposing the database straight to the public internet has no auth or rate limiting, leaving the attack surface wide open.
Authentication, rate limiting, and routing are cross-cutting entry-layer jobs, and the API gateway is exactly that boundary for merchant traffic.
Kafka is an asynchronous event-streaming component, not the place to parse a credit-card form's synchronous logic.
The Webhook Service delivers outbound notifications; it isn't the entry point for a merchant's synchronous API calls.

scenario: 商户 API key 若泄露，攻击者可能重放旧请求；支付系统需要证明请求未被篡改且在有效时间窗内。
q: 比静态 API key 更安全的认证方案是什么？
options: 只把 API key 放在 URL 的 query 参数里传输
每次请求都强制客户输入图形验证码
签名认证：secret key 对请求内容、时间戳和 nonce 做 HMAC
只把商户 ID 写进请求 body，不做任何签名
why: HMAC 签名同时验证来源和内容完整性，timestamp 与 nonce 限制重放窗口。
why_en: HMAC request signing proves authenticity and integrity while timestamp and nonce checks limit replay attacks.
whenOtherWins: 低风险内部工具可能静态 API key 就够；公开金融 API 不应只靠长期 bearer token。
diagram:
flowchart TD
  R[Request]
  S[Server secret]
  H[Recompute HMAC]
  N[Check nonce time]
  A[Accept or reject]
  R --> H
  S --> H
  H --> N --> A
options_en: Send the API key only as a URL query parameter.
Force the customer to solve a CAPTCHA on every request.
Signed auth: HMAC the request body, timestamp, and nonce with a secret key.
Just put the merchant ID in the body with no signature at all.
tradeoff: 签名防篡改防重放 vs 静态凭证仅声明身份

termDefinitions.meaning: 用密钥对消息计算的哈希签名，用来验证消息来源和是否被篡改。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HMAC is a keyed hash used to verify a message's origin and integrity.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每次请求唯一的随机值，用来防止请求被重放。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A nonce is a unique per-request value used to prevent replay attacks.

q_en: What authentication scheme is safer than a static API key?
scenario_en: If a merchant API key leaks, an attacker may replay old requests; the payment system must prove the request was not tampered with and is inside a valid time window.
optionExplanations: 把 key 放进 URL query 很容易被日志、代理和浏览器历史记下来，反而扩大泄露面。
验证码是给人看的交互，服务器对服务器的自动化请求根本没法解验证码。
用 secret 对请求内容、时间戳和 nonce 做 HMAC，既能验证来源又能挡重放，比静态 key 强得多。
只写商户 ID 不签名，任何人都能伪造身份提交请求。
optionExplanations_en: Putting the key in a URL query string gets it logged by servers, proxies, and browser history, widening the leak surface.
CAPTCHAs are for humans; a server-to-server automated request has no way to solve one.
HMAC-signing the body, timestamp, and nonce with a secret proves both origin and freshness, well beyond what a static key offers.
Putting only the merchant ID in the body with no signature lets anyone forge the identity and submit requests.

scenario: API Gateway 收到带 API key、timestamp、nonce 和签名的商户请求，需要判断如何验证。
q: 验证流程最关键的一步是哪一个？
options: 只检查 Authorization header 是否存在
把 nonce 存进客户端 localStorage
让数据库自动接受签名字段
用商户 secret 重算 HMAC 并检查 timestamp/nonce
why: 服务端必须用已知 secret 重算签名并做时间窗、nonce 去重；仅有 header 并不能防伪造或重放。
why_en: The gateway must recompute the HMAC with the merchant secret and validate timestamp and nonce to prevent tampering and replay.
whenOtherWins: 如果服务间走 mTLS 且不暴露给商户，签名可能不是必需，但公网商户 API 需要它。
codeSample:
Authorization: Bearer pk_live_...
X-Request-Timestamp: 2023-10-15T14:22:31Z
X-Request-Nonce: a1b2c3d4
X-Signature: sha256=<hmac(method,path,body,timestamp,nonce)>
options_en: Only check whether the Authorization header is present.
Store the nonce in the client's localStorage.
Let the database auto-accept the signature field.
Recompute the HMAC with the merchant secret and validate the timestamp and nonce.
tradeoff: 服务端重算校验 vs 仅检查请求是否携带签名
q_en: What is the most important step in the request verification flow?
scenario_en: The API Gateway receives a merchant request with an API key, timestamp, nonce, and signature, and must decide how to verify it.
optionExplanations: header 存在只能说明请求带了个 Authorization 值，不代表签名或时间戳真的有效。
nonce 要由服务端集中记录去重，存进客户端 localStorage 等于把防重放交给不可信的一方。
密码学校验不是数据库的职责，签名字段必须在网关这一层被主动验证。
用商户 secret 重算 HMAC 并核对 timestamp/nonce，才能同时防住伪造和重放。
optionExplanations_en: An Authorization header being present only shows something was sent, not that the signature or timestamp is actually valid.
The nonce must be tracked server-side for dedup; storing it in the client's localStorage hands replay protection to an untrusted party.
Cryptographic verification isn't the database's job; the signature field has to be actively checked at the gateway.
Recomputing the HMAC with the merchant's secret and checking the timestamp and nonce together blocks both forgery and replay.

q: 只使用长期静态 API key（无到期时间的密钥）的主要安全风险是什么？
options: 泄露后可长期被重放使用
无法支持 HTTPS
数据库不能索引 key
商户无法创建 PaymentIntent
why: 静态凭证每次请求都携带，一旦在代码仓库、配置或网络边界泄露，就可能被攻击者长期滥用。
why_en: A leaked static API key can be replayed indefinitely because it is a long-lived bearer credential.
options_en: A leaked key can be replayed indefinitely.
It cannot support HTTPS.
The database cannot index the key.
Merchants cannot create a PaymentIntent.
q_en: What is the main security risk of using only long-lived static API keys?
optionExplanations: 静态 key 没有失效或签名校验，一旦泄露就能被攻击者反复重放使用。
认证方式和是否支持 HTTPS 传输是两码事，API key 本身不影响 HTTPS。
key 只是普通字符串字段，数据库完全可以正常给它建索引。
静态 key 本身就能被用来创建请求，问题出在安全性而不是这项功能能不能用。
optionExplanations_en: A static key has no lapse or signature check, so once leaked it can be replayed by an attacker indefinitely.
The auth scheme and HTTPS support are unrelated; using an API key doesn't stop HTTPS from working.
The key is just a plain string column, and databases index those without any trouble.
A static key can still be used to create requests just fine; the issue is its security, not whether the feature works.

scenario: 客户在商户网页输入卡号，目标是尽量让敏感卡数据不要经过商户服务器，降低商户 PCI 负担和泄露风险。
q: 更合理的卡数据收集方式是什么？
options: 商户服务器先收集卡号再转发给支付系统处理
支付系统 SDK 在商户页面嵌入来自支付域名的安全 iframe
打电话让客户口头告知客服卡号
直接把卡号写进 URL 的 query string 里
why: 支付域名的 iframe 形成浏览器同源边界，商户页面代码无法直接读取卡号，减少敏感数据触达面。
why_en: A payment-domain iframe uses the browser same-origin boundary to keep raw card data away from merchant servers and page scripts.
whenOtherWins: 若商户是完全 PCI 合规的大型处理方，直接收卡也可能可行，但平台型支付系统通常要替商户降合规负担。
options_en: The merchant server collects the card number first, then forwards it for processing.
The payment SDK embeds a secure iframe from the payment domain on the merchant page.
Have the customer read the card number aloud to support over the phone.
Put the card number directly in the URL query string.
tradeoff: 同源隔离降低商户合规负担 vs 商户直收更简单但风险更高

termDefinitions.meaning: 网页里嵌入的独立文档窗口，受浏览器同源策略保护。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An iframe is an embedded document in a page that is isolated by the browser's same-origin policy.

termDefinitions.meaning: 支付卡行业制定的数据安全标准，规定如何处理持卡人数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PCI DSS is the payment card industry's data security standard for handling cardholder data.

q_en: What is the better way to collect card data?
scenario_en: A customer enters a card number on a merchant web page; the goal is to keep sensitive card data away from merchant servers and reduce PCI scope and breach risk.
optionExplanations: 卡号一旦落到商户服务器，商户系统就已经进入 PCI 合规范围，白白扩大了合规和泄露责任。
支付域名的 iframe 靠浏览器同源策略把商户页面代码和卡号输入框隔开，商户代码根本读不到卡号。
电话口述卡号既没有加密也没法审计，客服渠道完全不适合传递敏感支付数据。
卡号写进 URL 会被服务器日志、代理和浏览器历史悄悄记录下来，暴露面比表单提交大得多。
optionExplanations_en: Once the card number lands on the merchant server, the merchant's systems fall inside PCI scope, adding compliance burden and breach liability for nothing.
A payment-domain iframe uses the browser's same-origin boundary to keep merchant page code away from the card field entirely.
Reading a card number aloud over the phone has no encryption or audit trail — a support channel is the wrong place for sensitive payment data.
Putting the card number in a URL gets it quietly logged by servers, proxies, and browser history — far more exposure than a form post.

scenario: 仅靠 iframe 和 HTTPS 仍担心页面或传输层某处被攻破，希望卡号离开用户设备前就不可读。
q: 防御纵深的下一层是什么？
options: 把卡号简单做 base64 编码后再发送
让商户在自己日志系统里做脱敏处理即可
SDK 用平台公钥端上加密卡号，私钥存 HSM
把 CVC 安全码单独用邮件发送给客服
why: 客户端加密让卡数据在离开设备前就变成密文，HSM 保护私钥，HTTPS 只作为额外传输保护。
why_en: Client-side encryption with a payment public key makes card data ciphertext before it leaves the device, with private keys protected in HSMs.
whenOtherWins: 低风险非支付表单通常 HTTPS 足够；真实卡数据需要更强防御纵深。
options_en: Base64-encode the card number before sending.
Just have the merchant redact card numbers in its own logging system.
The SDK encrypts the card on the client with the platform's public key; the private key lives in an HSM.
Email the CVC security code separately to support.
tradeoff: 端上加密+HSM解密 vs 仅靠传输层(HTTPS)保护

termDefinitions.meaning: 专用硬件安全模块，用来安全存储密钥并执行加解密运算。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An HSM is dedicated hardware that securely stores keys and performs encryption or decryption.

q_en: What is the next layer of defense-in-depth?
scenario_en: Even with an iframe and HTTPS, the team wants card numbers to be unreadable before leaving the user device.
optionExplanations: base64 只是编码格式，任何人拿到密文都能直接解码还原，不提供任何保密性。
脱敏只清理了商户自己的日志，卡号本身在传输和处理过程中仍然是明文。
SDK 用平台公钥在客户端把卡号加密成密文，只有 HSM 里的私钥能解开，卡数据从离开设备起就没有明文形态。
CVC 是不该被记录或转发的一次性安全码，用邮件传递既不加密也违反基本处理规则。
optionExplanations_en: Base64 is just an encoding, not encryption — anyone can decode it back to the original with no effort.
Redacting only cleans up the merchant's own logs; the card number itself is still plaintext everywhere else in the flow.
The SDK encrypts the card client-side with the platform's public key, so only the private key inside the HSM can decrypt it — plaintext never leaves the device.
The CVC is a one-time security code that should never be stored or forwarded; emailing it is both unencrypted and against basic handling rules.

scenario: 商户网页要收信用卡信息，但原始卡号最好不要被商户服务器或商户页面脚本直接接触。
q: 支付表单的安全分层通常包括哪些？（多选）
options: 支付域名 iframe，受浏览器同源策略隔离
客户端 public-key 加密
把原始卡号写到商户应用日志
HTTPS 传输保护
why: 三层各挡一类风险：iframe 让商户脚本读不到卡号，public-key 加密让离开设备的是密文，HTTPS 防网络窃听。日志原始卡号是反模式。
why_en: The layers defend different surfaces: the iframe blocks merchant scripts, public-key encryption makes card data ciphertext before transit, and HTTPS protects the connection.
options_en: A payment-domain iframe isolated by the browser's same-origin policy.
Client-side public-key encryption.
Log raw card numbers in the merchant application.
HTTPS transport protection.

termDefinitions.meaning: iframe：网页里嵌入的另一个网页窗口；这里由支付平台域名提供卡号输入框。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An iframe is an embedded page inside another page; here it hosts the card field from the payment domain.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同源策略：浏览器限制不同协议、域名或端口的页面互相读取数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The same-origin policy prevents pages from different schemes, hosts, or ports from reading each other's data.

termDefinitions.meaning: 公钥加密：公钥可公开给浏览器加密，只有对应私钥能解密。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Public-key encryption lets the browser encrypt with a public key while only the matching private key can decrypt.

termDefinitions.meaning: HTTPS：用 TLS 加密浏览器和服务器之间的网络传输。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HTTPS uses TLS to encrypt network traffic between the browser and the server.

termDefinitions.fullName: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard
termDefinitions.meaning: PCI DSS：处理银行卡数据时需要遵守的支付行业安全标准。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PCI DSS is the payment industry security standard for handling cardholder data.

q_en: Which layers usually belong in secure payment-form handling? (Select all that apply)
scenario_en: A merchant page needs to collect credit-card information, but raw card numbers should not be directly exposed to merchant servers or merchant page scripts.
optionExplanations: 支付域名 iframe 让卡号输入框脱离商户页面的同源范围，商户 JS 读不到里面的值。
客户端 public-key 加密让卡号在离开用户设备前就已经是密文。
把原始卡号写进商户应用日志是反模式——日志常被搜索、备份、转储，等于新开一个泄露渠道。
HTTPS 用 TLS 加密浏览器到服务端这一段连接，挡住网络中间人窃听。
optionExplanations_en: A payment-domain iframe puts the card field outside the merchant page's origin, so merchant JavaScript can't read what's inside.
Client-side public-key encryption turns the card number into ciphertext before it ever leaves the user's device.
Logging raw card numbers in the merchant app is an anti-pattern — logs get searched, backed up, and exported, opening a whole new leak path.
HTTPS encrypts the browser-to-server leg with TLS, blocking a network man-in-the-middle from reading traffic.

scenario: 系统需要创建交易记录、调用 Visa/Mastercard/银行网络，并接收授权、结算、拒付等外部状态变化。
q: 哪个服务应拥有这段职责？
options: 静态 CDN
Webhook Delivery Service
商户浏览器
Transaction Service
why: Transaction Service 负责内部交易状态和外部支付网络交互，减少无意义网络跳转并集中 PCI 控制面。
why_en: The Transaction Service owns transaction state and payment-network interaction, centralizing the PCI-sensitive processing path.
whenOtherWins: 纯状态查询可由 PaymentIntent Service 服务；对外商户通知才由 Webhook Service 处理。
options_en: A static CDN.
The Webhook Delivery Service.
The merchant's browser.
The Transaction Service.
tradeoff: 集中 PCI 控制面 vs 拆成多个服务增加网络跳
q_en: Which service should own this responsibility?
scenario_en: The system must create transaction records, call Visa/Mastercard or bank networks, and receive authorization, settlement, and dispute status changes.
optionExplanations: CDN 只做静态内容缓存分发，接触不到支付网络交互这类业务逻辑。
Webhook Delivery Service 是把结果通知商户的下游消费者，不直接连 Visa/Mastercard。
浏览器是客户端环境，不该持有调用支付网络所需的 PCI 敏感凭证。
Transaction Service 把交易记录管理和外部网络交互集中在一起，减少不必要的服务间跳转并收紧 PCI 控制面。
optionExplanations_en: A CDN only caches and serves static content; it never touches business logic like talking to a payment network.
The Webhook Delivery Service notifies merchants downstream; it doesn't call Visa or Mastercard directly.
The browser is client-side and shouldn't hold the PCI-sensitive credentials needed to call a payment network.
The Transaction Service centralizes transaction records and network calls in one place, cutting extra hops and tightening the PCI control boundary.

q: 补全支付网络的真实交互特征：
text: 支付网络往往不是普通公网 REST API，而是经由专线/VPN、mTLS、HSM 和专有协议（如 {{ISO 8583}}）接入，并可能异步返回后续状态。
why: 这解释了为什么支付处理要围绕异步、重试、对账和合规来设计，而不是当作普通内部服务调用。
why_en: Payment networks behave like asynchronous regulated external systems rather than simple internal REST services.

termDefinitions.meaning: 银行卡支付行业常用的报文格式标准，用于授权和清算消息。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ISO 8583 is a common messaging standard used for card-payment authorization and settlement.

termDefinitions.meaning: 双向 TLS，通信双方都要出示证书互相验证身份。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: mTLS is mutual TLS, where both sides present certificates to verify each other's identity.

q_en: Fill in the real interaction traits of payment networks:

q: 把支付网络超时直接当成失败，最危险的后果是什么？
options: 客户可能被银行成功扣款，但商户看到失败并诱导重试，造成重复扣款
API Gateway 会失去限流能力
Kafka partition 数变成 0
iframe 无法渲染
why: 超时只代表我们没收到结果，不代表外部网络没处理；贸然标记失败会制造双扣或履约错配。
why_en: A timeout means the outcome is unknown, not failed, so treating it as failure can cause duplicate charges or fulfillment mismatches.
options_en: The customer may already be charged by the bank while the merchant sees failure and prompts a retry, causing a duplicate charge.
The API gateway loses its rate-limiting capability.
The Kafka partition count drops to zero.
The iframe fails to render.
q_en: What is the most dangerous consequence of treating a payment-network timeout as failure?
optionExplanations: 客户可能已经被银行扣款成功，商户却看到失败提示诱导重试，这一来一回就制造了重复扣款。
限流是网关的独立能力，跟怎么判断一次超时的结果没有关系。
Kafka partition 数由 topic 配置决定，不会因为一次超时判断策略而改变。
iframe 渲染是前端展示问题，跟支付网络超时的一致性风险完全是两件事。
optionExplanations_en: The bank may have already charged the customer while the merchant sees failure and prompts a retry — that mismatch is exactly how a duplicate charge happens.
Rate limiting is a separate gateway capability, unrelated to how a timeout outcome gets classified.
Kafka partition count comes from topic config, not from how a single timeout gets classified.
iframe rendering is a frontend display concern, unrelated to the consistency risk of a payment-network timeout.

scenario: 支付网络 30 秒无响应，但外部银行可能已经批准并扣款；商户和客户需要避免重复扣款。
q: 内部状态最应该如何表达？
options: 立即标记为 failed 并通知商户
pending_verification 待验证状态
直接标记为 succeeded 放行履约
直接把这条记录 deleted 删除
why: 超时是未知态，应该进入待验证状态并由后台对账查询网络结果，而不是猜成功或失败。
why_en: A network timeout is an unknown outcome, so the system should mark it pending verification and reconcile later.
whenOtherWins: 如果外部系统明确返回 decline，才可以标 failed；如果明确授权成功，才可以推进成功路径。
options_en: Mark it failed immediately and notify the merchant.
Mark it pending_verification.
Mark it succeeded and let fulfillment proceed.
Delete the record outright.
tradeoff: 承认未知、留给对账 vs 立即猜测成功或失败
q_en: How should the internal state represent this outcome?
scenario_en: The payment network has not responded for 30 seconds, but the external bank may already have approved and charged; the merchant and customer must avoid duplicate charges.
optionExplanations: 银行侧可能其实已经批准扣款，这时候标 failed 会诱导商户或客户重复发起支付。
结果未知时应该老实进入 pending_verification，交给后台对账去查真实的网络结果，而不是猜。
银行也可能确实拒绝了这笔交易，直接标 succeeded 会让商户在没收到钱的情况下就放行履约。
删除这条记录会连带丢掉后续对账和审计需要的全部线索。
optionExplanations_en: The bank side may have already approved the charge, so marking it failed here can prompt a duplicate attempt.
When the outcome is unknown, the honest move is pending_verification, letting reconciliation look up the real network result instead of guessing.
The bank may equally well have declined the charge, so marking it succeeded can let fulfillment proceed with no money actually collected.
Deleting the record wipes out the trail that reconciliation and audit would need later.

scenario: 商户在网络抖动后用同一个业务请求重试创建/支付，系统必须返回原记录而不是再次扣款。
q: 哪种数据库约束最直接支持商户重试幂等？
options: INDEX (amount)
CHECK (currency IN (...))
UNIQUE (merchant_id, idempotency_key)
FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id)
why: 同一商户同一 idempotency key 只能创建一条记录，重试时读取已有 PaymentIntent/Transaction。
why_en: A unique constraint on merchant and idempotency key ensures retries return the existing record instead of creating another charge.
whenOtherWins: 普通查询优化用索引；这里要防重复副作用，唯一约束才是关键。
codeSample:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uniq_payment_idempotency
ON payment_requests (merchant_id, idempotency_key);
options_en: INDEX (amount).
CHECK (currency IN (...)).
UNIQUE (merchant_id, idempotency_key).
FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id).
tradeoff: 数据库唯一约束防重复 vs 应用层自行判断去重

termDefinitions.meaning: 客户端提供的请求去重键，同一个 key 的重复请求只会生效一次。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An idempotency key is a client-supplied token that ensures a repeated request only takes effect once.

q_en: Which database constraint most directly supports idempotent merchant retries?
scenario_en: A merchant retries the same business request after a network glitch; the system must return the original record instead of charging again.
optionExplanations: 普通索引只能加速查询，挡不住同一个请求被重复插入成两条记录。
CHECK 约束只校验取值范围合不合法，跟重试要不要去重没有关系。
UNIQUE(merchant_id, idempotency_key) 让同一商户同一个 key 只能存在一条记录，重试直接撞约束返回原记录。
外键只校验引用关系是否存在，防不住同一个请求被重复处理。
optionExplanations_en: A plain index only speeds up lookups; it does nothing to stop the same request from being inserted twice.
A CHECK constraint only validates that a value is in range; it has nothing to do with deduplicating retries.
UNIQUE(merchant_id, idempotency_key) allows only one row per merchant per key, so a retry hits the constraint and returns the original record.
A foreign key only checks that a reference exists; it can't prevent the same request from being processed twice.

q: 处理一次外部支付网络调用的可靠顺序是什么？
steps: 根据结果更新 attempt 为 succeeded/failed/timeout
先写 attempt 记录，包含 network、referenceId 和意图
timeout 事件由 Reconciliation Service 查询外部网络
再调用外部支付网络
why: 先记录意图再执行外部副作用，才能在超时或崩溃后知道自己试图做过什么并继续对账。
why_en: Recording the attempt before the external side effect preserves the intent needed for retries and reconciliation.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  I[Create idempotent transaction]
  P[Set processing]
  N[Call payment network]
  U[Record outcome or unknown]
  I --> P --> N --> U

termDefinitions.meaning: 用外部权威记录核对并修正内部状态的过程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Reconciliation is the process of matching internal records against an external authoritative source.

q_en: What is the reliable order for handling one external payment-network call?

scenario: 外部支付网络可能实时查询，也会定期提供批量结算/对账文件；内部 timeout 状态必须最终收敛。
q: 应该引入哪个组件？
options: 只部署一个 Image CDN 加速静态图片
前端加一个客户端倒计时器控件
新增一个游戏排行榜服务
Reconciliation Service 对账服务
why: 对账服务把内部 attempt 与外部权威记录关联，修正 timeout、丢响应和结算状态差异。
why_en: A reconciliation service correlates internal attempts with external authoritative records to resolve unknown or drifted payment states.
whenOtherWins: 如果外部系统完全同步且强可靠，简单请求/响应足够；真实支付网络通常不是这种形态。
options_en: Just deploy an image CDN to speed up static images.
Add a client-side countdown timer widget.
Add a game leaderboard service.
A Reconciliation Service.
tradeoff: 主动对账收敛不确定态 vs 被动等待客户端反馈
q_en: Which component should be introduced?
scenario_en: The external payment network may support realtime queries and also deliver batch settlement or reconciliation files; internal timeout states must eventually converge.
optionExplanations: CDN 只负责加速静态图片分发，参与不了支付状态的判定。
前端倒计时器只是 UI 展示效果，查不到银行侧的真实处理结果。
游戏排行榜服务和支付状态的收敛没有任何关系。
对账服务把内部 pending 记录和外部实时查询、批量结算文件关联起来，把未知状态收敛成确定结果。
optionExplanations_en: An image CDN only speeds up static assets; it plays no role in deciding payment state.
A client-side countdown is just a UI effect; it can't look up the bank's actual processing result.
A game leaderboard service has nothing to do with resolving payment state.
A reconciliation service ties internal pending records to external realtime queries and batch settlement files, resolving unknown states into certainty.

q: 对账服务通常会使用哪些外部信号？（多选）
options: 按 network referenceId 做实时状态查询
支付网络定时交付的批量 reconciliation/settlement files
内部 CDC/Kafka timeout events
客户浏览器截图
why: 实时查询、批量文件和内部事件共同把未知状态推进到确定结果；截图不是可审计的权威来源。
why_en: Realtime status queries, batch settlement files, and internal timeout events together move uncertain payments toward authoritative outcomes.
options_en: Real-time status queries by network reference ID.
Batch reconciliation/settlement files delivered periodically by the payment network.
Internal CDC/Kafka timeout events.
Customer browser screenshots.
q_en: Which external signals does a reconciliation service usually use? (Select all that apply)
optionExplanations: 按 network referenceId 实时查询能直接问外部网络这笔交易现在是什么状态。
支付网络定期交付的批量结算文件是权威的、可审计的结果来源。
内部 CDC/Kafka 的 timeout 事件是触发对账流程该去查哪些记录的信号。
客户浏览器截图是非结构化证据，系统解析不了也没法作为审计依据。
optionExplanations_en: Querying by network reference ID in realtime asks the external network directly what state a transaction is in right now.
Batch settlement files the network delivers periodically are an authoritative, auditable source of outcomes.
Internal CDC/Kafka timeout events signal reconciliation which records need to be looked up.
A customer's browser screenshot is unstructured evidence a system can't parse or use as an audit trail.

scenario: 支付系统必须多年后仍能证明某笔支付如何从创建、授权、捕获到争议，且不能依赖应用代码每次手写 audit insert。
q: 更稳健的审计架构是什么？
options: Operational DB + CDC + Kafka + 归档
只在原地更新 payments.status 字段，不留痕迹
只保留 Nginx 的访问日志文件
把审计这件事完全交给商户自己去做
why: CDC 在数据库提交层捕获变更，避免应用漏写审计；Kafka 与归档提供追加式历史和多消费者视图。
why_en: CDC captures committed database changes at the log level, feeding an immutable event stream without relying on every code path to write audit rows.
whenOtherWins: 小型非金融系统可用普通 audit table；支付系统对不可丢事件和独立扩展要求更高。
options_en: Operational DB + CDC + Kafka + archiving.
Only update the payments.status field in place, leaving no trace.
Only keep Nginx access log files.
Leave auditing entirely to each merchant.
tradeoff: 数据库层捕获不可变事件 vs 应用代码手动维护审计表

termDefinitions.meaning: 从数据库提交日志捕获变更并发布为事件流的技术。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CDC, or change data capture, reads committed database changes and publishes them as an event stream.

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据库预写日志，记录每次提交前的变更，用于恢复和 CDC。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A WAL, or write-ahead log, records every committed change and is the source CDC reads from.

q_en: What is the more robust audit architecture?
scenario_en: Years later, the payment system must still prove how a payment moved from creation through authorization, capture, and dispute, without relying on application code to hand-write every audit insert.
optionExplanations: CDC 从数据库提交日志层捕获变更，不依赖应用代码记得写审计，Kafka 和归档再把它变成可追加、多消费者能用的历史。
只做原地 UPDATE 会覆盖旧值，之前的状态变迁就再也证明不出来了。
接入层访问日志记录的是请求本身，不包含支付状态迁移的业务语义。
商户没有平台内部系统的写权限，没法记录一份真实完整的审计历史。
optionExplanations_en: CDC captures changes at the committed-log level without relying on application code to remember an audit insert, and Kafka plus archiving turn that into an append-only, multi-consumer history.
Updating status in place overwrites the old value, so the prior transition can never be proven again.
Access logs at the edge capture the request itself, not the business meaning of a payment status transition.
Merchants have no write access to the platform's internal systems, so they can't produce a real, complete audit history.

q: 只在关系库里原地 UPDATE payment status，为什么不满足支付审计？
options: SQL 无法存储金额
会覆盖历史状态，难以证明完整事件序列
关系库没有事务
无法返回当前状态
why: 原地更新保留当前值但丢掉状态变迁证据，应用 bug 也可能静默破坏历史。
why_en: In-place updates preserve current state but erase the transition history needed for audits and dispute investigation.
options_en: SQL cannot store monetary amounts.
It overwrites history, making it hard to prove the full sequence of events.
Relational databases have no transactions.
It cannot return the current state.
q_en: Why is updating payment status in place in a relational database not enough for payment audit?
optionExplanations: 金额可以正常存成数值类型，这跟审计要不要留痕迹没有关系。
UPDATE 会覆盖旧值，之前每一次状态转移的证据就随之消失，事后没法证明完整的事件序列。
关系库天然支持 ACID 事务，问题根本不出在有没有事务上。
原地更新恰恰能正确返回当前状态，缺的是历史，不是读取能力。
optionExplanations_en: Amounts store fine as numeric columns; that has nothing to do with whether history gets preserved.
UPDATE overwrites the old value, erasing evidence of every prior transition, so the full event sequence can no longer be proven.
Relational databases support ACID transactions natively; the problem was never about transactions existing.
In-place updates return the current state just fine — what's missing is history, not read capability.

q: 应用代码手动写 audit table 的主要缺陷是什么？
options: 审计表建好后无法支持 SELECT 查询
审计表必须用 Redis 才能实现
开发者漏写 audit insert 会悄悄丢失历史
审计记录写入后不能再追加新行
why: 手动双写依赖每条代码路径都正确执行，且把高吞吐 OLTP 与多年审计查询耦合在同一库上。
why_en: Manual audit inserts depend on every application path doing the right thing and couple operational writes with long-term audit storage.
options_en: An audit table cannot support SELECT queries once built.
An audit table must be implemented with Redis.
If a developer forgets the audit insert, history silently disappears.
Audit records cannot be appended after being written.
q_en: What is the main flaw of manually writing an audit table in application code?
optionExplanations: 普通表建好之后完全支持 SELECT 查询，这不是它的问题所在。
审计表可以用任何关系库实现，没有必须绑定 Redis 这回事。
手动双写依赖每一条代码路径都记得插入审计行，哪一处漏写，那部分历史就悄悄消失了。
审计表设计上本来就是只追加插入，问题不在于能不能追加新行。
optionExplanations_en: A regular table supports SELECT queries just fine once built; that isn't where the risk lives.
An audit table can live in any relational database — there's no requirement to use Redis.
Manual dual-writes depend on every code path remembering the audit insert, and one missed spot makes that slice of history silently vanish.
An audit table is designed to be append-only by nature; the flaw isn't about whether new rows can be added.

q: CDC（变更数据捕获）审计架构的数据流正确顺序是什么？
steps: Audit、Analytics、Reconciliation、Webhook 等消费者各自物化视图
Operational DB 提交 PaymentIntent/Transaction 变更
Kafka 保存按 key 分区的追加事件流
CDC 从 WAL/oplog 捕获 committed changes
why: 业务库先提交当前状态，CDC 从日志捕获并写入事件流，下游消费者再按用途构建审计、对账和通知视图。
why_en: The operational database commits first, CDC captures the log, Kafka stores the event stream, and consumers build their specialized views.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  DB[Payment DB]
  CDC[CDC stream]
  K[Kafka topic]
  A[Audit store]
  W[Webhook service]
  DB --> CDC --> K
  K --> A
  K --> W

termDefinitions.meaning: 从数据库提交日志捕获变更并发布为事件流的技术。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CDC reads committed database changes from the log and publishes them as events.

q_en: What is the correct data-flow order in a CDC-based audit architecture?

scenario: 支付事件流要支撑约 10k TPS，同时必须保证同一个 PaymentIntent 的状态转移按顺序处理。
q: Kafka topic 最合理的分区 key 是什么？
options: 随机 UUID
merchant_webhook_url
事件 payload 大小
payment_intent_id
why: 按 payment_intent_id 分区能保证同一支付意图的事件在同一 partition 内有序，同时不同意图并行处理。
why_en: Partitioning by payment_intent_id preserves per-payment ordering while allowing parallelism across different payments.
whenOtherWins: 如果需求是按商户严格串行处理所有事件，merchant_id 可能更合适，但会牺牲并行度并制造大商户热点。
options_en: A random UUID.
merchant_webhook_url.
The event payload size.
payment_intent_id.
tradeoff: 按 payment_intent_id 保序 vs 按 merchant_id 增大并行度

termDefinitions.meaning: Kafka topic 内部的有序子日志，决定并行度和顺序边界。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Kafka partition is an ordered sub-log within a topic that bounds ordering and parallelism.

q_en: What is the best Kafka topic partition key here?
scenario_en: The payment event stream must handle about 10k TPS while preserving the order of state transitions for each PaymentIntent.
optionExplanations: 随机 UUID 能把负载打散，但同一个 PaymentIntent 的事件也会散落到不同分区，顺序就保不住了。
回调地址是商户配置的一个属性，不是决定事件该进哪个分区的维度。
事件载荷大小和顺序、路由都没有关系，用它分区没有意义。
按 payment_intent_id 分区能让同一支付意图的事件都落在同一分区保持有序，不同意图之间又能并行处理。
optionExplanations_en: A random UUID spreads load evenly, but it also scatters one PaymentIntent's events across partitions, breaking their order.
The callback URL is a merchant config attribute, not a dimension that should decide which partition an event lands in.
Payload size has nothing to do with ordering or routing, so keying on it doesn't accomplish anything.
Partitioning by payment_intent_id keeps one payment's events in order within a single partition while letting different payments run in parallel.

q: 这组数字最支持哪个分区设计判断？
options: 多分区（3-5 个）按 payment_intent_id 分区
只用 1 个 partition，让所有事件严格全局有序
分区数量对吞吐没有影响，用多少都一样
为了吞吐应该按随机 UUID 分区
why: 单 partition 先按 10k-50k msg/s 粗估；10k TPS 已踩到低端且还要留 2-5x 余量。多分区按 payment_intent_id 分摊吞吐，同时保留单个意图内顺序。
why_en: Use 10k-50k msg/s as a rough single-partition anchor. A 10k TPS peak is already near the low end and still needs 2-5x headroom, so multiple partitions keyed by payment_intent_id add throughput while preserving per-payment ordering.
scenario: Kafka 单个 partition 先按 10k-50k msg/s 粗估；系统峰值约 10k TPS，仍需留 2-5x 余量，且要保证同一 PaymentIntent 内事件有序。
options_en: Multiple partitions (about 3-5) keyed by payment_intent_id.
Use just 1 partition so every event is strictly globally ordered.
Partition count has no effect on throughput; any number works.
Partition by random UUID to maximize throughput.
q_en: What partitioning decision is best supported by these numbers?
scenario_en: Use roughly 10k-50k messages per second as a Kafka single-partition anchor; the system peaks around 10k TPS, still needs 2-5x headroom, and must keep events ordered within a PaymentIntent.
optionExplanations: 单 partition 粗估上限约 10k-50k msg/s，10k TPS 峰值已贴着低端还要留余量，所以按 payment_intent_id 开 3-5 个分区更稳。
只用 1 个 partition 虽然全局有序，但吞吐完全卡死在单分区上限，撑不住促销峰值。
分区数其实直接决定了可并行处理的上限，说它对吞吐没有影响是错的。
随机 UUID 分区确实能提吞吐，但会打乱同一支付意图内部的事件顺序。
optionExplanations_en: A single partition tops out around 10k-50k msg/s, and a 10k TPS peak already sits near that low end with headroom still needed, so 3-5 partitions keyed by payment_intent_id fit better.
A single partition keeps everything globally ordered, but throughput is capped at one partition's ceiling — nowhere near enough for a promotion peak.
Partition count is exactly what bounds parallel throughput; claiming it has no effect is simply wrong.
Random-UUID partitioning does raise throughput, but it scrambles the order of events within a single payment.

q: 支付事件流常用 Kafka replication factor=3（副本数）的主要目的是什么？
options: 以为副本数=消息被处理三次，重复收三次钱
跨 broker 保留副本，容忍单点故障
让 partition key 失效
以为副本能替代数据库事务保证
why: 支付事件不能轻易丢失，副本分散在多个 broker/可用区能承受单点 broker 故障。
why_en: A replication factor of three keeps copies across brokers or zones so a broker failure does not lose payment events.
options_en: Assume replica count means each message is processed three times, charging three times.
Keep copies across brokers so a single broker failure is tolerated.
Invalidate the partition key.
Assume replication can substitute for database transaction guarantees.
q_en: What is the main purpose of replication factor three for payment-event Kafka topics?
optionExplanations: 副本数是持久性配置，不会让同一条消息被消费和处理三次，更不会让客户被扣三次款。
replication factor=3 把事件副本分散到多个 broker，单个 broker 挂了事件也不会丢。
分区键决定事件路由到哪个分区，副本数是另一个独立配置项，两者不冲突。
Kafka 复制解决的是消息持久性，替代不了数据库事务提供的原子性和一致性保证。
optionExplanations_en: Replica count is a durability setting; it doesn't make one message get processed three times, let alone charge a customer three times.
A replication factor of three spreads copies across brokers, so losing one broker doesn't lose the event.
The partition key decides which partition an event routes to; replica count is a separate setting that doesn't interfere with it.
Kafka replication buys durability; it can't substitute for the atomicity and consistency a database transaction provides.

q: CDC（变更数据捕获）系统本身故障时，主要风险和缓解是什么？
options: 支付网络会自动取消所有交易；无需处理
API key 全部失效；重启 Gateway 即可
事件停止流向 Kafka，需要 lag 监控和日志回放恢复
iframe 会变成跨域；换浏览器
why: CDC 是审计链路关键点，必须监控滞后、冗余运行，并保留从 WAL/oplog 补读遗漏事件的能力。
why_en: CDC failure stops events from flowing, so lag monitoring, redundant readers, and log replay recovery are essential.
options_en: Payment networks automatically cancel all transactions, so nothing needs to be done.
All API keys become invalid; just restart the gateway.
Events stop reaching Kafka; mitigate with lag monitoring and log replay recovery.
The iframe becomes cross-origin; switch browsers.
q_en: If the CDC system itself fails, what is the main risk and mitigation?
optionExplanations: 支付网络完全不知道我们内部 CDC 是否故障，也不会因此取消交易。
CDC 是审计管道的一环，跟 API key 认证是两个完全独立的系统。
数据库写入照常提交，但没人把变更发布出去，需要 lag 监控发现问题，再靠日志回放补齐漏掉的事件。
CDC 故障发生在后端管道，跟浏览器里 iframe 的跨域问题完全不是一回事。
optionExplanations_en: The external payment network has no idea our internal CDC failed, and it certainly won't cancel transactions because of it.
CDC is part of the audit pipeline, an entirely separate system from API-key authentication.
Database writes keep committing fine, but nothing publishes the changes, so lag monitoring has to catch it and log replay has to backfill the missed events.
CDC failure happens in the backend pipeline, unrelated to a browser iframe's cross-origin behavior.

q: CDC/Kafka 事件流可支持哪些下游消费者？（多选）
options: Audit Service 构建不可变历史
Analytics 构建业务分析视图
Reconciliation Service 对照外部网络
Webhook Service 生成商户通知
why: 同一条提交变更可被多个消费者按不同访问模式物化，避免把所有需求压在 OLTP 库上。
why_en: The same committed event stream can feed multiple materialized views without burdening the OLTP database.
options_en: The Audit Service builds an immutable history.
Analytics builds business-intelligence views.
The Reconciliation Service checks against the external network.
The Webhook Service generates merchant notifications.
q_en: Which downstream consumers can a CDC/Kafka event stream support? (Select all that apply)
optionExplanations: Audit Service 靠这条事件流建一份不可变、可举证的完整历史。
Analytics 把同一批事件物化成业务聚合视图，不用另外查询 OLTP 库。
Reconciliation Service 拿这些事件去核对外部支付网络的真实结果。
Webhook Service 消费同一条流，把状态变化转成商户通知。
optionExplanations_en: The Audit Service uses this event stream to build a complete, provable, immutable history.
Analytics materializes the same events into business-aggregate views without hitting the OLTP database directly.
The Reconciliation Service uses these events to check against the payment network's actual outcomes.
The Webhook Service consumes the same stream and turns status changes into merchant notifications.

scenario: 商户订阅 payment.succeeded 事件并提供 callback URL，系统要在 PaymentIntent 状态变化后可靠通知。
q: Webhook Service 应该从哪里获得触发事件？
options: 轮询商户浏览器
解析客户信用卡号
读取 CDN access log
消费 CDC/Kafka 事件流
why: 支付状态已经作为 CDC 事件进入 Kafka，Webhook Service 消费同一事件流即可避免额外耦合和漏通知。
why_en: Webhook delivery should consume the existing CDC event stream so status changes produce notifications without extra coupling.
whenOtherWins: 如果系统很小且没有事件流，短期可以直接在交易服务里同步触发，但会引入双写和延迟耦合。
options_en: Poll the merchant's browser.
Parse the customer's credit-card number.
Read the CDN access log.
Consume the CDC/Kafka event stream.
tradeoff: 复用已有事件流 vs 新建同步触发通道
q_en: Where should the Webhook Service get trigger events from?
scenario_en: A merchant subscribes to payment.succeeded and provides a callback URL; the system must reliably notify it after PaymentIntent state changes.
optionExplanations: 商户浏览器不是一个稳定可轮询的后端信号源，也不该被当作触发依据。
解析客户信用卡号属于卡数据处理路径，跟事件触发逻辑完全不搭边。
CDN 日志记录的是内容访问，看不到支付状态到底变成了什么。
支付状态变化本来就已经是 CDC 事件，Webhook Service 直接消费同一条流就不用另建一套触发通道。
optionExplanations_en: The merchant's browser isn't a reliable, pollable backend signal and shouldn't drive triggers at all.
Parsing a customer's card number belongs to card-data handling, unrelated to how events get triggered.
CDN logs capture content access, not what a payment's status actually changed to.
Status changes are already CDC events, so the Webhook Service can consume that same stream instead of building a separate trigger path.

q: 可靠 webhook 投递通常需要哪些机制？（多选）
options: 商户返回 2xx 后仍无限重试
记录每次 delivery attempt 和状态
失败后指数退避重试
对 payload 签名供商户验证
why: 投递日志支持排查和重放，退避避免压垮商户，签名防伪造；2xx 表示已接收，应停止该次重试。
why_en: Delivery logs, exponential backoff, and signed payloads make webhook delivery reliable and verifiable.
options_en: Keep retrying forever even after the merchant returns 2xx.
Record every delivery attempt and its status.
Retry with exponential backoff after failures.
Sign the payload so the merchant can verify it.
q_en: Which mechanisms are usually needed for reliable webhook delivery? (Select all that apply)
optionExplanations: 商户一旦返回 2xx 就说明这次投递已经成功，继续重试只会造成重复通知。
记录每次 delivery attempt 和状态，才有排查失败和重放事件的依据。
失败后指数退避重试，能在商户系统本就出问题时避免继续加压。
对 payload 签名让商户能验证事件确实来自支付平台、内容没被篡改。
optionExplanations_en: Once the merchant returns 2xx, that delivery already succeeded; retrying past that just duplicates the notification.
Logging every delivery attempt and its status is what makes debugging and replaying failed events possible.
Retrying with exponential backoff after a failure avoids piling more load onto a merchant system that's already struggling.
Signing the payload lets the merchant verify the event really came from the payment platform and wasn't tampered with.

q: 支付 webhook（服务器对服务器回调）和 WebSocket/SSE 的关键区别是什么？
options: webhook 是服务器间调用；WebSocket/SSE 面向客户端
两者本质上都是浏览器本地存储机制
webhook 通知必须由客户手机接收
WebSocket 协议只能用于批量数据处理
why: 商户需要系统间通知来触发履约，webhook 不要求用户浏览器在线，也不是给客户 UI 的连接。
why_en: Webhooks are server-to-server callbacks for merchant systems, unlike client-facing persistent realtime connections.
options_en: Webhooks are server-to-server calls; WebSocket/SSE are client-facing.
Both are fundamentally browser local-storage mechanisms.
