让所有查询都直接变成纯内存查询
缩短客户端与服务器的物理距离，直接降低延迟
让负载均衡组件从此变得完全不需要
why: 地理分片 = 按地区把「不同用户的不同数据+服务」放到就近的区域机房。附带收益：用户就近访问、物理距离短 → 往返时延 RTT 直接降。扩容 + 降延迟一举两得。
why_en: Geo-sharding partitions different users' data into nearby regional data centers, so besides adding capacity it lowers latency — clients are physically closer (lower RTT). Unlike a CDN, which replicates identical read-only content everywhere, geo-sharding splits distinct data by region.
options_en: It eliminates every need for cross-region data replication.
It turns every query into a pure in-memory lookup.
It shortens the physical distance between clients and servers, directly cutting latency.
It makes load balancing components entirely unnecessary.

termDefinitions.meaning: 地理分片：按用户地区把数据+服务分到就近的区域机房
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Geo-sharding partitions data and services into regional data centers close to their users.

termDefinitions.meaning: 内容分发网络：把同一份静态只读内容缓存到各地边缘节点
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A CDN caches the same read-only static content at edge nodes worldwide.

termDefinitions.meaning: 往返时延：请求到达再返回的总时间，主要受物理距离影响
termDefinitions.meaningEn: RTT is the round-trip time of a request, dominated by physical distance.

optionExplanations: 地理分片不会消除所有跨区复制需求，某些全局数据仍可能需要跨区同步。
地理分片改变的是数据放在哪个机房，不会把磁盘查询变成纯内存查询。
对，用户就近访问同区域机房，物理距离缩短直接降低往返时延，扩容和降延迟一举两得。
负载均衡在分片后依然需要，只是均衡的范围缩小到区域内，不会被彻底取消。
optionExplanations_en: Geo sharding doesn't eliminate all cross-region replication — some genuinely global data may still need to sync across regions.
Geo sharding changes which data center holds the data; it doesn't turn disk queries into pure in-memory ones.
Right, users hit a nearby regional data center, and the shorter physical distance directly cuts round-trip latency — scaling and lower latency in one move.
Load balancing is still needed after sharding, just scoped within a region — it isn't eliminated altogether.

scenario: 地理分片后，绝大多数就近查询只落在一个分片内即可完成。
scenario_en: After geographic sharding, most nearby-driver queries can be answered inside one shard.
q: 地理分片后，什么时候才需要跨分片的 scatter-gather 查询？
q_en: After geographic sharding, when do you need cross-shard scatter-gather queries?
options: 每次算费用预估时都需要
每次司机上线或下线切换状态时都需要触发一次
系统里的所有写操作都需要
当就近搜索落在分片边界上、搜索半径覆盖多个分片时
why: scatter-gather = 一个查询单片答不完，要「撒(scatter)」到多个分片各算一部分、再「聚(gather)」合并结果——慢(等最慢的分片 + 合并)。地理分片后绝大多数就近查询只落一个分片，省掉了 scatter-gather；只有搜索半径跨分片边界时才需要扇出多片再合并。
why_en: Scatter-gather fans a query out to many shards for partial results and merges them — slow. Geo-sharding keeps most proximity searches inside one shard; you only scatter-gather when a search radius crosses a shard boundary.
options_en: It's needed every time a fare estimate is computed.
It's needed every single time a driver toggles online or offline status.
It's needed for every write operation in the system.
It's needed when a proximity search sits near a shard boundary and its radius spans multiple shards.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把一次查询同时发给多个分片、再合并各分片结果的查询模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Scatter-gather is a query pattern that fans a request out to multiple shards and merges their results.

diagram:
flowchart LR
  Q1["就近查询·市中心"] --> S1["分片A 单片完成 ✓"]
  Q2["查询在分片边界·半径跨片"] --> G["scatter：发给 A+B+C"]
  G --> M["gather：合并结果"]
optionExplanations: 算费用预估通常只涉及本区域的路线数据，不需要跨分片扇出查询。
司机上线切换状态是单个司机的写操作，落在它所在的那一个分片里就够了。
写操作本身不需要跨分片聚合结果，那是查询侧才有的扇出合并逻辑。
对，只有搜索半径覆盖多个分片边界时，才需要向多个分片扇出查询再合并结果。
optionExplanations_en: Fare estimation usually only touches route data within one region, no cross-shard fan-out required.
A driver toggling status is a single-driver write that lands in whichever one shard they belong to.
Writes don't need cross-shard result aggregation — that fan-out-and-merge logic only applies to reads.
Right, only when the search radius spans multiple shard boundaries does the query need to fan out to several shards and merge results.

scenario: 分片系统需要同时解决数据均匀分布和节点增减时的重平衡问题。
scenario_en: A sharded system must solve both even data distribution and rebalancing when nodes are added or removed.
q: 分片系统里怎么处理数据均匀分布和故障重平衡？
q_en: How should a sharded system handle even distribution and failure rebalancing?
options: 用一致性哈希分布数据，配合跨服务器复制策略保证容错与高可用
所有写入都按轮询方式依次轮流写入每一个分片节点
按数据插入的先后顺序取模决定分片
节点增减时全部靠人工手动迁移数据
why: 一致性哈希让节点增减时只迁移少量数据、分布均匀；复制策略保证单分片故障不丢数据、服务不中断。
why_en: Consistent hashing distributes data evenly and eases rebalancing, while replication across servers preserves fault tolerance and availability.
options_en: Use consistent hashing to distribute data, paired with cross-server replication for fault tolerance and availability.
Every write goes round-robin, taking turns landing on each shard node in sequence.
Shard by taking the insertion order modulo the shard count.
Manually migrate data by hand whenever nodes are added or removed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 节点增减时只需重新映射一小部分数据的哈希分片方式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Consistent hashing is a sharding scheme where adding or removing a node only remaps a small fraction of the data.

optionExplanations: 对，一致性哈希让节点增减时只需迁移少量数据并保持均匀分布，复制策略再保证单分片故障不丢数据。
按轮询写入并不保证数据分布均匀，也没有解决节点变化时怎么重新分配数据的问题。
按插入顺序取模在节点数变化时会导致几乎所有数据的映射都要重算，迁移量极大。
完全靠人工迁移在这个规模下既慢又容易出错，不具备可持续的扩展性。
optionExplanations_en: Right, consistent hashing keeps distribution even and only moves a small slice of data when nodes join or leave, while replication keeps a single shard's failure from losing data or interrupting service.
Round-robin writes don't guarantee even distribution and don't address how to reassign data when nodes change.
Modulo by insertion order forces nearly every key's mapping to be recomputed whenever the node count changes, causing massive migration.
Relying entirely on manual migration is slow and error-prone at this scale — it isn't a sustainable way to scale.

scenario: 面试官按候选人级别设定不同的通过标准，这是 Uber 这道题对中级（E4）候选人的达标线。
scenario_en: Interviewers set different bars by candidate level; this is the Uber problem's bar for an intermediate E4 candidate.
q: Uber 题对中级（E4）候选人的达标线是什么？
q_en: What is the passing bar for an intermediate E4 candidate on the Uber problem?
options: 必须在现场深入讲透 3 个以上的深挖话题才行，浅尝辄止的讲法完全不算合格
清晰定义 API 与数据模型，给出满足需求的高层设计，意识到位置查询需要空间索引（不必定方案），至少给出锁问题的 good 方案
要求候选人必须现场完完全全从零手写出一份完整、可以真实编译并成功稳定运行起来的 quad-tree 空间索引实现代码
要求候选人准确背出 DynamoDB 官网定价页面上写着的具体数字
why: E4 重广度（约 80/20）：功能完备的高层设计加知道位置查询需要某种空间索引加至少 DB 状态锁级别的方案即可达标。
why_en: A mid-level candidate needs clear APIs and data model, a working high-level design, awareness that a spatial index is needed, and at least the good locking solution.
options_en: Must thoroughly deep-dive on three or more topics live on the spot; a shallow treatment doesn't count as passing at all.
Clearly define the API and data model, produce a working high-level design, recognize that location queries need a spatial index, and give at least the good locking solution.
Requires the candidate to hand-write, completely from scratch on the spot, a complete quad-tree spatial index implementation that genuinely compiles and runs successfully and stably.
The candidate must accurately recite the exact numbers printed on DynamoDB's official pricing page.
optionExplanations: E4 更看重广度而不是现场深挖三个以上话题，深挖数量不是这一级别的达标线。
对，清晰的 API 与数据模型、功能完备的高层设计、知道位置查询要用空间索引、至少给出锁的 good 方案，这些凑齐就够 E4 达标。
现场手写完整可跑的 quad-tree 实现超出了这一级别的期望，意识到需要空间索引就够。
背出具体定价数字不是考察点，E4 需要的是设计判断力而不是记忆力。
optionExplanations_en: E4 is weighted toward breadth, not live-deep-diving three or more topics — depth count isn't the bar at this level.
Right, a clear API and data model, a functionally complete high-level design, awareness that location queries need some spatial index, and at least a good lock solution together clear the E4 bar.
Hand-writing a complete, runnable quad-tree implementation live is beyond this level's expectations — just recognizing the need for a spatial index is enough.
Reciting exact pricing numbers isn't what's being assessed — E4 needs design judgment, not memorization.

scenario: 这是 Uber 这道题对高级（E5）候选人的达标线。
scenario_en: This is the Uber problem's bar for a senior E5 candidate.
q: 高级（E5）候选人的达标线是什么？
q_en: What is the passing bar for a senior E5 candidate?
options: 只要能大致画完一版高层设计草图，细节全部略过也算合格
要求候选人必须一字不差地背出所有 Redis 命令的完整参数列表和具体使用方法才算合格
快速过完高层设计，深入讨论至少 2 个深挖，并能讲清各架构选择对扩展性、性能、可维护性的利弊
要求候选人当场独立发明出一套全新的匹配排序算法
why: E5 约 60/40 广深比：高层设计要快，把时间花在至少 2 个深挖的细节与权衡上；面试官适度提示是可以接受的。
why_en: A senior candidate should speed through the high-level design and discuss at least two deep dives in detail with clear architectural trade-offs.
options_en: Just roughly sketching a version of the high-level design and skipping every detail counts as passing.
Requires the candidate to recite, word for word without a single mistake, the full parameter list and exact usage method of every Redis command to pass.
Speed through the high-level design and dive deep into at least two topics with clear trade-offs on scalability, performance, and maintainability.
The candidate must independently invent an entirely new matching-ranking algorithm on the spot.
optionExplanations: 只画个大致草图、细节全略过达不到 E5 要求的深度，广度够但深度不够。
背出所有 Redis 命令参数不是重点，E5 考的是能不能把架构选择的利弊讲清楚。
对，高层设计要快速过完，把时间留给至少 2 个深挖话题，讲清各选择对扩展性、性能、可维护性的取舍。
现场独立发明全新排序算法超出预期，E5 允许基于已知方案做合理取舍，不要求从零创新。
optionExplanations_en: A rough sketch with all details skipped falls short of E5's depth bar — breadth alone isn't enough.
Reciting every Redis command's parameters isn't the point — E5 tests whether you can articulate the tradeoffs behind architecture choices.
Right, race through the high-level design and spend the saved time on at least two deep dives that spell out the tradeoffs on scalability, performance, and maintainability.
Independently inventing a brand-new ranking algorithm on the spot is beyond expectations — E5 allows reasoned tradeoffs on known approaches, not from-scratch invention.

scenario: 这是 Uber 这道题对 Staff+ 候选人的显著标志。
scenario_en: This is the Uber problem's clear signal for a Staff+ candidate.
q: Staff+ 候选人的显著标志是什么？
q_en: What is the clear signal of a Staff+ candidate?
options: 约 40/60 广深比：主动深入 3 个以上关键领域，用实战经验支撑方案，最好让面试官也学到新东西
把全部 45 分钟的宝贵时间都完完整整地花在画一张极其精细复杂的整体组件架构图上面去了，别的都不做
全程被动地等待面试官指路，自己完全不主动向前推进任何设计工作
把文章里介绍的全部方案逐字逐句一字不差地原样背诵出来
why: Staff+ 期待极高的主动性与深度：自己发现问题、给出经过实战检验的方案；面试官只聚焦不引路，聊完还有所收获是最好的信号。
why_en: A staff-plus candidate proactively dives deep into three or more areas with practical insight, ideally teaching the interviewer something new.
options_en: Roughly a forty-sixty breadth-to-depth ratio: proactively going deep on three or more areas with practical experience, ideally teaching the interviewer something new.
Spend the entire precious forty-five minutes completely drawing just one extremely detailed, intricate overall component architecture diagram, and nothing else.
Passively wait to be guided by the interviewer the whole time, never proactively pushing the design forward at all.
Recite every solution described in the article word for word, verbatim.
optionExplanations: 对，约 40/60 广深比，主动深入 3 个以上关键领域并用实战经验支撑方案，最好还能让面试官学到新东西。
把 45 分钟全花在一张极其精细的架构图上等于牺牲了深挖的时间，广度都保不住。
全程被动等指路恰恰是 Staff+ 最忌讳的信号，这个级别期待候选人自己发现问题。
逐字背诵文章方案说明没有自己的判断和取舍，体现不出实战经验支撑的深度。
optionExplanations_en: Right, roughly a 40/60 breadth-to-depth ratio, proactively going deep on three or more key areas with battle-tested reasoning — ideally teaching the interviewer something new.
Spending all 45 minutes on one hyper-detailed diagram sacrifices depth time and even breadth suffers.
Passively waiting to be guided the whole time is exactly the red flag Staff+ interviewers watch for — this level expects candidates to surface problems themselves.
Reciting an article's solution verbatim shows no independent judgment or tradeoff reasoning, missing the depth that real experience provides.

q: 这个 Web Crawler 题的核心目标最准确地说是什么？
options: 从种子 URL 出发抓取网页、抽取文本并保存给后续训练使用
实时渲染所有 JavaScript 页面并抓取图片视频
为网站管理员提供可视化爬虫管理后台
构建一个能搜索和排序网页的完整搜索引擎
why: 目标收敛到为 LLM 训练收集网页文本，而不是做搜索排名、动态渲染或非文本处理。面试重点是抓取、抽取、存储和扩展。
why_en: The design is scoped to crawl from seed URLs, extract page text, and store it for later LLM training rather than building a full search engine.
scenario: 面试官要求设计一个为 LLM 训练收集网页文本的抓取系统（类似 OpenAI/Google 的训练数据管线），而不是搜索引擎或问答产品。
options_en: Crawl from seed URLs, extract page text, and store it for later training.
Render every page's JavaScript live and capture images and video.
Give website admins a dashboard to manage crawler behavior.
Build a full search engine that indexes and ranks web pages.
q_en: What is the core goal of this web crawler design?
scenario_en: The interviewer asks for a crawler that collects web text for LLM training, like an OpenAI or Google training-data pipeline, not a search engine or QA product.
optionExplanations: 这正是本题范围：抓取网页、抽文本、存起来供 LLM 训练用。
渲染 JS 和抓图片视频属于另一类爬虫，这道题不做实时渲染。
管理后台是运维工具，不是要设计的抓取、抽取、存储主链路。
搜索引擎还要做排序和查询服务，这道题只到产出训练文本为止。
optionExplanations_en: This is exactly the scope: crawl pages, extract text, and store it for LLM training.
Rendering JS live and pulling images or video belongs to a different crawler, not this text-only design.
An admin dashboard is an ops tool, not part of the crawl/extract/store pipeline in question.
A search engine also needs ranking and query serving; this design stops at producing training text.

q: Web Crawler 的核心功能需求包括哪些？（多选）
options: 从给定种子 URL 开始遍历网页
抽取每个网页的文本并存储
训练最终的大语言模型
处理登录后才能看到的页面
why: 本题只覆盖抓取和文本落库；训练模型、鉴权页面、动态内容、图片视频都被放到范围外。先明确范围能防止设计发散。
why_en: The core functions are crawling from seed URLs and storing extracted text, while model training and authenticated or dynamic content are out of scope.
options_en: Traverse the web starting from given seed URLs.
Extract each page's text and store it.
Train the final large language model.
Handle pages that require logging in.
q_en: Which functions are core requirements for this web crawler? (Select all that apply)
optionExplanations: 这条确立了系统入口：从种子集合出发做广度遍历，覆盖新链接。
这是系统唯一的产出动作：把网页转成文本，落到存储供后续读取。
训练模型是下游消费方的工作，这道题只交付文本，不训练模型。
登录态页面需要额外鉴权和会话管理，这道题范围只覆盖公开静态页面。
optionExplanations_en: This defines the entry point: traverse the web breadth-first from the seed set.
This is the crawler's only output action: turn pages into text and persist it for later reads.
Training the model is a downstream consumer's job; this design only delivers text.
Login-gated pages need extra auth and session handling, outside this crawler's public-page scope.

scenario: 这个爬虫的主线是收集公开静态网页文本，供后续 LLM 训练数据管线使用。
scenario_en: This crawler is scoped to collect public static web text for a later LLM training-data pipeline.
q: 这个 LLM 文本爬虫明确放到范围外的事项有哪些？（多选）
options: 处理非文本数据，如图片和视频
处理 JavaScript 渲染出的动态内容
处理需要登录的页面
记录每个 URL 的抓取状态
why: 非文本、动态内容、认证页面都不在核心设计里；URL 状态记录反而是后续容错和去重需要的内部状态。范围外不代表不能扩展，只是主线不展开。
why_en: Non-text media, JavaScript-rendered content, and authenticated pages are explicitly out of scope, while URL state tracking remains part of the crawler design.
options_en: Handling non-text data such as images and video.
Handling dynamic content rendered by JavaScript.
Handling pages that require a login.
Tracking each URL's crawl status.
q_en: Which items are explicitly out of scope for this LLM text crawler? (Select all that apply)
optionExplanations: 图片视频属于非文本媒体，这条 LLM 文本管线不处理，只处理可抽取的文本。
JS 渲染出的动态内容需要额外的浏览器执行环境，主线只抓静态 HTML。
登录页面需要维护会话和凭证，这条主线只覆盖公开可抓的页面。
URL 抓取状态是内部去重和容错必需的元数据，反而要保留，不是被排除的功能。
optionExplanations_en: Images and video are non-text media this LLM text pipeline never processes.
JS-rendered dynamic content needs a browser execution environment; the main line only fetches static HTML.
Login-gated pages require session and credential handling, outside this public-page pipeline.
URL crawl-state tracking is internal metadata needed for dedup and fault tolerance, so it stays in scope.

q: 这个 LLM 文本爬虫的核心非功能需求包括哪些？（多选）
options: 故障后能恢复且不丢进度
遵守 robots.txt 并避免压垮站点
5 天内完成大规模抓取
强一致地更新网页排名
why: 非功能主线是容错、礼貌、效率和可扩展到 10B 页面；网页排名不在这个 LLM 文本抓取题的主目标里。后续深挖都围绕这些约束展开。
why_en: The important nonfunctional requirements are fault tolerance, politeness, five-day completion, and scale to ten billion pages.
scenario: 该系统要为 LLM 训练抓取约 10B 网页文本，业务方要求 5 天内可用，并且不能对被抓取网站造成过大压力。
options_en: Recover from failures without losing progress.
Respect robots.txt and avoid overloading sites.
Finish the large-scale crawl within five days.
Keep page-rank scores strongly consistent.
q_en: Which nonfunctional requirements matter most for this LLM text crawler? (Select all that apply)
scenario_en: The crawler needs to collect about 10 billion web pages for LLM training within five days without overloading the sites it visits.
optionExplanations: 抓取要跑很久，Worker 崩溃是常态；这条要求保证进度不会归零。
礼貌抓取避免把目标站点打垮，也是不被封禁的前提。
5 天完成 10B 页面是硬性时间预算，直接决定后面要并行多少台机器。
网页排名一致性是搜索引擎才关心的问题，这道 LLM 文本抓取题不做排名。
optionExplanations_en: The crawl runs for days and workers will crash, so this guarantees progress survives failures.
Polite crawling keeps target sites from being overwhelmed, and keeps the crawler from getting blocked.
Finishing 10B pages in five days is a hard time budget that drives the fleet-size math later.
Page-rank consistency is a search engine's concern; this crawl never computes rankings.

q: 这组体量假设最直接决定了后续设计的哪个环节？
options: 决定了 Metadata DB 该选关系型还是文档型
决定了需要多少台抓取机器和总带宽预算
决定了要不要给每个域名设置速率限制
决定了文本抽取该用哪种 NLP 模型
why: 10B 页面和 2MB/页是后续带宽和机器数估算的输入锚点，不是要背的孤立数字。
why_en: The page count and average page size are the anchor inputs for bandwidth and fleet-size math, not facts to memorize on their own.
scenario: 面试官给出规模假设：网页总量约 10B，平均每页传输体量约 2MB（HTML 本身更小，但要给内联资源和规划余量）。
options_en: It determines whether the metadata store should be relational or document-based.
It determines how much bandwidth and how many crawler machines you need.
It determines whether to rate-limit each domain.
It determines which NLP model to use for text extraction.
q_en: Which later design decision is most directly driven by these scale assumptions?
scenario_en: The interviewer gives a scale assumption: about 10 billion pages, with roughly 2 MB transferred per page to leave room for embedded resources and planning margin.
optionExplanations: 数据库选型看的是查询模式和一致性需求，不是页面总量或单页体量。
页面数乘单页体量换算成总传输量，是估算机器数和带宽预算的输入。
域名限速取决于礼貌策略，不取决于总页面数或单页大小。
NLP 模型选择看内容语言和抽取质量要求，跟这组体量数字无关。
optionExplanations_en: Database choice hinges on query patterns and consistency needs, not total page count or size.
Page count times average page size converts into total transfer volume, the input to fleet sizing.
Per-domain rate limiting comes from politeness policy, not from total page count or size.
NLP model choice depends on content language and extraction quality, unrelated to these scale numbers.

q: 补全这个数据处理系统的输入和输出：
text: 输入是{{种子 URL}}；输出是从网页中抽取并保存的{{文本数据}}。
why: 非用户交互系统先定义边界很有用：系统接收什么、产出什么。这里边界非常清楚，后续组件只是在这条数据流上扩展。
why_en: For this data-processing system, the input is seed URLs and the output is extracted text data stored for later use.
q_en: Fill in the input and output of this data-processing system:

q: 把基础 Web Crawler 的数据流排成正确顺序。
steps: 抽取文本并把文本存入对象存储
从 Frontier 取出下一个 URL
解析页面里的新链接并加入待抓取集合
通过 DNS 解析域名到 IP
向外部网页服务器拉取 HTML
why: 先拿 URL，再解析域名并抓取 HTML；拿到页面后才抽取文本和新链接。这个朴素流程后续会被拆成更可靠的流水线。
why_en: The crawler takes a URL, resolves DNS, fetches HTML, extracts and stores text, then enqueues newly discovered links.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  A[Frontier URL] --> B[DNS]
  B --> C[Fetch HTML]
  C --> D[Extract text]
  C --> E[Extract links]
  E --> A
  D --> F[S3 text]
q_en: Put the basic web crawler data flow in the correct order.

q: 高层设计里哪些组件属于核心路径？（多选）
options: Frontier Queue
Crawler
DNS
S3 文本存储
广告投放服务
why: Frontier 管待抓 URL，Crawler 拉取和解析，DNS 支持访问外部站点，S3 存文本输出。广告投放与这个离线抓取系统无关。
why_en: The basic path uses a frontier queue, crawler workers, DNS, and blob storage for text output.
options_en: Frontier queue of URLs waiting to be crawled.
The crawler that fetches and parses pages.
DNS resolution for external domains.
S3 storage for extracted text.
An ad-serving service.
q_en: Which components belong on the core high-level path? (Select all that apply)
optionExplanations: Frontier 保存待抓 URL 队列，是驱动整个抓取循环的起点。
Crawler 负责实际发请求、拉页面、解析出文本和新链接。
DNS 把域名解析成 IP，没有它 Crawler 连不上外部站点。
S3 承接抽取出的文本产出，是这条流水线的终点存储。
广告投放服务属于变现系统，跟离线抓取管线没有依赖关系。
optionExplanations_en: The frontier holds the queue of URLs waiting to crawl and drives the whole fetch loop.
The crawler issues requests, fetches pages, and parses out text and new links.
DNS resolves domain names to IPs; without it the crawler can't reach any external site.
S3 receives the extracted text output, the terminal storage of this pipeline.
Ad serving belongs to a monetization system with no dependency on this offline crawl pipeline.

scenario: 爬虫要保存海量网页文本供后续批处理和训练读取，数据体量巨大，访问模式是对象级读写，不需要关系型事务。
q: 文本数据最适合存到哪里？
options: 存进 Redis 字符串缓存
只留在爬虫本机磁盘
对象存储（S3 / GCS 等 Blob 服务）
直接写进 Frontier 队列消息体
why: 抽取后的文本是大规模 blob 数据，适合便宜、持久、可扩展的对象存储；队列只传引用，不能承载大 payload。数据库或缓存只保元数据更合理。
why_en: Extracted text is large blob data, so object storage is the right durable and scalable target while queues should carry only references.
whenOtherWins: 如果是少量结构化查询字段，放关系型或 NoSQL 表更方便；如果是短期热点小对象，缓存可以作为读取加速层。
tradeoff: 对象存储的持久与低成本 vs 队列/缓存的即时但脆弱访问
options_en: Store it as a Redis string.
Keep it only on the crawler's local disk.
Object storage such as S3 or GCS.
Write it straight into the Frontier queue message.
q_en: Where should the extracted text data be stored?
scenario_en: The crawler must store massive extracted text for later batch processing and training reads; access is object-level and does not need relational transactions.
optionExplanations: Redis 更适合毫秒级热点小对象缓存，海量长期文本会把内存成本推得很高。
本机磁盘只在单机、可丢弃场景下够用，Worker 重建或迁移时数据就没了。
文本体量大、访问是对象级读写、不需要事务，这正是对象存储该出场的场景。
队列消息应保持轻量用于调度，大 payload 会拖慢投递和消费。
optionExplanations_en: Redis fits millisecond hot-object caching, but holding massive long-lived text there gets expensive fast.
Local disk only works for single-machine disposable data — it's gone when a worker is rebuilt or moved.
Large text volume, object-level access, and no transaction needs is exactly when object storage fits.
Queue messages should stay lightweight for scheduling; a large payload slows delivery down.

q: 面试中追问种子 URL 的来源，主要体现了什么设计意识？
options: 它能让 DNS 缓存完全失效
它把文本抽取改成实时查询问题
它证明不需要 Frontier Queue
它明确系统启动边界，避免默认全网可达
why: 几乎所有爬虫都从有限种子集合启动，且不可能覆盖全网。问清楚种子来源是在确认系统输入，而不是假设能自动发现所有页面。
why_en: Clarifying seed URLs defines the system's starting boundary and avoids pretending the crawler can discover the entire web from nothing.
options_en: It makes DNS caching completely ineffective.
It turns text extraction into a real-time query problem.
It proves the Frontier Queue is unnecessary.
It clarifies the system's starting boundary instead of assuming full web reachability.
q_en: What design awareness does asking about seed URL sources show?
optionExplanations: 种子 URL 来源和 DNS 缓存命中率没有因果关系。
文本抽取是抓到页面之后的离线处理，不会因为问种子来源就变成实时查询。
Frontier 依然要保存待抓 URL，问种子来源不影响它是否存在。
问清种子来自哪里，是在确认系统从哪个有限集合起步，而非假设能发现全网。
optionExplanations_en: Seed URL provenance has no causal link to DNS cache hit rate.
Text extraction is offline processing after a fetch; asking about seeds doesn't make it real-time.
The frontier still holds pending URLs regardless of where the seeds came from.
Asking where seeds come from confirms the crawler starts from a finite set, not an assumed full web.

scenario: 单个 Crawler 同时负责 DNS、抓 HTML、抽文本、抽链接；任何一步失败都会让整条 URL 处理进度变得不清晰。
q: 提升容错性的首要改造是什么？
options: 拆成 Fetcher、Extraction 两阶段流水线
只增加更多线程数量，但不改变任务边界划分
把原始 HTML 完整内容直接放进队列消息体里
把所有处理步骤都塞进一个更大的单体进程里
why: 流水线把失败隔离在单个阶段，可以重试抓取或解析而不重做其他工作，也能按瓶颈独立扩缩容。它是数据处理题常见的第一层可靠性改造。
why_en: Splitting the crawler into pipeline stages isolates failures, enables stage-level retries, and lets each stage scale independently.
whenOtherWins: 如果流量极小且失败代价低，一个简单单进程实现足够；但 10B 页面和 5 天期限下，阶段边界更重要。
tradeoff: 阶段隔离便于重试和独立扩容 vs 单体实现更简单
options_en: Split into Fetcher and Extraction pipeline stages.
Just add more worker threads without changing any task boundaries.
Put the entire raw HTML content directly inside the queue message.
Cram every processing step into one larger monolithic process.
q_en: What is the first change to improve fault tolerance?
scenario_en: One crawler process handles DNS, HTML fetch, text extraction, and link extraction; if any step fails, the URL's progress becomes ambiguous.
optionExplanations: 把网络抓取和 HTML 解析拆成两阶段，失败互不牵连，各自能独立重试扩容。
只加线程不改变任务边界，一步失败还是会搞乱整条 URL 的处理状态。
把原始 HTML 塞进消息体是加大 payload，队列更不稳定，不是容错改造。
塞进一个更大单体只会让失败面更集中，跟目标方向正好相反。
optionExplanations_en: Splitting fetch and extraction into stages isolates failures so each can retry and scale on its own.
Adding threads without changing task boundaries still lets one failing step wreck the whole URL's state.
Cramming raw HTML into the message just grows the payload and destabilizes the queue further.
Cramming everything into one bigger monolith concentrates the failure surface, the opposite of the goal.

q: URL Fetcher 和 Text/URL Extraction 的关键职责区别是什么？
options: Fetcher 负责解析链接，Extraction 负责访问 DNS
Fetcher 存原始 HTML，Extraction 从中产出文本和新 URL
Fetcher 负责更新模型参数，Extraction 负责训练模型
Fetcher 负责做去重，Extraction 负责管队列可见性
why: Fetcher 处理最容易失败的网络抓取并保存原始 HTML；Extraction 处理已经落库的 HTML，输出文本和链接。这个边界让抓取和解析可以分别重试。
why_en: The fetcher retrieves and stores raw HTML, while extraction workers read that HTML to produce text and discovered URLs.
tradeoff: 抓取失败隔离 vs 解析失败隔离——两个阶段各自的重试边界
options_en: The fetcher is responsible for parsing links, while extraction is responsible for talking to DNS.
The fetcher stores raw HTML; extraction turns it into text and new URLs.
The fetcher is responsible for updating model weights, while extraction is responsible for training the model.
The fetcher is responsible for deduplicating, while extraction is responsible for managing queue visibility.
q_en: What is the key responsibility split between the URL Fetcher and Text/URL Extraction?
optionExplanations: Fetcher 不解析链接，DNS 查询发生在抓取之前，不是 Extraction 的职责。
Fetcher 存原始 HTML，Extraction 读 HTML 产出文本和新链接。
模型训练不在这个爬虫流水线里，两个阶段都不碰模型参数。
去重和队列可见性是 Metadata DB 和队列服务的职责，不是这两阶段的划分依据。
optionExplanations_en: The fetcher doesn't parse links; DNS lookups happen before fetching, not inside extraction.
Fetcher stores raw HTML; extraction reads it to produce text and new URLs.
Model training isn't part of this pipeline; neither stage touches model weights.
Dedup and queue visibility belong to the metadata store and queue service, not this stage split.

scenario: 队列需要传递待处理 URL，但每个 URL 还要记录抓取状态、HTML 对象地址、文本对象地址、失败次数和深度等元数据。
q: Web Crawler 应该新增什么组件承载这些 URL 状态？
options: 让每个 Worker 用本地文件记录状态
只依赖浏览器缓存
Metadata DB，队列消息只放 URL 记录 id
把完整 HTML 和状态都塞进 SQS 消息
why: Metadata DB 保存可查询、可更新的 URL 状态和对象存储引用；队列负责调度，不适合大 payload 或复杂状态。DynamoDB、Postgres、MySQL 都可讨论。
why_en: A metadata database should hold URL state and blob references while the queue carries only lightweight identifiers for scheduling.
whenOtherWins: 如果只是临时小任务且不需要恢复，消息体可以带完整上下文；这里的规模和容错要求需要持久元数据。
diagram:
flowchart LR
Seeds[Seed URLs] --> Frontier[URL Frontier]
Frontier --> State[(URL state DB)]
Frontier --> Queue[Fetch queue]
Queue --> Fetcher[Fetcher workers]
tradeoff: 持久可查询的元数据存储 vs 把状态硬塞进队列消息
options_en: Have each worker keep state in a local file.
Rely only on the browser cache.
A Metadata DB, with the queue message carrying only the URL record id.
Stuff the full HTML and all state into the SQS message.
q_en: What component should the web crawler add to hold URL state?
scenario_en: The queue needs to pass URLs to process, but each URL also needs metadata such as crawl status, HTML object location, text object location, failure count, and depth.
optionExplanations: 本地文件只有那台机器能看到，别的 Worker 查不到某个 URL 的最新状态。
浏览器缓存服务的是终端用户，这条抓取管线里没有浏览器会话。
状态和大对象引用放进可查询的数据库，队列只传一个轻量 id 做调度。
把完整 HTML 塞进消息体会让队列超载，也让状态和调度耦合在一起。
optionExplanations_en: A local file is visible only to that one machine; other workers can't see a URL's current state.
Browser caching serves end users; there's no browser session in this crawl pipeline.
State and blob references live in a queryable database while the queue carries just a lightweight id.
Stuffing full HTML into the message overloads the queue and couples state with scheduling.

numberAnchors.risk: 单主写瓶颈、索引/事务变重
AWS 管扩展，但 hot key 仍会限流

q: 为什么不应该把原始 HTML 直接放进 Frontier 或处理队列消息里？
options: 这样做会让 DNS 解析明显变慢
这样做会导致 robots.txt 无法被正确解析
队列消息根本不允许携带任何字符串
队列不适合大 payload，应传对象存储引用而非内容本身
why: 队列适合传小消息和调度信号，不适合承载大量 HTML 内容。把 HTML 放对象存储、在消息里传 metadata id 或 URL 引用更稳。
why_en: Queues are optimized for lightweight scheduling messages, not large HTML payloads, so workers should pass blob references instead.
options_en: It would make DNS resolution noticeably slower.
It would prevent robots.txt from being parsed correctly.
A queue cannot store any string at all.
Queues are not built for large payloads; pass an object-storage reference instead.
q_en: Why should raw HTML not be placed directly in the Frontier or processing queue messages?
optionExplanations: HTML 大小和 DNS 解析速度没有关系，DNS 只查域名对应的 IP。
robots.txt 是单独抓取解析的文件，跟队列消息里放不放 HTML 无关。
队列消息可以携带字符串，只是不适合携带很大的 payload。
队列为轻量调度信号设计，大 HTML 应存对象存储，消息只带引用。
optionExplanations_en: HTML size has nothing to do with DNS resolution speed; DNS just looks up the IP for a domain.
robots.txt is fetched and parsed separately, unrelated to what the queue message carries.
Queue messages can carry strings fine; the issue is a very large payload, not any string at all.
Queues are built for lightweight scheduling signals; large HTML belongs in object storage, referenced.

q: 保存原始 HTML 对后续需求变化有什么直接好处？
options: 可以更换抽取逻辑而不必重新抓取网页
可以跳过所有 URL 去重
可以让每个域名每秒抓取无限次
可以避免对象存储
why: 原始 HTML 是昂贵网络抓取的结果；保存它后，抽取规则变化时只需重跑解析阶段。比如新增图片 alt 文本，不必重新抓整个网页。
why_en: Keeping raw HTML lets the team rerun extraction logic for new requirements without repeating the expensive external fetch.
options_en: You can swap the extraction logic without re-fetching the page.
You can skip all URL deduplication.
You can crawl a domain unlimited times per second.
You can avoid using object storage.
q_en: What direct benefit does keeping raw HTML give when extraction requirements change later?
optionExplanations: 留着原始 HTML，抽取规则变了只需重跑解析，不用重新抓一次网页。
去重靠的是 Metadata DB 记录和内容哈希，跟留不留原始 HTML 无关。
礼貌限速看的是抓取请求本身，留不留原始 HTML 不会改变这个约束。
原始 HTML 恰恰还是要存进对象存储，这个说法和留 HTML 的目的相反。
optionExplanations_en: Keeping raw HTML means you can rerun extraction when rules change, without hitting the site again.
Dedup relies on metadata records and content hashes, unrelated to whether raw HTML is kept.
Politeness limits govern the fetch requests themselves; keeping raw HTML doesn't change that.
Raw HTML is exactly what still needs to land in object storage, the opposite of avoiding it.

q: 抓取失败后只在 Worker 内存里 sleep 几秒再试，主要问题是什么？
options: 会让 S3 存储账单明显变贵
Worker 崩溃会丢失重试计时，短暂重试往往也没用
会强制所有抓取请求变成同步执行
会导致 robots.txt 完全无法下载
why: 内存定时器不持久，Worker 掉线后重试计划消失。抓取失败常常需要指数退避，而不是盲等几秒。
why_en: An in-memory retry timer is not durable, so a worker crash loses the retry plan and a short fixed delay is usually too naive.
options_en: It would make S3 storage noticeably more expensive.
A worker crash loses the retry timer, and a short fixed delay rarely helps anyway.
It would force every fetch request to become synchronous.
It would prevent robots.txt from ever being downloaded.
q_en: What is the main problem with sleeping in worker memory before retrying a failed fetch?
optionExplanations: 内存里的 sleep 计时器跟 S3 账单毫无关系。
计时器只活在内存里，Worker 崩溃就丢失重试计划；短暂固定等待往往也没用。
同步还是异步是执行模型的选择，跟要不要 sleep 重试没有必然关系。
robots.txt 依然可以正常下载，跟这个重试写法无关。
optionExplanations_en: An in-memory sleep timer has nothing to do with the S3 storage bill.
The timer lives only in memory, so a crash wipes the retry plan out — a short fixed wait rarely helps anyway.
Sync vs async execution is a separate choice, unrelated to whether you sleep before retrying.
robots.txt can still be downloaded fine; that's unrelated to this retry approach.

q: Kafka 自建重试相比 SQS 可见性超时方案的主要劣势是？
options: Kafka 完全无法记录消费 offset
Kafka 不能保留任何消息日志
Kafka 要自建失败 topic 和调度服务才能退避
Kafka 不支持多个消费者同时读取
why: Kafka 可以做，但要自己维护失败 topic、调度服务和下一次重试时间。SQS 直接给了 visibility timeout、ChangeMessageVisibility 和 DLQ 这些更贴合的原语。
why_en: Kafka can support retries with custom topics and services, but SQS provides simpler primitives for delayed retries and dead-letter handling.
scenario: 团队正在比较用 Kafka 还是 SQS 承载抓取重试，重点是失败后重新调度所需的额外基础设施。
tradeoff: SQS 内置可见性超时和 DLQ vs Kafka 需要自建重试基础设施
options_en: Kafka cannot track consumer offsets at all.
Kafka cannot retain any message log.
Kafka needs a custom failed-message topic and scheduler to implement backoff.
Kafka cannot support multiple consumers reading the same topic.

termDefinitions.meaning: 分布式消息日志系统，消费者通过 offset 追踪已处理到的位置。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Kafka is a distributed log where consumers track their position with an offset.

termDefinitions.meaning: AWS 托管消息队列，通过可见性超时和显式删除管理消息生命周期。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SQS is AWS's managed queue that manages message lifecycle with visibility timeouts and explicit deletes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 死信队列，用来存放重试多次仍失败的消息。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A dead-letter queue holds messages that have failed processing after repeated retries.

q_en: What is the main downside of building crawler retries on Kafka compared with SQS visibility timeouts?
scenario_en: The team is comparing Kafka and SQS for crawler retries, focusing on how much extra infrastructure is needed to reschedule failed fetches.
optionExplanations: Kafka 的 offset 正是由消费者自己追踪和提交的，不存在完全无法记录一说。
Kafka 靠日志天然支持长期保留消息，这不是它的短板。
SQS 内置可见性超时和 DLQ，Kafka 要自己搭失败 topic 和调度服务才能退避。
Kafka 用消费者组原生支持多个消费者并行读取，这不是它的弱点。
optionExplanations_en: Kafka consumers track and commit their own offsets — it's not true that Kafka can't record them.
Kafka's log naturally supports long retention, so that's not a real weakness.
SQS gives visibility timeouts and a DLQ out of the box; Kafka needs a custom topic and scheduler to match it.
Kafka natively supports multiple consumers via consumer groups, so that's not a weakness either.

scenario: URL 抓取失败后希望指数退避，消息不要被其他 Worker 立刻拿走；同时不能无限重试，失败多次后要隔离出来分析。
q: 最合适的队列机制组合是？
options: Redis list，Worker 进程内 sleep 重试
Kafka 单 topic，不记录失败次数
把重试计划写进本地 cron 文件
SQS：ChangeMessageVisibility + DLQ 组合
why: SQS 可以按接收次数动态延长可见性超时来实现退避，超过 maxReceiveCount 后进入 DLQ。这样重试状态由队列服务持久管理。
why_en: SQS can implement backoff by changing message visibility based on receive count and move exhausted messages to a DLQ.
whenOtherWins: 如果团队已有 Kafka 平台且能接受自建 retry scheduler，Kafka 也能做；如果任务非常小，本地重试可能足够。
diagram:
flowchart LR
Queue[SQS queue] --> Worker[Fetcher]
Worker -->|success delete| Done[Done]
Worker -->|fail no delete| Retry[Visibility timeout]
Retry --> Queue
Worker -->|too many| DLQ[Dead letter]
tradeoff: SQS 托管退避与死信 vs 自建队列机制
options_en: A Redis list with an in-process sleep for retries.
A single Kafka topic that does not track failure counts.
Write the retry schedule to a local cron file.
SQS: ChangeMessageVisibility plus a dead-letter queue.

termDefinitions.meaning: SQS 的 API，用来延长某条消息在队列里重新可见前的隐藏时间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ChangeMessageVisibility is the SQS API that extends how long a message stays hidden before becoming visible again.

termDefinitions.meaning: 消息被接收次数超过阈值后自动转入的死信队列。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A dead-letter queue automatically receives a message once it has been received too many times.

q_en: Which queue mechanism combination best fits this retry requirement?
scenario_en: After a URL fetch fails, the crawler needs exponential backoff so other workers do not grab it immediately, plus a limit that isolates repeatedly failing messages.
optionExplanations: Redis list 配内存 sleep 重试，Worker 一崩溃重试状态就没了，扛不住退避需求。
单 topic 不记录失败次数就没法判断该不该继续重试或该进死信了。
本地 cron 文件只在一台机器上可见，别的实例接手不了这个重试计划。
按接收次数动态延长可见性超时实现退避，超阈值自动进 DLQ，正是这个组合。
optionExplanations_en: A Redis list with in-process sleeps loses its retry state the moment the worker crashes.
A single topic with no failure count can't tell whether to keep retrying or dead-letter a message.
A local cron file is visible only on one machine, so no other instance can pick up that plan.
Extending visibility timeout by receive count, then auto dead-lettering past a threshold, is this combo.

q: 这个 SQS 重试上限设计的核心用意是什么？
options: 允许对暂时性故障重试，同时避免对长期失败站点无限重试
确保每个 URL 最终都会被成功抓取一次
让爬虫可以完全跳过 robots.txt 检查
把失败消息永久留在原队列里反复处理
why: 重试上限加 DLQ 把「暂时故障」和「该放弃」分开，既不会无限重试拖垮吞吐，也不会无声丢弃失败 URL。
why_en: A capped retry count paired with a DLQ separates transient failures from sites that are truly unreachable, without silently dropping work or retrying forever.
scenario: SQS 的 redrive policy 配置了 maxReceiveCount；示例策略是消息被接收 5 次仍失败后，自动移入死信队列（DLQ）。
options_en: It retries transient failures while avoiding endless retries on dead sites.
It guarantees every URL is eventually fetched successfully.
It lets the crawler skip robots.txt checks entirely.
It keeps failed messages in the original queue forever.

termDefinitions.meaning: 死信队列，存放重试多次仍失败的消息，供后续排查。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A dead-letter queue holds messages that failed processing after the retry limit is reached.

q_en: What is the main purpose of this SQS retry cap?
scenario_en: The SQS redrive policy sets maxReceiveCount; in this example, a message moves to the dead-letter queue after five failed receives.
optionExplanations: 重试上限加 DLQ 正好把暂时故障和该放弃分开处理。
重试上限恰恰承认有些 URL 会永远失败，不是保证每条都能成功。
重试次数和要不要检查 robots.txt 是两件独立的事。
达到上限后消息会被移出原队列进 DLQ，不会永远留在原地反复处理。
optionExplanations_en: A retry cap plus a DLQ is exactly what separates transient failures from URLs worth giving up on.
The cap actually admits some URLs will never succeed — it's not a guarantee every one gets fetched.
Retry count and whether to check robots.txt are two unrelated concerns.
Once the cap is hit, the message moves out to the DLQ instead of looping in the original queue.

q: SQS 中 Worker 抓取 URL 时崩溃但还没 delete message，会发生什么？
options: 消息会永久丢失
消息超时后重新可见，其他 Worker 能接手
队列会自动把 HTML 写进 S3
所有后续消息都会停止投递
why: SQS 的消息只有显式删除才算完成；Worker 崩溃时消息会在超时后重新出现。这样半处理的 URL 不会因为 Worker 死亡而丢失。
why_en: If the worker dies before deleting the SQS message, it becomes visible again after the timeout and another worker can retry it.
options_en: The message is lost permanently.
The message becomes visible again after timeout, so another worker can pick it up.
The queue automatically writes the HTML into S3.
All subsequent messages stop being delivered.
q_en: What happens in SQS if a worker crashes while fetching a URL before deleting the message?
optionExplanations: SQS 消息只有显式删除才算完成，崩溃时不会丢，只是暂时不可见。
可见性超时一到，消息重新出现在队列里，别的 Worker 就能接手重试。
写 S3 是应用逻辑要做的事，队列本身不会自动帮你落盘。
一条消息的可见性状态不会影响队列里其他消息的投递。
optionExplanations_en: An SQS message only counts as done after an explicit delete, so a crash doesn't lose it, just hides it a while.
Once the visibility timeout expires, the message reappears and another worker can pick it up.
Writing to S3 is application logic; the queue itself never auto-persists anything.
One message's visibility state has no effect on delivery of any other message.

q: Kafka 和 SQS 在「消费者失败后不丢 URL」这个维度上的共同点是什么？
options: 都不能支持多个消费者
都必须用 Redis 做 offset
都依赖消息在成功处理前不会被永久确认
都必须把 HTML 放在消息体里
why: Kafka 通过不提交 offset 保留进度，SQS 通过不删除消息并让它重新可见来重试。机制不同，但目标都是成功处理前不要确认完成。
why_en: Kafka avoids advancing offsets and SQS avoids deleting the message until processing succeeds, so both protect unfinished work.
scenario: 对比 Kafka 和 SQS 两种队列技术，在「消费者处理到一半就崩溃」这个失败场景下的共同设计原则。
tradeoff: Kafka 靠不提交 offset、SQS 靠不删除消息——机制不同，目标相同
options_en: Neither can support multiple consumers.
Both must use Redis to track offsets.
Both rely on never permanently acknowledging a message until it is fully processed.
Both require putting the HTML inside the message body.
q_en: What do Kafka and SQS have in common for not losing a URL after consumer failure?
scenario_en: Compare Kafka and SQS under the failure case where a consumer crashes halfway through processing a URL.
optionExplanations: 两者都原生支持多消费者并行处理，这不是共同点的反面。
SQS 不用 offset 概念，也不依赖 Redis 追踪进度。
Kafka 靠不提交 offset、SQS 靠不删除消息，机制不同但都不会提前确认未完成的工作。
两者的消息体都应该只放引用，不是必须塞完整 HTML。
optionExplanations_en: Both natively support multiple consumers in parallel, so that's not the shared trait here.
SQS has no offset concept at all and doesn't depend on Redis to track progress.
Kafka withholds offset commits and SQS withholds deletion — different mechanisms, same rule: never confirm early.
Both should carry just a reference in the message body, not the full HTML.

scenario: 这个爬虫需要简单的指数退避、自动死信队列、托管扩展，并且业务不需要 Kafka 日志回放的复杂能力。
q: 这个 Web Crawler 更倾向选择哪种队列？
options: Redis Pub/Sub
本地内存队列
Kafka
SQS
why: SQS 的 visibility timeout、ChangeMessageVisibility、DLQ 和托管伸缩正好贴合抓取失败重试。Kafka 不是错，只是需要更多自建机制。
why_en: SQS is favored because its visibility timeout, dead-letter queues, and managed scaling match the crawler's retry and failure semantics.
whenOtherWins: 如果需要长期事件日志、严格顺序消费或已有 Kafka 平台，Kafka 可能更合适；本题主线更看重托管重试便利性。
tradeoff: SQS 托管重试语义简单 vs Kafka 更适合长期日志和严格顺序
options_en: Redis Pub/Sub.
A local in-memory queue.
Kafka.
SQS.
q_en: Which queue is the better fit for this web crawler?
scenario_en: This crawler needs simple exponential backoff, automatic dead-lettering, and managed scaling, but it does not need Kafka-style log replay.
optionExplanations: Pub/Sub 没有持久化，Worker 断线期间的消息直接丢失，不适合需要重试保证的抓取。
内存队列锁在单进程里，别的 Worker 或重启后完全看不到这些待抓 URL。
Kafka 能做，但要自己搭失败 topic、调度服务和退避逻辑，运维成本更高。
可见性超时、DLQ、托管伸缩正好对上抓取失败重试和不需要日志回放这两点。
optionExplanations_en: Pub/Sub has no persistence, so messages sent while a worker is disconnected are simply lost.
An in-memory queue is scoped to one process; other workers or a restart can't see pending URLs.
Kafka can do this, but you'd build the failed-topic, scheduler, and backoff logic yourself.
Visibility timeouts, a DLQ, and managed scaling match retry-on-failure needs with no log-replay requirement.

q: 补全 robots.txt 中常见字段的含义：
text: {{User-agent}} 指定规则适用的爬虫；{{Disallow}} 指定不可抓路径；{{Crawl-delay}} 表示同站点请求之间建议等待的秒数。
why: robots.txt 是网站给爬虫的访问规则。礼貌抓取必须在真正请求页面前检查这些约束。
why_en: Robots.txt tells crawlers which user agents the rules apply to, which paths are disallowed, and optionally how long to wait between requests.

termDefinitions.meaning: robots.txt 中标识规则适用于哪个爬虫。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: User-agent identifies which crawler a robots.txt rule applies to.

termDefinitions.meaning: robots.txt 中标记不允许被抓取的路径。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Disallow marks a path that crawlers are not permitted to fetch.

termDefinitions.meaning: 建议同一站点连续请求之间等待的秒数，非官方标准但值得尊重。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Crawl-delay suggests how many seconds to wait between requests to the same site, and though unofficial, it is worth respecting.

q_en: Fill in the meanings of common robots.txt fields:

scenario: 爬虫准备抓取 https://example.com/private/a.html，已缓存该域名的 robots.txt 规则如下，需要判断下一步动作。
q: 基于这段 robots.txt，最合适的处理是？
codeSample:
User-agent: *
Disallow: /private/
Crawl-delay: 10
options: 跳过该 URL 并确认队列消息完成
忽略 Disallow，直接抓取
把该 URL 放进高优先级队列
只要等待 10 秒就可以抓取 /private/a.html
why: Disallow: /private/ 说明该路径不允许抓取，Crawl-delay 只约束允许抓取的请求间隔。对不允许的 URL 应删除或确认消息，避免反复重试。
why_en: The disallow rule blocks the private path entirely, so the crawler should skip the URL rather than simply wait for the crawl delay.
whenOtherWins: 如果 URL 不在 Disallow 范围内，才需要继续检查 Crawl-delay 和限速；如果规则只针对别的 User-agent，也可能允许抓取。
tradeoff: 遵守 Disallow 直接跳过 vs 只等待 Crawl-delay 后抓取
options_en: Skip the URL and acknowledge the queue message as done.
Ignore the Disallow rule and fetch it anyway.
Put the URL into a high-priority queue.
Just wait 10 seconds and then fetch /private/a.html.

termDefinitions.meaning: robots.txt 中标记不允许抓取的路径前缀。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Disallow marks a path prefix that crawlers must not fetch.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同域名请求之间建议等待的秒数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Crawl-delay is the suggested number of seconds to wait between requests to the same domain.

q_en: Given this robots.txt snippet, what should the crawler do?
scenario_en: The crawler is about to fetch https://example.com/private/a.html and has already cached this domain's robots.txt rules, so it must choose the next action.
optionExplanations: 路径前缀被规则挡住了，跳过并把消息标记完成才是收尾这条 URL 的正确方式。
忽略 Disallow 违反站点规则，也违反本题的礼貌抓取要求。
优先级和路径是否被禁止无关，被 Disallow 的 URL 不该进任何抓取队列。
Crawl-delay 管的是允许路径之间的等待秒数，挡不住已经被禁止的路径。
optionExplanations_en: That path prefix is blocked by the rule, so skipping it and marking the message done is how you close it out correctly.
Ignoring Disallow breaks the site's rule and this crawler's politeness requirement alike.
Priority is unrelated to whether a path is disallowed — a blocked URL shouldn't enter any fetch queue.
Crawl-delay only paces the wait between requests on allowed paths; it cannot override a path that is already disallowed.

q: 关于 Crawl-delay，哪项说法最准确？
options: 它是官方标准的一部分，所有大爬虫都必须支持
它不是官方标准的一部分，但本设计选择尊重它来保持礼貌
它表示页面最大大小
它只用于 DNS 缓存过期
why: Crawl-delay 并非标准要求，某些大爬虫会忽略它；但本题目标是礼貌抓取，所以应尊重站点表达的节奏。面试中说明这个细节能体现现实感。
why_en: Crawl-delay is not part of the official standard, but this crawler respects it as a politeness signal.
options_en: It is part of the official standard, and every major crawler must support it.
It is not part of the official standard, but this design respects it as a politeness signal.
It specifies the maximum page size.
It is only used for DNS cache expiration.
q_en: Which statement about Crawl-delay is most accurate?
optionExplanations: Crawl-delay 从未被写进官方 robots.txt 标准，大爬虫是否遵守是各自的选择。
它是非官方惯例，但本设计主动选择尊重它，把礼貌抓取落到实处。
Crawl-delay 表示的是请求间隔秒数，不是页面大小限制。
它和 DNS 缓存过期完全是两回事，只管抓取节奏。
optionExplanations_en: Crawl-delay was never part of the official robots.txt standard, so honoring it is each crawler's choice.
It's an unofficial convention, but this design deliberately honors it to make politeness real.
Crawl-delay is a request-interval in seconds, not a page-size limit.
It has nothing to do with DNS cache expiry — it only paces fetch requests.

scenario: Worker 从队列拿到一个 URL，robots 允许抓取，但该域名上一次抓取时间距离现在还没超过 Crawl-delay。
q: 对已经 in-flight 的 SQS 消息应该怎么处理？
options: 既然 robots 规则已经允许，就应该立刻直接抓取
调用 DelaySeconds 参数尝试修改这条消息的投递安排
调用 ChangeMessageVisibility 延后重新可见
直接删除这条消息，永久丢弃这个 URL
why: DelaySeconds 只影响新发送的消息；已经被取出的消息要用 ChangeMessageVisibility 延长不可见时间。这样不会忙等，也不会违反 Crawl-delay。
why_en: For an in-flight SQS message, ChangeMessageVisibility is the right way to defer retry until the crawl delay has elapsed.
whenOtherWins: 如果是在首次发送新消息时要延迟投递，DelaySeconds 才合适；如果 URL 被 Disallow，则应确认并跳过。
tradeoff: 延后已取出消息的可见性 vs 只对新消息生效的 DelaySeconds
options_en: Fetch immediately since the robots.txt rule already allows it.
Try calling the DelaySeconds parameter to change this message's delivery timing.
Call ChangeMessageVisibility to defer when it becomes visible again.
Delete the message outright and permanently drop the URL.

termDefinitions.meaning: 仅对新发送到队列的消息生效的延迟投递参数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DelaySeconds only delays delivery for messages that are newly sent to the queue.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用于延长一条已取出消息保持不可见的时间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ChangeMessageVisibility extends how long an already-received message stays hidden from other consumers.

q_en: How should an already in-flight SQS message be handled?
scenario_en: A worker receives a URL from the queue; robots.txt allows it, but the domain's last crawl time is still inside the Crawl-delay window.

DelaySeconds 这个参数只延迟全新发送的消息，跟已经取出的这条无关。
这条消息已被取出，要延长它保持隐藏，只能主动改可见性超时。
URL 只是暂时还没到抓取时间，删掉消息等于永久放弃这条本该正常抓的页面。
optionExplanations_en: Robots.txt allowing it is only step one — the crawl-delay pacing check still hasn't passed.
DelaySeconds only applies to a message not yet sent; this one has already been received.
Since the message is already in flight, hiding it longer needs a visibility change call, not a new delay.
The URL just isn't due yet — deleting the message permanently gives up a page that should still be fetched.

scenario: 系统需要判断每个域名上次抓取时间、已解析的 robots 规则，并在多个 Worker 之间共享这些信息。

options: 每个 Worker 本地维护一个 Map
把 last crawl time 写进 HTML 文件名
完全依赖 DNS TTL
在 Metadata DB 中维护 Domain 表

why_en: A shared domain table keeps robots rules and last-crawl timestamps visible to all workers for coordinated politeness checks.
whenOtherWins: 如果只有一个 Worker 或只是本地 demo，本地状态可以简化；分布式爬虫需要共享状态。
tradeoff: 集中共享状态 vs 每个 Worker 各自本地状态
options_en: Have each worker keep its own local map.
Encode the last crawl time into the HTML filename.
Rely entirely on DNS TTL.
Maintain a Domain table inside the Metadata DB.
q_en: What is the best way to model shared domain state?
scenario_en: The system must track each domain's last crawl time and parsed robots rules, and share that information across multiple workers.
optionExplanations: 本地 Map 只活在一个进程里，别的 Worker 完全看不到这个域名刚被抓过。
文件名不是可查询的结构化字段，没法方便地按域名读取或更新时间戳。
DNS TTL 管的是域名解析结果的有效期，跟抓取节奏或 robots 规则无关。
Domain 表集中存 robots 规则和上次抓取时间，所有 Worker 读到同一份状态。
optionExplanations_en: A local map lives in one process; other workers have no visibility into a domain's recent crawl.
A filename isn't a queryable structured field, so reading or updating a timestamp per domain is awkward.
DNS TTL governs how long a resolved IP stays valid, unrelated to crawl pacing or robots rules.
A shared domain table centralizes robots rules and last-crawl time so every worker reads the same state.

scenario: 多个 Worker 可能同时拿到同一域名的 URL，为避免同时抓取，需要在抓取前抢一个短期域名锁。
q: 下面哪种 Redis 命令形态最贴合这个需求？
codeSample: SET crawl_lock:example.com worker-17 NX EX 10
options: 获得锁：key 不存在才设置，10 秒后自动过期
永久删除该域名的所有待抓 URL
把该域名塞进 Bloom Filter
把这条消息立刻发进 DLQ
why: SET NX EX 可以原子地获取短期锁，TTL 可对齐 Crawl-delay，防止 Worker 崩溃后锁永久存在。抢不到锁的 Worker 应延后消息可见性。
why_en: Redis SET with NX and EX provides an atomic per-domain lease that expires automatically after the crawl-delay window.
whenOtherWins: 如果只需统计每秒请求数，滑动窗口计数更合适；如果需要强事务和审计，数据库锁可能更合适但成本更高。
tradeoff: 原子短租锁保证互斥 vs 长期删除/标记类操作
options_en: Acquire the lock: set only if the key is absent, auto-expiring after 10 seconds.
Permanently delete every pending URL for that domain.
Add the domain into a Bloom filter.
Send the message straight to the DLQ.

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis SET 的选项，只在 key 不存在时才写入。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NX is a Redis SET option that writes the key only if it does not already exist.

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis SET 的选项，给 key 设置秒级过期时间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: EX is a Redis SET option that attaches an expiration time in seconds to the key.

termDefinitions.meaning: 概率型集合结构，可能有假阳性但不会有假阴性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Bloom filter is a probabilistic set structure that can have false positives but never false negatives.

q_en: Which Redis command shape best fits this locking need?
scenario_en: Multiple workers may receive URLs from the same domain at the same time, so each worker must acquire a short-lived domain lock before fetching.
optionExplanations: NX 保证只有第一个 Worker 能设置成功，EX 让锁在崩溃场景下也能自动到期，不会永久卡死。
SET 命令不会删除数据，这是新建 key，不是删除操作。
Bloom Filter 是用来判断某个东西见没见过，不能用来做互斥锁。
抢锁和消息该不该进死信队列是两件事，锁本身不会触发 DLQ。
optionExplanations_en: NX makes only the first worker succeed, and EX makes the lock lapse on its own after a crash, never stuck forever.
SET doesn't delete data — this call creates a key, it isn't a delete operation.
A Bloom filter checks whether something was seen before; it can't provide mutual exclusion like a lock.
Acquiring a lock and dead-lettering a message are unrelated; the lock itself never triggers a DLQ.

q: Web Crawler 常用的默认礼貌限速大致是多少？
options: 全系统每秒 1 个请求
每个域名每秒 1 个请求
每个域名每秒 1000 个请求
每个 Worker 每天 1 个请求
why: 礼貌限速按域名维度控制，常见默认是每个域名约 1 rps。全系统仍可通过同时抓取大量不同域名取得高吞吐。
why_en: The crawler limits each domain to about one request per second while achieving aggregate throughput across many domains.
options_en: About one request per second, system-wide.
About one request per second, per domain.
About one thousand requests per second, per domain.
About one request per day, per worker.
scenario: 多个爬虫实例同时抓取同一批域名，需要一个默认的、不必特别设计就能遵守的礼貌限速基线。
q_en: What is a common default polite crawl rate for a web crawler?
scenario_en: Multiple crawler instances fetch from the same set of domains and need a default polite rate limit that is easy to enforce.
optionExplanations: 限速维度按域名算，不是把全系统压到 1 rps，那样吞吐太低。
这是常见的默认礼貌基线：每个域名约 1 rps，不用特别设计就能遵守。
1000 rps 对单个域名来说太激进，容易被识别为攻击式流量。
每天 1 次太保守，10B 页面 5 天内根本抓不完。
optionExplanations_en: The limit is scoped per domain, not the whole system throttled to one rps — that would tank throughput.
This is the common default politeness baseline: about one rps per domain, easy to enforce without special design.
1000 rps against a single domain is way too aggressive and reads like attack traffic.
Once a day per worker is far too conservative to fetch 10 billion pages in five days.

scenario: 多个爬虫实例要共同遵守每个域名每秒最多 1 个请求的规则，不能只靠单机内存计数。
q: 更合适的限流实现是？
options: 把所有 URL 按字母排序
只依赖 S3 的吞吐限制
Redis 等中心化存储里的按域名滑动窗口计数
每个 Worker 自己 sleep 1 秒
why: 分布式 Worker 需要共享限流状态，Redis 滑动窗口能按域名统计当前窗口请求数。单机 sleep 看不到其他 Worker 的请求。
why_en: A shared Redis sliding window lets distributed crawlers enforce per-domain request limits consistently.
whenOtherWins: 如果只有单实例爬虫，本地令牌桶就足够；如果域名量非常大，还要考虑限流 key 的分片和过期策略。
diagram:
flowchart TD
URL[URL] --> Domain[Extract domain]
Domain --> Token[Domain token bucket]
Token -->|allowed| Fetch[Fetch now]
Token -->|limited| Delay[Delay queue]
tradeoff: 共享的分布式限流状态 vs 单机本地计时
options_en: Sort all URLs alphabetically.
Rely only on S3's throughput limits.
A centralized per-domain sliding-window counter, such as in Redis.
Have each worker just sleep for one second.
q_en: What rate-limiting implementation fits this distributed crawler?
scenario_en: Multiple crawler instances must jointly enforce at most one request per second per domain, so a single worker's memory counter is not enough.
optionExplanations: 字母排序和限速完全无关，也不解决跨 Worker 协调的问题。
S3 的吞吐限制管的是对象存储，不是外部网站的请求速率。
滑动窗口计数存在共享存储里，所有 Worker 读写同一份状态，能真正协调限速。
各 Worker 各睡各的，互相看不到对方的请求，聚合起来照样可能超过限速。
optionExplanations_en: Alphabetical sorting has nothing to do with rate limiting or cross-worker coordination.
S3's throughput limits govern object storage, not the request rate against external websites.
A sliding-window counter in shared storage lets every worker read and write the same state, coordinating for real.
Each worker sleeping on its own can't see the others' requests, so the combined rate can still exceed the limit.

q: 限流窗口重置时多个 Worker 同时重试，最容易产生什么问题？
options: 所有 URL 都会被自动去重
DNS 缓存会立刻全部命中
S3 里的对象会被自动删除
同步重试挤爆同一个域名配额，反复失败
why: 如果 Worker 都在同一时刻醒来，它们会再次拥挤到同一个域名窗口。加随机 jitter 能把重试打散，减少同步冲突。
why_en: Jitter spreads retry attempts over time so workers do not stampede the same per-domain rate-limit window.
options_en: All URLs get automatically deduplicated.
DNS caches suddenly hit one hundred percent.
Objects in S3 get automatically deleted.
Synchronized retries flood the same domain quota and keep failing together.
q_en: What problem happens when many workers retry at the same rate-limit window reset?
optionExplanations: 去重逻辑跟窗口重置时机无关，不会因为重试同步就触发。
DNS 缓存命中率和限流窗口重置是两个独立的机制。
S3 对象生命周期由存储策略管，不会因为重试撞车就被删除。
大家同一时刻醒来，会挤爆同一个域名的配额，结果又一起失败。
optionExplanations_en: Dedup logic is unrelated to when the rate-limit window resets — synchronized retries don't trigger it.
DNS cache hit rate and rate-limit window resets are two independent mechanisms.
S3 object deletion follows storage policy, not a pile-up of retries.
Everyone waking up at once floods the same domain's quota, so they fail together again.

q: 这组 BOE 带宽推算得到的结论是什么？
options: 单机网络理论上限约 12,500 页/秒，只是理论峰值
单机实际就能稳定跑到约 12,500 页/秒
带宽和页面大小对估算机器数量没有意义
这个数字说明应该改成抓更小的页面
why: 200 Gbps 换算成约 12,500 页/秒只是纯网络理论上限；DNS、限流、重试等现实损耗会让实际吞吐明显更低。
why_en: The bandwidth math gives a theoretical per-machine ceiling of about twelve thousand five hundred pages per second, but real throughput will be far lower once you account for DNS, rate limits, and retries.
scenario: 网络优化型实例带宽约 200 Gbps，平均页面体量约 2MB，这决定了单机纯网络维度的理论抓取速度上限。
options_en: The theoretical per-machine ceiling is about 12,500 pages/sec, only a theoretical peak.
A single machine can actually sustain 12,500 pages per second in practice.
Bandwidth and page size are irrelevant to estimating fleet size.
This number implies you should switch to crawling smaller pages.
q_en: What conclusion does this back-of-the-envelope bandwidth estimate give?
scenario_en: A network-optimized instance has about 200 Gbps of bandwidth, and the average page transfer is about 2 MB, which sets the per-machine theoretical network ceiling.
optionExplanations: 200 Gbps 除以 2MB/页只是纯网络算术给出的峰值，不代表真实可持续吞吐。
实际吞吐会被 DNS、限流、重试等损耗拉低，达不到这个理论峰值。
带宽和页面大小正是算机器数的两个直接输入，不是无关变量。
这个数字是用来估算需要多少机器，不是在建议改抓取内容策略。
optionExplanations_en: 200 Gbps divided by 2MB per page is pure network arithmetic — a ceiling, not a sustainable number.
Real throughput gets pulled down by DNS, rate limits, and retries, so it never sustains that peak.
Bandwidth and page size are exactly the two direct inputs to sizing the fleet, not irrelevant variables.
This number is meant to size the fleet, not to suggest changing what pages get crawled.

q: 把这个 30% 折扣系数放进估算的目的是什么？
options: 把所需机器数直接提高到原来的 3 倍
把理论峰值折算成更贴近现实的吞吐去估算机器数
证明可以完全忽略 DNS 和限流这些因素
说明只需要原计划 30% 的机器成本
why: 30% 利用率把纯网络峰值打折成贴近现实的吞吐（约 3,750 页/秒），这个折扣后的数字才用于估算机器数。
why_en: The thirty-percent utilization factor discounts the theoretical peak down to a realistic sustainable throughput that is actually used to size the fleet.
scenario: 同一套 BOE 假设进一步估计，因为 DNS、延迟、限流、重试等现实损耗，实际能有效利用的带宽大约只有 30%。
options_en: It directly triples the number of machines required.
It discounts the theoretical peak into a realistic throughput used to size the fleet.
It proves DNS and rate limiting can be fully ignored.
It means the project only needs 30% of the original machine budget.
q_en: Why include a 30% utilization discount in the estimate?
scenario_en: Using the same back-of-the-envelope assumptions, real losses from DNS, latency, rate limits, and retries mean only about 30% of bandwidth is effectively usable.
optionExplanations: 30% 是利用率折扣，不是机器数的倍数，两者算法方向不一样。
拿理论峰值乘以 30% 利用率，得到更接近真实运行情况的吞吐，再拿它算机器数。
正因为 DNS、限流这些损耗真实存在，才需要打这个折扣，不是可以忽略它们。
30% 折的是吞吐，不是机器预算或成本，两者不能画等号。
optionExplanations_en: 30% is a utilization discount, not a multiplier on machine count — the math points the other way.
Multiply the theoretical peak by 30% utilization for throughput closer to reality, then size the fleet with it.
This discount exists precisely because DNS and rate-limit losses are real, not because you can ignore them.
The 30% discounts throughput, not machine budget or cost — those aren't the same number.

q: 单机抓完 10B 页面耗时计算在设计讨论里起什么作用？
options: 说明页面大小对完成时间没有任何影响
证明应该直接放弃 5 天这个时间要求
算出单机约 31 天，需多机并行才压进 5 天预算
证明单机完全可以满足 5 天的时间要求
why: 单机耗时约 31 天远超 5 天预算，这个差距就是论证需要并行扩容到多台机器的依据。
why_en: The single-machine estimate of about thirty-one days is far beyond the five-day budget, which is exactly the gap that justifies scaling out to many machines.
scenario: 把 10B 页面除以约 3,750 页/秒的单机吞吐，得到单机独立完成全部抓取所需的时间。
options_en: It shows page size has no effect on completion time.
It proves the five-day requirement should be abandoned.
It shows a single machine needs about 31 days, proving parallel machines are required to fit the five-day budget.
It proves a single machine can already meet the five-day requirement.
q_en: What role does the single-machine time estimate play in the design discussion?
scenario_en: Divide 10 billion pages by the single-machine throughput of about 3,750 pages per second to estimate how long one machine would need.
optionExplanations: 页面大小已经算进了每秒吞吐里，正是它决定了这 31 天怎么来的。
31 天超预算恰恰是要论证需要并行，不是要放弃 5 天这个目标。
单机独立跑要约 31 天，远超 5 天预算，这个差距正是要并行扩容的依据。
31 天远超 5 天，单机显然满足不了这个时间要求。
optionExplanations_en: Page size is already baked into per-second throughput — it's exactly what produced this 31-day figure.
Being over budget at 31 days argues FOR parallelizing, not for abandoning the five-day goal.
One machine alone needs about 31 days, far past the five-day budget — that gap is why you scale out.
31 days is far beyond five days, so a single machine clearly can't meet the requirement.

q: 用 8 台机器线性并行估算的重点是什么？
options: 机器数量对完成时间没有任何实际影响
无论用多少台机器都无法在 5 天内完成任务
线性假设在真实系统里永远精确成立
线性并行把 31 天压到约 3.9 天，重点是估算路径
why: 除以并行机器数只是粗略线性近似；面试更看重你能给出估算路径并承认假设局限，而不是记住这个数字。
why_en: Dividing by the number of parallel machines is only a rough linear approximation, and interviewers care more that you can walk through the estimate and admit its limits than that you memorize the number.
scenario: 把单机约 31 天的估算线性除以并行机器数，示例用 8 台机器。
options_en: The number of machines has no effect on completion time.
No number of machines can finish within five days.
The linear assumption always holds exactly in real systems.
Linear parallelism cuts 31 days to about 3.9 days; the point is the estimation path.
q_en: What is the point of the eight-machine linear parallelism estimate?
scenario_en: Take the roughly 31-day single-machine estimate and divide it linearly by the number of parallel machines; this example uses eight machines.
optionExplanations: 机器数直接除进总耗时里，正是它把天数压下来的。
8 台机器就能把 31 天压到约 4 天内，5 天预算是够得着的。
现实里有热点域名、机器差异等因素，线性只是一阶近似，不会精确成立。
除以机器数只是粗略线性近似，面试更看重你能讲清估算路径、承认假设局限。
optionExplanations_en: Machine count divides directly into total time — it's exactly what pulls the day count down.
Eight machines already brings 31 days under roughly four, so the five-day budget is reachable.
Real systems have hot domains and uneven machines, so linear scaling is only a first-order guess.
Dividing by machine count is a rough approximation; what matters is naming the path and its limits.

q: 为什么每个域名 1 rps 的礼貌限制不等于全系统只能 1 rps？
options: 爬虫能同时访问数百万不同域名，各自限速
因为 robots.txt 可以被忽略
因为 S3 会替爬虫下载网页
因为 DNS 查询不算请求
why: 限速维度是域名，不是全局；并行抓取大量不同域名时，聚合吞吐仍然很高。这个解释能化解礼貌和高吞吐看似矛盾的问题。
why_en: The one-request-per-second limit is per domain, so crawling many domains concurrently still allows high aggregate throughput.
tradeoff: 限速维度是域名 vs 全系统聚合吞吐
options_en: The crawler can hit millions of distinct domains at once, each rate-limited on its own.
Because robots.txt can simply be ignored.
Because S3 downloads the pages on the crawler's behalf.
Because DNS lookups do not count as requests.
q_en: Why does a one-rps-per-domain politeness limit not mean the whole crawler is limited to one rps?
optionExplanations: 限速是按域名分别计的，同时抓几百万个不同域名，总吞吐照样很高。
忽略 robots.txt 违反礼貌抓取原则，也不是吞吐能起来的原因。
S3 只存文本产出，从不替爬虫发网络请求。
DNS 查询本身也占带宽和时间，只是限速规则通常不把它计进请求配额。
optionExplanations_en: The rate limit is counted per domain, so hitting millions of domains at once still yields high throughput.
Ignoring robots.txt violates the politeness principle and isn't why throughput is high anyway.
S3 only stores the text output — it never makes network requests on the crawler's behalf.
DNS lookups do take time and bandwidth; they're just not usually counted against the request quota.

scenario: Parser Worker 只需要从对象存储读取 HTML、抽文本、写回文本，但必须跟上 URL Fetcher 的产出速度。
q: Parser Worker 更适合怎样扩缩容？
options: 只在每天午夜运行一次
按下游队列积压动态扩缩容
固定一台机器，完全不做并发
按 DNS TTL 来扩缩容
why: 解析阶段计算和 I/O 相对简单，可以用队列积压作为伸缩信号，通过 Lambda、Fargate 或 Worker 池扩展。这样不必提前精确估算解析机器数。
why_en: Parser workers can autoscale based on the downstream queue backlog so they keep pace with fetchers without fixed capacity guesses.
whenOtherWins: 如果解析包含复杂模型推理或严格批处理窗口，可能需要专门容量规划；本题解析任务较常规。
tradeoff: 按积压信号弹性伸缩 vs 固定容量预先规划
options_en: Run it only once a day at midnight.
Autoscale based on the downstream queue backlog.
Fix it at one machine with no concurrency.
Scale it based on DNS TTL.
q_en: How should Parser Workers scale up and down?
scenario_en: Parser workers read HTML from object storage, extract text, and write the text back, but they must keep up with the URL Fetchers' output rate.
optionExplanations: 每天一次的节奏跟不上 Fetcher 持续产出 HTML 的速度，会造成解析积压。
解析计算和 I/O 都比较轻，用队列积压做伸缩信号最直接，不用提前精算机器数。
固定一台机器没法跟上 Fetcher 波动的产出速度，高峰期会持续积压。
DNS TTL 管的是域名解析缓存有效期，跟解析阶段该配多少机器无关。
optionExplanations_en: Running once a day can't keep up with fetchers continuously producing HTML — the backlog piles up.
Extraction is fairly light on compute and I/O, so scaling off queue backlog is the most direct signal.
One fixed machine can't track the fetcher's variable output rate and falls behind during peaks.
DNS TTL governs how long a resolved domain stays cached, unrelated to parser machine sizing.

q: DNS 耗时占比较高对 Web Crawler 设计意味着什么？
options: 这个比例只在很小规模的测试场景下成立，规模变大反而会更快
应该放弃自建缓存，全部交给单一第三方
大规模抓取下 DNS 是真实瓶颈，要缓存加多 provider
DNS 耗时可以完全忽略，不需要任何优化
why: 70% 的耗时占比说明大规模抓取下 DNS 是真实瓶颈，缓存解析结果和使用多个 provider 是直接的应对手段。
why_en: A seventy-percent time share means DNS is a genuine bottleneck at crawler scale, and caching lookups plus using multiple providers are the direct fixes.
scenario: 早期爬虫研究（如 Mercator 论文）发现，没有自建解析优化前，DNS 查询可能占到每个线程耗时的约 70%。
options_en: This ratio only holds in a very small-scale test scenario and improves automatically as scale grows.
You should drop self-managed caching entirely and rely on a single third-party provider.
At crawler scale, DNS is a real bottleneck needing caching and multiple providers.
DNS lookup time can be ignored entirely and needs no optimization at all.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把域名解析成 IP 地址的系统。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DNS resolves a domain name into an IP address.

q_en: What does a high DNS time share imply for web crawler design?
scenario_en: Early crawler research, such as the Mercator paper, found that before custom resolver optimizations, DNS lookups could take about 70% of each thread's time.
optionExplanations: 这个比例只会在没有优化时随并发和域名量继续放大，不会自动变快。
单一第三方一样有限流上限，放弃自建缓存反而更容易撞到配额。
把握时耗大头才知道该往哪投入：先缓存解析结果，再叠加多个第三方分摊压力。
70% 的耗时占比摆在那，完全不管等于放着最大的瓶颈不处理。
optionExplanations_en: Without optimization this ratio only worsens as concurrency and domain count grow, it doesn't fix itself.
A single third party still has its own rate cap, so dropping your own cache makes hitting it more likely.
Knowing where the time goes tells you where to invest: cache lookups first, then spread across providers.
That seventy-percent figure is sitting right there — ignoring it leaves the biggest bottleneck untouched.

scenario: 爬虫会反复抓取同一域名下的多个 URL，DNS 解析在高并发下成为瓶颈。
q: 第一层 DNS 优化是什么？
options: 每次请求都强制绕过缓存
把 DNS 查询写入 S3
用 Bloom Filter 代替 DNS
在 Crawler 中缓存域名到 IP 的解析结果
why: 同一域名的多个 URL 可以复用 DNS 结果，减少网络往返和外部 DNS 压力。缓存需要尊重 TTL，但它是最直接的优化。
why_en: Caching DNS results lets many URLs on the same domain reuse one lookup and reduces external resolver load.
whenOtherWins: 如果域名解析高度动态或 TTL 极短，缓存时间要更保守；如果单一 provider 达到限额，还要叠加多 provider。
tradeoff: 缓存复用解析结果 vs 每次都发起新查询
options_en: Force every request to bypass the cache.
Write DNS query logs into S3.
Replace DNS lookups with a Bloom filter.
Cache the domain-to-IP resolution inside the crawler.

termDefinitions.meaning: DNS 记录的缓存有效期，过期后需要重新解析。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TTL is how long a DNS record stays valid in cache before it must be re-resolved.

q_en: What is the first DNS optimization layer?
scenario_en: The crawler repeatedly fetches multiple URLs from the same domain, and DNS resolution becomes a bottleneck at high concurrency.
optionExplanations: 绕开缓存等于放弃这层优化，请求量不会因此减少。
S3 是给文本产出用的对象存储，不会替你做域名解析。
Bloom Filter 只能判断见没见过，回答不了域名对应哪个 IP。
同域名多个 URL 共用一次解析结果，直接省掉大量重复的网络往返。
optionExplanations_en: Bypassing the cache throws away this layer of optimization — request volume doesn't drop because of it.
S3 is object storage for the text output; it doesn't perform domain resolution for you.
A Bloom filter can only tell you whether something's been seen, not which IP a domain maps to.
Many URLs on the same domain reuse one lookup, cutting a large share of redundant round trips.

scenario: 第三方 DNS provider 有 QPS 限制，单 provider 很容易在全网抓取时触顶；团队希望快速降低被限流风险。
q: 第三方 DNS 限流下的务实优化是什么？
options: 多个 DNS provider 轮询分摊请求
停止 DNS 解析，直接猜 IP
把所有域名固定到同一个 IP
只抓取没有域名的 URL
why: 多 DNS provider 轮询能分散负载，降低单点限流风险。它不学术但很实用，适合在面试里展示真实约束意识。
why_en: Round-robining across multiple DNS providers spreads resolver load and reduces the chance of hitting one provider's rate limits.
whenOtherWins: 如果团队能运营自建高性能 resolver，自建也可能更优；若流量很小，单 provider 加缓存就足够。
tradeoff: 多 provider 分摊限流风险 vs 单一 provider 简单但脆弱
options_en: Round-robin across multiple DNS providers.
Stop resolving DNS and guess the IP directly.
Pin every domain to the same IP address.
Only crawl URLs that have no domain name.
q_en: What practical optimization helps when a third-party DNS provider rate-limits you?
scenario_en: Third-party DNS providers have QPS limits, and one provider can hit its cap during web-scale crawling, so the team wants a quick way to reduce throttling risk.
optionExplanations: 轮询多个 provider 把请求摊开，任何单一 provider 都不容易撞到限流上限。
猜 IP 大概率连不上正确的服务器，也完全不解决限流问题。
不同域名对应不同服务器，固定成同一个 IP 会让大部分请求直接失败。
几乎所有网页都有域名，只抓没有域名的 URL 等于放弃了绝大部分目标。
optionExplanations_en: Round-robining across providers spreads requests so no single provider is likely to hit its rate cap.
Guessing the IP will usually miss the right server, and it doesn't solve the throttling problem either.
Different domains map to different servers; pinning them to one IP fails most requests outright.
Nearly every page has a domain name, so crawling only domain-less URLs abandons almost every target.

q: 补全 URL 级去重和内容级去重的区别：
text: {{URL 级去重}} 在入队前查 Metadata DB，避免同一 URL 重复抓；{{内容级去重}} 在抓取后对页面内容哈希，识别不同 URL 返回相同内容。
why: URL 去重便宜但不够，因为不同 URL 可能返回同一页面。内容哈希去重能跳过重复内容的解析和存储。
why_en: URL deduplication avoids repeated URLs before enqueueing, while content deduplication hashes fetched pages to catch identical content served by different URLs.
q_en: Fill in the difference between URL-level and content-level deduplication:

scenario: 抓取后需要判断 HTML 内容是否已经见过，希望准确、不引入误判，并且 Metadata DB 能承受索引写入。
q: 这个爬虫更偏向的实用内容去重方案是？
options: 完全跳过内容去重这一整个步骤
hash 存 Metadata DB 并建索引
只比较 URL 字符串是否完全相同
只用进程内存里的 Set，不落盘
why: 内容 hash 加索引简单、准确，现代数据库维护大索引通常可接受。这个方案比 Bloom Filter 更适合追求准确和简单的主线设计。
why_en: Storing content hashes in the metadata database with an index is simple, exact, and practical for deduplicating fetched pages.
whenOtherWins: 如果内存和查询延迟极端敏感且能接受少量漏抓，Bloom Filter 可以更省空间；只做 URL 去重会漏掉重复内容。
tradeoff: 简单准确的 hash 索引 vs 省内存但有误判的 Bloom Filter
options_en: Skip content deduplication entirely, as a whole step.
Store the content hash in the metadata DB and index it.
Only compare whether the URL strings are exactly identical.
Use only an in-process memory set, with no persistence.
q_en: Which practical content-deduplication approach fits this crawler best?
scenario_en: After fetching a page, the crawler must tell whether the HTML content has been seen before; it wants exact results and the Metadata DB can handle indexed writes.
optionExplanations: 跳过内容去重会让不同 URL 返回同一页面时被重复抽取和存储。
内容哈希建索引既能精确判重，又能被所有 Worker 共享查询，符合准确优先的目标。
不同 URL 常指向相同内容，只比 URL 字符串会漏掉这类重复。
内存 Set 只活在一个进程里，重启或换机器就丢，也没法跨 Worker 共享。
optionExplanations_en: Skipping content dedup means identical pages served by different URLs get extracted and stored repeatedly.
An indexed content hash gives exact duplicate detection every worker can query, matching accuracy-first.
Different URLs often serve the same content, so comparing only URL strings misses that duplicate.
An in-memory set lives in one process, disappears on restart, and can't be shared across workers.

q: Bloom Filter 在内容去重里的核心语义是什么？
options: 它能返回原始 HTML
它能替代所有数据库索引且没有误差
说不存在时一定不存在，说存在时只是可能存在
说存在时一定存在，说不存在时只是可能不存在
why: Bloom Filter 没有 false negative，但有 false positive。用于去重时，可能把没抓过的内容误判为已抓过。
why_en: A Bloom filter can prove an item is absent but only says it is probably present, so false positives are the main trade-off.
scenario: 系统要在抓取后判断内容是否已抓过；对比 Bloom Filter 和精确 hash 索引在「是否存在」判断上的语义差异。
tradeoff: 精确但重的 hash 索引 vs 省内存但有 false positive 的 Bloom Filter
options_en: It can return the original HTML content.
It can replace every database index with zero error.
Saying 'absent' is always certain; saying 'present' is only probable.
Saying 'present' is always certain; saying 'absent' is only probable.

termDefinitions.meaning: 概率型集合结构：不存在时一定准确，存在时可能是假阳性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Bloom filter is a probabilistic set: a negative answer is certain, but a positive answer can be a false positive.

termDefinitions.meaning: 误判为存在，实际上并不存在。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A false positive means the filter says an item is present when it actually is not.

q_en: What is the core Bloom filter semantic in content deduplication?
scenario_en: The crawler must decide after fetching whether content has been seen before, so compare Bloom filters and exact hash indexes on existence-check semantics.
optionExplanations: Bloom Filter 只存位图指纹，从不保存原始内容，查不到 HTML 本身。
它偶尔会把没见过的东西错认成见过，没法做到零误差替代所有精确索引。
查不到时可以完全放心地判定没抓过，查到时只能当作大概率线索，还得留一手复核。
把这两种确定性搞反了：它是 positive 存疑、negative 才可信。
optionExplanations_en: A Bloom filter stores only a bitmap fingerprint and never the original content, so it can't return HTML.
It can occasionally mistake something unseen for seen, so it cannot be a zero-error replacement for exact indexes.
A miss can be trusted completely as unseen, but a hit is only a probable signal worth double-checking.
This flips the certainty backwards — it's the positive that's uncertain, the negative that's reliable.

q: 在爬虫内容去重中使用 Bloom Filter 的主要风险是什么？
options: 一定会重复抓取所有页面
会让对象存储失去持久性
会禁止 URL 深度字段
误判某个新页面已经抓过，从而跳过它
why: false positive 会让系统误以为某个内容 hash 已存在，导致少量新页面被跳过。可以增大 filter 和 hash 函数数量来降低概率，但不能完全消除。
why_en: The risk is a false positive that causes the crawler to skip a page it has not actually processed.
scenario: 系统已经决定用 Bloom Filter 做内容去重，用来快速跳过可能重复的页面。
options_en: It will definitely re-crawl every single page.
It strips durability from object storage.
It forbids using a URL depth field.
It may mistakenly treat an unseen page as already crawled and skip it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 概率型集合结构，可能有假阳性但没有假阴性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Bloom filter is a probabilistic set that can produce false positives but never false negatives.

termDefinitions.meaning: 误判为已存在，实际是新内容。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A false positive here means new content is wrongly treated as already seen.

q_en: What is the main risk of using a Bloom filter for crawler content deduplication?
scenario_en: The crawler has chosen a Bloom filter for content deduplication so it can quickly skip pages that appear to be duplicates.
optionExplanations: 这类误判只连累零星几个页面，不会波及整批已经抓过的数据。
Bloom Filter 只是判重工具，跟对象存储的持久性没有关系。
深度字段属于爬虫陷阱防护，跟内容去重用不用 Bloom Filter 无关。
指纹位图偶尔把没见过的东西错认成见过，那一页就被悄悄漏掉不抓了。
optionExplanations_en: This kind of mistake only touches a stray handful of pages, not the whole already-crawled batch.
A Bloom filter is just a duplicate-check tool; it has no bearing on object storage durability.
The depth field belongs to crawler-trap protection, unrelated to Bloom filter dedup.
The fingerprint bitmap occasionally mistakes something unseen for seen, so that page quietly gets skipped.

scenario: 面试官问 Bloom Filter 是否应该用于本题内容去重；系统追求简单准确，现代数据库索引成本可接受。
q: 内容去重里是否应该优先使用 Bloom Filter？
options: 先用 hash 索引；Bloom Filter 留作可选优化
完全不需要任何去重
只靠 URL 字符串比较就够了
坚持用 Bloom Filter，因为它永远不会误判
why: Bloom Filter 有趣但对这条主线偏过度设计；hash 索引更简单且准确。能说明何时 Bloom Filter 胜出，比机械套数据结构更高级。
why_en: The practical answer is to use an indexed content hash first and treat a Bloom filter as an optional optimization with false-positive cost.
whenOtherWins: 当 hash 集合极大、内存/查询压力极高、业务能接受少量漏抓时，Bloom Filter 才更有吸引力。
diagram:
flowchart LR
HTML[Raw HTML] --> Extract[Extract text]
Extract --> Hash[Content fingerprint]
Hash --> Seen[(Seen index)]
Seen --> Store[Store if new]
tradeoff: 简单准确优先 vs 省内存但要接受 false positive
options_en: Start with a hash index; keep the Bloom filter as an optional later optimization.
Skip deduplication entirely.
Rely only on comparing URL strings.
Insist on a Bloom filter because it never makes mistakes.
q_en: Should a Bloom filter be the first choice for content deduplication here?
scenario_en: The interviewer asks whether a Bloom filter should be used for content deduplication; the system prefers simple exact behavior and can afford a database index.
optionExplanations: 先用精确的 hash 索引挡住重复，等真遇到内存或查询瓶颈再考虑加 Bloom Filter。
不去重会让大量重复内容占用存储和后续处理资源。
不同 URL 常返回相同内容，只比字符串会漏掉这类重复，达不到准确的目标。
Bloom Filter 恰恰会有 false positive，说它永远不会误判本身就是错的。
optionExplanations_en: Start with an exact hash index, and only reach for a Bloom filter once memory or query pressure shows up.
Skipping dedup lets a lot of duplicate content eat storage and downstream processing capacity.
Different URLs often return the same content, so comparing only strings misses that and the accuracy goal.
A Bloom filter can absolutely produce false positives — claiming it never makes mistakes is wrong.

q: Crawler trap 指的是什么？
options: 队列里的死信消息
让爬虫在同一站点无限跟链接、难以结束的页面结构
DNS provider 的免费额度
S3 的对象版本控制
why: Crawler trap 可能通过自链接、日历页、无限参数等方式制造无限链接空间。爬虫如果没有边界，会把时间耗在局部站点上。
why_en: A crawler trap is a link structure that keeps the crawler following effectively endless pages within the same site.
options_en: A dead-letter message sitting in a queue.
A link structure that keeps the crawler following endless links on one site.
A DNS provider's free-tier quota.
S3 object versioning.
q_en: What is a crawler trap?
optionExplanations: 死信消息是重试失败后的队列产物，跟站点页面结构无关。
自链接、日历页、无限参数这类结构会不断生成新链接，让爬虫在一个站点里出不来。
免费额度是第三方服务的计费概念，不是页面结构问题。
对象版本控制是存储层特性，跟爬虫会不会陷进某个站点无关。
optionExplanations_en: A dead-letter message is a queue artifact from failed retries, unrelated to a site's page structure.
Self-links, calendar pages, or endless parameters keep generating new links, trapping the crawler on one site.
A free-tier quota is a third-party billing concept, not a page-structure problem.
Object versioning is a storage-layer feature, unrelated to whether the crawler gets stuck on a site.

q: 防止 crawler trap 的简单措施是什么？
options: 直接禁用所有 DNS 缓存查询机制
永远优先抓取最深的链接
记录 link-hop depth，超阈值就停止扩展
把所有抓到的 URL 强行改写成同一个域名
why: depth 是从种子 URL 起算的链接跳数，不是路径段数。超过 15-20 这类阈值时停止扩展，可以避免在无限站点结构里耗尽时间。
why_en: Tracking link-hop depth from the seed URL and cutting off branches beyond a threshold prevents crawler traps from consuming the crawl.
options_en: Disable all DNS cache lookups entirely.
Always prioritize the deepest links first.
Record link-hop depth and cut off a branch past a threshold.
Forcibly rewrite every fetched URL onto the same domain.
q_en: What is a simple way to avoid crawler traps?
optionExplanations: 禁用 DNS 缓存只会拖慢正常抓取，跟陷阱页面无穷无尽的链接没关系。
优先抓最深的链接正好一头扎进陷阱最深处，反而更容易耗尽时间。
从种子起算跳数，超过阈值就不再往下探，能直接切断无限链接空间。
强改域名会让抓取彻底偏离目标站点，不解决陷阱问题。
optionExplanations_en: Disabling DNS caching only slows normal crawling — it has nothing to do with a trap's endless links.
Prioritizing the deepest links first walks straight into the trap's deepest point, wasting more time.
Counting hops from the seed and cutting a branch past a threshold severs an otherwise endless link space.
Forcing every URL onto one domain sends the crawl off target and doesn't address the trap at all.

scenario: 需求后来要求抓取 React/Angular 页面中由 JavaScript 加载出来的正文，而静态 HTML 里没有这些内容。
q: 抓取 JavaScript 动态内容需要引入什么能力？
options: 只增加 SQS 可见性超时
只提高 DNS 查询的 QPS
用 Bloom Filter 代替浏览器渲染
用 headless browser 渲染后再抽取正文
why: 动态内容需要执行 JavaScript 并等待页面渲染，普通 HTTP 抓 HTML 不够。Headless browser 能解决，但成本和复杂度明显更高。
why_en: JavaScript-rendered pages require a headless browser to execute scripts and extract the rendered content.
whenOtherWins: 如果页面正文已经在服务端 HTML 中，普通 fetch 更便宜、更快；动态渲染处理在本题主范围外。
tradeoff: 渲染后抽取覆盖 JS 内容 vs 普通 HTTP 抓取更便宜更快
options_en: Just increase the SQS visibility timeout.
Just raise the DNS query rate limit.
Replace browser rendering with a Bloom filter.
Render with a headless browser like Puppeteer or Playwright, then extract.

termDefinitions.meaning: 没有图形界面、可编程控制的浏览器，能执行 JavaScript 渲染页面。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A headless browser is a scriptable browser without a GUI that can execute JavaScript to render a page.

q_en: What capability is needed to crawl JavaScript-rendered content?
scenario_en: The requirement expands to text loaded by JavaScript in React or Angular pages, and that text is missing from the static HTML.
optionExplanations: 可见性超时只影响队列重试节奏，跟页面里有没有渲染出内容毫无关系。
DNS 查询速度再快，也生成不出脚本才注入的正文内容。
Bloom Filter 只做判重，没有执行脚本或渲染 DOM 的能力。
只有真正跑一遍脚本、等页面加载完，才能拿到这部分动态生成的正文。
optionExplanations_en: Visibility timeout only affects queue retry pacing — unrelated to whether content got rendered.
No matter how fast DNS resolves, it can't produce text that a script injects into the page.
A Bloom filter only checks for duplicates; it can't execute a script or render a DOM.
Only actually running the script and letting the page finish loading surfaces that generated text.

scenario: 有些 URL 指向非常大的文件，系统只想抓取适合文本抽取的页面，避免下载超过 10MB 的对象。
q: 抓取前更合适的优化是什么？
options: 先用 HEAD 探测文件大小
直接 GET 下载完整文件再决定
把整个文件塞进队列消息体
直接关闭所有失败重试机制
why: HEAD 可以用很小的代价读取 Content-Length 等元数据，提前跳过大文件。这样节省带宽和 Worker 时间。
why_en: An HTTP HEAD request can check Content-Length cheaply so oversized files are skipped before downloading the body.
whenOtherWins: 如果服务端不支持 HEAD 或 Content-Length 不可信，可能需要带 Range 的探测或下载后中止策略。
tradeoff: 先探测大小再决定 vs 先下载再判断
